en:
user_stubs.py - your space. The game NEVER overwrites this file.

This module holds type declarations that the in-game editor, the VS Code extension and other editors all read. The game accepts imports from user_stubs as no-ops, so put executable helpers in an in-game Library. Add type aliases, type-only declarations, and re-exported library types here. Import each name explicitly in player scripts. They survive every game update and every "Regenerate Stubs". The generated API stubs are produced by the game; do not edit those directly. Edit this file instead.
zh:
user_stubs.py - 你的空间。游戏绝不会覆盖此文件。

此模块保存游戏内编辑器、VS Code 扩展和其他编辑器都会读取的类型声明。游戏接受从 user_stubs 的导入，并将其视为空操作，因此请将可执行辅助函数放在游戏内库中。在此添加类型别名、仅类型声明和重新导出的库类型。在玩家脚本中显式导入每个名称。它们会在每次游戏更新和每次“重新生成存根”后保留。生成的 API 存根由游戏产生；不要直接编辑它们。请改为编辑此文件。

zh: orders.list_orders() / orders.list_upcoming_orders() / orders.list_weekly_orders() / orders.get_order() / orders.completed_orders() (地球订单)

zh: 冶炼厂、制造机、饲料机、精炼机和燃料装配机上的 `list_recipes()` / `find_recipe()`

zh: PortableBioScanner.scan().scan（在 status == "ok" 之后）/ 日志生物点查询

zh: 没有额外结果字段的游戏命令

任何返回 Site 且 `kind() == "inert"` 的 API

列表字面量 `[1, 2, 3]` · `list(iterable)` · 返回列表的方法
字符串字面量 · `str(value)` · 返回字符串的方法

zh: 字典字面量 `{k: v}` · `dict()` · 返回字典的方法

en: calling a function containing `yield` · generator expressions
zh: 调用包含 `yield` 的函数 · 生成器表达式

en: {description} Fixed result contract: `{resultType}`; branch on `.status` and read `.message`.{payload}
zh: {description} 固定结果合约：`{resultType}`；根据 `.status` 分支并读取 `.message`。{payload}
此组件的程序化标识符。

en: Which kind of component this is, as the stable type id ("bio_lab", "rover", "drone_small"). Every component of the same kind shares it, so a library function can branch on what it was handed. The same token machine-type queries accept, so `outpost.buildings(self.type_id)` lists this machine's siblings. Use `.id` for which individual one this is.
zh: 组件类型 ID，表示这是哪种组件的稳定类型 ID（"bio_lab", "rover", "drone_small"）。同类组件共享该 ID，因此库函数可以根据传入对象进行分支。它与机器类型查询接受的标记相同，因此 `outpost.buildings(self.type_id)` 会列出该机器的同型机器。要区分具体是哪一个，请使用 `.id`。

en: The regular expression pattern string that produced this match.
zh: 生成此匹配的正则表达式模式字符串。

en: Return the matched text for group `index`. Group `0` is the whole match. Optional groups that did not match return `None`; an out-of-range group raises.
zh: 返回组 `index` 的匹配文本。组 `0` 为整个匹配。未匹配的可选组返回 `None`；超出范围的组会引发异常。

en: Return a tuple of captured groups, excluding group `0`. Groups that did not match use `default`, which is `None` if omitted.
zh: 返回捕获组的元组，不包含组 `0`。未匹配的组使用 `default`；若省略则为 `None`。

en: Start character index for the group. Unmatched optional groups return `-1`.
zh: 该组的起始字符索引。未匹配的可选组返回 `-1`。

en: End character index for the group. Unmatched optional groups return `-1`.
zh: 该组的结束字符索引。未匹配的可选组返回 `-1`。

en: Return `(start, end)` for the group. Unmatched optional groups return `(-1, -1)`.
zh: 返回该组的 `(start, end)`。未匹配的可选组返回 `(-1, -1)`。

en: Set target coordinates to drive toward.
zh: 设置要驶向的目标坐标。

en: Current throttle setpoint (**0.0-1.0**). Returns the value the script last wrote via `set_throttle(...)`. Distinct from `get_speed()`: `throttle()` is intent (does not change tick-to-tick); `get_speed()` is what the vehicle actually moved last tick.
zh: 当前油门设定值（**0.0-1.0**）。返回脚本最后一次通过 `set_throttle(...)` 写入的值。与 `get_speed()` 不同：`throttle()` 是意图（不随 tick 变化）；`get_speed()` 是车辆上一 tick 的实际移动。

en: Vehicle position as a `Position` object with `.x` and `.y`.
zh: 车辆位置，作为带有 `.x` 和 `.y` 的 `Position` 对象。

en: Distance (meters) from the vehicle to the given point. Arrival loops need a tolerance, normally `> 2`, rather than exact zero. When the next action targets a building, route to its `BuildingRef.position`.
zh: 车辆到给定点的距离（米）。到达循环需要容差，通常 `> 2`，而不是精确零。当下一个动作以建筑为目标时，路由到其 `BuildingRef.position`。

en: Top-speed multiplier: **1.0** basic, or **1 + mounted Sport Nav count** on Pioneer. Speed only; range still depends on battery, throttle, cargo load, and movement draw.
zh: 最高速度倍率：基础为 **1.0**，或在先锋建造机上为 **1 + 已安装 Sport Nav 数量**。仅影响速度；航程仍取决于电池、油门、载货量和移动耗电。

en: Point-sweep for nearby sites. A completed sweep can find no compatible contacts. Mineral contacts obey sonar range and hardness; thermal, water, oil, and exotic contacts also require matching research. The sweep updates the Journal with newly classified sites. A stale captured module reference raises `ReferenceError`.
zh: 对附近站点进行点扫描。完成一次扫描可能找不到兼容接触。矿物接触受声呐范围和硬度限制；热液、水、石油和奇异接触还需要相应研究。扫描会用新分类站点更新日志。过期的已捕获模块引用会抛出 `ReferenceError`。

en: Reveal the details available for a productive site. An inert `GeologicalAnomaly` is already resolved, so surveying it is free. Re-surveying is also free unless a deeper sonar tier can reveal more. Malformed site values raise `ValueError`; a stale captured module reference raises `ReferenceError`.
zh: 揭示可用生产站点的详细信息。惰性的 `GeologicalAnomaly` 已解析，因此勘测它免费。重新勘测也免费，除非更深层声呐等级能揭示更多信息。格式错误的站点值会抛出 `ValueError`；过期的已捕获模块引用会抛出 `ReferenceError`。

en: Site id string or a `Site` from `scan()`
zh: 站点 ID 字符串，或来自 `scan()` 的 `Site`

en: Sonar range in meters (**50** basic, **180** Wide, **280** Deep). A stale captured module reference raises `ReferenceError`.
zh: 声呐范围，单位为米（基础 **50**，宽频 **180**，深层 **280**）。过期的已捕获模块引用会抛出 `ReferenceError`。

en: Max mineral hardness this sonar can identify (**1** basic, **3** Wide, **4** Deep). A stale captured module reference raises `ReferenceError`.
zh: 此声纳可识别的矿物硬度上限（**1** 基础、**3** 广域、**4** 深域）。过期的已捕获模块引用会引发 `ReferenceError`。

en: Survey-depth tier granted by the mounted sonar: `"basic"` / `"wide"` / `"deep"`. Determines thermal/exotic survey detail; `"deep"` is also required to discover oil wells once **Petroleum Survey** is unlocked. A stale captured module reference raises `ReferenceError`.
zh: 由已安装声纳授予的勘测深度层级：`"basic"` / `"wide"` / `"deep"`。决定热/异质勘测细节；在解锁 **石油勘测** 后，`"deep"` 也是发现油井所必需的。过期的已捕获模块引用会引发 `ReferenceError`。

en: Stable sweep outcome. An empty `.sites` list with `"ok"` is a completed sweep with no contacts requiring player action.
zh: 稳定的扫描结果。空的 `.sites` 列表且状态为 `"ok"` 表示扫描已完成，但没有需要玩家处理的接触目标。

en: Player-readable explanation of the sweep outcome.
zh: 面向玩家的扫描结果说明。

en: Sites resolved by this completed sweep; empty when no compatible site was returned.
zh: 此已完成扫描解析出的地点；当没有返回兼容地点时为空。

en: Contacts the sweep detected but this sonar cannot identify, nearest first, and empty when everything in range was identified. A contact appears here instead of in `.sites`, so the two lists never overlap. Each entry carries `.x`, `.y`, a `.reason` code, and a readable `.message`. This is how a script tells an unreachable contact apart from empty ground: `.status` describes the sweep itself and stays `"ok"` whenever any site was identified.
zh: 本次扫描检测到但当前声呐无法识别的接触点，按距离由近到远排列；如果范围内的所有目标都已识别，则此列表为空。接触点会出现在这里而不是 `.sites` 中，因此两个列表不会重叠。每个条目包含 `.x`、`.y`、一个 `.reason` 代码，以及可读的 `.message`。脚本借此区分无法抵达的接触点和空地面：`.status` 描述扫描本身，只要识别出任何站点就保持 `"ok"`。

en: Whole-number X coordinate (meters from base) of the unidentified contact, matching the `"?"` marker on the map.
zh: 未识别接触点的整数 X 坐标（距基地的米数），与地图上的 `"?"` 标记对应。

en: Whole-number Y coordinate (meters from base) of the unidentified contact.
zh: 未识别接触点的整数 Y 坐标（距基地的米数）。

en: Why this sonar could not identify the contact. `"wrong_scanner"` needs a different instrument entirely, such as a drone bio-scan for a biomass contact. `"too_hard"` exceeds the mounted sonar's hardness limit, `"tier_too_low"` needs a higher sonar tier, and `"research_required"` needs a classification technology that is not unlocked.
zh: 当前声呐无法识别该接触点的原因。`"wrong_scanner"` 表示需要完全不同的仪器，例如对生物质接触点使用无人机生物扫描。`"too_hard"` 表示超出所装声呐的硬度限制，`"tier_too_low"` 表示需要更高等级的声呐，`"research_required"` 表示需要尚未解锁的分类技术。

en: Readable explanation of `.reason`, suitable for printing straight to the console.
zh: 对 `.reason` 的可读说明，适合直接打印到控制台。

en: Player-readable, exact explanation of the survey outcome.
zh: 面向玩家、准确的勘测结果说明。

en: Surveyed concrete `Site`, or `None` when the survey was rejected.
zh: 被勘测的具体 `Site`，或勘测被拒绝时为 `None`。

en: `"ok"`, `"empty"`, `"inventory_full"`, or `"invalid_slot"`, narrowed further by the command that returned it.
zh: `"ok"`、`"empty"`、`"inventory_full"` 或 `"invalid_slot"`，并根据返回它的命令进一步限定。

en: Player-readable explanation of the item operation.
zh: 面向玩家的物品操作说明。

en: Stable id of the item moved or destroyed, or `None` when no item changed.
zh: 被移动或销毁物品的稳定 ID；若没有物品发生变化，则为 `None`。

en: Always `"ok"` after the waste chamber is dumped.
zh: 在废料腔排放完成后始终为 `"ok"`。

en: Player-readable explanation of the dump and its resulting efficiency penalty.
zh: 面向玩家的排放说明，包括由此产生的效率惩罚。

en: Efficiency penalty applied by this dump, in the **0-1** range.
zh: 本次排放施加的效率惩罚，范围为 **0-1**。

en: `"ok"` when one queued message was consumed, or `"invalid_channel"` when any listed channel id is invalid. Valid empty queues keep waiting.
zh: 当消耗了一条排队消息时为 `"ok"`；当任一列出的频道 ID 无效时为 `"invalid_channel"`。有效的空队列会保持等待。

en: Player-readable explanation of the wait outcome.
zh: 等待结果的玩家可读说明。

en: The channel the consumed message came from when `status == "ok"`; otherwise `None`.
zh: 当 `status == "ok"` 时，已消费消息来自的频道；否则为 `None`。

en: The consumed `CommsMessage` when `status == "ok"`; otherwise `None`. Its id, sender, tick, and copied value belong to the selected channel.
zh: 当 `status == "ok"` 时，已消费的 `CommsMessage`；否则为 `None`。其 id、sender、tick 和 copied value 属于所选频道。

en: `"ok"` when a new broadcast was captured, or `"invalid_channel"` for an invalid channel id. A valid channel keeps waiting until a new broadcast arrives.
zh: 捕获到新广播时为 `"ok"`，频道 id 无效时为 `"invalid_channel"`。有效频道会持续等待，直到新的广播到达。

en: Player-readable explanation of the broadcast wait outcome.
zh: 广播等待结果的玩家可读说明。

en: The captured `BroadcastInfo` when `status == "ok"`; otherwise `None`. It contains the publication's copied value, sender, and age when the script resumes.
zh: 当 `status == "ok"` 时，捕获到的 `BroadcastInfo`；否则为 `None`。它包含脚本恢复时该发布项的 copied value、sender 和 age。

en: `"ok"` when a queued message was consumed; `"empty"` when no id was requested and the queue was empty; `"not_found"` when the requested id was absent; or `"invalid_channel"` for an invalid channel id.
zh: 已消费队列消息时为 `"ok"`；未请求 id 且队列为空时为 `"empty"`；请求的 id 不存在时为 `"not_found"`；频道 id 无效时为 `"invalid_channel"`。

en: Send outcome. `"ok"` means a message was queued; every other outcome means no message was sent.
zh: 发送结果。`"ok"` 表示消息已入队；其他任何结果均表示未发送消息。

en: Player-readable explanation of the send outcome.
zh: 发送结果的玩家可读说明。

en: The queued message's positive integer id when `status == "ok"`, or `None` when no message was sent. Matches `.id` in `pending()` and `receive().packet`. Use it with `receive()`, `cancel()`, or `update()` to target that exact request.
zh: 当 `status == "ok"` 时，队列消息的正整数 id；未发送消息时为 `None`。与 `pending()` 和 `receive().packet` 中的 `.id` 匹配。可与 `receive()`、`cancel()` 或 `update()` 配合使用，以定位该确切请求。

en: Player-readable explanation of the receive outcome.
zh: 接收结果的玩家可读说明。

en: The consumed `CommsMessage` when `status == "ok"`, otherwise `None`. When a message id was requested, this packet has that exact id.
zh: 当 `status == "ok"` 时，已消费的 `CommsMessage`；否则为 `None`。当请求了消息 id 时，该 packet 具有完全相同的 id。

en: Stable planning outcome. Branch on this field before reading `.blueprint_ids`.
zh: 稳定的规划结果。读取 `.blueprint_ids` 前请基于此字段进行分支。

en: Player-readable explanation of the exact planning outcome.
zh: 确切规划结果的玩家可读说明。

en: Newly created blueprint ids. Empty for every outcome except `"ok"`.
zh: 新创建的蓝图 id。除 `"ok"` 外的所有结果均为空。
在静止状态下钻探一个单位。

en: Max mineral hardness this drill can extract (**1** basic, **3** Industrial, **4** Heavy). A stale captured module reference raises `ReferenceError`.
zh: 该钻头可开采的矿物最大硬度（**1** 基础、**3** 工业、**4** 重型）。引用过期的已捕获模块会引发 `ReferenceError`。

en: Drill-time multiplier (**1.0** basic, **0.75** Industrial, **0.6** Heavy: lower is faster). A stale captured module reference raises `ReferenceError`.
zh: 钻探时间倍率（**1.0** 基础、**0.75** 工业、**0.6** 重型：数值越低越快）。引用过期的已捕获模块会引发 `ReferenceError`。

en: Yielding scan at the hovering drone's current whole-number coordinate. A valid non-site coordinate completes with an empty biological scan. Repeat scans are free.
zh: 在悬停无人机当前整数坐标处执行可让出的扫描。有效的非地点坐标会以空生物扫描完成。重复扫描免费。

en: Yielding harvest at the discovered permanent biosite under a hovering drone. The drone stays occupied until completion, including across a script stop and restart. The module has a 25 t chamber for one life-form type; Cargo Pods add capacity. Partial depletion persists and cooldown starts only when the site is empty.
zh: 在悬停无人机下方已发现的永久生物地点处执行可让出的采集。无人机保持占用直至完成，包括脚本停止并重启后。该模块有一个 25 吨的舱室，仅容纳一种生命形式类型；货运舱可增加容量。部分耗尽状态会保留，且冷却仅在地点清空时开始。

en: Player-readable explanation of the biological scan outcome.
zh: 面向玩家的生物扫描结果说明。

en: Completed `LifeFormScanResult`, or `None` when the scan was rejected.
zh: 完成的 `LifeFormScanResult`，若扫描被拒绝则为 `None`。

en: Player-readable explanation of the biological extraction outcome.
zh: 面向玩家的生物提取结果说明。

en: Tons committed to drone cargo by this extraction; **0** for every rejection.
zh: 本次提取已计入无人机货舱的吨数；每次被拒绝均为 **0**。
生命形式物品 id（例如 `"ice_algae"`、`"snow_moss"`）。

en: Tons of this life-form available at the tile at scan time (peak value, not current state).
zh: 扫描时该地块上此生命形式的可用吨数（峰值，非当前状态）。

en: Tons currently available. Partial drone harvests reduce this; it returns to `.tons` after the coordinate's cooldown.
zh: 当前可用吨数。无人机部分采集会减少此值；坐标冷却结束后恢复至 `.tons`。

en: Rarity tier: `"common"`, `"uncommon"`, or `"rare"`. Determines both essence produced per ton at the Essence Liquifier and the cooldown after extraction.
zh: 稀有度层级：`"common"`、`"uncommon"` 或 `"rare"`。决定精华液化器每吨产出的精华量以及提取后的冷却时间。

en: Native biome this species belongs to: `"frozen"`, `"coastal"`, `"geothermal"`, `"volcanic"`, or `"deep"`. Fixed per species (never the terrain it grows on), and exactly the biome whose Essence Liquifier consumes it. Same value as `nocturna.life_form_biome(sample.type)`.
zh: 该物种所属的原生生物群系：`"frozen"`、`"coastal"`、`"geothermal"`、`"volcanic"` 或 `"deep"`。按物种固定（不是其生长地形），并且恰好是精华液化器消耗它的生物群系。与 `nocturna.life_form_biome(sample.type)` 的值相同。

en: `[x, y]` whole-number coordinate of the scanned location.
zh: 被扫描位置的 `[x, y]` 整数坐标。

en: List of `LifeFormSample` entries: 0-3 items per tile. Empty list means "scanned, nothing here."
zh: `LifeFormSample` 条目列表：每格 0-3 项。空列表表示“已扫描，这里没有东西”。

en: `True` if no life forms found at this tile.
zh: 若此格未发现生命形式，则为 `True`。

en: Sector id, e.g. `"E13"` (row letter A-H + column 1-24). Parse it to compute the four orthogonal neighbors yourself: the grid hands you no `neighbors()` helper.
zh: 扇区 id，例如 `"E13"`（行字母 A-H + 列 1-24）。你需要自行解析它来计算四个正交邻居：网格不会提供 `neighbors()` 辅助函数。

en: Species id of the planted flora, such as `"sunpetal"`, or `None` when the cell has no plant. This is the species id, not the `"seed_sunpetal"` item id. An empty cell may still contain a provider or uncollected item, so also check `.status`. It matches `SeedRecipe.species` and the species part of `"seed:<species>"`.
zh: 已种植植物的物种 id，例如 `"sunpetal"`，若该格没有植物则为 `None`。这是物种 id，不是 `"seed_sunpetal"` 物品 id。空格仍可能包含供应器或未收集物品，因此也要检查 `.status`。它与 `SeedRecipe.species` 以及 `"seed:<species>"` 中的物种部分匹配。

en: Crop growth progress **0-1**. **1.0** means ready to harvest. Advances only while every requirement is met and pauses (never regresses) otherwise. Clearing the crop returns it to **0**; a partial Harvester harvest leaves the crop mature at **1.0** with its remaining forage.
zh: 作物生长进度 **0-1**。**1.0** 表示可收获。只有在满足所有要求时才会推进，否则暂停（不会倒退）。清除作物会使其回到 **0**；采集车的部分收获会使作物保持在成熟状态 **1.0**，并留下剩余草料。

en: What occupies the sector or what its crop is doing: `"unknown"` until natural ground is scanned, `"empty"` (bare plantable ground), `"item"` (an uncollected surface item), `"base"` (the Harvester depot), `"provider"` (field equipment), `"growing"`, `"stalled"`, or `"mature"`. Player-created plants and providers remain visible. Only `"empty"` accepts planting or deployment.
zh: 占用该扇区的对象或其作物的状态：在扫描自然地面之前为 `"unknown"`，`"empty"`（裸露的可种植地面），`"item"`（未收集的地面物品），`"base"`（采集车仓库），`"provider"`（野外设备），`"growing"`、`"stalled"` 或 `"mature"`。玩家创建的植物和供应器仍可见。只有 `"empty"` 接受种植或部署。

en: `True` while the cell has an active 24-hour Harvester light treatment or a powered Grow Lamp covers it. Satisfies the **Light** requirement; **Shade** plants need this `False`.
zh: 当该格具有有效的 24 小时采集车光照处理，或被通电的生长灯覆盖时为 `True`。满足 **Light** 要求；**Shade** 植物需要此项为 `False`。

en: `True` while the cell has an active 24-hour Harvester water treatment, or while a powered, supplied Sprinkler covers it. Satisfies the **Water** requirement. A plant pauses when neither source is active.
zh: 当该格具有有效的 24 小时采集车浇水处理，或被通电且有补给的洒水器覆盖时为 `True`。满足 **Water** 要求。当两种来源均未生效时，植物会暂停。

en: `True` while the cell has an active 24-hour Harvester salt treatment, or while a powered, supplied Dispenser covers it. Satisfies the **Salt** requirement. A plant pauses when neither source is active.
zh: 当该格具有有效的 24 小时采集车撒盐处理，或被通电且有补给的分配器覆盖时为 `True`。满足 **Salt** 要求。当两种来源均未生效时，植物会暂停。

en: Hours remaining on the Harvester-applied light treatment, in the **0-24** range. This excludes Grow Lamp coverage. Each successful `light()` resets it to **24 hours**, replacing any remaining time.
zh: 采集车施加的光照处理剩余小时数，范围为 **0-24**。不包括生长灯覆盖。每次成功调用 `light()` 会将其重置为 **24 小时**，替换任何剩余时间。

en: Hours remaining on the Harvester-applied water treatment, in the **0-24** range. This excludes Sprinkler coverage. Each successful `water()` resets it to **24 hours**, replacing any remaining time.
zh: 采集车施加的浇水处理剩余小时数，范围为 **0-24**。不包括洒水器覆盖。每次成功调用 `water()` 会将其重置为 **24 小时**，替换任何剩余时间。

en: Hours remaining on the Harvester-applied salt treatment, in the **0-24** range. This excludes Dispenser coverage. Each successful `dispense_salt()` resets it to **24 hours**, replacing any remaining time.
zh: 采集车施加的撒盐处理剩余小时数，范围为 **0-24**。不包括分配器覆盖。每次成功调用 `dispense_salt()` 会将其重置为 **24 小时**，替换任何剩余时间。

en: `True` while any Fertilizer dose remains on this cell. `False` when undosed or fully drained.
zh: 当该格仍残留任何肥料剂量时为 `True`。未施用或完全耗尽时为 `False`。

en: Hours of Fertilizer effect remaining. Each applied unit adds **8 hours**; reads **0** when none remains.
zh: 剩余肥料效果小时数。每施加一个单位增加 **8 小时**；没有剩余时读取为 **0**。

en: Active Fertilizer tier: **1**, **2**, or **3**. Reads **0** when no Fertilizer remains.
zh: 当前肥料等级：**1**、**2** 或 **3**。没有肥料剩余时读取为 **0**。

en: `True` while any Growth Accelerant dose remains on this cell. `False` when undosed or fully drained.
zh: 当该格仍有任何生长加速剂剂量时读取为 `True`；未施加或完全耗尽时读取为 `False`。

en: Hours of Growth Accelerant effect remaining. Each applied unit adds **8 hours**; reads **0** when none remains.
zh: 剩余生长加速剂效果小时数。每施加一个单位增加 **8 小时**；没有剩余时读取为 **0**。

en: Whole **forage** banked by this crop. It rises with visible growth while requirements are met, includes diversity and field bonuses, and freezes at `growth == 1.0`. The Harvester moves as much as Inventory can hold and leaves any remainder on the crop. A Crop Automator moves what fits in its output, discards the remainder, and clears the cell; a completely full output blocks the job without changing the crop. Forage feeds Wildlife production and Plant Terraformer batches.
zh: 该作物累积的整份**草料**。满足要求时，它会随可见生长而增加，包含多样性与田块加成，并在 `growth == 1.0` 时冻结。采集车会搬运库存可容纳的量，并将剩余量留在作物上。作物自动机会搬运其输出可容纳的量，丢弃剩余量，并清空该格；输出完全满时会阻塞作业，且不会改变作物。草料用于野生动物生产与植物地球化器批次。

en: Cultivation condition: `"light"`, `"shade"`, `"water"`, `"salt"`, `"spacer"`, `"cluster"`, `"companion"`, or `"antagonist"`. Every entry in `SeedRecipe.requirements` is required; combined species expose multiple entries.
zh: 栽培条件：`"light"`、`"shade"`、`"water"`、`"salt"`、`"spacer"`、`"cluster"`、`"companion"` 或 `"antagonist"`。`SeedRecipe.requirements` 中的每个条目都必须满足；组合物种会暴露多个条目。

en: Related species key for relational conditions: the required neighbor for `"companion"`, or the forbidden neighbor for `"antagonist"`. `None` for all other kinds.
zh: 关系条件的相关物种键：`"companion"` 所需的相邻格物种，或 `"antagonist"` 禁止的相邻格物种。其他类型均为 `None`。

en: Production tier for this discovered Seed Maker recipe. Seed recipes are Tier 1 because their inputs are harvested source materials.
zh: 该已发现种子制造机配方的生产等级。种子配方为 1 级，因为其输入是已采集的原材料。

en: Bare flora species id this recipe produces, such as `"sunpetal"`. It matches `Cell.plant` and identifies the biological species, not the physical seed item used by planting commands.
zh: 此配方生产的纯植物物种 ID，例如 `"sunpetal"`。它与 `Cell.plant` 匹配，标识生物物种，而不是种植命令使用的物理种子物品。

en: Physical seed item id produced by this recipe, such as `"seed_sunpetal"`. Pass this value to the Harvester's `load_seed()` and `plant()`, or to a Crop Automator's `plant()` after loading the same item into its input.
zh: 此配方生产的物理种子物品 ID，例如 `"seed_sunpetal"`。将该值传给采集车的 `load_seed()` 与 `plant()`，或在将同一物品载入其输入后传给作物自动机的 `plant()`。

en: The exact list of 3 life-form ids that yields this seed (e.g. `["ice_algae", "sea_algae", "vent_moss"]`). Order doesn't matter: combine these three again to reproduce the seed.
zh: 生成该种子的确切 3 个生命形态 ID 列表（例如 `["ice_algae", "sea_algae", "vent_moss"]`）。顺序无关紧要：再次组合这三个即可复现该种子。

en: Lists every cultivation condition as a `PlantRequirement`. Each entry has a `.kind` and optional `.species`, identifying required companions or forbidden antagonists. Every listed requirement must be satisfied for growth to advance.
zh: 以 `PlantRequirement` 列出每项栽培条件。每个条目都有 `.kind` 和可选的 `.species`，用于标识所需同伴或禁止拮抗。必须满足所有列出的要求，生长才会推进。

en: Compact summary of the requirement kinds, e.g. `"light"`, `"light+water"`, or `"salt+companion"`. Use `.requirements` for programmable layout decisions because this summary intentionally omits the companion/antagonist species identity.
zh: 要求类型的紧凑摘要，例如 `"light"`、`"light+water"` 或 `"salt+companion"`。可编程的布局决策请使用 `.requirements`，因为此摘要有意省略同伴/拮抗物种身份。

en: Hours of met-requirement time to reach maturity (`growth == 1.0`). Longer-growing species are the harder, higher-value ones; growth only advances while all requirements hold.
zh: 达到成熟（`growth == 1.0`）所需满足要求的小时数。生长时间较长的物种更难、价值更高；只有所有要求持续满足时，生长才会推进。

en: Whole forage units this species yields before diversity, treatment, and field bonuses. Compare this with `.growth_time` and `.requirements` when choosing a crop.
zh: 该物种在多样性、处理与田块加成之前产出的整份草料单位。选择作物时，请将其与 `.growth_time` 和 `.requirements` 比较。

en: Execute a Plan Mode construction or deconstruction blueprint. Drive the Pioneer within interaction range of `blueprint.position`, then pass a blueprint id from `get_component("construction_blueprint").pending_constructions()`, `.active_constructions()`, or `.paused_constructions()`. Yielding. One Pioneer performs one field action at a time. Stop, power loss, leaving the site, rescue, or removing the Constructor Module pauses paid work without losing progress or materials. The owning Pioneer can rejoin active work, including after save/load; another Pioneer cannot steal an owned job.
zh: 执行规划模式下的建造或拆除蓝图。将先锋建造机移动到 `blueprint.position` 的交互范围内，然后传入来自 `get_component("construction_blueprint").pending_constructions()`、`.active_constructions()` 或 `.paused_constructions()` 的蓝图 ID。会挂起。一台先锋建造机一次只执行一项现场动作。停止、断电、离开工地、救援或移除建造模块会暂停已付费的工作，但不会丢失进度或材料。拥有该任务的先锋建造机可以重新加入当前工作，包括存档/读档后；其他先锋建造机不能抢占已归属的任务。

en: Pending, active, or paused blueprint id from the construction_blueprint queue.
zh: 来自 construction_blueprint 队列的待处理、进行中或已暂停蓝图 ID。

en: Immutable instance id (e.g. `"outpost_home"`, `"outpost_1"`). Stable for the life of the save: use this in scripts that need to outlive renames.
zh: 不可变实例 ID（例如 `"outpost_home"`、`"outpost_1"`）。在存档存续期间保持稳定：在需要跨越重命名长期使用的脚本中使用它。

en: Display name. Defaults to `"Nocturna Base"` for the home outpost or a generated `"Outpost N"` name for founded outposts; freely renameable from the Computer System tab. Mutable: prefer `id` when persistence matters.
zh: 显示名称。主前哨站默认为 `"Nocturna Base"`，新建前哨站默认为生成的 `"Outpost N"` 名称；可在“计算机系统”标签页自由重命名。可变：需要持久引用时优先使用 `id`。

en: World coordinates of the outpost anchor as `[x, y]`. Home outpost sits at `[0, 0]`; founded outposts carry the position chosen in Plan mode.
zh: 前哨站锚点的世界坐标，格式为 `[x, y]`。主前哨站位于 `[0, 0]`；新建前哨站采用在规划模式中选择的位置。

en: Number of buildings deployed at this outpost. Sensors, mobile units, structural hubs, and POI extraction don't count.
zh: 此前哨站已部署的建筑数量。传感器、移动单元、结构枢纽和兴趣点提取不计入。

en: Soft building threshold at this outpost. Each counted building above it reduces productive and service throughput. Nocturna Base has a few extra starter slots; founded outposts use the standard threshold.
zh: 此前哨站的软性建筑阈值。超过阈值的每栋计入建筑都会降低生产和服务吞吐量。诺克图纳星基地有几个额外起始槽位；新建前哨站使用标准阈值。

en: Returns `True` when this outpost has reached or exceeded its soft building threshold. The threshold itself does not block ordinary deployment.
zh: 当前哨站达到或超过其软性建筑阈值时返回 `True`。该阈值本身不会阻止普通部署。

en: Returns `True` when this is the home outpost (default name `"Nocturna Base"`).
zh: 当这是主前哨站（默认名称 `"Nocturna Base"`）时返回 `True`。

en: Fresh list of `BuildingRef` snapshots: one entry per building deployed here. Pass a `type_id` (e.g. `"storage_bin"`) to filter, or omit for every building. Each ref carries `.id` / `.name` / `.type_id` / `.outpost` / `.powered` / `.position`: for type-specific live reads (`count()`, `material()`, `recipe`, etc.) call `get_component(ref.id)` to reach the full component API.
zh: 最新 `BuildingRef` 快照列表：此处每栋已部署建筑对应一个条目。传入 `type_id`（例如 `"storage_bin"`）进行筛选，或省略以返回所有建筑。每个引用都带有 `.id` / `.name` / `.type_id` / `.outpost` / `.powered` / `.position`：若需进行类型特定的实时读取（`count()`、`material()`、`recipe` 等），请调用 `get_component(ref.id)` 以访问完整组件 API。

en: Optional. Machine type id to filter by (e.g. "storage_bin"). Omit to return every building at this outpost.
zh: 可选。用于筛选的机器类型 ID（例如 "storage_bin"）。省略时返回此前哨站的所有建筑。

en: Fresh list of `HarvestingMachineRef` snapshots for fixed machines deployed on this outpost's Harvesting field. Currently only the home outpost, Nocturna Base, has that field, so founded outposts return an empty list. Includes Grow Lamps, Sprinklers, Dispensers, and Crop Automators, which occupy field cells but do not use building capacity or appear in `buildings()`. It does not include the mobile Harvester, crops, loose items, Water Wells, or other POI extractors. Pass a `type_id` to filter, or omit it for all four fixed machine types. Use `get_component(ref.id)` for type-specific live reads.
zh: 此前哨站“采集”田地上已部署固定机器的最新 `HarvestingMachineRef` 快照列表。目前只有主前哨站诺克图纳星基地拥有该田地，因此新建前哨站会返回空列表。包括生长灯、洒水器、分配器和作物自动化机，它们占据田地格位，但不占用建筑容量，也不会出现在 `buildings()` 中。不包括移动采集车、作物、散落的物品、水井或其他兴趣点提取器。传入 `type_id` 进行筛选，或省略以返回全部四种固定机器类型。类型特定的实时读取请使用 `get_component(ref.id)`。

en: Optional fixed Harvesting-field machine type id: `"grow_lamp"`, `"sprinkler"`, `"dispenser"`, or `"crop_automator"`. Omit it to return every fixed machine deployed on the field.
zh: 可选的“采集”田地固定机器类型 ID：`"grow_lamp"`、`"sprinkler"`、`"dispenser"` 或 `"crop_automator"`。省略时返回该田地上部署的所有固定机器。

en: All owned outposts as read-only `OutpostRef` snapshots, including home. Use `.id` when passing an outpost to another API; call `outposts()` again when you need fresh counts/names.
zh: 所有拥有的前哨站，作为只读 `OutpostRef` 快照返回，包含主前哨站。将前哨站传递给其他 API 时使用 `.id`；需要最新数量/名称时再次调用 `outposts()`。

en: The home outpost as an `OutpostRef` snapshot.
Nearest owned outpost to the given world coordinate as an `OutpostRef` snapshot.
zh: 以 `OutpostRef` 快照形式返回给定世界坐标最近的已拥有前哨站。

en: Immutable outpost id, e.g. `"outpost_home"` or `"outpost_1"`. Use it with `get_component(id)` or APIs that need a stable target.
zh: 不可变前哨站 ID，例如 `"outpost_home"` 或 `"outpost_1"`。将其用于 `get_component(id)` 或需要稳定目标的 API。

en: Display name at the time this ref was returned.
zh: 此引用返回时的显示名称。

en: World X coordinate of the outpost footprint's top-left anchor, in meters from base. For an at-building action, route to that building's `BuildingRef.position` instead.
zh: 前哨站占地左上锚点的世界 X 坐标，单位为距基地的米数。对于针对建筑的操作，请改为指向该建筑的 `BuildingRef.position`。

en: World Y coordinate of the outpost footprint's top-left anchor, in meters from base. For an at-building action, route to that building's `BuildingRef.position` instead.
zh: 前哨站占地左上锚点的世界 Y 坐标，单位为距基地的米数。对于针对建筑的操作，请改为指向该建筑的 `BuildingRef.position`。

en: Top-left anchor of the outpost footprint as a `Position` snapshot. This identifies the outpost, not a particular building's docking point.
zh: 以 `Position` 快照表示的前哨站占地左上锚点。它标识前哨站，而非特定建筑的对接点。

en: Top-left anchor of the outpost footprint as `[x, y]`. Use `buildings()` and `BuildingRef.position` when routing to a particular service building.
zh: 以 `[x, y]` 表示的前哨站占地左上锚点。若需导航至特定服务建筑，请使用 `buildings()` 和 `BuildingRef.position`。

en: Biome this outpost sits in: one of `"frozen"`, `"coastal"`, `"geothermal"`, `"volcanic"`, `"deep"`. Derived from the outpost's location. A building reaches its own biome via `self.outpost.biome`.
zh: 该前哨站所在生物群系：`"frozen"`、`"coastal"`、`"geothermal"`、`"volcanic"`、`"deep"` 之一。由前哨站位置推导。建筑可通过 `self.outpost.biome` 获取自身生物群系。

en: Buildings deployed at this outpost when this ref was returned.
zh: 此引用返回时，部署在该前哨站的建筑。

en: Soft building threshold at this outpost when this ref was returned. Buildings above it reduce productive and service throughput.
zh: 此引用返回时，该前哨站的软性建筑阈值。超过该阈值的建筑会降低生产与服务吞吐量。

en: `True` when this outpost had reached or exceeded its soft building threshold at the time this ref was returned. The threshold itself does not block ordinary deployment.
zh: 当此引用返回时，该前哨站已达到或超过其软性建筑阈值时为 `True`。该阈值本身不会阻止普通部署。

en: Fresh list of `BuildingRef` snapshots: one entry per building deployed here. Pass a `type_id` (e.g. `"storage_bin"`) to filter, or omit for every building. Each ref carries `.id` / `.name` / `.type_id` / `.outpost` / `.powered` / `.position`: for type-specific live reads (`count()`, `material()`, `recipe`, etc.) call `get_component(ref.id)` to reach the full component API.
zh: 最新 `BuildingRef` 快照列表：每个部署在此的建筑对应一项。传入 `type_id`（例如 `"storage_bin"`）以筛选，或省略以返回所有建筑。每个引用都包含 `.id` / `.name` / `.type_id` / `.outpost` / `.powered` / `.position`：若要进行特定类型的实时读取（`count()`、`material()`、`recipe` 等），请调用 `get_component(ref.id)` 以访问完整组件 API。

en: Optional. Machine type id to filter by (e.g. "storage_bin"). Omit to return every building at this outpost.
zh: 可选。用于筛选的机器类型 id（例如 "storage_bin"）。省略则返回该前哨站的所有建筑。

en: Fresh list of `HarvestingMachineRef` snapshots for fixed machines deployed on this outpost's Harvesting field. Currently only the home outpost, Nocturna Base, has that field, so founded outposts return an empty list. Includes Grow Lamps, Sprinklers, Dispensers, and Crop Automators, which occupy field cells but do not use building capacity or appear in `buildings()`. It does not include the mobile Harvester, crops, loose items, Water Wells, or other POI extractors. Pass a `type_id` to filter, or omit it for all four fixed machine types. Use `get_component(ref.id)` for type-specific live reads.
zh: 部署在该前哨站采集场上的固定机器的最新 `HarvestingMachineRef` 快照列表。目前只有主前哨站诺克图纳基地拥有该采集场，因此已建立的前哨站会返回空列表。包括生长灯、洒水器、分配器和作物自动化机，它们占据采集场地块，但不占用建筑容量，也不会出现在 `buildings()` 中。不包括移动采集车、作物、散落物品、水井或其他 POI 提取器。传入 `type_id` 进行筛选，或省略以返回全部四种固定机器类型。使用 `get_component(ref.id)` 获取类型专属的实时读取。

en: Optional fixed Harvesting-field machine type id: `"grow_lamp"`, `"sprinkler"`, `"dispenser"`, or `"crop_automator"`. Omit it to return every fixed machine deployed on the field.
zh: 可选的固定采集场机器类型 id：`"grow_lamp"`、`"sprinkler"`、`"dispenser"` 或 `"crop_automator"`。省略则返回部署在该采集场上的所有固定机器。

en: Stable component id. Use with `get_component(id)` to reach the full machine API (counts, recipes, materials, etc.).
zh: 稳定组件 id。配合 `get_component(id)` 使用，以访问完整机器 API（数量、配方、材料等）。

en: Display name when this ref was returned (e.g. `"Iron Ore Bin"`). For fresh names or live machine state, call `get_component(id)`.
zh: 此引用返回时显示的机器名称（例如 `"Iron Ore Bin"`）。如需最新名称或实时机器状态，请调用 `get_component(id)`。

en: Machine type id, e.g. `"storage_bin"`, `"smelter"`, `"solar_generator"`. Stable forever; use this for branching logic.
zh: 机器类型 id，例如 `"storage_bin"`、`"smelter"`、`"solar_generator"`。永久稳定；可用于分支逻辑。

en: Id of the outpost this building is deployed at.
zh: 该建筑部署所在前哨站的 id。

en: Snapshot back-reference to the owning outpost as an `OutpostRef` (or `None` if the link can't be resolved).
zh: 指向所属前哨站的快照反向引用，类型为 `OutpostRef`（若无法解析链接则为 `None`）。

en: `True` when the building's power toggle was on as this ref was returned. For live power/production reads, call `get_component(id)`.
zh: 当此引用返回时，若该建筑的电源开关处于开启状态，则为 `True`。如需实时电力/生产读取，请调用 `get_component(id)`。

en: World coordinates as `[x, y]`. For most buildings this is the deploy anchor; doesn't move.
zh: 世界坐标，格式为 `[x, y]`。对大多数建筑而言，这是部署锚点；不会移动。

en: Stable component id. Use with `get_component(id)` to reach the full Grow Lamp, Sprinkler, Dispenser, or Crop Automator API.
zh: 稳定组件 id。配合 `get_component(id)` 使用，以访问完整的生长灯、洒水器、分配器或作物自动化机 API。

en: Display name when this ref was returned. Call `get_component(id)` for current machine state.
zh: 此引用返回时显示的机器名称。调用 `get_component(id)` 获取当前机器状态。

en: Fixed Harvesting-field machine type id: `"grow_lamp"`, `"sprinkler"`, `"dispenser"`, or `"crop_automator"`.
zh: 固定采集场机器类型 id：`"grow_lamp"`、`"sprinkler"`、`"dispenser"` 或 `"crop_automator"`。

en: `True` when the machine's power toggle was on as this ref was returned. Call `get_component(id)` for live status and supply reads.
zh: 当此引用返回时，若该机器的电源开关处于开启状态，则为 `True`。调用 `get_component(id)` 获取实时状态与供应读取。

en: Harvesting-field sector occupied by the fixed machine, such as `"B22"`.
zh: 固定机器所占用的采集场扇区，例如 `"B22"`。

en: Current charge in Wh (across all batteries).
zh: 当前电量（Wh，所有电池合计）。

en: List of every Battery Holder currently mounted on the vehicle. Empty for the Rover (sealed battery).
zh: 当前安装在车辆上的所有电池座列表。漫游车为空（密封电池）。
便携电池物品 ID：`"portable_battery"` 或 `"heavy_portable_battery"`。

en: Rated Wh across every battery in this holder.
zh: 该电池座内所有电池的额定 Wh。

en: Current Wh in this holder (pool level × rated capacity).
zh: 该电池座当前 Wh（池电量水平 × 额定容量）。

en: List indexed by internal slot: each entry is a `PortableBattery` object, or `None` for an empty slot.
zh: 按内部槽位索引的列表：每项为 `PortableBattery` 对象，空槽为 `None`。

en: Total units currently carried by the vehicle.
zh: 车辆当前承载的总单位数。

en: Total units the vehicle can carry in its integrated hold or installed Cargo Racks.
zh: 车辆可在其集成货舱或已安装的货物架中承载的总单位数。

en: Snapshot of every property-distinct `ItemStack` in the vehicle's cargo. Use this to distinguish variants that share an item id.
zh: 车辆货舱中每个属性不同的 `ItemStack` 快照。用于区分共享同一物品 id 的变体。

en: `True` when the integrated hold or every installed cargo bin is full. A Pioneer without installed bins is also full.
zh: 当集成货舱或所有已安装货箱均满载时为 `True`。未安装货箱的先锋建造机也视为满载。

en: List of every Cargo Rack currently mounted. Empty for the Rover.
zh: 当前已安装的所有货舱架列表。漫游车为空。

en: On a Pioneer, consolidate equal item ids into the fewest installed Portable Bins that can hold them. Property-distinct variants remain intact, and the planner preserves the fullest compatible bins to minimize physical movement. Requires **Auto Feeders**, waits for time proportional to the units repositioned, and holds the Pioneer stationary as a material endpoint during that cycle. This does not change which bin `send()` drains first.
zh: 在先锋建造机上，将相同物品 id 的物品合并到可容纳它们的最少已安装便携货箱中。属性不同的变体保持不变，且规划器会保留最满的兼容货箱，以尽量减少物理移动。需要 **自动供料器**，等待时间与重新定位的单位数量成正比，并在该周期内将先锋建造机作为物料端点保持静止。这不会改变 `send()` 首先排空哪个货箱。

en: Permanently jettison everything in the whole-number, zero-based `rack_index`. On a Rover, which has no racks, `self.cargo.discard(0)` addresses the integrated hold. An already-empty hold or rack finishes immediately; destroying cargo takes **1 hour** and pauses the script. This is the vehicle cargo destruction API.
zh: 永久抛弃由整数、从零开始的 `rack_index` 指定货舱架中的所有内容。对于没有货舱架的漫游车，`self.cargo.discard(0)` 指向集成货舱。已经为空的货舱或货舱架会立即完成；销毁货物需要 **1 小时** 并暂停脚本。这是车辆货物销毁 API。

en: Whole-number zero-based index among mounted Cargo Racks (0 = the integrated hold on a Rover)
zh: 已安装货舱架中的整数从零开始索引（0 = 漫游车上的集成货舱）

en: List indexed by internal slot: each entry is a `Bin` object, or `None` for an empty slot.
zh: 按内部槽位索引的列表：每个条目是一个 `Bin` 对象，空槽位为 `None`。
便携货箱物品 id：`"portable_bin"` 或 `"heavy_portable_bin"`。

en: Assigned item id (mineral, ingot, component: anything the bin holds), or `None` if the bin is empty/unassigned.
zh: 已分配的物品 id（矿物、锭、组件：货箱可容纳的任何物品），若货箱为空/未分配则为 `None`。

en: Property-distinct `ItemStack` snapshots in this portable bin. Equal ids with different properties remain separate entries.
zh: 此便携货箱中属性不同的 `ItemStack` 快照。id 相同但属性不同的条目仍分开保留。

en: X coordinate in meters from base for this position snapshot.
zh: 此位置快照中距基地的 X 坐标（米）。

en: Y coordinate in meters from base for this position snapshot.
zh: 该位置快照中距基地的 Y 坐标（米）。

en: Iterate over `x`, then `y`, so this position can be unpacked or passed to `list()`.
zh: 依次迭代 `x`、`y`，因此此位置可被解包或传入 `list()`。

en: All owned ground vehicles as read-only `VehicleRef` snapshots. Use `.id` when passing a vehicle to station APIs; call `vehicles()` again for fresh ref fields, or `get_component(ref.id)` for the live vehicle API.
zh: 所有已拥有的地面车辆，以只读 `VehicleRef` 快照形式提供。将车辆传入站点 API 时使用 `.id`；若需获取新的引用字段，请再次调用 `vehicles()`，或使用 `get_component(ref.id)` 获取实时车辆 API。

en: All owned drones as read-only `DroneRef` snapshots. Use `.id` when passing a drone to station/recovery APIs; call `drones()` again for fresh ref fields, or `get_component(ref.id)` for the live drone API.
zh: 所有已拥有的无人机，以只读 `DroneRef` 快照形式提供。将无人机传入站点/回收 API 时使用 `.id`；若需获取新的引用字段，请再次调用 `drones()`，或使用 `get_component(ref.id)` 获取实时无人机 API。

en: All owned vehicles and drones in one snapshot list. Use `.category` to branch between `"vehicle"` and `"drone"`; re-query for fresh positions/status.
zh: 所有已拥有的车辆与无人机合并为一个快照列表。使用 `.category` 在 `"vehicle"` 与 `"drone"` 之间分支；重新查询以获取最新位置/状态。

en: Stable component id. Use with `get_component(id)` or station APIs.
zh: 稳定的组件 id。与 `get_component(id)` 或站点 API 配合使用。

en: Display name when this ref was returned.
zh: 此引用返回时的显示名称。

en: Unit type, e.g. `"rover"`, `"pioneer"`, or a drone chassis id.
zh: 单位类型，例如 `"rover"`、`"pioneer"`，或无人机底盘 id。

en: Activity/status string when this ref was returned.
zh: 返回此引用时的活动/状态字符串。

en: X coordinate in meters from base when this ref was returned.
zh: 返回此引用时距基地的 X 坐标（米）。

en: Y coordinate in meters from base when this ref was returned.
zh: 返回此引用时距基地的 Y 坐标（米）。

en: Position snapshot from when this ref was returned.
zh: 此引用返回时的位置快照。

en: `True` if the unit was parked at a service point/station when this ref was returned.
zh: 若返回此引用时该单位停放在服务点/站点，则为 `True`。

en: `True` if a rescue/recovery mission owned this unit when this ref was returned.
zh: 若返回此引用时该单位正被救援/回收任务占用，则为 `True`。

en: Rescue status when this ref was returned: `"none"`, `"outbound"`, `"charging"`, `"carrying"`, or `"returning"`.
zh: 返回该引用时的救援状态：`"none"`、`"outbound"`、`"charging"`、`"carrying"` 或 `"returning"`。

en: Stable component id. Use with `get_component(id)` or `charging_station.dispatch_rescue(id)`.
zh: 稳定组件 id。配合 `get_component(id)` 或 `charging_station.dispatch_rescue(id)` 使用。

en: Display name when this ref was returned.
zh: 返回该引用时的显示名称。

en: Current vehicle activity when this ref was returned.
zh: 返回该引用时的当前车辆活动。

en: X coordinate in meters from base when this ref was returned.
zh: 返回该引用时距基地的 X 坐标（米）。

en: Y coordinate in meters from base when this ref was returned.
zh: 返回该引用时距基地的 Y 坐标（米）。

en: Position snapshot from when this ref was returned.
zh: 返回该引用时的位置快照。

en: Battery fraction **0-1** when this ref was returned.
zh: 返回该引用时的电池比例 **0-1**。

en: Battery charge in Wh when this ref was returned.
zh: 返回该引用时的电池电量（Wh）。

en: `True` if the vehicle was parked inside an outpost's **2 by 2-tile footprint**, including the **~2 m** service margin, when this ref was returned. A moving or merely stopped vehicle with an active route is not docked.
zh: 如果返回该引用时，车辆停放在前哨站的 **2×2 格占地** 内，并包含 **~2 m** 的服务余量，则为 `True`。正在移动或仅停驻但仍有活动路线的车辆不算停靠。

en: Outpost id when this ref was returned, or empty string.
zh: 返回该引用时的前哨站 id，或空字符串。

en: `True` if a Vehicle Charging Station rescue was active for this vehicle when this ref was returned.
zh: 如果返回该引用时，该车辆正处于车辆充电站救援中，则为 `True`。

en: Rescue status when this ref was returned: `"none"`, `"outbound"`, `"charging"`, or `"returning"`.
zh: 此引用返回时的救援状态：`"none"`、`"outbound"`、`"charging"` 或 `"returning"`。

en: Stable component id. Use with `get_component(id)` or pass it to Drone Service Station and Depot APIs.
zh: 稳定的组件 id。可与 `get_component(id)` 一起使用，或传递给无人机服务站和仓库 API。

en: Display name when this ref was returned.
zh: 此引用返回时的显示名称。

en: `"electric"`, `"heli"`, or empty string if no thruster is mounted.
zh: `"electric"`、`"heli"`，若未安装推进器则为空字符串。

en: Activity/status string when this ref was returned.
zh: 此引用返回时的活动/状态字符串。

en: X coordinate in meters from base when this ref was returned.
zh: 此引用返回时距基地的 X 坐标（米）。

en: Y coordinate in meters from base when this ref was returned.
zh: 此引用返回时距基地的 Y 坐标（米）。

en: Position snapshot from when this ref was returned.
zh: 此引用返回时的位置快照。

en: Station id when this ref was returned, or empty string.
zh: 此引用返回时的站点 id，或空字符串。

en: `True` if the drone was parked at a drone station when this ref was returned.
zh: 若此引用返回时无人机停放在无人机站点，则为 `True`。

en: Electric drone charge fraction **0-1** when this ref was returned, or `None` for heli drones.
zh: 此引用返回时电动无人机的电量比例 **0-1**，直升机无人机为 `None`。

en: Electric drone charge in Wh when this ref was returned, or `None` for heli drones.
zh: 此引用返回时电动无人机的电量（Wh），直升机无人机为 `None`。

en: Electric drone charge capacity in Wh, or `None` for heli drones.
zh: 电动无人机的电量容量（Wh），直升机无人机为 `None`。

en: Heli drone oil fraction **0-1** when this ref was returned, or `None` for electric drones.
zh: 此 ref 返回时直升机无人机的油量比例 **0-1**，电动无人机为 `None`。

en: Heli drone oil in tons when this ref was returned, or `None` for electric drones.
zh: 此 ref 返回时直升机无人机的油量（吨），电动无人机为 `None`。

en: Heli drone oil capacity in tons, or `None` for electric drones.
zh: 直升机无人机的油量容量（吨），电动无人机为 `None`。

en: `True` if a Drone Service Station rescue was active for this drone when this ref was returned.
zh: 若此 ref 返回时无人机服务站对该无人机的救援处于激活状态，则为 `True`。

en: Rescue status when this ref was returned: `"none"`, `"outbound"`, `"charging"`, `"carrying"`, or `"returning"`.
zh: 此 ref 返回时的救援状态：`"none"`、`"outbound"`、`"charging"`、`"carrying"` 或 `"returning"`。

en: Current charge in Wh across mounted Battery Packs. Raises `ReferenceError` when this drone does not have an electric powertrain.
zh: 所有已安装电池组的当前电量（Wh）。当该无人机没有电动动力系统时引发 `ReferenceError`。

en: Total charge capacity in Wh. Raises `ReferenceError` when this drone does not have an electric powertrain.
zh: 总电量容量（Wh）。当该无人机没有电动动力系统时引发 `ReferenceError`。

en: Charge as a fraction **0-1** (`level / capacity`). Raises `ReferenceError` when this drone does not have an electric powertrain.
zh: 电量比例 **0-1**（`level / capacity`）。当该无人机没有电动动力系统时引发 `ReferenceError`。

en: Current oil in tons across mounted Oil Tanks. Raises `ReferenceError` when this drone does not have a heli powertrain.
zh: 所有已安装油箱的当前油量（吨）。当该无人机没有直升机动力系统时引发 `ReferenceError`。

en: Total oil capacity in tons. Raises `ReferenceError` when this drone does not have a heli powertrain.
zh: 总油量容量（吨）。当该无人机没有直升机动力系统时引发 `ReferenceError`。

en: Oil as a fraction **0-1**. Raises `ReferenceError` when this drone does not have a heli powertrain.
zh: 油量比例 **0-1**。当该无人机没有直升机动力系统时引发 `ReferenceError`。

en: Total units across every Cargo Pod plus the Bio Extractor chamber.
zh: 所有货舱以及生物提取器舱室的总单位数。

en: Total physical capacity summed over every container: each mounted Cargo Pod (Small **100**, Medium **250**, Large **500**) plus the Bio Extractor's **25 t** chamber. Shield Plating halves each pod's capacity.
zh: 所有容器的总物理容量：每个已安装货舱（小型 **100**、中型 **250**、大型 **500**）加上生物提取器的 **25 t** 舱室。护盾镀层会使每个货舱的容量减半。

en: Dict mapping `item_id` → unit count for every material currently in cargo. Iterate with `.keys()` / `.items()`.
zh: 字典，将 `item_id` 映射到当前货物中每种材料的单位数。使用 `.keys()` / `.items()` 迭代。

en: Free room for this specific material. **Each Cargo Pod holds one material**, so a pod counts only if it is empty or already holds `item_id`; the Bio Extractor's 25 t chamber counts only for life forms. Returns **0** for a material with no empty or matching pod, even while other pods still have room for their own materials.
zh: 该特定材料的剩余空间。**每个货舱只容纳一种材料**，因此只有当货舱为空或已存放 `item_id` 时才计入；生物提取器的 25 t 舱室只计入生命形式。对于没有空货舱或匹配货舱的材料，即使其他货舱仍可为各自材料腾出空间，也返回 **0**。

en: Item id to size remaining room for
zh: 用于计算剩余空间的物品 ID

en: `True` when `count() >= capacity()`. A drone may still be unable to load a new item type when every pod is committed, even if `full()` is `False`; use `space_for(item_id)` for a specific item.
zh: 当 `count() >= capacity()` 时为 `True`。即使 `full()` 为 `False`，当每个货舱单元都已占用时，无人机仍可能无法装载新物品类型；对于特定物品，请使用 `space_for(item_id)`。

en: Move up to whole-number `count` units into this drone's cargo, retaining exact properties. Loads from the docked Drone Depot stockpile or a field Mining Drill after the drone finishes its route there. Hot cargo loads from a local Lead Cask and requires Shield Plating.
zh: 最多将整数 `count` 个单位移入此无人机的货舱，并保留精确属性。无人机完成路线后，从停靠的无人机仓库库存或野外采矿钻机装载。热货从本地铅桶装载，且需要护盾镀层。
要装载的最大整数数量

en: Optional property dict, matched as a subset by default. Omitted or `None` matches any properties; use `None` with `property_match="exact"` to select propertyless items only.
zh: 可选属性字典，默认按子集匹配。省略或为 `None` 时匹配任意属性；将 `None` 与 `property_match="exact"` 配合使用，可仅选择无属性物品。

en: Optional selection mode: any, subset, or exact
zh: 可选选择模式：any、subset 或 exact

en: Move up to whole-number `count` units from this drone's cargo into its docked Drone Depot, retaining exact properties. Hot cargo unloads into a compatible Lead Cask.
zh: 最多将整数 `count` 个单位从此无人机的货舱移入其停靠的无人机仓库，并保留精确属性。热货卸载到兼容的铅桶。
要卸载的最大整数数量

en: Optional property dict, matched as a subset by default. Omitted or `None` matches any properties; use `None` with `property_match="exact"` to select propertyless items only.

zh: 插槽类型：决定哪些模块可安装（`nav`、`sonar_basic`、`drill_basic`、`universal`、`thruster` 或 `drone_module`）。

en: Module id currently mounted in this slot, or `None` if empty.
zh: 当前安装在此插槽中的模块 id，若为空则为 `None`。

en: Number of internal slots this mounted module exposes. `0` for non-container modules.
zh: 此已安装模块暴露的内部插槽数量。非容器模块为 `0`。

en: List of item ids currently installed in this module's internal slots. `None` entries mark empty internal slots.
zh: 当前安装在此模块内部插槽中的物品 id 列表。`None` 项表示内部插槽为空。

en: Stable item id shared by every unit in this stack.
zh: 此堆叠中每个单位共享的稳定物品 id。

en: Whole-number units with this exact property identity.
zh: 具有此精确属性标识的整数单位数量。

en: Exact property dict for this item, or `None` for an ordinary commodity. Items with different properties form separate stacks and never merge.
zh: 此物品的精确属性字典，普通商品为 `None`。具有不同属性的物品会形成独立堆叠，且永不合并。

en: Set a compatible item source by stable id or display name. Two stationary endpoints must share an outpost. A Rover or Pioneer is reachable from any outpost, but only while it is parked inside this machine's service area. Field-extractor pickup outputs can be pulled only by a Rover or Pioneer. A drone's cargo moves through its Drone Depot. `"inventory"` is a freight source only while the endpoint is at Nocturna Base; remote stationary ports use local Storage Bins, Warehouses, or machine buffers.
zh: 通过稳定 id 或显示名称设置兼容的物品来源。两个固定端点必须共享同一个前哨站。漫游车或先锋建造机可从任意前哨站访问，但仅当它停放在此机器的服务区域内时。野外采集器的拾取输出只能由漫游车或先锋建造机拉取。无人机的货物通过其无人机仓库转移。`"inventory"` 仅当端点位于诺克图纳基地时才是货运来源；远程固定端口使用本地储物箱、仓库或机器缓冲区。

en: Stable id or display name of a compatible item source, or inventory
zh: 兼容物品来源的稳定 id 或显示名称，或 inventory

en: Clear the current source connection. Does not move or discard buffered items; use `eject(...)` to recover them or `flush()` to destroy them.
zh: 清除当前来源连接。不会移动或丢弃缓冲物品；使用 `eject(...)` 回收它们，或使用 `flush()` 销毁它们。

en: Display name of the currently connected source, or empty string.
zh: 当前连接来源的显示名称，或空字符串。

en: Stable id of the currently connected source, or empty string. `connect()` accepts an id or a display name, so compare against this when you need the identity to match what you passed: `connected_to()` answers with the renameable name.
zh: 当前连接来源的稳定 id，或空字符串。`connect()` 接受 id 或显示名称，因此当你需要标识与传入值匹配时，请与此比较：`connected_to()` 返回的是可重命名的名称。

en: Take up to whole-number `count` units of `item_id` from the connected source. A property dict selects stacks containing that subset by default. Pass `"exact"` as the fourth argument for one full identity; `None, "exact"` selects only propertyless items. `"any"` ignores properties. Exact source properties are always retained. The transfer waits automatically for time proportional to units moved and requires Auto Feeders research.
zh: 从已连接来源取用最多 `count` 个整数单位的 `item_id`。默认情况下，属性字典会选择包含该子集的堆叠。传入 `"exact"` 作为第四个参数以匹配一个完整身份；`None, "exact"` 仅选择无属性物品。`"any"` 会忽略属性。来源的精确属性始终会被保留。传输会自动等待与移动数量成比例的时间，并需要自动供料器研究。
要取用的最大整数单位数

en: Optional property dict, matched as a subset by default. Omitted or `None` matches any properties; use `None` with `property_match="exact"` to select propertyless items only.

en: Optional selection mode: any, subset, or exact
zh: 可选选择模式：任意、子集或精确

en: Recover up to whole-number `count` units of `item_id` from this buffer without changing its source connection. Use `"inventory"` at Nocturna Base, or a compatible same-outpost store, machine input, or parked ground vehicle. Optional properties use the standard any, subset, or exact selection rules; exact item properties are preserved. Destination capacity may limit the move. Active or reserved work rejects without moving anything; a successful ejection cancels fractional work attached to the staged input. The transfer waits automatically for time proportional to units moved and requires Auto Feeders research.
zh: 从此缓冲区回收最多 `count` 个整数单位的 `item_id`，且不改变其来源连接。在诺克图纳星基地使用 `"inventory"`，或同一前哨站内兼容的仓库、机器输入端口或停放的地面载具。可选属性使用标准的任意、子集或精确选择规则；物品的精确属性会被保留。目的地容量可能限制本次移动。若存在进行中或已预留的工作，回收将被拒绝且不会移动任何物品；成功回收会取消与已暂存输入关联的部分工作。传输会自动等待与移动数量成比例的时间，并需要自动供料器研究。

en: Stable id or display name of a local compatible freight destination, or inventory
zh: 本地兼容货运目的地的稳定 id 或显示名称，或库存

en: Permanently discard everything currently buffered in this input port. Flushed items are not returned to inventory. On processing machines, flushing also cancels any in-progress craft.
zh: 永久丢弃当前缓冲在此输入端口中的全部内容。被清除的物品不会返回库存。在处理机器上，清除也会取消任何进行中的制作。

zh: 当前位于此端口缓冲区中的总单位数。

en: Maximum units this port's buffer can hold.
zh: 此端口缓冲区可容纳的最大单位数。

zh: 当前缓冲的按属性区分的 `ItemStack` 值快照列表。当属性不同，两个条目可能具有相同 id。

Vehicle handoffs require both vehicles to be stopped and nearby. `"inventory"` is available only while parked at Nocturna Base; remote outposts use local Storage Bins, Warehouses, or machine buffers.
zh: 按稳定 id 或显示名称设置兼容的货物源。漫游车或先锋建造机必须停放在固定源的服务区域内。野外采矿钻和水泵的储备堆支持搬运车拾取。车辆交接要求两辆载具均已停止且彼此靠近。`"inventory"` 仅在停放在诺克图纳基地时可用；远程前哨站使用本地储物箱、仓库或机器缓冲区。

en: Stable id or display name of a compatible cargo source, or inventory
zh: 兼容货物源的稳定 id 或显示名称，或库存

zh: 清除当前货物源连接。这不会移动或丢弃货物。

zh: 当前连接的货物源的显示名称，或空字符串。

zh: 当前连接的货物源的稳定 id，或空字符串。`connect()` 接受 id 或显示名称，因此在重命名后仍需保持身份时，请与此值比较。

zh: 按稳定 id 或显示名称设置兼容的物品目的地。两个固定端点必须位于同一前哨站。从任意前哨站均可连接漫游车或先锋建造机，但仅当它停放在此机器的服务区域内时。无人机的货物通过其无人机仓库转运。`"inventory"` 仅在端点位于诺克图纳基地时才是货运目的地；远程固定端口使用本地储物箱、仓库或机器输入端。

en: Stable id or display name of a compatible item destination, or inventory
zh: 兼容物品目的地的稳定 id 或显示名称，或库存

en: Exact shared Insight currently spendable by any Habitat, including retained fractions.
zh: 当前任何栖息地可消耗的精确共享洞察，包括保留的小数部分。

en: Alias of `shared`, retained for scripts that already read the explicitly named exact balance.
zh: `shared` 的别名，保留给已读取显式命名精确余额的脚本。

en: This colony's projected Insight production per hour at current growth and supply.
zh: 该殖民地在当前增长和供给条件下每小时预计的洞察值产量。

en: Insight this colony has produced over its lifetime, including fractions.
zh: 该殖民地在其生命周期内已生产的洞察值，包括小数部分。

en: Whether this colony is producing positive Insight at its current growth rate.
zh: 该殖民地是否以当前增长率产生正向洞察值。

en: Creature id whose authored tree is shown, or an empty string before a target is selected.
zh: 显示其已设计树的生物 ID；未选择目标时为空字符串。

en: Exact shared Insight currently available for purchases, including retained fractions.
zh: 当前可用于购买的精确共享洞察值，包括保留的小数部分。

en: Number of permanent nodes purchased from this species' tree.
zh: 从该物种树中购买的永久节点数量。

en: The species-only adaptation and all-species breakthrough in stable order, including locked and purchased nodes.
zh: 按稳定顺序排列的物种专属适应节点与全物种突破节点，包括锁定和已购买节点。

en: Creature id whose tree owns this node. Global breakthroughs are still earned from one source species.
zh: 此节点所属树的生物 ID。全局突破仍从单一来源物种获得。

en: Effect scope: `"species"` affects only `source_species`; `"global"` affects every current and future Habitat colony.
zh: 效果范围：`"species"` 仅影响 `source_species`；`"global"` 影响所有当前和未来的栖息地殖民地。
玩家可读的已设计节点名称。
精确的已设计效果摘要。

en: Whether this node is permanently purchased.
zh: 该节点是否已永久购买。

en: Whether this purchased node currently has at least one effect applying to the Habitat that returned it. Unpurchased nodes are always `False`.
zh: 该已购买节点当前是否至少有一个效果应用于返回它的栖息地。未购买节点始终为 `False`。

en: Minimum local colony population: **0** for the adaptation or **10,000** for the breakthrough.
zh: 最低本地殖民地人口：适应型为 **0**，突破型为 **10,000**。

en: All currently unmet requirements: at most `"population"` and `"insight"`.
zh: 当前所有未满足要求：最多为 `"population"` 和 `"insight"`。

en: Stable result code for scripts to check. `.message` explains what happened.
zh: 供脚本检查的稳定结果代码。`.message` 说明发生了什么。

en: Player-readable explanation of the exact command outcome. Suitable for logs and player-facing diagnostics.
zh: 面向玩家的可读说明，解释命令的确切结果。适用于日志和面向玩家的诊断。

en: `"queued"` when the job entered the FIFO, otherwise the exact reason it was not accepted.
zh: 任务进入 FIFO 时为 `"queued"`，否则为未被接受的确切原因。

en: Player-readable explanation of the submission outcome.
zh: 面向玩家的可读说明，解释提交结果。

en: Stable whole-number job id, or `None` when no job was created.
zh: 稳定的整数任务 id，若未创建任务则为 `None`。

en: One-based execution position at submission time, including the active job, or `None` when rejected.
zh: 提交时的从 1 开始的执行位置（包含当前活动任务），被拒绝时为 `None`。

en: Requested seed or treatment item, or `None` for harvest jobs.
zh: 请求的种子或处理物品；采集任务时为 `None`。

en: Completed fraction from **0-1**. Pending jobs read **0**.
zh: 已完成比例，范围 **0-1**。待处理任务读取为 **0**。

en: Exact physical blocker, or `None` while working or queued.
zh: 确切的物理阻碍物；工作或排队时为 `None`。

en: Terminal job outcome, or `"empty"` when no completed result was waiting.
zh: 任务最终结果；没有等待中的已完成结果时为 `"empty"`。

en: Player-readable explanation of the terminal outcome.
zh: 面向玩家的最终结果说明。

en: Completed job id, or `None` when empty.
zh: 已完成任务 ID；为空时为 `None`。
已完成的动作；为空时为 `None`。

en: Completed target sector, or `None` when empty.
zh: 已完成的目标扇区；为空时为 `None`。

en: Requested seed or treatment item, or `None` for harvest and empty results.
zh: 请求的种子或处理物品；采集结果和空结果为 `None`。

en: Whole Forage units committed to the output bin by a harvest. Always **0** otherwise.
zh: 采集时投入输出箱的完整 Forage 单位。其他情况始终为 **0**。

en: Whole Forage units a harvest could not fit and threw away. Non-zero only with `"partial"`; the cell is cleared either way.
zh: 采集时无法容纳而被丢弃的完整 Forage 单位。仅在 `"partial"` 时非零；无论如何该单元格都会被清空。

en: `"ok"` when one or more entries changed, `"no_op"` when nothing changed, or a command-specific rejection such as `"invalid_channel"` or `"invalid_key"`.
zh: 一个或多个条目发生变化时为 `"ok"`，无变化时为 `"no_op"`，或命令特定的拒绝原因，如 `"invalid_channel"` 或 `"invalid_key"`。

en: Player-readable explanation of the count operation.
zh: 面向玩家的计数操作说明。

en: Whole-number entries or units affected by the command.
zh: 受命令影响的整数条目或单位数量。

en: `"ok"` when a command was consumed, otherwise `"empty"`.
zh: 当命令被消耗时返回 `"ok"`，否则返回 `"empty"`。

en: Player-readable explanation of the command dequeue result.
zh: 玩家可读的命令出队结果说明。

en: Consumed `ScriptCommand`, or `None` when the queue was empty.
zh: 已消耗的 `ScriptCommand`；若队列为空则为 `None`。

en: Player-readable explanation of the sale outcome.
zh: 玩家可读的销售结果说明。

en: Stable item id requested for sale.
zh: 请求出售的稳定物品 id。
从库存中移除的整数单位。

en: Whole-number credits earned by this sale.
zh: 本次出售获得的整数积分。

en: Player-readable explanation of the exact collection outcome.
zh: 玩家可读的准确采集结果说明。

en: Stable id of the collected material, or `None` when no material was collected.
zh: 已采集材料的稳定 id；若未采集到材料则为 `None`。

en: Whole-number units committed to drone cargo by this call.
zh: 本次调用提交给无人机货舱的整数单位。

en: Player-readable explanation of the combine trial outcome.
zh: 玩家可读的融合试验结果说明。

en: Stable seed item id deposited into output, or `None` when no seed was produced.
zh: 存入产出的稳定种子物品 id；若未产生种子则为 `None`。

en: Stable discovered flora species id, or `None` when no seed was produced.
zh: 稳定发现的植物物种 ID，或未产生种子时为 `None`。

en: Player-readable explanation of the discard outcome.
zh: 面向玩家的丢弃结果说明。

en: Whole-number units requested or observed for destruction.
zh: 请求或观测到的待销毁整数单位数。
永久销毁的整数单位数。

en: Stable result code for scripts to check. `.message` explains what happened.
zh: 供脚本检查的稳定结果代码。`.message` 说明发生了什么。

en: Player-readable, contextual explanation of this exact outcome. Suitable for logs and player-facing diagnostics.
zh: 面向玩家、结合上下文的精确结果说明。适合用于日志和面向玩家的诊断。

en: Whole-number units requested by the call. For parameterless `flush()` or `compact()`, this is the buffered or repositioned amount observed by the operation.
zh: 调用请求的整数单位数。对于无参数的 `flush()` 或 `compact()`，表示该操作观察到的缓存量或重定位量。

en: Whole-number units actually transferred, repositioned, or destroyed. Always **0** for rejected outcomes.
zh: 实际转移、重定位或销毁的整数单位数。被拒绝的结果始终为 **0**。

en: Stable outcome code. Scanner results use `"ok"` / `"empty"`; Harvester results can also report `"holding"`, `"overheated"`, `"moving"` (in transit), `"busy"` (occupied by another action), or `"collecting"`.
zh: 稳定结果代码。扫描仪结果使用 `"ok"` / `"empty"`；采集车结果还可能报告 `"holding"`、`"overheated"`、`"moving"`（运输中）、`"busy"`（被其他操作占用）或 `"collecting"`。

en: Player-readable explanation of the scan or collection outcome.
zh: 面向玩家的扫描或采集结果说明。

en: Item ID at the scanned sector (empty string if nothing).
zh: 被扫描区域中的物品 ID（若无则为空字符串）。

en: Stable category used to distinguish materials, biological items, and equipment kinds.
zh: 用于区分材料、生物物品和设备类别的稳定分类。

en: `True` when multiple units share one inventory stack; `False` when each unit occupies its own slot.
zh: 当多个单位共享一个库存堆叠时为 `True`；当每个单位占用独立槽位时为 `False`。

en: Native biome for a life form or biology sample; `None` when biome does not apply.
zh: 生命体或生物样本的原生生物群系；不适用生物群系时为 `None`。

en: Rarity for a life form or biology sample; `None` when rarity does not apply.
zh: 生命体或生物样本的稀有度；不适用稀有度时为 `None`。

en: Lowest production tier that creates this item, or `None` when it is a raw, harvested, purchased, or otherwise source item. Smelter products are Tier 0.
zh: 创建该物品的最低生产层级；若为原始、采集、购买或其他来源物品，则为 `None`。冶炼厂产品为 Tier 0。

en: Item ID (empty string if slot is empty).
zh: 物品 ID（槽位为空时为空字符串）。

en: Exact property dict for this stack, or `None` for an ordinary item. Pass it to property-aware transfer and capacity methods.
zh: 该堆叠的精确属性字典；普通物品为 `None`。将其传递给支持属性的转移与容量方法。

en: The genes a held **geothermal** fragment carries, e.g. `["cold_tolerance", "pressure_tolerance"]`: read it straight from inventory without loading the DNA Sequencer. A spliced fragment carries exactly the set you engineered; a raw fragment carries its natural genes. Empty for non-geothermal items.
zh: 所持 **地热** 碎片携带的基因，例如 `["cold_tolerance", "pressure_tolerance"]`：无需加载 DNA 测序仪即可直接从库存读取。拼接碎片只携带你工程化的基因集合；原始碎片携带其自然基因。非地热物品为空。

en: Per-instance bioluminescent glow `[r,g,b]` (0-255) for a held **coastal** fragment. `None` for any other item.
zh: 所持 **海岸** 碎片的实例级生物发光 `[r,g,b]`（0-255）。其他物品为 `None`。

en: `True` if this is an engineered (already gene-spliced) geothermal fragment: a further DNA Sequencer alter would destroy it. `False` for raw items.
zh: 若这是工程化（已进行基因拼接）的地热碎片，则为 `True`：再次使用 DNA 测序仪修改会将其摧毁。原始物品为 `False`。

en: Item id this slot holds (empty string if the slot is empty).
zh: 此槽位持有的物品 id（槽位为空时为空字符串）。
此槽位当前的单位数量。

en: Exact property dict for the item variant in this physical slot, or `None` when the slot is empty or holds an ordinary item.
zh: 此物理槽位中物品变体的精确属性字典，或当槽位为空或持有普通物品时为 `None`。

en: True if connected to a target.
zh: 若已连接到目标，则为 True。

en: Connected planet id, or `"none"` when disconnected.
zh: 已连接的星球 id，或断开连接时为 "none"。

en: Planet id: pass this to transmitter.connect().
zh: 星球 id：将其传给 transmitter.connect()。

en: Iterate over `row`, then `col`, so this position can be unpacked or passed to `list()`.
zh: 依次迭代 `row`、`col`，因此该位置可被解包或传给 `list()`。

en: Number of digits in the correct position.
zh: 位于正确位置的数字个数。

en: Number of correct digits in wrong positions.
zh: 数字正确但位置错误的个数。

en: Whole-number Manhattan distance (steps) to the nearest message cell. 0 means this cell IS a message cell.
zh: 到最近消息单元格的整数曼哈顿距离（步数）。0 表示此单元格就是消息单元格。

en: Site X coordinate in meters from base.
zh: 站点距基地的 X 坐标（米）。

en: Site Y coordinate in meters from base.
zh: 站点距基地的 Y 坐标（米）。

en: One of `"mineral"` / `"thermal"` / `"water"` / `"oil"` / `"exotic"` / `"inert"`. Use it to narrow to the concrete subtype: after `if site.kind() == "mineral":` the editor surfaces `MiningSite`-specific fields on `site`. `"inert"` means sonar resolved a physical formation with no extractable signal.
zh: `"mineral"` / `"thermal"` / `"water"` / `"oil"` / `"exotic"` / `"inert"` 之一。用它收窄到具体子类型：在 `if site.kind() == "mineral":` 之后，编辑器会在 `site` 上显示 `MiningSite` 专属字段。`"inert"` 表示声呐解析出一个没有可提取信号的物理构造。
包含 `.x` / `.y` 世界坐标的 `Position` 快照。

en: Survey flag captured when this object was returned; resolved inert contacts also report `True`. The property never updates. Mining-site fields are snapshots. Well, vent and exotic-deposit methods read live, except on pre-survey sonar results: those keep their hidden values, so obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 此对象返回时捕获的勘察标志；已解析的惰性目标也会报告 `True`。该属性不会更新。矿址字段是快照。井口、喷口和奇异矿藏方法读取实时数据，但勘察前的声呐结果除外：这些结果会保留其隐藏值，因此勘察后应获取新对象。

en: Item id this site yields when drilled (e.g. `"iron_ore"`, `"silicon"`). `None` until `surveyed`.
zh: 此站点钻探时产出的物品 ID（例如 `"iron_ore"`、`"silicon"`）。在 `surveyed` 前为 `None`。

en: Hardness rating (**1-4**): gates drill compatibility. `None` until `surveyed`.
zh: 硬度评级（**1-4**）：决定钻头兼容性。在 `surveyed` 前为 `None`。
产量倍率等级：`"standard"`（**1×**）/ `"rich"`（**2×**）/ `"pure"`（**3×**）。在 `surveyed` 前为 `None`。

en: Record or replace this port's one declared target, using a stable machine id or display name. The target must expose a compatible opposite-direction port. Either the provider or consumer may declare the relationship; one declaration is enough. Local machines transfer directly, while remote intent waits for any completed conflict-free same-medium component reaching both anchors.
zh: 记录或替换此端口唯一声明的目标，使用稳定的机器 id 或显示名称。目标必须暴露兼容的反向端口。提供方或消费方均可声明该关系；一方声明即可。本地机器直接传输，而远程意图会等待任何已完成、无冲突、同介质且抵达两个锚点的组件。

en: Stable id or display name of the provider or consumer
zh: 提供方或消费方的稳定 id 或显示名称

en: Clear only this port's declared target. Buffered fluid remains. If the peer independently declared the same relationship, that reverse declaration remains active.
zh: 仅清除此端口声明的目标。已缓冲的流体仍保留。如果对端独立声明了同一关系，该反向声明仍保持有效。

en: Display name of the target declared by this port, or empty string. It does not list compatible reverse declarations owned by peer ports.
zh: 此端口声明的目标显示名称，或空字符串。它不会列出由对端端口拥有的兼容反向声明。

en: Stable id of the target declared by this port, or empty string. `connect()` accepts an id or a display name, so compare against this when you need the identity to match what you passed: `connected_to()` answers with the renameable name. For every effective peer, including declarations owned by the other side, use `connections()`.
zh: 此端口声明的目标稳定 id，或空字符串。`connect()` 接受 id 或显示名称，因此当你需要身份与你传入的内容匹配时，请与此比较：`connected_to()` 返回的是可重命名的名称。对于每个有效对端，包括由另一侧拥有的声明，请使用 `connections()`。

en: Read-only snapshots of every effective peer relationship on this port, including declarations authored by peer ports. Each `FluidConnection` reports the peer, exact fluid when known, declaration ownership, and structural state. Pipe ids are deliberately not exposed or selected.
zh: 此端口上每个有效对端关系的只读快照，包括由对端端口编写的声明。每个 `FluidConnection` 报告对端、已知时的精确流体、声明归属和结构状态。管道 id 有意不暴露或选择。

en: Current tons of fluid buffered at this port. Pass-through source ports such as Pump outputs store nothing and therefore read **0**.
zh: 此端口当前缓冲的流体吨数。泵输出等直通源端口不存储任何东西，因此读取为 **0**。

en: Max tons this port's buffer can hold.
zh: 此端口缓冲区可容纳的最大吨数。

en: Current total live flow in **t/h**. **0** may mean idle, starved, full, unreachable, conflicted, or waiting across a simulation timing boundary; it does not erase the connection or pipe identity.
zh: 当前总实时流量，单位为 **t/h**。**0** 可能表示空闲、供料不足、已满、不可达、冲突，或正在等待跨越模拟时序边界；它不会抹除连接或管道身份。

en: Stable id of the peer machine.
Current display name of the peer machine.
zh: 对端机器的当前显示名称。

en: Exact fluid established by this relationship, or `None` while the relationship is neutral or incompatible.
zh: 此关系建立的精确流体，或在关系处于中立或不兼容时为 `None`。

en: Who owns the durable declaration: `"self"`, `"peer"`, or `"both"`. One side is sufficient for transport.
zh: 持久声明的拥有者：`"self"`、`"peer"` 或 `"both"`。一方即可用于传输。

en: Connection state: `"local"` for a direct same-outpost link; `"ready"` for a usable remote pipe network; `"unreachable"` when no completed component can be assigned; `"conflict"` when the assigned component carries different fluid connections; `"neutral"` before a fluid is known; or `"incompatible"` when the two fluids disagree.
zh: 连接状态：同一前哨站内直接链接为 `"local"`；可用的远程管道网络为 `"ready"`；无法分配已完成组件时为 `"unreachable"`；分配的组件承载不同流体连接时为 `"conflict"`；尚未确定流体时为 `"neutral"`；两种流体不一致时为 `"incompatible"`。

en: One of `"standard"` (**1×**) / `"rich"` (**2×**) / `"pure"` (**3×**). `None` until surveyed. Checks current survey progress, except on a pre-survey sonar result, which keeps returning `None`; obtain a new object after surveying. Wells reveal fully on basic survey.
zh: 以下之一：`"standard"` (**1×**) / `"rich"` (**2×**) / `"pure"` (**3×**)。勘测前为 `None`。会检查当前勘测进度；但勘测前的声呐结果除外，它仍会返回 `None`；勘测后请获取新对象。基础勘测即可完全揭示水井。

en: Tons of water per hour this well produces. **10 / 20 / 30** for standard / rich / pure. `None` until surveyed. Reads live, except on a pre-survey sonar result, which keeps returning `None`; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 这口井每小时产出的水量（吨）。标准 / 富矿 / 纯矿 为 **10 / 20 / 30**。勘测前为 `None`。读取实时值，但勘测前的声呐结果会一直返回 `None`；勘测后请获取新对象。

en: Boolean: `True` if a Water Pump is currently deployed on this well. A pre-survey sonar result always returns `False`; obtain a new object after surveying for live readings.
zh: 布尔值：如果此井当前部署了水泵，则为 `True`。勘测前的声呐结果始终返回 `False`；勘测后请获取新对象以读取实时数据。

en: Current machine id of the Water Pump deployed on this well, or empty string when no pump is present. A pre-survey sonar result always returns empty string; obtain a new object after surveying for live readings.
zh: 部署在此井上的水泵当前机器 id；无泵时为空字符串。勘测前的声呐结果始终返回空字符串；勘测后请获取新对象以读取实时数据。

en: One of `"standard"` (**1×**) / `"rich"` (**2×**) / `"pure"` (**3×**). `None` until surveyed. Checks current survey progress, except on a pre-survey sonar result, which keeps returning `None`; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 取值为 `"standard"`（**1×**）/ `"rich"`（**2×**）/ `"pure"`（**3×**）之一。勘测前为 `None`。检查当前勘测进度，但勘测前的声呐结果会一直返回 `None`；勘测后请获取新对象。

en: Peak tons of oil per hour. **8 / 16 / 24** for standard / rich / pure. Oil wells pulse through active and dormant phases: a dormant well delivers nothing at any throttle (read the pump's `well_active()`). `None` until surveyed. Reads live, except on a pre-survey sonar result, which keeps returning `None`; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 每小时产油量峰值（吨）。标准 / 富矿 / 纯矿 为 **8 / 16 / 24**。油井会在活跃期与休眠期之间脉动：休眠井在任何油门档位下都不产出（读取泵的 `well_active()`）。勘测前为 `None`。读取实时值，但勘测前的声呐结果会一直返回 `None`；勘测后请获取新对象。

en: Boolean: `True` if an Oil Pump is currently deployed on this well. A pre-survey sonar result always returns `False`; obtain a new object after surveying for live readings.
zh: 布尔值：如果此井当前部署了油泵，则为 `True`。勘测前的声呐结果始终返回 `False`；勘测后请获取新对象以读取实时数据。

en: Current machine id of the Oil Pump deployed on this well, or empty string when no pump is present. A pre-survey sonar result always returns empty string; obtain a new object after surveying for live readings.
zh: 部署在此井上的油泵当前机器 id；无泵时为空字符串。勘测前的声呐结果始终返回空字符串；勘测后请获取新对象以读取实时数据。

en: Cell-center x at this report's observation time, m.
zh: 此报告观测时刻的单元格中心 x 坐标，单位为米。

en: Cell-center y at this report's observation time, m.
zh: 此报告观测时刻的单元格中心 y 坐标，单位为米。

en: `"dust"` or `"thunder"`. Dust events transmit a Raw Uranium aftermath message. Thunder charges eligible Lightning Rods and may produce a Storm Glass message.
zh: `"dust"` 或 `"thunder"`。尘埃事件会发送一条原铀余波消息。雷电事件会为符合条件的避雷针充电，并可能生成风暴玻璃消息。

en: Cell radius in m. A heli drone on a straight route holds once its current position is inside the cell; it does not automatically route around it. Electric drones fly through.
zh: 单元格半径，单位为米。沿直线航线飞行的旋翼无人机会在当前坐标位于该单元格内时悬停；不会自动绕行。电动无人机会直接穿过。
移动速度，单位为米/小时。
单位移动方向，格式为 `[dx, dy]`。
报告时刻观测到的强度 **0-1**。

en: Live hours remaining before this observed cell dissipates.
zh: 此观测气团消散前的剩余实时小时数。

en: Hours until the cell's edge reaches the point. **0** when the point is already inside the cell; `None` when the track never gets there before dissipating.
zh: 气团边缘到达该点所需小时数。若该点已在气团内为 **0**；若轨迹在消散前永远不会到达该点则为 `None`。

en: Stable report id for provenance and logging.
zh: 稳定的报告 ID，用于溯源与日志记录。

en: Physical Weather Station id that made this report.
zh: 生成此报告的实体气象站 ID。

en: World-clock timestamp when the report was measured.
zh: 报告测量时的世界时钟时间戳。

en: Live age of this immutable report in world-clock hours.
zh: 此不可变报告的实时年龄，以世界时钟小时计。

en: The station's local coverage as a `Zone` frozen at observation time.
zh: 站点在观测时刻冻结的本地覆盖范围，以 `Zone` 表示。

en: List of active `Storm` snapshots inside local coverage at observation time.
zh: 观测时刻本地覆盖范围内活动 `Storm` 快照列表。

en: Local `WeatherEventForecast` entries expected to enter coverage within **8 world-clock hours**, or **24** after Weather Forecasting research.
zh: 预计将在 **8 个世界时钟小时**内进入覆盖范围的本地区域 `WeatherEventForecast` 条目；完成天气预报研究后为 **24**。

en: Stable event id shared with the active Storm and later signal transmissions.
zh: 与活动 Storm 及后续信号传输共享的稳定事件 ID。

en: `[earliest, latest]` hours after this report's observation time when the cell should enter coverage.
zh: `[earliest, latest]` 为本报告观测时间后气团应进入覆盖范围的小时数。

en: Coarse predicted travel corridor as a `Zone`; it is storm information, never the hidden aftermath path.
zh: 以 `Zone` 表示的粗略预测行进走廊；这是风暴信息，绝非隐藏的余波路径。
观测到的预报范围 `[low, high]`，每项均为 **0-1**。

en: Whether this station has published a Signal Board value.
zh: 该站点是否已发布信号板数值。

en: Publication timestamp, or `None` with no input.
zh: 发布时间戳；无输入时为 `None`。

en: `"no_input"`, `"fresh"`, or `"stale"`. A publication becomes stale after **2 world-clock hours**.
zh: 为 `"no_input"`、`"fresh"` 或 `"stale"`。发布内容在 **2 个世界时钟小时**后变为过期。

en: Event shown on this station's board, or an empty string with no input.
zh: 该站点板上显示的事件；无输入时为空字符串。

en: Publish one transmission into its declared numbered slot. A different event replaces this station's current board. An already-published slot for the same event is left unchanged. The board checks shape and bounds, not meaning or checksum validity.
zh: 将一条传输发布到其声明的编号槽位。不同事件会替换该站点当前板。同一事件的已发布槽位保持不变。板只检查形状和边界，不检查含义或校验和有效性。

en: A `SignalTransmission`, a saved dictionary such as `vars(signal)`, or a class instance with the same fields. Requires string `event_id`, `channel`, and `data`, plus whole-number `number` and `total` within the signal slot limits. Optional string `source_station_id` defaults to this station when omitted.
zh: `SignalTransmission`、保存的字典（例如 `vars(signal)`），或具有相同字段的类实例。需要字符串 `event_id`、`channel` 和 `data`，以及位于信号槽位限制内的整数 `number` 和 `total`。可选字符串 `source_station_id` 省略时默认为该站点。

en: Add one to the supplied event's refusal count without opening a slot. A different event replaces this station's current board.
zh: 在不开放槽位的情况下，将所提供事件的拒绝计数加一。不同事件会替换该站点当前板。

en: A `SignalTransmission`, a saved dictionary such as `vars(signal)`, or a class instance with the same fields and validation as `reveal()`.
zh: `SignalTransmission`、保存的字典（例如 `vars(signal)`），或与 `reveal()` 具有相同字段和验证的类实例。

en: Publish up to **6** labelled rows for an event. A different event replaces this station's current board. The board displays supplied values without validating them.
zh: 为一个事件发布最多 **6** 行带标签的行。不同事件会替换该站点当前板。板显示提供的值，但不进行验证。
这些行描述的事件 ID。

en: String-keyed dictionary of labels and display values.
zh: 以字符串为键的标签与显示值字典。

en: Clear the board, its rejection count, and any published conclusion.
zh: 清除板、其拒绝计数以及任何已发布的结论。

en: This station's current board publication metadata.
zh: 该站点当前板的发布元数据。

en: Raw transmissions audible to this powered station right now. More than one event may be present. Ordering is stable, but copies sharing a packet number are not ordered by validity. The receiver stores no history.
zh: 当前该通电站点可听到的原始传输。可能存在多个事件。顺序稳定，但共享同一数据包编号的副本不会按有效性排序。接收器不存储历史。

en: Event id shared by every packet and noise duplicate.
zh: 每个数据包与噪声副本共用的事件 ID。

en: Declared packet number. Different copies may declare the same number.
zh: 声明的数据包编号。不同副本可能声明相同编号。

en: Declared packet count for the event.
zh: 声明的该事件数据包总数。

en: Channel on which this copy is heard.

Encoded movement record `event_id|number|total|dx|dy`. Numbered records form a movement sequence beginning at `(0, 0)`; `dx` and `dy` are that record's signed movement offsets, and the sequence endpoint is the event coordinate.
zh: 编码的移动记录 `event_id|number|total|dx|dy`。编号记录构成从 `(0, 0)` 开始的移动序列；`dx` 与 `dy` 是该记录的有符号移动偏移，序列终点即事件坐标。

en: Checksum supplied with the transmission: the full sum of every character's ASCII code in `.data`, with no modulo reduction.
zh: 随传输提供的校验和：`.data` 中每个字符 ASCII 码的完整求和，不进行取模缩减。

en: Storm-start world-clock timestamp shared by every valid and noisy copy in this event.
zh: 此事件中每个有效与噪声副本共用的风暴起始世界时钟时间戳。

en: World-clock timestamp when this event's live listening window closes.
zh: 此事件的实时监听窗口关闭时的世界时钟时间戳。

en: Physical Weather Station hearing this copy.
zh: 听到此副本的实体气象站。

en: World-clock hour when the strike landed.
zh: 雷击落点时的世界时钟小时。

en: Electrical energy carried by the strike in Wh.
zh: 雷击携带的电能，单位为 Wh。

en: Whether an eligible Lightning Rod banked this strike.
zh: 合格避雷针是否捕获了这次雷击。

en: Keep only the geometry shared by both zones.
zh: 仅保留两个区域共享的几何形状。

en: Keep everything covered by either zone.
zh: 保留任一区域覆盖的全部内容。

en: Remove the other zone's geometry from this zone.
zh: 从当前区域中移除另一区域的几何形状。

en: Keep geometry present in only one of the two zones.
zh: 保留仅存在于两个区域之一的几何形状。

en: Centroid as `[x, y]` in m, or `None` for an empty zone. This describes visible storm geometry, not its hidden aftermath.
zh: 质心，以米为单位的 `[x, y]`；空区域为 `None`。这描述的是可见的风暴几何形状，而非其隐藏余波。

en: `True` when the point is inside the zone.

zh: 世界坐标 x，单位 m。
世界坐标 y，单位 m。
当区域不覆盖任何内容时为 `True`。

en: Highest survey tier achieved on this vent: `"basic"` / `"wide"` / `"deep"`, or `None` if not yet surveyed. Reads live: a deeper re-survey upgrades held Site objects too. Higher tiers unlock more fields below. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 该喷口已完成的最高勘测等级：`"basic"` / `"wide"` / `"deep"`，若尚未勘测则为 `None`。实时读取：更深入的重新勘测也会升级已持有的 Site 对象。更高等级会解锁下方更多字段。勘测前的声呐结果仍保持未揭示；请在勘测后获取新对象。

en: Duration of the active phase in minutes. Requires **deep** survey: returns `None` otherwise.
zh: 活跃阶段的持续时间，单位分钟。需要 **deep** 勘测：否则返回 `None`。

en: Duration of the dormant phase in minutes. Requires **deep** survey: returns `None` otherwise.
zh: 休眠阶段的持续时间（分钟）。需要**深度**勘测：否则返回 `None`。

en: The vent's phase right now: `"active"` or `"dormant"`. Reads live: poll it from a held Site object and it follows the cycle. Returns `None` before the vent is surveyed. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 喷口当前阶段：`"active"` 或 `"dormant"`。实时读取：从持有的 Site 对象轮询时，它会跟随循环。喷口勘测前返回 `None`。勘测前的声呐结果仍保持未揭示；勘测后请获取新对象。

en: Game-minutes until the next phase flip. Reads live: poll it in a control loop to act before dormancy hits. Requires **deep** survey: returns `None` otherwise. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 距离下一次阶段切换的游戏分钟数。实时读取：在控制循环中轮询它，以便在休眠期到来前采取行动。需要**深度**勘测：否则返回 `None`。勘测前的声呐结果仍保持未揭示；勘测后请获取新对象。

en: Peak steam rate during active phase (t/h). Requires **wide** survey: returns `None` at basic.
zh: 活跃阶段的峰值蒸汽速率（t/h）。需要**广角**勘测：基础勘测时返回 `None`。

en: Steam rate right now (t/h: **0** during dormant phase). Reads live. Requires **wide** survey: returns `None` at basic. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 当前蒸汽速率（t/h：休眠阶段为 **0**）。实时读取。需要**广角**勘测：基础勘测时返回 `None`。勘测前的声呐结果仍保持未揭示；勘测后请获取新对象。

en: Boolean: `True` if a Thermal Cap is currently deployed on this vent. Reads live. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 布尔值：如果该喷口当前部署了热液盖，则为 `True`。实时读取。勘测前的声呐结果仍保持未揭示；勘测后请获取新对象。

en: Machine id of the currently deployed Thermal Cap, or empty string when no cap is present. Reads live. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 当前部署的热液盖机器 id，若无盖则为空字符串。实时读取。勘测前的声呐结果仍保持未揭示；勘测后请获取新对象。

en: Fluid id this deposit emits, e.g. `"ammonia"` (common, usable direct) or `"raw_chlorine"` (rare, needs the Refiner). `None` until `surveyed`.
zh: 该矿藏排放的流体 id，例如 `"ammonia"`（常见，可直接使用）或 `"raw_chlorine"`（稀有，需要精炼机）。`surveyed` 前为 `None`。

en: `"gas"` (tap with an **Exotic Gas Cap**) or `"liquid"` (tap with an **Exotic Spring Tap**). `None` until `surveyed`.
zh: `"gas"`（使用**奇异气体盖**抽取）或 `"liquid"`（使用**奇异泉眼抽取器**抽取）。`surveyed` 前为 `None`。

en: `"common"` emits the usable fluid with no refining; `"uncommon"` and `"rare"` emit a raw feedstock the Refiner converts with tar. Rarer deposits are sparser and stay dormant longer. `None` until `surveyed`.
zh: `"common"` 无需精炼即可排放可用流体；`"uncommon"` 和 `"rare"` 排放原料，由精炼机用焦油进行转化。越稀有的矿藏越稀疏，休眠时间也越长。`surveyed` 前为 `None`。

en: Highest survey tier achieved on this deposit: `"basic"` / `"wide"` / `"deep"`, or `None` if not yet surveyed. Reads live: a deeper re-survey upgrades held Site objects too. Higher tiers unlock more fields below. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 该矿藏已完成的最高勘测等级：`"basic"` / `"wide"` / `"deep"`，尚未勘测则为 `None`。实时读取：更深入的重新勘测也会升级持有的 Site 对象。更高等级会解锁下方更多字段。勘测前的声呐结果仍保持未揭示；勘测后请获取新对象。

en: The deposit's phase right now: `"active"` (emitting) or `"dormant"` (idle). Reads live: poll it from a held Site object and it follows the cycle. Returns `None` before the deposit is surveyed. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 矿藏当前阶段：`"active"`（排放中）或 `"dormant"`（空闲）。实时读取：从持有的 Site 对象轮询时，它会跟随循环。矿藏勘测前返回 `None`。勘测前的声呐结果仍保持未揭示；勘测后请获取新对象。

en: Duration of the active phase in minutes. Requires **deep** survey: returns `None` otherwise.
zh: 活跃阶段的持续时间（分钟）。需要**深度**勘测：否则返回 `None`。

en: Duration of the dormant phase in minutes (rare deposits stay dormant longest). Requires **deep** survey: returns `None` otherwise.
zh: 休眠阶段的持续时间（分钟）（稀有矿藏休眠最久）。需要**深度**勘测：否则返回 `None`。

en: Game-minutes until the next phase flip. Reads live: poll it in a control loop to act before dormancy hits. Requires **deep** survey: returns `None` otherwise. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 距离下一次阶段切换的游戏分钟数。实时读取：在控制循环中轮询它，以便在休眠期到来前采取行动。需要**深度**勘测：否则返回 `None`。勘测前的声呐结果仍保持未揭示；勘测后请获取新对象。

en: Peak output rate during the active phase (t/h). Requires **wide** survey: returns `None` at basic.
zh: 活跃阶段期间的峰值输出速率（t/h）。需要**广域**勘测：基础勘测时返回 `None`。

en: Output rate right now (t/h: **0** during dormant). Reads live. Requires **wide** survey: returns `None` at basic. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 当前输出速率（t/h：休眠期间为 **0**）。实时读取。需要**广域**勘测：基础勘测时返回 `None`。勘测前的声呐结果不会揭示；请在勘测后获取新对象。

en: Boolean: `True` if an Exotic Gas Cap or Exotic Spring Tap is currently deployed on this deposit. Reads live. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 布尔值：如果此矿藏上当前部署了奇异气体盖或奇异泉眼阀，则为 `True`。实时读取。勘测前的声呐结果不会揭示；请在勘测后获取新对象。

en: Machine id of the currently deployed cap/tap, or empty string when none is present. Reads live. A pre-survey sonar result stays unrevealed; obtain a new object after surveying.
zh: 当前部署的盖/阀机器 id，若不存在则为空字符串。实时读取。勘测前的声呐结果不会揭示；请在勘测后获取新对象。

en: Geometric start coordinate of this pipe piece as a `Position`. This is construction geometry, not flow direction. Returns `None` only if malformed state contains no segment geometry.
zh: 此管道段的几何起始坐标，作为 `Position`。这是建造几何，不是流向。仅当异常状态不包含线段几何时返回 `None`。
