zh: 无法读取此设备上的存档。数据未作更改。请检查存储访问权限后重试。

en: The title screen could not start safely because window-close handling is unavailable. Nothing was changed. Retry, or exit and relaunch the game.
zh: 因缺少窗口关闭处理功能，标题画面无法安全启动。数据未作更改。请重试，或退出游戏后重新启动。

en: Restore a backup into a new save slot
zh: 将备份恢复至新的存档槽位

en: The backup was restored as a new save. Load it now?
zh: 备份已恢复为新存档。是否立即加载？

en: That backup could not be imported. Check that it is a valid Code: Terraform save file.
zh: 无法导入该备份。请确认其为有效的《代号:地球化》存档文件。

en: File import is not available on this platform.
zh: 此平台不支持文件导入功能。

en: Send a note or bug report
This save is still on disk. Something blocked the game from reading it just now, which is usually temporary. Close any program that may have the file open and try again.
zh: 该存档仍在磁盘上。刚才有程序阻止了游戏读取它，这通常是暂时性的。请关闭可能正在占用该文件的程序，然后重试。

en: Delete the {planet} save for {commander} from Day {day}, including all history snapshots? This cannot be undone.
zh: 是否删除 {commander} 于 {planet} 第 {day} 天的存档（含所有历史快照）？此操作不可撤销。

en: This save changed while confirmation was open. Nothing was deleted. Review it and try again.
zh: 确认期间存档已发生变更。未执行删除。请检查后重试。

en: This save no longer exists. Nothing was deleted.
zh: 该存档已不存在。未执行删除。

en: Could not fully delete this save. The save is still available. Please try again.
zh: 无法完全删除该存档。存档仍可用。请重试。

en: The save was deleted, but the save list could not be refreshed.
zh: 存档已删除，但存档列表无法刷新。

en: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Restoring keeps your existing snapshots and protects the save you leave as Before restore. Autosaves do not remove this checkpoint; your next restore replaces it. You can also delete individual snapshots.
zh: 还原将保留现有快照，并将当前存档设为“还原前”检查点加以保护。自动存档不会移除此检查点，下次还原时会将其替换。你也可以单独删除特定快照。

en: No earlier saves yet, keep playing for a minute.
zh: 暂无历史存档，请继续游玩片刻。

en: Restore {when}? Your current save will become the Before restore checkpoint, replacing the previous one. All other history snapshots stay available.
zh: 确定要还原至 {when} 吗？当前存档将作为“还原前”检查点保存，并替换之前的记录。其他历史快照均会保留。

en: Delete only the snapshot from {when}? Your current save and every other snapshot will remain.
zh: 确定仅删除 {when} 的快照吗？当前存档及其他所有快照均会保留。

en: This snapshot changed while confirmation was open. Nothing was deleted. Review the refreshed history and try again.
zh: 确认期间该快照已发生变更。未删除任何内容。请查看刷新后的历史记录并重试。

en: This snapshot no longer exists. Nothing was deleted. The history list was refreshed.
zh: 该快照已不存在。未删除任何内容。历史记录列表已刷新。

en: This snapshot is currently keeping the save recoverable. Restore it first or delete the entire save.
zh: 该快照当前正维持存档的可恢复状态。请先将其还原，或删除整个存档。

en: Could not fully delete this snapshot. The snapshot is still available. Please try again.
zh: 未能完全删除此快照。快照仍然存在。请重试。

en: That history save is no longer available. The history list was refreshed.
zh: 该历史存档已不可用。历史记录列表已刷新。

en: The rewind could not be saved. Recovery history was kept. Please try again.
zh: 回退操作未能保存。已保留恢复历史记录。请重试。

en: The save backup could not be exported. Please try again.
zh: 无法导出存档备份。请重试。

en: File export is not available on this platform.
zh: 此平台不支持文件导出。

en: A separate practice session for learning code, sensors, components, self, and simple control loops.
zh: 独立练习环节，用于学习代码、传感器、组件、自身及基础控制回路。

en: All {total} lessons complete. Ready for field deployment.
zh: 全部 {total} 节课程已完成。已具备实地部署条件。
已获得认证：认证地球化工程师。

en: Code Lab progress could not be read. Nothing was changed. Check storage access and try again.
zh: 无法读取代码实验室进度。未作任何更改。请检查存储访问权限并重试。

en: The compute core is still working; retry after a short pause.
zh: 计算核心仍在运行；请暂停片刻后重试。

en: The compute core finished and produced a value.
zh: 计算核心已运行完毕并输出结果。

en: The Heat Generator power setpoint is now {power}.
zh: 热力发电机的功率设定值现已设为 {power}。

en: The Pressure Generator accepted this sweep's sync attempt.
zh: 压力发电机已接受本轮扫描的同步请求。

en: This sweep already has a sync attempt, so the Pressure Generator state did not change.
zh: 本轮扫描已存在同步请求，因此压力发电机状态未发生改变。

en: sync() is self-only and belongs to the Pressure Generator's own script.
zh: sync() 仅限自身调用，属于压力发电机自身的脚本。

en: The Sample Probe found 2 units of ice_shard.
zh: 采样探针发现了 2 单位的冰屑。

en: The hidden number is higher than {guess}.
The hidden number is lower than {guess}.
Could not replace the full lesson source. Reopen Code Lab and try again.
zh: 无法替换完整课程源代码。请重新打开代码实验室并重试。

en: Code Lab could not run this lesson. Try again or reopen Code Lab.
zh: 代码实验室无法运行此课程。请重试或重新打开代码实验室。

en: The lesson took too long to run. Try again or reopen Code Lab.
zh: 课程运行超时。请重试或重新打开代码实验室。

en: Run the lesson code to check it.
zh: 运行课程代码以验证结果。

en: Code Lab source saved for this session.
zh: 本次会话的代码已保存。

en: Run finished. Check the note below.
zh: 运行完成。请查看下方提示。
温度 -- | 气压 -- | 周期 0
温度 {temp}C | 气压 {pressure} kPa | 周期 {ticks}

en: Tell me what happened, what felt off, or what you want to see.
zh: 请描述遇到的问题、体验不佳之处，或您希望看到的内容。
附带本次会话的诊断信息

en: I read every report, but this form does not let me reply directly. For questions or follow-up, join Discord.
zh: 我会阅读每一份报告，但此表单无法让我直接回复。如有疑问或需进一步沟通，请加入 Discord。

en: Join Discord for questions or follow-up
zh: 加入 Discord 以提问或获取后续回复

en: Could not open Discord. Please use the Discord link from the main menu.
zh: 无法打开 Discord。请使用主菜单中的 Discord 链接。

en: Could not send feedback. Please try again.
The feedback server could not accept this report. Please review it and try again.
zh: 反馈服务器无法接收此报告。请检查后重试。

en: Feedback sending is not connected in this build yet.
zh: 此构建版本尚未接入反馈发送功能。
请至少输入 3 个字符。

en: Controls the overall volume of all game audio.
zh: 控制所有游戏音频的总音量。

en: Controls gameplay and progression sounds, including research unlocks, achievements, equipment deployment, and system alerts.
zh: 控制游戏进程与玩法音效，包括研究解锁、成就达成、设备部署及系统警报。

en: Controls interface sounds, including button clicks, confirmations, purchases, sales, and map controls.
zh: 控制界面音效，包括按钮点击、确认、购买、出售及地图操作。

en: Controls spoken transmissions and character dialogue.
zh: 控制语音通讯与角色对话。

en: Pause the simulation while the game is in another tab or minimized. This happens immediately, without an AFK timer.
zh: 当游戏处于其他标签页或最小化时暂停模拟。此操作立即生效，无需等待挂机计时器。

en: Place the Camera Feed, Planet Map, and Harvesting field beside their related readings or equipment instead of above them. This starts on for ultrawide displays and off for regular displays. Your choice is remembered.
zh: 将监控画面、星球地图与采集区置于相关读数或设备的侧边，而非上方。超宽屏默认开启，普通屏幕默认关闭。系统将记住您的选择。

en: Silence all audio while the game is in another tab or minimized.
zh: 当游戏处于其他标签页或最小化时，静音所有音频。
使用鼠标滚轮缩放代码

en: Hold Ctrl while scrolling over code to change its size. On macOS, Command and trackpad pinch also work. Normal scrolling and horizontal gestures are unchanged.
zh: 在代码区域滚动时按住 Ctrl 键可调整大小。在 macOS 上，Command 键与触控板捏合手势同样有效。常规滚动与横向手势不受影响。

en: Changes the font used in script editors, playgrounds, training editors, autocomplete, and code-entry fields. Console output keeps its table-safe font stack.
zh: 更改脚本编辑器、演练场、训练编辑器、自动补全及代码输入框中使用的字体。控制台输出将保留其表格安全字体栈。

en: Allows fonts such as JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Code, and Fira Code to visually combine operators like != or <=. The underlying code remains unchanged.
zh: 允许 JetBrains Mono、Cascadia Code 和 Fira Code 等字体将 != 或 <= 等运算符进行视觉合并。底层代码保持不变。

en: Language changes apply after restart so the current interface does not partially change mid-session.
zh: 语言更改将在重启后生效，以避免游戏过程中界面显示不一致。

en: {name} is a built-in preset, so its colors stay as shipped. Make a copy to get a theme you can edit and keep.
zh: {name} 是内置预设，其配色将保持出厂状态。请创建副本，即可获得可编辑并保存的主题。

en: {name} is yours. Open the Studio to change its colors, rename it, or start another.
zh: {name} 已属于你。打开工作室可更改颜色、重命名或创建新主题。

en: Pick a preset to start from, then change any color you like. The preset itself is never touched.
zh: 选择一个预设作为起点，然后随意更改颜色。原始预设不会被修改。

en: You already have a theme with that name.
Delete "{name}"? Its colors go with it, and this cannot be undone.
zh: 删除“{name}”？其配色将一并删除，且此操作不可撤销。

en: Colors you have not changed keep following this preset, along with everything the Studio does not list, such as shadows and map colors.
zh: 未修改的颜色将继续跟随此预设，同时包含 Studio 未列出的所有元素（如阴影和地图颜色）。

en: You have reached the limit of {count} themes. Delete one to make room.
zh: 主题数量已达上限 {count}。请删除一个以腾出空间。

en: Put every color back to {name}? Your theme keeps its name.
zh: 将所有颜色恢复为 {name}？主题名称将保留。

en: Shows vertical guide lines in the code editor so nested Python blocks are easier to follow.
zh: 在代码编辑器中显示垂直参考线，以便更清晰地查看嵌套的 Python 代码块。

en: Soft-wraps long lines in the code editor so they stay visible instead of scrolling sideways. Also toggleable from the editor's View menu.
zh: 在代码编辑器中对长行进行软换行，使其保持可见而非横向滚动。也可从编辑器的“视图”菜单中切换。

en: Controls how many spaces Tab inserts, auto-indent uses, and indentation guides are spaced. Default is 4 spaces.
zh: 控制 Tab 键插入的空格数、自动缩进使用的空格数以及缩进参考线的间距。默认为 4 个空格。

en: Controls keyboard behavior inside the code editor only. Vim mode is opt-in and does not affect game menus or dashboard controls.
zh: 仅控制代码编辑器内的键盘操作。Vim 模式需手动开启，不会影响游戏菜单或主界面操作。
优先自动补全，其次缩进

en: Choose whether Tab accepts the current autocomplete suggestion when the popup is open, or always behaves as indentation.
zh: 选择当自动补全弹窗打开时，按 Tab 键是接受当前建议，还是始终执行缩进。

en: Compatibility option for streamed or remote trackpads where horizontal swipes scroll vertically inside code windows. Leave off unless you see that exact issue.
zh: 针对流式或远程触控板的兼容选项，可解决水平滑动在代码窗口内变为垂直滚动的问题。除非遇到此特定问题，否则请保持关闭。

en: Enable this if punctuation or international characters do not type correctly in code editors. It gives layout-aware text priority over shortcuts, including Shift punctuation such as : and ;, AltGr characters such as [, ], {, }, \, |, and @, macOS Option characters, and non-Latin letters. Dead keys and IME composition keep using native input.
zh: 若在代码编辑器中无法正常输入标点或国际字符，请启用此项。它将使基于键盘布局的文本输入优先于快捷键，包括 Shift 标点（如 : 和 ;）、AltGr 字符（如 [, ], {, }, \, | 和 @）、macOS Option 字符以及非拉丁字母。死键和输入法组合仍使用原生输入。

en: When on, each script's Console button opens or focuses its own console window, so several can stay visible at once. When off, one shared console switches to the script whose Console button you click.
zh: 开启时，每个脚本的“控制台”按钮将打开或聚焦其专属的控制台窗口，以便同时查看多个窗口。关闭时，所有脚本共用一个控制台，点击按钮将切换至对应脚本的输出。
在独立窗口中打开面板

en: When on, pop-out and window-open actions open a real separate window you can move to another monitor. When off, panels float inside the game window as before. Desktop only, and works best in windowed mode.
zh: 开启时，弹出或打开面板操作将创建真实的独立窗口，可拖拽至其他显示器。关闭时，面板将如旧版般在游戏窗口内浮动。仅限桌面端，在窗口化模式下效果最佳。

en: Pick which tracks the in-game music player will shuffle. Story tracks appear here once you've heard them in any save.
zh: 选择游戏内音乐播放器将随机播放的曲目。剧情曲目在任意存档中听过一次后，将在此处显示。

en: Restore every preference on this tab to its default. Other settings, saved progress, and scripts are not affected.
zh: 将此选项卡中的所有偏好设置恢复为默认值。其他设置、已保存的进度和脚本不受影响。

en: Restore every preference on this tab to its default? Any custom values on this tab will be lost.
zh: 是否将此选项卡中的所有偏好设置恢复为默认值？此选项卡上的自定义值将丢失。

en: Choose which tab a script editor opens to when that editor has no remembered tab.
zh: 选择脚本编辑器在未记录上次标签页时，默认打开的标签页。

en: Open scripts in Dock by default
zh: 默认以停靠模式打开脚本

en: When enabled, Manage opens script editors directly in Dock mode with the console attached.
zh: 启用后，管理界面将直接在附带控制台的停靠模式下打开脚本编辑器。

en: Open a separate console when running
zh: 运行时打开独立控制台

en: Used only with Separate window placement. Explicit Console buttons always open the requested script's output.
zh: 仅在“独立窗口”布局下生效。控制台按钮始终会打开对应脚本的输出。

en: Inline adds a persistent, script-specific output pane to every floating editor, including while the script is idle. Dock mode always uses its built-in console.
zh: 内联模式会为每个浮动编辑器添加一个持久的专属输出面板，即使在脚本空闲时也会保留。停靠模式始终使用其内置控制台。

en: Code: Terraform draws its interface with your system's web engine. On most Linux systems it can hand that drawing to your graphics card, which keeps the interface responsive at 4K and on HiDPI screens. On a few driver and desktop combinations that path is unstable, so the game chooses the safe one for you. Change this only if the interface is slow at high resolution, or if it renders incorrectly.
zh: 代号:地球化 使用系统的网页引擎绘制界面。在大多数 Linux 系统上，它可以将绘制工作交给显卡，从而在 4K 和 HiDPI 屏幕上保持界面响应。少数驱动与桌面环境组合下该路径不稳定，因此游戏会为你选择安全的方式。仅当界面在高分辨率下缓慢，或渲染不正确时才更改此项。

en: Let the game choose for your hardware.
Faster at 4K and on HiDPI screens. If the game fails to start, it returns to compatibility rendering by itself.
zh: 在 4K 和 HiDPI 屏幕上更快。如果游戏无法启动，它会自动返回兼容渲染。

en: Slower at high resolution. Works on every system.
zh: 高分辨率下较慢。适用于所有系统。

en: This applies the next time you start the game. Returning to the main menu is not enough.
zh: 此项将在下次启动游戏时生效。仅返回主菜单不够。
当前正在使用显卡渲染。
当前正在使用兼容渲染。

en: Currently using compatibility rendering, because your graphics driver and desktop are a combination known to render incorrectly with acceleration.
zh: 当前正在使用兼容渲染，因为您的显卡驱动与桌面环境组合在启用加速时已知会渲染异常。

en: Currently using compatibility rendering, because acceleration was tried on this computer and the game did not start.
zh: 当前正在使用兼容渲染，因为此计算机已尝试启用加速，但游戏未能启动。

en: Currently using compatibility rendering, because no graphics device is available to this computer.
zh: 当前正在使用兼容渲染，因为此计算机没有可用的图形设备。

en: A launch option is choosing the renderer for this launch, so this setting has no effect until you remove it.
zh: 启动选项正在为本次启动选择渲染器，因此在移除该选项之前，此设置无效。

en: This computer has no writable cache folder, so the choice cannot be saved.
zh: 此计算机没有可写的缓存文件夹，因此无法保存此选择。

en: The graphics acceleration choice could not be saved.
zh: 图形加速选择无法保存。

en: Editor font, size, and indentation guides.
zh: 编辑器字体、字号与缩进参考线。
快捷键、制表符行为与缩进。

en: Optional fixes for keyboard and pointing-device input that is reported differently by some systems.
zh: 针对部分系统键盘与指针设备输入报告差异的可选修复。

en: How script editors open, and where each script's console lives.
zh: 脚本编辑器的打开方式及各脚本控制台的显示位置。
脚本标签页置于停靠编辑器上方

en: Moves the script tab strip to the top edge of the editor in Dock mode. Floating mode and the remaining bottom controls are unchanged.
zh: 在停靠模式下将脚本标签栏移至编辑器顶部边缘。浮动模式及底部其余控件保持不变。
编辑器位于右侧（停靠模式）

en: Moves the docked editor panel to the right side of the screen instead of the left.
zh: 将停靠的编辑器面板移至屏幕右侧而非左侧。

en: Tools for working with this save's scripts from an external code editor.
zh: 用于通过外部代码编辑器管理当前存档脚本的工具。

en: The DOCS page walks through VS Code, other editors, console output in your editor, and every file in the scripts folder.
zh: DOCS 页面会介绍 VS Code、其他编辑器、编辑器中的控制台输出，以及脚本文件夹中的每个文件。

en: Install or update the bundled Code Terraform extension and open this save's scripts in VS Code. Requires VS Code on this computer. This is optional; other editors can use the same scripts and language service.
zh: 安装或更新随附的“代号:地球化”扩展，并在 VS Code 中打开此存档的脚本。需要此计算机上已安装 VS Code。此项可选；其他编辑器可以使用相同的脚本和语言服务。
在 VS Code 中打开

en: VS Code is ready for Code Terraform scripts.
zh: VS Code 已准备好处理“代号:地球化”脚本。

en: The game could not find the VS Code launcher. If VS Code is installed, use the ? beside VS Code for manual setup steps.
zh: 未找到 VS Code。请安装 VS Code 后重试，或使用“打开脚本文件夹”配合其他编辑器。

en: VS Code setup could not finish. Use the ? beside VS Code for manual setup steps.
zh: VS Code 设置无法完成。请检查 VS Code 的扩展权限，或使用“显示扩展包”安装随附扩展。

en:
If automatic setup fails, install the bundled extension manually. VS Code must already be installed.

1. Choose **Show Extension Package** in these settings. This opens the folder containing `code-terraform.vsix`.
2. In VS Code, open **View > Command Palette**, choose **Extensions: Install from VSIX...**, and select that file. Reload VS Code if prompted.
3. With your save open in the game, choose **Open Scripts Folder** in these settings.
4. In VS Code, choose **File > Open Folder...** and select that same scripts folder.

Keep the save open in the game. Save your edits in VS Code to sync them. If the extension is already installed, start at step 3. Turn off **Pause When Inactive** if you want scripts to keep running while you edit.
zh:
如果自动设置失败，请手动安装随附的扩展。必须先安装 VS Code。

1. 在这些设置中选择**显示扩展包**。这会打开包含 `code-terraform.vsix` 的文件夹。
2. 在 VS Code 中，打开**查看 > 命令面板**，选择**扩展：从 VSIX 安装...**，然后选择该文件。如果提示，请重新加载 VS Code。
3. 在游戏中打开存档，在这些设置中选择**打开脚本文件夹**。
4. 在 VS Code 中，选择**文件 > 打开文件夹...**，然后选择同一个脚本文件夹。

请在游戏中保持打开存档。在 VS Code 中保存编辑以同步。如果已安装该扩展，请从步骤 3 开始。如果你希望在编辑时脚本继续运行，请关闭**不活动时暂停**。

en: Manual package for custom VS Code installations. Use Set Up VS Code above for automatic installation. Other editors can use the shared language server and debug adapter described in the guide.
zh: 面向自定义 VS Code 安装的手动安装包。使用上方的“设置 VS Code”进行自动安装。其他编辑器可以使用指南中介绍的共享语言服务器和调试适配器。

en: Could not open the extension package. Reinstall this game build and try again.
zh: 无法打开扩展包。请重新安装此游戏版本后重试。

en: Safety limits for scripts that create unusually large values.
zh: 针对生成异常大数值的脚本的安全限制。

en: Standard stops a single script string above 10,000 characters. Expanded raises the limit to 100,000 characters. Expanded scripts can use more memory and make a simulation tick take longer. The limit cannot be disabled.
zh: 标准模式会拦截长度超过 10,000 字符的单个脚本字符串。扩展模式将上限提升至 100,000 字符。扩展脚本会占用更多内存，并可能导致模拟单步耗时增加。该限制无法关闭。

en: Standard stops any one list, tuple, dictionary, set, or eagerly collected iterator result above 10,000 items. Expanded raises the limit to 50,000 items. Expanded collections can use substantially more memory and make simulation ticks take longer, especially when values are nested. Infinite iterators still cannot be fully collected. The limit cannot be disabled.
zh: 标准模式会拦截任何包含超过 10,000 个元素的列表、元组、字典、集合或已完全收集的迭代器结果。扩展模式将上限提升至 50,000 个元素。扩展集合会显著增加内存占用，并可能延长模拟步进时间，尤其在值存在嵌套时更为明显。无限迭代器仍无法被完全收集。该限制无法关闭。

en: Restore the interface if a saved window layout becomes unusable.
zh: 若已保存的窗口布局无法正常使用，请使用此功能恢复界面。

en: If your window layout becomes stuck or a window ends up off-screen or unresponsive, use this to restore the default layout. The in-game windows will close and the console will reopen. If the introductory tutorial is still in progress, its current script editor will also reopen.
zh: 若窗口布局卡死、窗口移出屏幕外或无响应，请使用此功能恢复默认布局。游戏内窗口将关闭，控制台会重新打开。若入门教程仍在进行中，当前的脚本编辑器也会随之重新打开。

en: Reset window layout? All open windows will close and the default layout will be restored. Your scripts and progress are not affected.
zh: 确认重置窗口布局？所有已打开的窗口将关闭并恢复默认布局。您的脚本与进度不会受影响。

en: Open this save's scripts folder in your file manager. Useful when editing scripts in an external editor.
zh: 在系统文件管理器中打开当前存档的脚本文件夹。便于使用外部编辑器修改脚本。

en: Scripts folder opened, but some files could not be synchronized. Retry saving after resolving any file or permission errors.
zh: 脚本文件夹已打开，但部分文件未能同步。请解决文件或权限错误后，重试保存。

en: Couldn't save "{file}" to disk for external editing: {error}. Your script is safe in the game, only its external-editor file sync is affected.
zh: 无法将“{file}”保存到磁盘以供外部编辑：{error}。您的脚本在游戏内依然安全，仅外部编辑器文件同步功能受到影响。

en: the file could not be synchronized; check storage access and try again
zh: 文件无法同步；请检查存储访问权限后重试

en: it contains modified code owned by a timeline discarded by Restore Snapshot; rename or remove that file after recovering anything you need
zh: 该文件包含已被“恢复快照”丢弃的时间线所修改的代码；请在找回所需内容后，重命名或删除该文件。

en: Couldn't load "{file}" from disk because it has {size} characters and scripts are limited to {limit}. The in-game source was left unchanged. Reduce the file externally and save it again.
zh: 无法从磁盘加载“{file}”，因为它包含 {size} 个字符，而脚本上限为 {limit}。游戏内源码保持不变。请在外部缩减文件大小后重新保存。

en: Mirror console output to log files
zh: 将控制台输出镜像至日志文件
代号:地球化 控制台日志：{name}
[日志镜像已截断，超出大小限制已刷新]

en: Appends visible console output to bounded .log files under this save's scripts/logs folder, where the VS Code extension shows it live in its Code Terraform output channel and other editors can follow logs/all.log. en:
## Goal

Earth needs to verify your instruments are working. Connect to Earth, read the temperature, and transmit it back.

## Steps

• Get the `thermometer` and `transmitter` components
• Read the current temperature
• Connect the transmitter to `"earth"`
• Send the reading with the key `"current_temperature"`

Every piece of equipment has a display name and a component ID. Click **INFO** on any sensor card to see its ID. Pass that ID to `get_component()` to access the equipment in code:

```
thermometer = get_component("thermometer")
```

Open the linked component entries in DOCS to find the temperature-reading and transmission methods.

> **Component handle rule:** `get_component("transmitter")` gives you a transmitter handle, like an object instance. `connect()` opens the channel on that handle. Store it in a variable and keep using that same variable; a second `get_component("transmitter")` call is a different handle and has not connected yet.
zh:
## 目标

地球方面需验证你的仪器是否正常运行。连接地球，读取温度，并将数据传回。

## 步骤

• 获取 `thermometer` 和 `transmitter` 组件
• 读取当前温度
• 将发射器连接至 `"earth"`
• 使用键 `"current_temperature"` 发送读数

每台设备均配有显示名称与组件ID。点击任意传感器卡片上的 **INFO** 即可查看其ID。将该ID传入 `get_component()` 即可在代码中访问该设备：

```
thermometer = get_component("thermometer")
```

打开 DOCS 中链接的组件条目，查找温度读取与传输方法。

> **组件句柄规则：** `get_component("transmitter")` 会返回一个发射器句柄，类似于对象实例。`connect()` 负责在该句柄上建立通道。请将其存入变量并始终复用该变量；再次调用 `get_component("transmitter")` 将生成一个全新的句柄，且该新句柄尚未建立连接。
指挥官，欢迎执行本次任务。

en: What do I have to work with?
zh: 我手头有哪些可用资源？

en: A terminal, basic equipment, and whatever you can build. Everything on this rock runs on code.
zh: 一台终端、基础装备，以及你能自行搭建的一切。这颗星球上的所有设备都由代码驱动。

en: You'll set up power, repair broken sensors, build infrastructure. Every machine you deploy is yours to program.
zh: 你将负责搭建供电系统、修复故障传感器并建设基础设施。你部署的每一台机器都归你编程控制。

en: Writing code to fix a planet. My resume's gonna look interesting.
zh: 靠写代码来改造星球。我的履历看起来会挺有意思的。

en: Just make sure the planet looks good first.
zh: 先确保这颗星球能看再说。

en: There are resources on the surface worth money. Scan, harvest, ship it back. Earth pays on delivery.
zh: 地表有具备商业价值的资源。扫描、采集、运回。交货即付款。

en: And Commander, the better this planet shapes up, the bigger your budget gets.
zh: 另外，指挥官，这颗星球的地球化进展越好，你的预算就越高。

en: The brochure made this sound like a piece of cake.
zh: 宣传册上把这任务说得轻而易举。

en: I don't know if this will get through.
zh: 我不知道这能不能传过去。

en: They said I'm not supposed to use this channel.
zh: 他们说我不该用这个频道。

en: I drew you a picture but I can't send it this way, so I'll just tell you...
zh: 我给你画了幅画，但没法这样传给你，所以我直接跟你说吧……

en: it's our house, and the big tree, and you're on the planet waving back.
zh: 画里有我们的房子，还有那棵大树，你就在星球上朝我们挥手。

en: The sky here looks weird at night now.
zh: 现在晚上的天空看起来有点奇怪。

en: That's enough honey. We need to go.
zh: 好了亲爱的，我们得走了。
算是吧……大多数晚上都睡。

en: You never slept as a baby, you know that?
zh: 你小时候可是从来不睡觉的，知道吗？

en: Your mother would get up, hold you at the window. Sky was the only thing that calmed you down. We thought something was wrong with you for a while.
zh: 你妈妈会起来，抱着你站在窗前。只有天空能让你安静下来。我们一度以为你出了什么问题。

en: You asked her once where the stars went during the day. You were four. Weren't satisfied with her answer.
zh: 你有一次问她，白天星星都去哪儿了。那时候你才四岁。你对她的回答可不满意。

en: She's good. Was here Sunday. Got flour on the ceiling making cookies. Said it could be a star.
zh: 她挺好的。周日来过这儿。做饼干的时候把面粉弄到天花板上了。她说那可以是一颗星星。

en: She asked me which star you're on.
zh: 她问我你在哪颗星星上。

en: Told her that her daddy is the star.
zh: 我跟她说，她爸爸就是那颗星星。

en: In his sleep. He didn't suffer.
zh: 在睡梦中走的。没受什么苦。

en: I wanted to tell you myself.
Thursday. I didn't wait. You couldn't have made it back.
zh: 周四。我没等。你也赶不回来。

en: I couldn't reach Kate. I thought you should know.
zh: 我联系不上凯特。我想你应该知道。

en: Did he... at the end... did he say anything?
zh: 他……到最后……有没有说什么？

en: He wasn't really talking by then.
zh: 那时候他已经说不出话了。

en: Elliot, they're going to kill you.
zh: 艾略特，他们会杀了你的。

en: The return vehicle. They've rigged it. I saw the order.
zh: 返回载具。他们动了手脚。我看过命令。

en: You were never supposed to come back. None of you were.
zh: 你们本来就不该回来。你们谁都不例外。

en: Don't board it. Whatever they tell you. Whatever excuse they give.
zh: 别登上去。不管他们怎么说。不管他们找什么借口。

en: The woman on your comms, the new one. Don't trust her. Not one word.
zh: 你通讯频道里的那个女人，新来的那个。别信她。一个字也别信。

en: If this is the last transmission you get from me...
zh: 如果这是你最后一次收到我的通讯……

en: Stay out there. Don't come home.
Elliot, listen to me. I don't have long.
zh: 艾略特，听我说。我的时间不多了。

en: People are disappearing. Researchers, scientists, anyone connected to your mission.
zh: 人们正在失踪。研究员、科学家，任何与你任务有关的人都在消失。

en: I found files. Your name is in them.
zh: 我找到了一些文件。里面有你的名字。

en: Elliot, they didn't come back. None of them came back.
zh: 艾略特，他们没有回来。一个都没回来。

en: You weren't selected because you're a good engineer.
zh: 你被选中，不是因为你是个优秀的工程师。

en: There's something about your blood... your DNA... it doesn't...
zh: 你的血液……你的DNA……有些不对劲……
指挥官。地球已收到你的数据读数。

en: You're moving in the right direction. Good work.

zh: 我这边感觉没什么变化。

en: A number at a time. That's how it works.
zh: 一次只更新一个数值。流程就是这样。

en: Earth's happy with the pace. Keep going.
zh: 地球对当前进度很满意。继续推进。
为什么。她为什么会在这里。

en: You did all the work, Elliot.
zh: 所有工作都是你完成的，艾略特。

en: And they were waiting for it.
zh: 而它们一直在等这一刻。

en: We don't have a name for them.
zh: 我们还没有给它们命名。

en: They contacted Earth a week ago. From a nearby system.
zh: 一周前它们联系了地球。来自邻近星系。

en: They showed us what they could do.
zh: 它们向我们展示了它们的能力。

en: And they gave us a choice.
zh: 它们给了我们一个选择。

en: Deliver Elena, or they do it themselves. With less care for the rest of us.
zh: 交出艾琳娜，否则它们会亲自动手。届时可不会顾及我们其他人的死活。

en: They say she's the key. Something in her biology. Something they planted.
zh: 它们说她是钥匙。她生理特征里的某种东西。是它们埋下的。

en: Generations ago, Elliot. She was already this when she was born.
zh: 几代以前的事了，艾略特。她出生时就已经是这样了。

en: I'm sorry. She has to be sacrificed.
zh: 我很抱歉。她必须被牺牲。

en: It's her or all of us.
zh: 要么是她，要么是我们所有人。

en: We never knew they were out there.
zh: 我们从未察觉它们的存在。

en: They believed they were saving themselves.
Extraction fleet departing. Arrival in seventeen cycles.
zh: 撤离舰队已出发。预计十七个周期后抵达。

en: For a million years we waited.
I caused this? Elena! Don't take her!
zh: 是我造成的？艾琳娜！别带走她！
地球已审阅你的遥测数据。
指挥官，你无法阻止这一切。

en: You've seen them. We have too.
zh: 你见过它们了。我们也是。

en: They are frozen, but still alive, Commander.
zh: 它们处于冻结状态，但依然存活，指挥官。

en: Mission Control, Commander. Your readout is through.
zh: 这里是任务控制中心，指挥官。您的遥测读数已接通。

en: That's not information I have, Commander.
zh: 我无权获知该信息，指挥官。

en: I need to speak with him.
Earth needs a surface status from you. Power, output, atmospheric deltas. Standard channels.
zh: 地球方面需要您的地表状态报告。电力、输出、大气差值。通过标准频道传输。
请在方便时提交，指挥官。
任务控制中心通话结束。

en: Just wanted to hear your voice.
Dad. You don't call just to talk. What's going on.
zh: 爸。你不会只是打电话来闲聊的。到底怎么了。

en: Sick? What do you mean, Dad? How sick?
zh: 病了？什么意思，爸？病得有多重？
他们说是几个月。可能更短。

en: Months?! What are you talking about, are they sure? Did you get a second opinion?
zh: 几个月？！你在说什么，他们确定吗？有没有找别的医生再看看？

en: I'll come home. I'm coming home.
Dad, I'm not staying out here while you're...
zh: 爸，你这样我怎么可能还待在外面……

en: You finish what you went there to do.
zh: 把你去那儿该做的事做完。

en: I don't care about this rock. None of this matters. None of it.
zh: 我不在乎这颗破石头。这一切都不重要。一点都不。

en: I've seen you chase that sky your whole life. You don't come back here because I'm leaving. You stay out there.
zh: 我见过你一辈子都在追逐那片天空。别因为我快走了就回来。你留在那儿。

en: I don't want to be out here without you.
zh: 我不想在没有你的地方待着。

en: You were always my son. Don't let anyone tell you different.
zh: 你永远都是我的儿子。别让任何人告诉你不是。

en: Got your readout. You're ahead of schedule.
zh: 收到你的遥测数据。你进度超前了。

en: It's not like I can play video games around here.
zh: 反正这地方也没法打游戏。

en: Let's talk about the mission, Commander. Did you deliver any new orders this week?
zh: 还是谈任务吧，指挥官。这周有收到新指令吗？

en: Copy that, Daniel... sorry. Elliot. Long shift on my end.
zh: 收到，丹尼尔……抱歉。艾略特。我这边值班太久了。
频道串线了，指挥官。抱歉。

en: He was a Commander. Before you.
zh: 他以前也是指挥官。在你之前。

en: What do you mean before me?
I've been on this rotation a long time, Elliot.
zh: 我在这个轮值周期上待了很久了，艾略特。

en: You're doing good work out there. Better than most of them.
zh: 你在那边干得不错。比大多数人都强。

en: Keep private notes. Just to be safe.
zh: 留点私人记录。以防万一。

en: Safe? From what? Most dangerous thing I've seen around here is some unhinged minerals.
zh: 安全？防什么？这地方我见过最危险的东西也就是些失控的矿物。

en: Take care of yourself out there, Elliot.
zh: 在那边照顾好自己，艾略特。

en: Switch to the Code tab, type boot() and click ▶ to run.
zh: 切换到“代码”标签页，输入 boot() 并点击 ▶ 运行。

en: Systems are coming online. Watch the console output...
zh: 系统正在启动。请观察控制台输出……

en: Type activate_power() and click ▶ to power up.
zh: 输入 activate_power() 并点击 ▶ 启动电源。

en: Power is online! Type activate_sensors() and click ▶ to bring sensors online.
zh: 电源已接通！输入 activate_sensors() 并点击 ▶ 启动传感器。

en: Establish uplink: connect to Earth, read the temperature, and transmit it. Check the editor for hints.
zh: 建立上行链路：连接地球，读取温度并发送数据。请查看编辑器中的提示。

en: Open DOCS to see all available commands and learn the language.
zh: 打开 DOCS 查看所有可用命令并学习该语言。

en: Writing scripts? Try **DOCK** mode, click the ⊞ Dock button (highlighted) for a comfortable IDE layout.
zh: 编写脚本？试试 **DOCK** 模式，点击 ⊞ Dock 按钮（高亮显示）即可获得舒适的 IDE 布局。

en: This is the comfortable coding mode, editor, console, DOCS, and other windows all as tabs. Click **Undock** (highlighted) to return to floating windows.
zh: 这是舒适的编码模式，编辑器、控制台、DOCS 及其他窗口均整合为标签页。点击 **Undock**（高亮显示）即可恢复浮动窗口。

en: Click here to open the editor if you accidentally closed it
zh: 若不慎关闭编辑器，请点击此处重新打开

en: Uplink established. 2,500 credits received. Open Shop in the sidebar to power the base and start oxygen production.
zh: 上行链路已建立。收到 2,500 积分。打开侧边栏中的商店，为基地供电并启动制氧。

en: Earth received your transmission. You earned 2,500 credits, and the Shop and Biology Lab are now open.
zh: 地球已收到你的传输信号。你获得 2,500 积分，商店与生物实验室现已开放。

en: Pressure Sensor and Oxygen Sensor are already deployed. Repair Pressure to open Harvesting and Contracts; repair Oxygen to open Atmosphere.
zh: 压力传感器与氧气传感器已部署。修复压力传感器以开放采集与合约；修复氧气传感器以开放大气系统。

en: Open the Shop in the left sidebar and buy a Solar Generator, a Battery, and an Oxygen Generator.
zh: 打开左侧边栏的商店，购买一台太阳能发电机、一块电池和一台氧气发电机。

en: Open Inventory and Deploy all three.
zh: 打开库存并部署全部三台设备。

en: Script the Solar Generator and Oxygen Generator. At 1 ppt oxygen, Auto Feeders unlock and the Biology Lab can be automated.
zh: 为太阳能发电机与氧气发电机编写脚本。氧气浓度达到 1 ppt 时，自动投喂器将解锁，生物实验室即可实现自动化。

en: Repair the sensors in either order. This starter setup reserves enough credits and power for manual Biology now and automated Biology after Auto Feeders unlock.
zh: 可按任意顺序修复传感器。此初始配置预留了充足的积分与电力，用于当前手动处理生物样本，以及在自动投喂器解锁后实现生物自动化。

en: Four early approaches, each teaching a different kind of play:
zh: 四种早期发展路线，各自侧重不同的玩法风格：

en: use the Biology workbench buttons to collect, analyze, extract, and deliver samples. No code is needed, so this is the easiest first payout. It becomes repetitive after the first few orders.
zh: 使用生物工作台按钮收集、分析、提取并交付样本。无需编写代码，因此这是最轻松的首笔收入来源。完成前几单后流程会趋于重复。

en: after repairing the Pressure Sensor, write a simple grid sweep that moves, collects, stores, and sells. Heat and the held-item slot need attention, but pathfinding and route optimization are optional.
zh: 修复压力传感器后，编写一段简单的网格遍历脚本，执行移动、收集、存储与出售操作。需留意热量与携带槽状态，但路径寻路与路线优化属可选内容。

en: after repairing the Pressure Sensor, solve contained programming puzzles with minimal machine state and safe retries. These favor loops, collections, and abstract problem solving.
zh: 修复压力传感器后，在有限的机器状态与安全重试机制下解决封闭式编程谜题。此类玩法侧重循环、集合与抽象问题解决能力。

en: after Auto Feeders unlock, coordinate the Bio Collector, Bio Lab, and Bio Exchange through separate scripts. Your code must manage orders, reagents, item ports, completed output, and recovery from partial state.
zh: 自动投喂器解锁后，通过独立脚本协调生物采集器、生物实验室与生物交换站。你的代码需管理订单、试剂、物品端口、成品输出，以及处理中断后的状态恢复。

en: Every credit feeds back into the Shop. More machines means more terraforming progress.
zh: 所有积分均可用于商店消费。设备越多，地球化进度越快。

en: This guide also lives in DOCS, search for "First Steps" anytime to revisit it.
zh: 本指南亦收录于 DOCS 中，随时搜索“First Steps”即可重新查阅。
🎧 新歌曲：{title}，🔇 音乐已静音
🎧 新歌曲：{title}，🔉 音乐音量较低

en: Open Info in a separate window so you can see it while editing code
zh: 在独立窗口中打开信息，以便在编辑代码时查看

en: Switch to "{name}"? This script's current code has already been saved.
zh: 切换到“{name}”？此脚本的当前代码已保存。

en: Delete saved variant "{name}"? Scripts using it keep their current code and continue in their current running, paused, or stopped state.
zh: 确定删除已保存的变体“{name}”？使用该变体的脚本将保留当前代码，并维持原有的运行、暂停或停止状态。

en: "{name}" changed after this machine loaded it. This machine keeps running the copy it has until you update it.
zh: “{name}”在此机器加载后已发生变更。该机器将继续运行其已加载的副本，直至您执行更新。

en: Load the current "{name}" onto this machine.
zh: 将当前“{name}”加载到此机器上。

en: Save the code this machine is running as its own variant, leaving "{name}" alone.
zh: 将此机器当前运行的代码保存为其专属变体，不影响“{name}”。

en: Load this variant onto matching machines of this exact type.
zh: 将此变体加载到所有同类型的匹配机器上。

en: Load this variant onto every compatible machine tier in this script family.
zh: 将此变体加载到该脚本系列中所有兼容的机器层级上。

en:
Load variant "{name}" into {count} matching machine script and make it active there?

{machines}

If "{name}" is active on this machine, its current catalog source is what gets applied. Running scripts restart automatically with the applied code. Paused and stopped scripts remain paused or stopped.

This is a one-time copy, not a permanent link. Future edits to "{name}" update its catalog entry but do not change other machines' loaded copies. Use Apply to all again when you want them to load the updated version.
zh:
是否将变体“{name}”加载到 {count} 个匹配的机器脚本中并设为激活状态？

{machines}

若“{name}”在此机器上处于激活状态，将应用其当前的目录源。运行中的脚本将自动重启并应用新代码。已暂停或已停止的脚本将保持原状态。

此为一次性复制，非永久链接。后续对“{name}”的编辑仅更新其目录条目，不会更改其他机器已加载的副本。若需加载更新后的版本，请再次使用“应用到全部”。

en:
Load variant "{name}" into {count} matching machine scripts and make it active there?

{machines}

If "{name}" is active on this machine, its current catalog source is what gets applied. Running scripts restart automatically with the applied code. Paused and stopped scripts remain paused or stopped.

This is a one-time copy, not a permanent link. Future edits to "{name}" update its catalog entry but do not change other machines' loaded copies. Use Apply to all again when you want them to load the updated version.
zh:
是否将变体“{name}”加载到 {count} 个匹配的机器脚本中并设为激活状态？

{machines}

若“{name}”在此机器上处于激活状态，将应用其当前的目录源。运行中的脚本将自动重启并应用新代码。已暂停或已停止的脚本将保持原状态。

此为一次性复制，非永久链接。后续对“{name}”的编辑仅更新其目录条目，不会更改其他机器已加载的副本。若需加载更新后的版本，请再次使用“应用到全部”。

en: No matching machines in this variant scope with the same script slot found.
zh: 未在此变体范围内找到具有相同脚本槽位的匹配机器。
变体已应用到 {count} 个匹配脚本。
变体已应用到 {count} 个匹配脚本。

en: Could not apply variant. Review the matching scripts and try again.
zh: 无法应用变体。请检查匹配的脚本后重试。

en: The variant or matching scripts changed while confirmation was open. Review them and try again.
zh: 确认对话框打开期间，变体或匹配脚本已发生变更。请重新检查后重试。

en: The variant or script changed while the dialog was open. Review it and try again.
zh: 对话框打开期间，变体或脚本已发生变更。请重新检查后重试。

en: Exact-type variants come first. Compatible family variants are available below. Editing saves changes to the active variant. Other scripts keep their loaded copies until you update them.
zh: 精确类型变体优先显示。兼容的家族变体列于下方。编辑将保存至当前激活的变体。其他脚本将保留已加载的副本，直至您手动更新。

en:
Named variants are shared saved versions of a script. A machine can have an exact-type catalog plus a compatible family catalog. For example, Small, Medium, and Large Drones share family variants because they expose the same script API, while a Small Drone can still keep specialized exact-type variants. Contract variants stay with one contract, Custom Panel variants are shared by panels, and library variants are shared by libraries.

`Main` is this script's own fallback code. Editing in the Code tab saves changes to the active variant. Changes to `Main` stay with this script; changes to a named variant update its shared catalog entry. Other scripts keep their loaded copies until you explicitly update them. If another script edits the shared variant, an older loaded copy is marked **outdated**. Click **Update** to load the latest version, or **Keep mine** to save the current copy as a separate variant.

To add a named variant, click **Duplicate Variant** or **Create Variant from Selection…**. Compatible machines let you choose whether the variant belongs only to this exact type or to the whole family.

**Use** loads a named variant into this script's running code. **Apply to all** uses the variant's scope: exact-type variants target that type, while family variants target every compatible tier with the same script slot. Running scripts restart automatically with the applied code. Paused and stopped scripts keep their state.

Renaming or deleting a named variant changes its catalog. When a saved variant is deleted, scripts using it keep their current working code and lifecycle, then detach to `Main`. This lets you remove an obsolete variant without interrupting automation or losing local edits. `Main` is protected so each script always keeps its own fallback.

A variant's description is the note you type when you save it. Leave it blank and it falls back to the script's top-of-file `"""docstring"""` or first `#` comment. In the list, click the ▸ arrow to expand a long description.
zh:
命名变体是脚本的共享已保存版本。机器可以有精确类型目录和兼容家族目录。例如，小型、中型和大型无人机共享家族变体，因为它们提供相同的脚本 API，但小型无人机仍可保留专门的精确类型变体。合约变体属于某个合约，自定义面板变体由面板共享，库变体由库共享。

`Main` 是本脚本自身的回退代码。在“代码”标签页中编辑会将更改保存到当前变体。对 `Main` 的更改保留在本脚本中；对命名变体的更改会更新其共享目录条目。其他脚本会保留已加载的副本，直到你显式更新它们。如果另一个脚本编辑了共享变体，较早的已加载副本会被标记为**过期**。点击**更新**以加载最新版本，或点击**保留我的**以将当前副本保存为独立变体。

要添加命名变体，请点击**复制变体**或**从选区创建变体…**。兼容机器允许你选择该变体仅属于此精确类型，还是属于整个家族。

**使用**将命名变体加载到此脚本的运行代码中。**应用到全部**会依据变体的作用范围：精确类型变体针对该类型，而家族变体针对所有具有相同脚本槽位的兼容等级。运行中的脚本会自动重启并应用代码。暂停和停止的脚本会保持其状态。

重命名或删除命名变体会改变其目录。删除已保存变体时，使用它的脚本会保留当前工作代码和生命周期，然后分离回 `Main`。这让你可以在不中断自动化或不丢失本地修改的情况下移除过时变体。`Main` 受保护，因此每个脚本始终保留自己的回退。

变体的描述是保存时输入的备注。留空时，它会回退到脚本文件顶部的 `"""docstring"""` 或第一个 `#` 注释。在列表中，点击 ▸ 箭头展开长描述。

en: These I/O ports move discrete items with `connect(name)`, `take(item_id, count)`, and `send(item_id, count)`. A stationary `InputSlot` can recover buffered items with `eject(destination, item_id, count)` without changing its source connection. Inventory is a destination only at Nocturna Base; remote machines must eject to compatible freight at their own outpost. Exact item properties and destination capacity are preserved. A successful ejection cancels fractional work attached to the staged input; active or reserved work rejects without moving anything. Use `input.flush()` only when you intend to destroy the entire input buffer. Item transfers require Auto Feeders research. Named fluid ports such as `water_out`, `oil_out`, and `gas_out` use the separate `FluidPort` API described above.
zh: 这些 I/O 端口通过 `connect(name)`、`take(item_id, count)` 和 `send(item_id, count)` 移动离散物品。固定的 `InputSlot` 可通过 `eject(destination, item_id, count)` 回收缓冲区内的物品，且不会改变其源连接。库存仅能在诺克图纳基地作为目标；远程机器必须将物品弹出至其所在前哨站的兼容货舱中。物品的精确属性与目标容量将得到保留。成功弹出将取消与已暂存输入关联的部分加工进度；若存在进行中或已预留的工作，则操作会被拒绝且不移动任何物品。仅当您打算清空整个输入缓冲区时，才使用 `input.flush()`。物品传输需要完成“自动供料”研究。诸如 `water_out`、`oil_out` 和 `gas_out` 等命名流体端口使用上文所述的独立 `FluidPort` API。

en: Oxygen sensor hardware is intact but returning raw unprocessed data. Calibrate it to bring it online.

en:
## Problem

This sensor is offline. Its hardware works but the readings need software processing.

The sensor outputs raw values like **0.047** but the system expects numbers like **4.7**.

Example: `0.047` → `4.7`

## What to do

• Read the current value from the sensor
• Convert it to the correct format
• Calibrate the sensor with the result

> Read the actual value from the sensor, **don't hardcode numbers**. The reading changes.
zh:
## 问题

该传感器处于离线状态。其硬件正常，但读数需要软件处理。

传感器输出的原始值如 **0.047**，但系统期望的数值格式如 **4.7**。

示例：`0.047` → `4.7`

## 操作步骤

• 读取传感器的当前值
• 将其转换为正确的格式
• 使用转换后的结果校准传感器

> 读取传感器的实际值，**切勿硬编码数字**。读数会发生变化。

en:
## Problem

This sensor is offline. Its signal is unstable; it returns readings that may be corrupted.

Corrupted readings are **odd** numbers. Valid readings are **even**.

Examples:

• `17` → `18` (odd, so add 1)
• `24` → `24` (even, already valid)

## Useful operator

Use `%` to check the remainder after division. For this sensor, `value % 2 == 0` means the value is even; any remainder means it is odd.

## What to do

• Read the current value from the sensor
• If it's odd, add 1 to correct it
• If it's even, it's already valid
• Stabilize the sensor with the result

> Read the actual value from the sensor, **don't hardcode numbers**. The reading changes.
zh:
## 问题

该传感器处于离线状态。其信号不稳定，返回的读数可能已损坏。

损坏的读数为**奇数**。有效的读数为**偶数**。

示例：

• `17` → `18`（奇数，因此加 1）
• `24` → `24`（偶数，已有效）

## 实用运算符

使用 `%` 检查除法后的余数。对于此传感器，`value % 2 == 0` 表示值为偶数；若有余数则为奇数。

## 操作步骤

• 读取传感器的当前值
• 若为奇数，加 1 进行修正
• 若为偶数，则已有效
• 使用修正后的结果稳定传感器

> 读取传感器的实际值，**切勿硬编码数字**。读数会发生变化。

en:
Runs the selected ownerless document against the current save.

Use named document tabs to keep separate diagnostics and manual tools. Each document autosaves in this game save, but runs only when you choose Run.

Use Playground to inspect unlocked APIs, call get_component(...), print values, and test helpers without editing a machine script.

Playground runs on the normal simulation clock: sleep() waits for game time and pauses while the game is paused.

Playground does not provide self and will not run owner-only hardware actions such as scan(), drill(), or move(). Those must run from the machine that owns them.

One-shot code, not a persistent background script.
zh:
针对当前存档运行所选的独立文档。

使用命名文档标签页可隔离不同的诊断与手动工具。各文档会随游戏存档自动保存，但仅在你选择“运行”时执行。

利用沙盒可检查已解锁的 API、调用 `get_component(...)`、打印数值并测试辅助函数，无需修改机器脚本。

沙盒遵循常规模拟时钟运行：`sleep()` 会等待游戏时间流逝，并在游戏暂停时同步暂停。

沙盒不提供 `self` 上下文，无法执行仅限所属硬件的操作（如 `scan()`、`drill()` 或 `move()`）。此类操作必须在对应机器上运行。

此为一次性代码，非持久后台脚本。

en: The replacement must contain only JSON-safe values within the Signal Bus size and nesting limits: `None`, booleans, finite numbers, strings, lists, tuples, and dictionaries with string keys. A dictionary keyed by numbers or any other type is rejected; convert the key with `str(key)`. The queued message was not changed.
zh: 替换内容必须只包含符合信号总线大小与嵌套限制的 JSON 安全值：`None`、布尔值、有限数字、字符串、列表、元组，以及键为字符串的字典。以数字或其他类型作为键的字典会被拒绝；请使用 `str(key)` 转换键。排队中的消息未被更改。

channels 必须包含 1 至 128 个条目。

en: The archive prefix must use letters, numbers, `_`, `.`, `:`, or `-` and be at most 96 characters.
zh: 存档前缀必须仅包含字母、数字、`_`、`.`、`:` 或 `-`，且长度不得超过 96 个字符。

en: Data Archive values must be JSON-safe: `None`, booleans, finite numbers, strings, lists, tuples, and dictionaries with string keys. A dictionary keyed by numbers or any other type is rejected; convert the key with `str(key)`. A value may contain at most 8 nested levels, 16,384 total nodes counting values and containers, and 4,096 characters per string or dictionary key.
zh: 数据档案值必须是 JSON 安全的：`None`、布尔值、有限数字、字符串、列表、元组，以及键为字符串的字典。以数字或其他类型作为键的字典会被拒绝；请使用 `str(key)` 转换键。单个值最多可包含 8 层嵌套、16,384 个总节点（计入值和容器），且每个字符串或字典键最多包含 4,096 个字符。

en: The sonar sweep completed. Inspect `result.sites` for every compatible contact found.
zh: 声呐扫描已完成。请检查 `result.sites` 以查看所有兼容目标。

zh: 声呐扫描已完成。`result.sites` 包含所有兼容目标；若为空列表，则表示范围内未发现兼容目标。

en: The sweep completed, but a nearby contact exceeds this sonar's detection limit. Upgrade the sonar and scan again.
zh: 扫描已完成，但附近存在超出该声呐探测上限的目标。请升级声呐后重新扫描。

en: The completed sweep detected a nearby unresolved contact above the mounted sonar's hardness limit.
zh: 扫描已检测到附近存在未解析目标，其硬度已超出当前声呐的探测上限。

en: The sweep completed, but a nearby contact requires a higher-tier sonar.
zh: 扫描已完成，但附近存在需要更高级别声呐的目标。

en: The completed sweep detected a nearby unresolved contact that the mounted sonar tier cannot classify.
zh: 扫描已检测到附近存在未解析目标，当前声呐等级无法对其进行分类。

en: The sweep completed, but current research cannot classify a nearby contact.
zh: 扫描已完成，但当前研究进度不足以对附近目标进行分类。

en: The completed sweep detected a nearby unresolved contact whose classification research is not unlocked.
zh: 扫描已检测到附近存在未解析目标，其分类研究尚未解锁。

en: The sonar sweep completed, but a nearby contact requires a different scanner type.
zh: 声呐扫描已完成，但附近存在需要其他类型扫描仪的目标。

en: The completed sweep detected a nearby contact that vehicle sonar cannot classify.
zh: 扫描已检测到附近存在载具声呐无法分类的目标。

zh: 载具正忙于执行其他外勤行动，请等待其完成。

zh: 当前有其他外勤行动正在占用该载具。

zh: 载具电池电量不足以执行声呐扫描。

zh: 载具正执行其他外勤作业，请等待其完成。

zh: 当前有其他外勤作业正在占用该载具。

zh: 站点 {site_id} 需要尚未解锁的研究项目。

en: The mounted sonar tier cannot survey site {site_id}.
zh: 已搭载的声呐等级不足以勘测站点 {site_id}。

en: Site {site_id} is outside the mounted sonar's current range.
zh: 站点 {site_id} 超出已搭载声呐的当前探测范围。

zh: 站点 {site_id} 的矿物硬度超出已搭载声呐的探测上限。

zh: 载具电池电量不足以勘测站点 {site_id}。

zh: survey() 需要传入非空的站点 ID 或 Site 对象。

Inventory has no capacity for the held item.
zh: 库存容量已满，无法容纳所持物品。

zh: 请求的库存槽位不存在。

en: The waste chamber was emptied. This dump applied an efficiency penalty of {penalty}.
zh: 废料舱已清空。此次倾倒产生了 {penalty} 的效率惩罚。

en: Consumed a queued message from channel {channel}.
zh: 已消费来自通道 {channel} 的一条队列消息。

en: One message was removed from the queue and returned. Without a message id it was the oldest; with an id it was exactly the requested message.
zh: 已从队列中移除并返回一条消息。若未指定消息 ID，则返回最旧的一条；若指定了 ID，则返回请求的对应消息。

en: The channel has no queued message to consume.
zh: 该通道没有可消费的队列消息。

en: No message id was requested and the channel has no queued messages. Nothing was consumed.
zh: 未请求消息 ID，且该通道无队列消息。未消费任何内容。

en: No message with that id is waiting on this channel. It may already have been received or removed.
zh: 该通道上无此 ID 的待处理消息。该消息可能已被接收或移除。

en: The supplied message id is not waiting on this channel. No other message was consumed.
zh: 提供的消息 ID 不在该通道等待队列中。未消费其他消息。
已创建施工蓝图：{count} 张。

en: The required construction technology or kit recipe has not been unlocked.
zh: 尚未解锁所需的建造技术或套件配方。

en: The requested map structure kind is not supported.
zh: 不支持请求的地图结构类型。

en: A structure rotation must be 0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
zh: 结构旋转角度必须为 0、90、180 或 270 度。

en: The requested infrastructure medium is not supported.
zh: 不支持请求的基础设施介质。

en: A bridge axis must be "horizontal" or "vertical".
zh: 桥梁轴向必须为 "horizontal" 或 "vertical"。

en: A deconstruction layer must be "auto", "building", "gas", "liquid", or "power".
At least one requested construction tile lies outside the planet bounds.
zh: 至少有一个请求的施工地块超出星球边界。

en: The requested position does not contain the map feature required by this structure.
zh: 请求的位置不包含该结构所需的地图特征。

en: The required map feature has not been surveyed.
zh: 所需的地图特征尚未完成勘测。

en: The selected Mining Drill cannot cut this deposit's mineral hardness.
zh: 所选采矿钻机无法切割该矿床的矿物硬度。

en: The required map feature already has a built or planned extractor.
zh: 所需地图特征已建有或规划了提取器。

en: The requested structure footprint overlaps existing or planned construction, or a physical anomaly.
zh: 请求的建筑占地范围与现有或规划中的建筑，或物理异常区域重叠。

en: The requested structure footprint crosses an Outpost or physical-anomaly clearance boundary.
zh: 请求的建筑占地范围跨越了前哨站或物理异常的安全边界。

en: The requested endpoints do not define a usable construction route.
zh: 指定的端点无法构成有效的建造路线。

en: The requested construction or deconstruction is blocked by existing or planned infrastructure.
zh: 请求的建造或拆除操作受现有或规划中的基础设施阻挡。

en: The matching infrastructure route already exists, so no blueprint was created.
zh: 匹配的基础设施路线已存在，故未生成蓝图。

en: A matching deconstruction blueprint is already queued.
zh: 匹配的拆除蓝图已处于队列中。

en: More than one deconstructable target matches that position and layer. Choose a more specific layer or another tile.
zh: 该位置与图层对应多个可拆除目标。请选择更具体的图层或更换图块。

en: There is no completed deconstructable target at that position.
zh: 该位置不存在已完工的可拆除目标。

en: Neighboring volatile nodes in the clear cell: {reading}.
zh: 安全单元内的相邻不稳定节点：{reading}。

en: The probed cell contained a volatile node. The lattice is faulted. Call grid.reset() to clear the fault and try again.
zh: 探测单元内存在不稳定节点，导致网格故障。请调用 grid.reset() 清除故障并重试。

en: The probed cell contained a volatile node and faulted the lattice.
zh: 探测单元内存在不稳定节点，已导致网格故障。

en: The lattice was faulted by an earlier probe. Call grid.reset() to clear the fault and try again.
zh: 晶格因先前的探测操作发生故障。请调用 `grid.reset()` 清除故障后重试。

en: An earlier volatile-node probe faulted the lattice.
zh: 先前的不稳定节点探测导致晶格发生故障。

en: LatticeGrid.probe() requires numeric x and y coordinates.
zh: `LatticeGrid.probe()` 需要数值型的 x 和 y 坐标。

en: LatticeGrid.probe() requires finite whole-number coordinates inside the 32 by 32 grid.
zh: `LatticeGrid.probe()` 需要位于 32x32 网格范围内的有限整数坐标。

en: The lattice fault was cleared. The hidden board and starting cell are unchanged.
zh: 晶格故障已清除。隐藏棋盘与起始单元格保持不变。

en: The vault opened and released its key.
zh: 保险库已开启并释放了钥匙。

en: The vault can open only from the exit cell.
zh: 保险库仅能在出口单元格处开启。

en: This DrillModule reference is stale because its module is no longer mounted. Read self.drill again after mounting a drill.
zh: 此 `DrillModule` 引用已失效，因为其对应模块已卸载。安装钻头后请重新读取 `self.drill`。

en: This drone does not currently have an electric powertrain and mounted Battery Pack.
zh: 该无人机当前未配备电力传动系统及已安装的电池组。

en: This drone does not currently have a heli powertrain.
zh: 该无人机当前未配备旋翼动力系统。

en: The contract probe received an argument or element of the wrong type.
zh: 合约探测接收到类型错误的参数或元素。

en: The contract probe received a value, shape, or coordinate outside its documented domain.
zh: 合约探测接收到超出文档定义范围的值、形状或坐标。

en: Archive.flip() requires numeric row and column coordinates.
zh: `Archive.flip()` 需要数值型的行与列坐标。

en: Archive.flip() requires finite whole-number coordinates inside the archive grid.
zh: `Archive.flip()` 需要位于档案网格范围内的有限整数坐标。
`Vault.move()` 需要字符串类型的方向参数。

en: Vault.move() accepts only north, south, east, or west.
zh: Vault.move() 仅接受 north、south、east 或 west。

en: Analyzer.read() requires a list containing only string tokens.
zh: Analyzer.read() 需要一个仅包含字符串标记的列表。

en: Analyzer.read() requires exactly five tokens forming a recognized aligned group.
zh: Analyzer.read() 需要恰好五个标记，以构成一个已识别的对齐组。

en: Loom.weave() accepts at most 30 characters in each input.
zh: Loom.weave() 的每个输入最多接受 30 个字符。
Arbiter.play() 需要一个数值型单元格。

en: Arbiter.play() requires a finite whole-number cell in the **0-8** range.
zh: Arbiter.play() 需要一个位于 **0-8** 范围内的有限整数单元格。

zh: CoreDevice.submit() 需要一个数值索引和一个仅包含数值字节的列表。

en: CoreDevice.submit() requires a whole-number slot in the **0-9** range and a correctly sized list of whole-number bytes in the **0-255** range.
zh: CoreDevice.submit() 需要一个位于 **0-9** 范围内的整数槽位，以及一个长度正确、包含 **0-255** 范围内整数字节的列表。
已永久丢弃 {discarded} 个单位。
已永久丢弃所请求的 {requested} 个单位中的 {discarded} 个。

The vehicle is occupied by another field action.
zh: 该载具正被另一项外勤操作占用。

zh: 请求的货舱货架不存在。

zh: 已移动 {moved}/{requested} 个请求单位；受源端可用量或目标端容量限制，传输未完全执行。

en: No units were requested, so no state changed.
zh: 未请求任何单位，状态未发生变更。

zh: 已将 {moved} 个单位合并至更少的仓库格位中。

zh: 每种精确的物品变体已占用最少的仓库格位。

zh: 已将 {moved} 个单位重新安置至更少的先锋便携货箱中。

已永久丢弃 {moved} 个缓存单位。

The source is reserving its cargo for an active operation.

zh: 源在规划后发生变更；请基于最新状态重试。

zh: 已配置的目标属于其他前哨站。

zh: 载具位于目标服务区域之外。

zh: 已配置的目标无法接收兼容货物。

en: The destination is latched to or accepts a different material.
zh: 目标已锁定或仅接受其他物料。

en: The destination rejects this biological material because its biome is incompatible.
zh: 目标因生态区不兼容而拒绝此生物物料。

en: This hot cargo requires Shield Plating on the drone.
zh: 此高危货物要求无人机装备屏蔽镀层。

zh: 此前哨站无兼容的铅制容器。

zh: 目标缺少接收此物料所需的世界状态配置。

en: One transfer can contain only one item id.
zh: 单次传输仅可包含一个物品ID。

en: This hot cargo must move through a compatible Lead Cask.
zh: 此高危货物必须经由兼容的铅制容器运输。

en: Lead Casks accept only supported hot cargo.
zh: 铅罐仅接收支持的活性货物。

en: The active order does not require this item.
zh: 当前订单不需要此物品。

zh: 补给坞的所有材料槽位均已分配给其他所需物品。

zh: 当前订单所需的该物品单位已全部装载或已发货。

zh: 目标已完成工作，不再接收材料。

zh: 载具无法将货物转移至自身。

zh: 源载具必须停止移动后才能移交货物。

en: Lab reagent used in many specimen analyses.
zh: 用于多种样本分析的实验室试剂。

en: Lab reagent for analyzing living-tissue specimens.
zh: 用于分析活体组织样本的实验室试剂。

en: Lab reagent for processing metal-rich specimens.
zh: 用于处理富金属样本的实验室试剂。

en: Lab reagent for identifying rare species.
zh: 用于鉴定稀有物种的实验室试剂。
用于深度冷冻样本的实验室试剂。

en: Fills Bio Orders with collected fragments for credits.
zh: 将收集的碎片用于完成生物订单，以换取积分。

en: Automated collector that gathers biology specimens from the field.
zh: 自动采集器，用于从野外收集生物样本。

en: Analyzes collected specimens and extracts biology samples.
zh: 分析已收集的样本并提取生物样本。

en: Tunes coastal fragments to an order's exact glow color for delivery.
zh: 调节海岸碎片的发光颜色，使其精确匹配订单要求以便交付。

en: Splices genes into geothermal fragments so they carry the genes an order needs.
zh: 将基因剪接至地热碎片中，使其携带订单所需的基因。

en: Heat-casts volcanic fragments for Bio Orders using fabricated materials, steam, and water.
zh: 利用预制材料、蒸汽与水对火山碎片进行热铸，以交付生物订单。

en: Conditions deep fragments for Bio Orders through a five-stage quality inspection.
zh: 通过五阶段质检处理深层碎片，以满足生物订单需求。

en: Turns life-form samples into biome essence. Deploys to a chosen outpost.
zh: 将生命体样本转化为生态精华。可部署至选定前哨站。

en: Combines biome essences into biomass, with higher output from more balanced mixtures. Deploys to a chosen outpost.
zh: 将生态精华混合为生物质，配比越均衡产出越高。可部署至选定前哨站。

en: Biomass Mixer Mk II Upgrade Pack
zh: 生物质混合器 Mk II 升级包

en: Upgrades a deployed Biomass Mixer to Mk II: 4.5× output, 2.4× essence consumption, and 5× power draw.
zh: 将已部署的生物质混合器升级至 Mk II：产出提升至 4.5 倍，精华消耗增至 2.4 倍，功耗增至 5 倍。

en: Revives and houses one creature species at a time. Established colonies can move without losing progress when the destination has enough capacity.
zh: 每次可复苏并容纳单一生物物种。若目标地容量充足，已建立的群落可无损迁移。

en: Feed Maker Mk II Upgrade Pack
zh: 饲料制造机 Mk II 升级包

zh: 在制造机中制作。在库存中使用升级，可升级一台已部署的饲料制造机：**1.5× 制造与输入自动喂料器速度**，运行功率为 **2×**。

zh: 利用植物饲草与采集的生命体合成生物饲料。可部署至选定前哨站。

zh: 将原始异星原料与焦油转化为生物级气体或液体。可部署至选定前哨站。

en: Deploys an Exotic Gas Cap that collects gas from an exotic vent.
zh: 部署异星气体收集盖，用于从异星喷口采集气体。

en: Deploys an Exotic Spring Tap that collects liquid from an exotic spring.
zh: 部署一台异泉取水器，用于从异泉中采集液体。

en: Plant Terraformer Mk II Upgrade Pack
zh: 植物地球化仪 Mk II 升级包

en: Upgrades a deployed Plant Terraformer to Mk II: **2,200 Forage/h** conversion throughput, an input feeder that handles **80 items per step** instead of **16**, **900 W** draw while enabled, and Fertilizer and Growth Accelerant injectors.
zh: 将已部署的植物地球化仪升级至 Mk II：**2,200 饲料/小时**转化吞吐量，输入进料器每步处理 **80 个物品**（原为 **16**），启用时功耗 **900 W**，并配备肥料与生长促进剂注入器。

en: Grow Lamp Mk II Upgrade Pack
zh: 生长灯 Mk II 升级包

en: Upgrades one Grow Lamp to Mk II: **2×** base Forage yield on its own (**+100%**) and **25 W** draw while enabled. The bonus applies during growth to crops that require light in the four orthogonally adjacent cells, while the lamp is powered and enabled. Coverage and growth speed stay the same. Only the strongest covering lamp counts; its bonus adds to other yield bonuses.
zh: 将一台生长灯升级至 Mk II：独立提供 **2 倍**基础饲料产量（**+100%**），启用时功耗 **25 W**。当生长灯通电且启用时，该加成将作用于其正交相邻四格内需光照作物的生长阶段。覆盖范围与生长速度保持不变。仅生效覆盖范围内加成最高的生长灯；其加成可与其他产量加成叠加。

en: Grow Lamp Mk III Upgrade Pack
zh: 生长灯 Mk III 升级包

en: Upgrades one Grow Lamp to Mk III: **4×** base Forage yield on its own (**+300%**) and **100 W** draw while enabled. The bonus applies during growth to crops that require light in the four orthogonally adjacent cells, while the lamp is powered and enabled. Coverage and growth speed stay the same. Only the strongest covering lamp counts; its bonus adds to other yield bonuses.
zh: 将一台生长灯升级至 Mk III：独立提供 **4 倍**基础饲料产量（**+300%**），启用时功耗 **100 W**。当生长灯通电且启用时，该加成将作用于其正交相邻四格内需光照作物的生长阶段。覆盖范围与生长速度保持不变。仅生效覆盖范围内加成最高的生长灯；其加成可与其他产量加成叠加。
洒水器 Mk II 升级包

en: Upgrades one Sprinkler to Mk II: **2×** base Forage yield on its own (**+100%**), **25 W** draw while enabled, and **10 t/h Water** use while supplied. The bonus applies during growth to crops that require water in the four orthogonally adjacent cells, while the sprinkler is powered, enabled, and supplied. Coverage and growth speed stay the same. Only the strongest covering sprinkler counts; its bonus adds to other yield bonuses.
zh: 将一台洒水器升级至 Mk II：独立提供 **2 倍**基础饲料产量（**+100%**），启用时功耗 **25 W**，供水时耗水 **10 吨/小时**。当洒水器通电、启用且供水时，该加成将作用于其正交相邻四格内需水作物的生长阶段。覆盖范围与生长速度保持不变。仅生效覆盖范围内加成最高的洒水器；其加成可与其他产量加成叠加。
洒水器 Mk III 升级包

en: Upgrades one Sprinkler to Mk III: **4×** base Forage yield on its own (**+300%**), **100 W** draw while enabled, and **200 t/h Water** use while supplied. The bonus applies during growth to crops that require water in the four orthogonally adjacent cells, while the sprinkler is powered, enabled, and supplied. Coverage and growth speed stay the same. Only the strongest covering sprinkler counts; its bonus adds to other yield bonuses.
zh: 将一台洒水器升级至 Mk III：独立提供 **4 倍**基础饲料产量（**+300%**），启用时功耗 **100 W**，供水时耗水 **200 吨/小时**。当洒水器通电、启用且供水时，该加成将作用于其正交相邻四格内需水作物的生长阶段。覆盖范围与生长速度保持不变。仅生效覆盖范围内加成最高的洒水器；其加成可与其他产量加成叠加。
栖息地 Mk II 升级包

en: Upgrades a deployed Habitat to Mk II: **2x carrying capacity** and **144-168 W** draw. Breeding speed and biological costs still come from creature adaptations. Each Habitat needs its own pack.
zh: 将已部署的栖息地升级至 Mk II：承载容量提升至 **2 倍**，功耗 **144-168 W**。繁殖速度与生物消耗仍取决于生物适应性。每个栖息地需单独使用一个升级包。

en: Drone module that harvests scanned life forms. Includes a 25 t sealed chamber for one life-form type; Cargo Pods add general capacity.
zh: 无人机模块，用于采集已扫描的生命体。内置25吨密封舱，仅限存放单一生命体类型；货运舱可增加通用容量。

en: Drone module that scans the current surface tile for life forms and records results in the Journal.
zh: 无人机模块，用于扫描当前地表格子的生命体，并将结果记录至日志。
商店目录中不存在该物品。

en: Not enough {name} in Inventory to sell the requested quantity.
zh: 库存中 {name} 不足，无法出售指定数量。

en: {stock} of {max} units remain in shop stock.

zh: 完全充电后储存的能量。

en: Maximum units of a single mineral this container holds.
zh: 该容器可容纳的单一矿物最大数量。

en: Maximum units of a single material this base bin can hold.
zh: 该基础料仓可容纳的单一材料最大数量。

en: Total bulk capacity across 5 material-locked slots (2,000 each), holds several materials at once.
zh: 5个物料锁定槽位的总容量（每槽2,000单位），可同时存放多种物料。

en: Total bulk capacity across 15 material-locked slots, each holding up to 2,000 units of one material.
zh: 15个物料锁定槽位的总容量，每槽最多可存放2,000单位单一物料。

en: Sonar sweep radius. Sites inside this distance are discoverable and surveyable.
zh: 声呐扫描半径。此距离内的地点可被发现与勘测。

en: Highest mineral hardness this sonar can reveal. H1 covers iron and silicon; H4 covers everything including neutronium.
zh: 该声呐可揭示的最高矿物硬度。H1 涵盖铁与硅；H4 涵盖所有矿物，包括中子素。

en: Highest mineral hardness this drill can extract. H1 covers iron and silicon; H4 covers everything including neutronium.
zh: 该钻机可开采的最高矿物硬度。H1 涵盖铁与硅；H4 涵盖所有矿物，包括中子素。

en: The vehicle moves at its base top speed.
zh: 载具将以其基础最高速度移动。

en: One Sport Nav gives 2× base top speed with 2.6× movement power draw compared with Basic Nav in the same rig, about 1.3× battery use per meter at full throttle. Further Sport Navs stack at a rising cost.
zh: 单个运动导航模块可使基础最高速度提升至 2 倍，移动功耗为同配置载具中基础导航模块的 2.6 倍，满油门状态下每米电池消耗约为 1.3 倍。后续叠加的运动导航模块成本将递增。

en: Time to extract one unit of iron ore. Harder minerals take proportionally longer.
zh: 开采一单位铁矿石所需时间。硬度更高的矿物将按比例增加耗时。

en: Power draw while drilling, in watts. Comes straight out of the vehicle's battery.
zh: 钻孔时的功率消耗（瓦特）。直接从载具电池中扣除。

en: Battery cost per scan or survey, in watt-hours.
zh: 每次扫描或勘测的电池消耗（瓦时）。

en: Universal mounting slots. Accepts any mix of modules, Battery Holders, or Cargo Racks.
zh: 通用安装槽位。可任意搭配模块、电池支架或货物架。

en: Number of Portable Battery items this holder can host.
zh: 此支架可容纳的便携式电池数量。

en: Number of Portable Storage Bin items this rack can host.
zh: 此货架可容纳的便携式储物箱数量。

en: Total units the dock can hold across all slots.
zh: 码头所有槽位可容纳的总单位数。

en: Maximum watts this turbine produces when fed full steam at full throttle.
zh: 满蒸汽输入且满油门状态下，该涡轮机的最大输出功率（瓦特）。
本地报告与闪电观测半径。

en: Maximum distance from this Lightning Rod at which a strike can be captured.
zh: 闪电可被该避雷针捕获的最大距离。

en: Power required while the machine is actively operating, in watts.
zh: 设备处于运行状态时的功耗，单位为瓦特。

en: Peak variable draw at full throttle. Power use scales linearly with the throttle setting.
zh: 满油门状态下的峰值可变功耗。实际功耗随油门设置呈线性变化。

en: Maximum clean-water output at full throttle with enough steam and output capacity.
zh: 蒸汽与输出容量充足时，满油门状态下的最大净水产量。

en: How far one pipe segment spans when the Constructor lays infrastructure.
zh: 建造机铺设基础设施时，单段管道的覆盖跨度。

en: Maximum tons of fluid this tank can hold.
zh: 此储罐可容纳的最大流体吨数。

en: Tons of oil stored when full.
zh: 满载时可储存的石油吨数。

en: Script-tracked photovoltaic panel producing up to **50 W** in sunlight and **0 W** at night. Poor tilt reduces daytime output.
zh: 由脚本追踪的光伏面板，日照下最高输出 **50 W**，夜间为 **0 W**。倾角不佳会降低日间发电量。

en: Converts atmospheric CO₂ into breathable oxygen.
zh: 将大气中的 CO₂ 转化为可呼吸的氧气。

en: Radiates heat to warm the planet surface.
zh: 辐射热量以提升星球地表温度。

en: Compresses atmospheric gas to raise surface pressure.
zh: 压缩大气气体以提升地表气压。

en: Oxygen Generator Mk II Upgrade Pack
zh: 氧气发电机 Mk II 升级套件

en: Upgrades a deployed Oxygen Generator to Mk II: 5× output and 5× power draw.
zh: 将已部署的氧气发生器升级为 Mk II：输出与功耗均提升至 5 倍。

en: Heat Generator Mk II Upgrade Pack
zh: 热能发电机 Mk II 升级套件

en: Upgrades a deployed Heat Generator to Mk II: 4.7× output and 5× power draw.
zh: 将已部署的热量发生器升级为 Mk II：输出提升至 4.7 倍，功耗提升至 5 倍。

en: Pressure Generator Mk II Upgrade Pack
zh: 气压发电机 Mk II 升级套件

en: Upgrades a deployed Pressure Generator to Mk II: 5× output and 5× power draw.
zh: 将已部署的压力发生器升级为 Mk II：输出与功耗均提升至 5 倍。

en: Vehicle Charging Station Mk II Upgrade Pack
zh: 载具充电站 Mk II 升级包

en: Upgrades a deployed Vehicle Charging Station to Mk II: **2 bays** and a **120 W** total charging budget. One vehicle pools both idle bays.
zh: 将已部署的载具充电站升级为 Mk II：提供 **2 个泊位** 与 **120 W** 的总充电功率配额。单辆载具可合并使用两个空闲泊位。

en: Vehicle Charging Station Mk III Upgrade Pack
zh: 载具充电站 Mk III 升级包

en: Upgrades a Mk II Vehicle Charging Station to Mk III: **4 bays** and a **240 W** total charging budget. One vehicle pools every idle bay.
zh: 将 Mk II 载具充电站升级至 Mk III：提供 **4 个泊位** 与 **240 W** 总充电功率。空闲泊位由载具共享。

en: Starter expedition chassis with an integrated **100 Wh** battery and **10-unit** cargo hold. Mount Nav, Sonar, and Drill modules to configure its role.
zh: 初始勘探底盘，内置 **100 Wh** 电池与 **10 单位** 货舱。可搭载导航、声呐与钻头模块以配置其职能。

en: Basic mobility drivetrain for surface vehicles.
zh: 地表载具的基础移动传动组件。

en: High-performance drivetrain for a Pioneer's universal slot. One Sport Nav gives 2× top speed with 2.6× movement power draw compared with Basic Nav in the same rig, about 1.3× battery use per meter at full throttle.
zh: 适用于先锋建造机通用插槽的高性能传动系统。与同底盘下的基础导航模块相比，单个运动型导航模块可提供 2 倍最高速度，移动功耗为 2.6 倍，全油门状态下每米耗电量约为 1.3 倍。

en: Basic sonar: 50 m point sweeps, hardness-1 minerals, basic survey detail.
zh: 基础声呐：50 米单点扫描，可探测硬度 1 级矿物，提供基础勘测精度。

en: Pioneer universal-slot sonar: 180 m point sweeps, hardness-3 minerals, wider survey detail.
zh: 先锋建造机通用插槽声呐：180 米单点扫描，可探测硬度 3 级矿物，提供更广范围的勘测精度。

en: Pioneer universal-slot sonar: 280 m point sweeps, hardness-4 minerals, deepest survey detail.
zh: 先锋建造机通用插槽声呐：280 米单点扫描，可探测硬度 4 级矿物，提供最深层次的勘测精度。

en: Heavy-duty drill for a Pioneer's universal slot.
zh: 适用于先锋建造机通用插槽的重型钻头。

en: Top-tier drill for a Pioneer's universal slot and the densest minerals.
zh: 适用于先锋建造机通用插槽的顶级钻头，专为开采最高密度矿物设计。

en: Empty **1-bay** battery housing for a Pioneer. Sold without a Portable Battery, which must be purchased and installed separately.
zh: 适用于先锋建造机的 **1 槽位** 空电池舱。不含便携式电池，需另行购买并安装。

en: Empty **2-bay** battery housing for a Pioneer. Portable Batteries are purchased and installed separately.
zh: 适用于先锋建造机的 **2 槽位** 空电池舱。便携式电池需另行购买并安装。

en: Empty **3-bay** battery housing for a Pioneer. Portable Batteries are purchased and installed separately.
zh: 适用于先锋建造机的 **3 槽位** 空电池舱。便携式电池需另行购买并安装。

en: Empty **1-bin** Cargo Rack for a Pioneer. Sold without a Portable Storage Bin, which must be purchased and installed separately.
zh: 适用于先锋建造机的 **1 格** 空货舱架。不含便携式储物箱，需另行购买并安装。

en: Empty **2-bin** Cargo Rack for a Pioneer. Portable Storage Bins are purchased and installed separately.
zh: 适用于先锋建造机的 **2 格** 空货舱架。便携式储物箱需另行购买并安装。

en: Empty **3-bin** Cargo Rack for a Pioneer. Portable Storage Bins are purchased and installed separately.
zh: 供先锋使用的空 **3 箱位** 货箱架。便携式储物箱需单独购买并安装。

en: **50 Wh** rechargeable cell for any Battery Holder, delivered fully charged.
zh: 适用于任意电池座的 **50 Wh** 可充电电芯，交付时已处于满电状态。

en: **100 Wh** high-density cell for any Battery Holder, delivered fully charged.
zh: 适用于任意电池座的 **100 Wh** 高密度电芯，交付时已处于满电状态。

en: Portable single-mineral container holding **25 units**. Latches to the first mineral loaded into it.
zh: 便携式单矿物储物箱，容量 **25 单位**。装入首种矿物后将自动锁定该类型。

en: Reinforced single-mineral container holding **50 units**, double the standard bin.
zh: 加固型单矿物储物箱，容量 **50 单位**，容量为标准储物箱的两倍。

en: Grid-powered vehicle charger with **1 bay** and a **30 W** charging budget. Upgrade packs add bays and increase pooled charging speed.
zh: 由电网供电的载具充电设备，配备 **1 个充电位** 与 **30 W** 充电功率。升级包可增加充电位并提升总充电速度。

en: Outpost storage container for a single material.
zh: 用于前哨站的单材料储物容器。

en: Industrial furnace. Refines raw ore into metal stock.
zh: 工业熔炉。将原矿精炼为金属坯料。

en: Manufacturing press. Assembles equipment from refined stock.
zh: 制造压机。使用精炼坯料组装设备。

en: Eight-slot modular expedition chassis with no built-in battery, cargo, or Nav. The bare Pioneer cannot move until separately purchased hardware is installed.
zh: 八槽模块化远征底盘，无内置电池、货舱或导航模块。未安装另行采购的硬件前，裸机先锋无法移动。

en: Ships Earth Orders at a base rate of **25 units/h**. Additional docks cost more; the Shop and Inventory show the live price.
zh: 以 **25 单位/小时** 的基础速率发运地球订单。增建停靠坞费用更高；商店与库存界面将显示实时价格。

en: Pioneer module that builds planned surface structures and utility networks.
zh: 先锋专用模块，用于建造规划中的地表建筑与管线网络。

en: Pipe section for building gas lines.
zh: 用于铺设气体管线的标准管段。

en: Pipe section for building liquid lines.
zh: 用于铺设液体管线的标准管段。

en: Conduit section for building power lines.
zh: 用于铺设电力线路的导管段。

en: Overpass that lets gas lines cross without joining.
zh: 允许气体管线交叉互不连通的跨线桥段。

en: Overpass that lets liquid lines cross without joining.
zh: 立交桥，允许液体管线交叉而不连通。

en: Overpass that lets power lines cross without joining.
zh: 立交桥，允许电力管线交叉而不连通。

en: Deploys a Thermal Cap on a surveyed vent. If its chamber reaches **100%**, it blows all stored Steam into the atmosphere; a script must release, route, or relieve the pressure.
zh: 在已勘测的喷口上部署隔热盖。若其腔室压力达到 **100%**，会将所有储存的蒸汽排入大气；必须通过脚本释放、导流或泄压。

en: Founding the next outpost will cost {price} cr.
zh: 建立下一个前哨站将消耗 {price} 积分。

en: Buying the next Supply Dock will cost {price} cr.
zh: 购买下一个补给码头将消耗 {price} 积分。

en: Founds a new outpost that hosts machines and links utility networks. Additional kits cost more; the Shop and Inventory show the live price.
zh: 建立新的前哨站，用于承载机器并连接公用设施网络。额外套件价格递增；商店与库存界面显示实时价格。

en: Produces up to **108 W** from **90 t/h Steam** at full throttle. A script controls its throttle.
zh: 满负荷运行时，可利用 **90 t/h 蒸汽** 产生最高 **108 W** 电力。由脚本控制其节流阀。

en: Condenses steam into clean water at up to 250 t/h.
zh: 将蒸汽冷凝为净水，最高速率 250 t/h。

en: Buffer tank that stores any one gas: steam, ammonia, swamp gas, or any gas it receives first.
zh: 缓冲储罐，仅可储存单一气体：蒸汽、氨气、沼气，或优先接收到的第一种气体。

en: Buffer tank that stores any one liquid: water, oil, or essence.
zh: 缓冲储罐，仅可储存单一液体：水、油或精华。

en: A big passive tank that holds 1,000 t of one liquid and sticks to the first liquid it receives.
zh: 大型被动储罐，容量为 1,000 t，仅容纳单一液体，且会锁定首次接收到的液体类型。

en: Extracts water from a surveyed water well.
zh: 从已勘测的水井中抽取水。

en: Extracts oil from a surveyed oil well.
zh: 从已勘测的油井中抽取油。

en: Programmable 50 W local weather station with live reception and an optional Signal Board.
zh: 可编程的 50 W 本地气象站，支持实时数据接收，可选配信号面板。

en: Lead drone armor for exposure-free Raw Uranium collection and hot-cargo loading from Lead Casks. Heavy: **halves every Cargo Pod's capacity** and raises fuel burn **1.5x**.
zh: 铅制无人机装甲，可在无辐射暴露下采集原始铀，并从铅罐中装载热货物。重型：**所有货舱容量减半**，燃料消耗提升 **1.5 倍**。

en: Shielded storage cask. The only stationary container that holds Raw Uranium and Fuel Rods.
zh: 屏蔽存储罐。唯一能够存放原始铀与燃料棒的固定式容器。

en: Glass fused where lightning struck open ground. A rare trade good Earth pays well for.
zh: 闪电击中裸露地表时熔合而成的玻璃。地球方面愿意高价收购的稀有贸易品。

en: Deploys a **4,000 Wh**, **600 m** lightning reserve. Condition falls **0.05 per day**, reducing capture to zero unless a script repairs it with Storm Glass.
zh: 部署一个 **4,000 Wh**、**600 m** 的雷电储备。耐久度每日下降 **0.05**，若不通过脚本使用风暴玻璃进行修复，捕获效率将降至零。

en: Nuclear workbench that presses Raw Uranium and lead plates into Fuel Rods or Nuclear Batteries.
zh: 核能工作台，可将原始铀与铅板压制为燃料棒或核能电池。

en: Uranium-core storage cell holding thirty times a base battery's charge.
zh: 铀芯储能单元，储电量为基础电池的三十倍。

en: Grow Lamp Upgrade Pack Mk IV
zh: 生长灯升级包 Mk IV

en: Upgrades one Grow Lamp to Mk IV: **8×** base Forage yield on its own (**+700%**) and **500 W** draw while enabled. The bonus applies during growth to crops that require light in the four orthogonally adjacent cells, while the lamp is powered and enabled. Coverage and growth speed stay the same. en:
## Overview

Converts sunlight into power. The panel produces more power when it's pointed directly at the sun.

## Geometry

The sun rises, moves overhead, and sets. Its elevation spans **0°-90°**, from the horizon to straight overhead. Your panel has a tilt you can adjust across **0°-90°**, from flat to straight up.

The panel works best when it's perpendicular to the sun. The sun's elevation and your panel's tilt should add up to **90°**. For example: sun at 60° → tilt at 30°.

## What your script does

The sun moves constantly, so your script needs to keep adjusting. Your generator is already loaded as `self`.

Use the Clock component to read the sun's elevation, then call `self.set_tilt(degrees)` to aim the panel.

> **Wrap your logic in `while True:` so it runs forever.** A script that runs once tilts the panel a single time and then ends, the sun keeps moving, the panel doesn't, and your power output collapses. The loop is what keeps the panel tracking.

`clock.get_elevation()` reads how high the sun is (always in the **0°-90°** range).
zh:
## 概述

将阳光转化为电力。当面板正对太阳时，发电量更高。

## 几何关系

太阳升起、移至天顶，然后落下。其仰角范围为 **0°-90°**，从地平线到正头顶。你的面板具有倾角，可在 **0°-90°** 范围内调节，从水平到垂直向上。

当面板与太阳光线垂直时，工作效率最高。太阳仰角与面板倾角之和应为 **90°**。例如：太阳仰角 60° → 面板倾角 30°。

## 脚本作用

太阳持续移动，因此你的脚本需要不断进行调整。你的发电机已作为 `self` 加载。

使用时钟组件读取太阳仰角，然后调用 `self.set_tilt(degrees)` 来调整面板朝向。

> **将你的逻辑包裹在 `while True:` 中，使其无限循环运行。** 仅运行一次的脚本只会调整面板一次便结束，而太阳持续移动，面板却静止不动，导致电力输出骤降。正是该循环让面板保持追踪状态。

`clock.get_elevation()` 用于读取太阳高度（始终在 **0°-90°** 范围内）。

en:
## Overview

The generator converts atmospheric CO₂ into oxygen through electrolysis. Carbon waste is stored inside the machine.

## Intake

The reaction chamber reaches peak efficiency when intake is set to **CO₂ / 10** for the current atmospheric CO₂ level. Values above or below that point reduce efficiency smoothly.

## Waste

Carbon waste builds up during operation. The machine runs at full efficiency up to **60 waste**. Above **60**, efficiency drops steadily. At **100**, the machine stalls completely.

The waste exhaust port operates most cleanly when waste is in the **50-60** range. Clearing outside that range strains the mechanism, the further from the safe range, the more conversion efficiency is lost until the next clearance. Scripts read the active penalty with `self.dump_penalty()`.

## What your script does

In pseudocode: *loop forever, read the CO₂ level, set intake to `CO₂ / 10`, dump waste when it lands in the 50-60 sweet spot.*

Read atmospheric conditions with `get_component("atmosphere")`.
zh:
## 概述

该发电机通过电解将大气中的 CO₂ 转化为氧气。碳废料会储存在机器内部。

## 进气

当进气量设置为当前大气 CO₂ 浓度的 **CO₂ / 10** 时，反应室将达到峰值效率。高于或低于该值均会使效率平滑下降。

## 废料

运行期间碳废料会不断累积。在废料量达到 **60** 前，机器保持满效率运行。超过 **60** 后，效率稳步下降。达到 **100** 时，机器将完全停转。

废料排气口在废料量处于 **50-60** 区间时运行最为顺畅。在此范围外进行清理会加重机械负荷，偏离安全范围越远，在下次清理前损失的转化效率就越多。脚本可通过 `self.dump_penalty()` 读取当前的惩罚值。

## 你的脚本需要做什么

伪代码逻辑：*无限循环，读取 CO₂ 浓度，将进气量设为 `CO₂ / 10`，当废料量落入 50-60 的最佳区间时执行排放。*

使用 `get_component("atmosphere")` 读取大气状况。

en:
## Overview

The heater warms the planet surface by producing thermal energy. Set base heater power with `self.set_power()`, the machine draws real watts from your batteries, and higher Mk tiers multiply that grid draw.

## Thermal state

The planet's heater thermal state is chosen once per in-game day and stays fixed until the next day. It affects only the Heat Generator's optimal base power setting; solar panels still depend on sun elevation and panel tilt.

When you match the right power level for today's thermal state, efficiency reaches **100%**. Too high or too low and efficiency drops. `set_power(0)` is a valid command and turns heating off: efficiency and output read 0.

The optimal power for each thermal state isn't given, you have to find it. Loop through positive values, watch `self.efficiency()`, and remember the value that hits 100% for each state.

The mapping is useful only if your script keeps using it. A one-time search can find today's best setting, but tomorrow's thermal state may need a different power level. You do not need to detect midnight directly: keep reading `self.thermal_state()` each loop, and when the returned string changes, set the power for the new state.

## What your script does

In pseudocode: *loop forever, read the current thermal state, set power to the value you've found works for it.*
zh:
## 概述

加热器通过产生热能来温暖行星地表。使用 `self.set_power()` 设置基础加热功率，该设备会从你的电池中实时抽取实际功率（瓦特），更高的 Mk 等级会成倍增加电网负载。

## 热力状态

行星的热力状态每天（游戏内）确定一次，并固定保持至次日。它仅影响加热器的最佳基础功率设置；太阳能板仍取决于太阳高度角与面板倾角。

当你将功率设置为与今日热力状态匹配的正确值时，效率将达到 **100%**。过高或过低都会导致效率下降。`set_power(0)` 是有效指令，可关闭加热功能：此时效率与输出均显示为 0。

每种热力状态对应的最佳功率值并未直接给出，你需要自行摸索。循环遍历正值，观察 `self.efficiency()`，并记下使效率达到 100% 的数值。

该映射关系仅在你的脚本持续使用时才有意义。单次搜索可以找到今天的最佳设置，但明天的热力状态可能需要不同的功率。你无需直接检测午夜：只需在每次循环中持续读取 `self.thermal_state()`，当返回的字符串发生变化时，即为新状态设置对应功率。

## 你的脚本该做什么

伪代码：*无限循环，读取当前热力状态，将功率设置为你已验证有效的对应值。*

en:
## Overview

The pressure generator compresses atmospheric gas in a resonance chamber. Its gauge sweeps across **0-100** over and over. Each sweep has a small sync window. Call `self.sync()` while `self.gauge()` is between `self.next_window_low()` and `self.next_window_high()`, both ends included.

A hit adds **+25%** efficiency. A miss, or no sync before the gauge wraps, subtracts **10%**. Efficiency is floored at **0%**.

## What your script does

Read the window and gauge in the same loop. The window values are for the sweep happening now. They change when the gauge wraps into the next sweep, so do not read them once at startup and reuse them forever.

In pseudocode: *loop forever, read the current sync window, read the gauge, and sync when the gauge is inside that window.*

Only the first `sync()` attempt in a sweep counts. Extra calls before the gauge wraps do nothing.

## Common pitfall

The `next_` in `next_window_low()` refers to the sync opportunity in the sweep currently underway.

Efficiency takes several good sweeps to settle. Four consecutive hits bring it to **100%**, and a miss costs **10%**.

> A fresh start reads **0%** efficiency and **0** pressure until your first sync lands, then climbs in **+25%** steps. Seeing 0% for the first few sweeps is the resonance settling, not a fault.
zh:
## 概述

压力发生器在共振腔内压缩大气气体。其仪表读数在 **0-100** 之间反复扫过。每轮扫描都有一个短暂的同步窗口。当 `self.gauge()` 位于 `self.next_window_low()` 和 `self.next_window_high()` 之间时调用 `self.sync()`，包含两端。

命中会增加 **25%** 效率。未命中，或在仪表完成循环前未同步，会减少 **10%**。效率最低为 **0%**。

## 你的脚本应做什么

在同一循环中读取窗口和仪表。窗口值针对当前正在进行的扫描。当仪表完成循环进入下一轮扫描时，这些值会改变，因此不要只在启动时读取一次并永久复用。

伪代码如下：*循环往复，读取当前同步窗口，读取仪表，并在仪表位于该窗口内时同步。*

每轮扫描中只有第一次 `sync()` 尝试有效。在仪表完成循环前额外调用不会有任何效果。

## 常见陷阱

`next_window_low()` 中的 `next_` 指的是当前正在进行的那轮扫描中的同步机会。

效率需要几轮良好扫描才能稳定。连续四次命中可使其达到 **100%**，一次未命中会损失 **10%**。

> 刚启动时，效率为 **0%**，压力为 **0**，直到你的第一次同步命中，然后以 **+25%** 的幅度逐步上升。最初几轮扫描看到 0% 是共振正在稳定，不是故障。

en:
## Overview

A Thermal Cap bolts onto a surveyed thermal vent and captures its steam into an internal **chamber**. The vent cycles between an **active** phase (steam flows, the chamber fills) and a **dormant** phase (nothing comes in). Your script decides how fast to release the chamber and which connected machines may receive it.

## The chamber, and overpressure

The chamber fills while the vent is active. Reach **100%** and it **overpressurizes**: the whole chamber blows off to atmosphere and rebuilds from empty, so everything banked is gone. Keeping it off the ceiling is the whole job. Watch it with `self.pressure()` (**0.0-1.0**) and open the valve with `self.set_throttle(value)` as it climbs, where `value` is **0-1**. There is no cap on the valve and no auto-safety: stop releasing and it blows.

## Routing the release

Declare at least one compatible machine relationship. From the Cap script, `self.steam_out.connect("bio_caster_1")` declares one destination. A consumer may instead declare the equivalent relationship with `self.steam_in.connect("thermal_cap_1")`, and several consumers may connect their own input ports to this Cap. The Cap's available release is shared across every reachable connected destination with headroom.

The Cap is a field structure and never belongs to a nearby outpost. Every destination needs a compatible completed Gas Pipe component reaching the Cap and that destination; scripts never select a pipe id. The complete connection establishes steam identity even before flow starts and keeps it while the Cap is dormant, powered off, full, or throttled to zero.

Route to a Gas Tank to bank a reserve, then separately connect each downstream consumer to that tank. Tanks are optional explicit storage, not automatic outpost adapters. If no reachable connected destination has headroom, `self.is_stalled()` reads `True`.

## The relief valve

When every usable sink is full and the vent still out-produces your consumers, `pressure()` climbs at full throttle and the chamber blows. `self.set_relief(value)` is the escape, where `value` is **0-1**: a second valve that dumps chamber steam straight to atmosphere, wasting it. Open it when `pressure()` passes ~**0.9** to shed the surplus so the chamber never tops out; `self.relief_rate()` reports how much you're wasting. Relief is deliberate waste, only open it for genuine surplus you can't use.

## Reading the cycle

`self.phase()` returns `"active"` or `"dormant"`. A **Deep**-surveyed vent also gives `self.next_phase_in()` in minutes, so you can open the valve before a surge and ease it before a dry spell.

## Common pitfall

> The chamber is a small pressure vessel, not long-term storage. A consumer's internal buffer can accept steam through the completed pipe route, but a **Gas Tank** is the practical way to bank surplus during the active phase and ride through dormancy. The consumer must still connect its input to that tank.
