## 概述

热能盖通过螺栓固定在已勘测的地热喷口上，将捕获的蒸汽导入内部**腔室**。喷口会在**活跃**期（蒸汽流入，腔室充能）与**休眠**期（无蒸汽进入）之间循环。你的脚本将决定腔室的释放速度，以及哪些已连接的机器可以接收蒸汽。

## 腔室与超压

腔室会在喷口活跃期间持续充能。一旦达到 **100%**，就会发生**超压**：整个腔室会向大气泄压并清空重置，所有已储存的蒸汽将全部损失。控制压力不触及上限是核心任务。使用 `self.pressure()`（**0.0-1.0**）监控压力值，并在压力攀升时通过 `self.set_throttle(value)` 打开阀门，其中 `value` 为 **0-1**。阀门没有上限限制，也没有自动安全机制：一旦停止释放，它就会超压爆裂。

## 路由释放

声明至少一个兼容的机器连接关系。在热能盖脚本中，`self.steam_out.connect("bio_caster_1")` 可声明一个目标设备。消耗设备也可通过 `self.steam_in.connect("thermal_cap_1")` 声明等效的连接关系，且多个消耗设备可将各自的输入端口连接至该热能盖。热能盖的可用释放量将在所有可达且有余量的已连接目标之间共享。

热能盖属于野外设施，从不归属于附近的前哨站。每个目标设备都需要一条兼容且已铺设完毕的气体管道组件，连接至热能盖与该目标；脚本无需选择管道 ID。完整的连接会在蒸汽流动前就确立蒸汽身份标识，并在热能盖处于休眠、断电、满载或节流至零的状态下保持该标识。

可将蒸汽路由至**储气罐**以储备余量，随后再将每个下游消耗设备单独连接至该储气罐。储气罐是可选的显式存储设备，并非自动适配前哨站的组件。若所有可达的已连接目标均无余量，`self.is_stalled()` 将返回 `True`。

## 泄压阀

当所有可用接收端均已满载，且喷口产量仍高于消耗量时，`pressure()` 将在全开节流下持续攀升，最终导致腔室超压爆裂。`self.set_relief(value)` 是应对方案，其中 `value` 为 **0-1**：这是一个第二阀门，可将腔室蒸汽直接排入大气，造成浪费。当 `pressure()` 超过约 **0.9** 时打开它，以释放多余蒸汽，确保腔室永不触顶；`self.relief_rate()` 会报告当前的浪费量。泄压属于主动损耗，仅在确实存在无法利用的多余蒸汽时才应开启。

## 读取循环周期

`self.phase()` 返回 `"active"` 或 `"dormant"`。经过**深度**勘测的喷口还会提供以分钟为单位的 `self.next_phase_in()`，以便你在蒸汽激增前打开阀门，或在枯竭期来临前平稳节流。

## 常见误区

> 腔室是一个小型压力容器，并非长期存储设备。消耗设备的内部缓冲区可通过已铺设的管道接收蒸汽，但**储气罐**才是活跃期储备余量、平稳度过休眠期的实用方案。消耗设备仍必须将其输入端口连接至该储气罐。

en:
## Overview

A Steam Turbine converts incoming steam into **electrical power** for the grid. The `throttle` knob controls how hard it runs: **0** = idle, **1.0** = full steam draw for peak watts. More throttle draws more steam and makes more power.

**Idle until scripted**, `throttle` defaults to **0**, so a turbine with no script consumes no steam and produces nothing. Your script sets the throttle for what the grid needs right now.

## What your script does

Call `self.set_throttle(...)` to run the turbine. The main job is keeping it fed and not spinning on empty:

• Steam buffer healthy → run at full throttle (**1.0**) for peak power.
• Steam buffer running dry (vent dormant) → ease the throttle down so it idles cleanly instead of reporting `is_stalled`.
• Night → keep it running; steam power carries the grid while solar is out.

Good inputs for this decision: `self.steam_in.level()` / `self.steam_in.capacity()` (your fuel buffer), and the cap feeding this turbine (`cap.vent()` for `current_phase()`, `next_phase_in()` if Deep-surveyed) to anticipate dormant phases.

## Riding out vent cycles

> Vents cycle active/dormant. Buffer steam through a Gas Tank so the turbine keeps producing power across the dormant phase. Deep Sonar reveals `next_phase_in()` so you can see the dry spell coming and stockpile steam first.

> Nothing prevents setting `throttle` every tick. `sleep()` is never needed just to keep the game running.
zh:
## 概述

蒸汽轮机将输入的蒸汽转化为供给电网的**电力**。`throttle` 旋钮控制其运行强度：**0** = 待机，**1.0** = 全速抽取蒸汽以输出峰值功率。开度越大，抽取的蒸汽越多，产生的电力也越多。

**未编写脚本前处于待机状态**，`throttle` 默认值为 **0**，因此未加载脚本的轮机不消耗蒸汽也不产出任何电力。你的脚本将根据电网的实时需求来设置节流阀开度。

## 脚本功能

调用 `self.set_throttle(...)` 即可驱动轮机。主要任务是确保其燃料充足，避免空转：

• 蒸汽缓冲充足 → 全开节流阀（**1.0**）以输出峰值功率。
• 蒸汽缓冲即将耗尽（喷口休眠） → 降低节流阀开度，使其平稳待机，而非触发 `is_stalled` 报错。
• 夜间 → 保持运行；在太阳能停摆期间，由蒸汽电力支撑电网。

用于决策的参考数据：`self.steam_in.level()` / `self.steam_in.capacity()`（你的燃料缓冲），以及为该轮机供气的喷口状态（通过 `cap.vent()` 获取 `current_phase()`，若已深度勘测可获取 `next_phase_in()`），以便提前预判休眠期。

## 应对喷口周期

> 喷口会在活跃与休眠之间循环。通过储气罐缓冲蒸汽，可使轮机在休眠期持续发电。深度声呐可揭示 `next_phase_in()`，让你提前预见枯竭期并预先囤积蒸汽。

> 没有任何限制阻止你在每一周期设置 `throttle`。仅为了维持游戏运行而调用 `sleep()` 是完全没有必要的。

en:
## Overview

A Steam Condenser turns vent steam into clean water at a **1:1 mass ratio**. At full throttle it consumes **250 t/h Steam**, produces **250 t/h Water**, and draws **150 W**. Steam sent here cannot also feed a turbine or Heat Generator, so the machine makes water supply a script-owned allocation decision.

## Wire both sides

Connect an upstream Thermal Cap or steam-latched Gas Tank to `steam_in`, then connect `water_out` to a Liquid Tank, Large Liquid Tank, or water consumer. Machines at the same outpost transfer directly. Connections between outposts also need a complete compatible Gas Pipe or Liquid Pipe route. The outpost itself is not a hidden fluid buffer.

```
self.steam_in.connect("gas_tank_1")
self.water_out.connect("liquid_tank_1")
```

A tank needs a relationship on both sides: connect the source to the tank, then connect each consumer to that tank.

## Control and diagnose

`self.status()` reports `"idle"`, `"no_power"`, `"no_steam"`, `"output_full"`, or `"running"`. `self.is_stalled()` is `True` only for the two fluid blockers, no steam or no water headroom. `condensation_rate()` and `efficiency()` report what the last simulation tick completed.

Throttle scales steam use, water output, and draw across **0.0-1.0**. An open throttle still reserves its wattage while steam-starved or output-blocked. Set it to **0** when you want to save that power. Once throttle is **0**, `status()` reads `"idle"`, so inspect the two port levels when deciding when to reopen it.

```
while True:
  steam = self.steam_in.level()
  water_room = self.water_out.capacity() - self.water_out.level()
  target = 1.0 if steam >= 5 and water_room >= 5 else 0.0
  result = self.set_throttle(target)
  if result.status != "ok":
    print(result.message)
  print(self.status(), self.condensation_rate())
```

## Buffering and scale

Thermal vents cycle through active and dormant phases. Gas Tanks bank steam through the dormant stretch; Liquid Tanks smooth uneven water demand. Two full Condensers produce **500 t/h Water** and draw **300 W**, enough to supply two Mk III Sprinklers with **100 t/h** left for other consumers. Four full Condensers produce the **1,000 t/h** required by one Mk IV Sprinkler and draw **600 W**.

> Late oil and nuclear grids can replace turbine power, letting a mature base dedicate more of its captured steam to water.
zh:
## 概述

蒸汽冷凝器以 **1:1 的质量比**将排气蒸汽转化为净水。满负荷运行时，它消耗 **250 t/h 蒸汽**，产出 **250 t/h 水**，功耗为 **150 W**。输送至此的蒸汽无法再用于驱动涡轮机或热力发电机，因此该设备使供水成为一项由脚本控制的资源分配决策。

## 连接两侧

将上游的集热盖或已锁定蒸汽的气体储罐连接至 `steam_in`，再将 `water_out` 连接至液体储罐、大型液体储罐或用水设备。同一前哨站内的机器可直接传输。跨前哨站连接还需铺设完整且兼容的气体管道或液体管道路由。前哨站本身不具备隐藏的流体缓冲功能。

```
self.steam_in.connect("gas_tank_1")
self.water_out.connect("liquid_tank_1")
```

储罐需要在两侧建立连接关系：先将源头连接至储罐，再将各消耗端连接至该储罐。

## 控制与诊断

`self.status()` 返回 `"idle"`、`"no_power"`、`"no_steam"`、`"output_full"` 或 `"running"`。仅当出现两种流体阻塞状况（无蒸汽或无储水空间）时，`self.is_stalled()` 才为 `True`。`condensation_rate()` 与 `efficiency()` 报告上一模拟步长内完成的数据。

节流阀在 **0.0-1.0** 范围内按比例调节蒸汽消耗、水产量与功耗。即使处于缺蒸汽或输出受阻状态，开启的节流阀仍会占用其额定功率。若需节省该部分电力，请将其设为 **0**。当节流阀为 **0** 时，`status()` 将显示 `"idle"`，因此在决定何时重新开启时，请检查两端端口的储量。

```
while True:
  steam = self.steam_in.level()
  water_room = self.water_out.capacity() - self.water_out.level()
  target = 1.0 if steam >= 5 and water_room >= 5 else 0.0
  result = self.set_throttle(target)
  if result.status != "ok":
    print(result.message)
  print(self.status(), self.condensation_rate())
```

## 缓冲与规模

热泉口会循环经历活跃期与休眠期。气体储罐可在休眠期储存蒸汽；液体储罐可平抑不均匀的用水需求。两台满负荷冷凝器可产出 **500 t/h 水**，功耗 **300 W**，足以供应两台 III 型洒水器，并剩余 **100 t/h** 供其他设备使用。四台满负荷冷凝器可产出单台 IV 型洒水器所需的 **1,000 t/h**，功耗 **600 W**。

> 后期的石油与核能电网可替代涡轮机供电，使成熟基地能将更多捕获的蒸汽专用于制水。

en:
## Overview

A Water Pump is bolted onto a surveyed water well. It extracts water at the well's flow rate, `10 / 20 / 30 t/h` for `standard` / `rich` / `pure` yield tiers, multiplied by the pump's `throttle` (**0-1**). The pump idles at `throttle = 0` until your script opens it.

## Connect water demand

The pump stores no water. It is a field structure and never belongs to a nearby outpost, so every consumer needs a completed Liquid Pipe route reaching the Pump and that destination.

From the Pump script, call `self.water_out.connect(...)` with the destination's stable machine id or display name to declare one destination. A consumer can instead declare the equivalent relationship through its own `water_in` port. Several consumers may connect to one Pump; available production and physical throughput are shared across reachable consumers with headroom.

`self.water_out.connected_to()` reports only the target declared by the Pump's own output port. It does not list consumers that declared the relationship from their input ports. `self.water_out.flow_rate()` and `self.pump_rate()` report total live delivery.

## Throttle and backpressure

`self.set_throttle(value)` controls extraction and power draw across **0-1**. Your script decides whether to favor maximum production, a storage target, current demand, or grid power.

If every reachable sink is full, the pump backs up cleanly: `self.pump_rate()` drops to **0** and `self.is_stalled()` becomes `True`. The throttle remains open, so lowering it while demand is satisfied saves power.

## Optional reserve storage

A Liquid Tank can hold a larger reserve. Connect the Pump to the Tank, complete the Liquid Pipe route, then connect each downstream consumer to that Tank. The outpost does not make tank contents automatically available; tanks are ordinary connected storage machines, not automatic pipe adapters.

## Salt byproduct

Pumping also accumulates salt in the discrete `self.output` item buffer. This is separate from `water_out`: water uses Liquid Pipes, while salt needs a physically present Rover or Pioneer to connect its own input and pull the item. The Pump cannot send salt directly to Inventory or stationary storage. A full salt buffer vents excess salt but never stops water production.

## Common pitfalls

> `self.well()` returns a `WaterWell` only if the pump was built on a surveyed well. If your pump blueprint never completed correctly, `pump_rate()` reads **0** even with an open throttle. Check the blueprint job before debugging the pipeline.

> A successful `connect()` records compatible intent but does not prove physical reachability. At zero flow, confirm the declaration, completed Liquid Pipe path, pipe conflict state, source power and throttle, and destination headroom.
zh:
## 概述

水泵被固定在已勘测的水井上。它以水井的流量抽取水源，`standard` / `rich` / `pure` 产量等级对应的流量分别为 `10 / 20 / 30 t/h`，并乘以水泵的 `throttle`（**0-1**）。在 `throttle = 0` 时水泵处于待机状态，直到你的脚本将其开启。

## 连接用水需求

水泵本身不储存水。它属于野外设施，永远不会归属附近的 前哨站，因此每个消耗端都需要一条已铺设完成的 液体管道 路线，分别连接至水泵与该消耗端。

在水泵脚本中，调用 `self.water_out.connect(...)` 并传入目标设备的稳定机器ID或显示名称，即可声明一个连接目标。消耗端也可以通过自身的 `water_in` 端口声明等效的连接关系。多个消耗端可连接至同一台水泵；可用产量与物理吞吐量将在所有可达且有余量的消耗端之间共享。

`self.water_out.connected_to()` 仅报告由水泵自身输出端口声明的目标。它不会列出那些从输入端口声明关系的消耗端。`self.water_out.flow_rate()` 和 `self.pump_rate()` 报告的是实时总输送量。

## 节流阀与背压

`self.set_throttle(value)` 控制 **0-1** 范围内的抽水量与功耗。你的脚本将决定是优先最大化产量、维持库存目标、响应当前需求，还是节省电网电力。

如果所有可达的接收端均已满载，水泵将安全地停止输出：`self.pump_rate()` 降至 **0**，且 `self.is_stalled()` 变为 `True`。此时节流阀仍保持开启状态，因此在需求已满足时调低 `throttle` 可节省电力。

## 可选储备存储

液体储罐 可容纳更大的储备量。将水泵连接至储罐，完成 液体管道 路线，再将每个下游消耗端连接至该储罐。前哨站 不会自动提供储罐内的内容物；储罐只是普通的已连接存储设备，而非自动管道适配器。

## 盐类副产物

抽水过程还会在独立的 `self.output` 物品缓冲区中积累盐分。这与 `water_out` 是分开的：水通过 液体管道 输送，而盐分需要物理上在场的 漫游车 或 先锋建造机 连接其自身输入端来提取物品。水泵无法将盐分直接发送至 库存 或固定存储设施。盐分缓冲区满载时会排出多余盐分，但绝不会停止抽水作业。

## 常见陷阱

> `self.well()` 仅在水泵建造于已勘测水井上时才会返回 `WaterWell`。如果你的水泵蓝图作业未能正确完成，即使节流阀已开启，`pump_rate()` 的读数仍为 **0**。在调试管道系统前，请先检查蓝图作业状态。

> 成功的 `connect()` 仅记录兼容的连接意图，并不证明物理上的可达性。当流量为零时，请确认连接声明、已完成的 液体管道 路径、管道冲突状态、源端电力与节流阀开度，以及目标端的可用余量。

en:
## Overview

An Oil Pump is bolted onto a surveyed oil well. Peak flow rate is `8 / 16 / 24 t/h` for `standard` / `rich` / `pure` yields, multiplied by the pump's `throttle` (**0-1**). Power draw also scales with throttle, and the pump idles at `throttle = 0` by default.

Oil wells **pulse**: each well runs its own rhythm of active and dormant phases, several hours each. A dormant well delivers nothing at any throttle, `self.well_active()` reads the current phase, and a Liquid Tank downstream carries the chain through the gaps.

## What your script does

Pumps fill the chain that feeds the Oil Generator (`~8 t/h` at full output) and oil-product recipes in the Fabricator (lubricant, plastic, rubber, tar). A buffered pure well always sustains one full generator and produces enough for almost two on average. A typical rich well also sustains one, but a short-active, long-dormant rich well needs slightly lower generator throttle or a second source. A typical script keeps the pump at **1.0** unless the downstream Liquid Tank fills past a threshold, at which point it throttles back to avoid wasted draw.

• Watch the Liquid Tank's `fill_pct()` from a remote read, throttle to **0.3** above **0.9**.
• Coordinate with the Oil Generator's `throttle()`, if the generator is idle, the pump's only job is keeping the tank topped up.

## Common pitfall

> Oil flows through liquid pipes (`liquid_pipe_segment`), not gas pipes. Laying a gas-pipe-only network from the pump means no flow reaches the tank and `pump_rate()` will read **0** even when the pump is active and the well has yield. Verify the pipe medium matches the fluid.
zh:
## 概述

抽油泵固定在已勘测的油井上。针对 `standard` / `rich` / `pure` 产量，峰值流速分别为 `8 / 16 / 24 t/h`，实际流速需乘以抽油泵的 `throttle`（**0-1**）。功耗同样随 `throttle` 变化，默认情况下抽油泵在 `throttle = 0` 时处于待机状态。

油井呈**脉冲式**出油：每口油井均有独立的活跃期与休眠期节律，每期持续数小时。休眠期油井在任何 `throttle` 下均不产油，可通过 `self.well_active()` 读取当前相位，下游的储液罐可在断流间隙维持生产链运转。

## 脚本作用

抽油泵负责为供油链注油，该链条为石油发电机（满负荷输出约 `~8 t/h`）及制造机中的石油产品配方（润滑油、塑料、橡胶、沥青）提供原料。带缓冲的纯净油井始终能维持一台满负荷发电机运行，平均产量足以支撑近两台。典型的富集油井同样能维持一台，但活跃期短、休眠期长的富集油井需略微调低发电机的 `throttle`，或引入第二油源。常规脚本会将抽油泵保持在 **1.0**，除非下游储液罐液位超过设定阈值，此时脚本会降低 `throttle` 以避免无效功耗。

• 通过远程读取监控储液罐的 `fill_pct()`，当液位高于 **0.9** 时将 `throttle` 降至 **0.3**。
• 与石油发电机的 `throttle()` 协同工作：若发电机处于待机状态，抽油泵的唯一任务就是保持储液罐满液位。

## 常见陷阱

> 石油通过液体管道（`liquid_pipe_segment`）输送，而非气体管道。若从抽油泵仅铺设气体管道网络，石油将无法流入储液罐，此时即使抽油泵已启动且油井有产量，`pump_rate()` 的读数仍为 **0**。请确认管道介质与流体类型匹配。

en:
## Overview

The Oil Generator burns oil to produce up to **700 W** from a single machine, several times a Steam Turbine's peak. `throttle` is **0-1**; with enough oil supplied, power output and oil demand scale linearly. At full throttle it demands **8 t/h** and consumes that rate while fully supplied. A buffered pure well always sustains one full generator and produces enough for almost two on average. A typical rich well also sustains one, while its shortest-duty cycles need slightly lower generator throttle or a second source. Oil remains shared with refinery products and heli-drone fuel, so storage and load control still matter.

Default `throttle = 0`. The generator idles until a script sets a value.

## What your script does

The generator's role is **buffered bridge and load-following power**:

• Day with strong solar → throttle to **0** (oil is expensive).
• Solar dim or absent (night, dust) → throttle up to cover deficit.
• Critical demand spike (Mk III machines kicking in) → throttle high briefly.
• Oil tank near empty → throttle down to preserve the buffer until pumps catch up.

Read a base battery as a grid-load proxy (`get_component("battery_1").get_level() / get_component("battery_1").get_capacity()`, low = grid is starving, throttle up; high = grid has surplus, throttle down) and the oil tank's `fill_pct()` to drive the decision. The generator publishes `self.power_output()` and `self.oil_consumption()` so your script can verify it's actually contributing.

## Common pitfall

> If the `oil_in` buffer empties mid-burn, actual output and `oil_consumption()` both drop with the oil available during that tick. A generator at `throttle = 1.0` with a starved input produces less than one at `throttle = 0.6` with a full input. Watch `power_output()` and `oil_consumption()` rather than `throttle()` when judging real grid contribution.
zh:
## 概述

燃油发电机通过燃烧石油，单台最高输出 **700 W**，是蒸汽轮机峰值的数倍。`throttle` 范围为 **0-1**；在供油充足时，输出功率与耗油量呈线性比例。满油门时需求为 **8 t/h**，供油充足时将按此速率消耗。带缓冲的纯油井始终能维持一台满负荷发电机运行，平均产量几乎够两台使用。典型的富油井也能维持一台，但其最短工作周期需要略微降低发电机油门或接入第二油源。石油仍与炼油厂产品及直升机无人机燃料共享，因此储油与负载控制依然重要。

默认 `throttle = 0`。发电机将保持待机，直到脚本设定数值。

## 脚本的作用

发电机的角色是**缓冲桥接与负载跟随供电**：

• 日照强烈时 → 油门调至 **0**（石油成本较高）。
• 日照减弱或无日照（夜间、沙尘） → 提高油门以弥补电力缺口。
• 关键需求峰值（Mk III 设备启动） → 短暂调高油门。
• 油箱接近空 → 降低油门以保留缓冲储量，直至油泵恢复供应。

将基础电池读数作为电网负载的代理指标（`get_component("battery_1").get_level() / get_component("battery_1").get_capacity()`，数值低表示电网缺电，提高油门；数值高表示电网盈余，降低油门），并结合油箱的 `fill_pct()` 来驱动决策。发电机将发布 `self.power_output()` 和 `self.oil_consumption()`，以便你的脚本验证其是否实际在供电。

## 常见陷阱

> 若 `oil_in` 缓冲在燃烧过程中耗尽，实际输出与 `oil_consumption()` 均会随该计算周期内的可用油量下降。一台 `throttle = 1.0` 但供油不足的发电机，其产量低于一台 `throttle = 0.6` 且供油充足的发电机。评估实际电网贡献时，请观察 `power_output()` 和 `oil_consumption()`，而非 `throttle()`。

en:
## Purpose

A Weather Station is a **50 W local instrument and live receiver**. Reports help monitor storms, while raw transmissions carry the records needed to recover hidden aftermath coordinates.

## What your script handles

- Read `self.signal_receiver.transmissions()` while an event is audible and retain any records needed later. The receiver stores no history.
- Separate records by `event_id`, identify corrupted duplicates with the documented checksum, and assemble one complete numbered set.
- Interpret the valid movement records to obtain the exact coordinate, then make that result available to a drone script.

Dust records are divided among the five biome channels. A complete dust message therefore requires powered Weather Station reception in every biome. Thunder records use the broadcast channel, so one powered station can hear a complete Storm Glass message. A thunderstorm without such a message has no Storm Glass aftermath.

## Other interfaces

`self.observe()` measures local active storms and forecasts; `self.last_report()` reads that saved report. Neither contains an aftermath coordinate. `self.strikes()` returns local lightning history. `self.signal_board` is an optional display for records and labelled values published by this station's script; it does not store, validate, merge, or decode them.

After the storm ends, send a drone to the exact recovered coordinate and collect before the aftermath expires. Open DOCS for the transmission format, checksum rule, fields, and method contracts. How scripts store records, coordinate stations, and dispatch the drone remains your design.
zh:
## 用途

气象站是一台**50 W 本地仪器与实时接收器**。报告有助于监测风暴，而原始传输则携带着恢复隐藏灾后坐标所需的记录。

## 脚本处理内容

- 在信号可接收时读取 `self.signal_receiver.transmissions()`，并保留后续所需的任何记录。接收器不存储历史记录。
- 按 `event_id` 分离记录，使用文档中记载的校验和识别损坏的重复项，并组装成一套完整的编号序列。
- 解析有效的移动记录以获取精确坐标，然后将该结果提供给无人机脚本。

沙尘记录分布在五个生物群系频道中。因此，完整的沙尘消息需要每个生物群系中均有供电的气象站进行接收。雷电记录使用广播频道，因此一台供电的气象站即可接收完整的“风暴玻璃”消息。未携带此类消息的雷暴不会产生“风暴玻璃”灾后残留。

## 其他接口

`self.observe()` 测量本地活跃风暴与预报；`self.last_report()` 读取该保存的报告。两者均不包含灾后坐标。`self.strikes()` 返回本地闪电历史记录。`self.signal_board` 是一个可选显示面板，用于展示由本站脚本发布的记录与带标签的数值；它不负责存储、验证、合并或解码这些数据。

风暴结束后，派遣无人机前往恢复出的精确坐标，并在灾后残留消失前完成采集。打开 DOCS 查看传输格式、校验和规则、字段及方法契约。脚本如何存储记录、协调各站点以及调度无人机，均由你自行设计。

## Overview

A Lightning Rod catches nearby thunderstorm strikes and banks their energy. It discharges that reserve automatically when its grid runs short and its batteries are empty. Capture and discharge do not require a running script.

## Condition

`self.integrity()` reports condition from **0-1**. Continuous corrosion lowers condition by **0.05 per day**. Strikes do not cause separate damage.

Condition is also capture efficiency. At **0.5**, the rod banks half of the energy it accepts from a strike. At **0**, it still stands and remains repairable, but banks nothing.

## Maintenance

The rod's `self.input` holds Storm Glass supplied through ordinary item logistics. Repairs are not automatic: a running script must call `self.repair()`. One repair consumes **1 Storm Glass** when the rod is worn and restores condition to **1**. At full condition, no Storm Glass is consumed. Without Storm Glass in the input, condition does not change.

Open DOCS for exact method and result contracts.
zh:
## 概述

避雷针可捕获附近的雷击并储存其能量。当电网供电不足且电池耗尽时，它会自动释放储备能量。捕获与释放均无需运行脚本。

## 完整度

`self.integrity()` 报告的完整度范围为 **0-1**。持续腐蚀会使完整度每天降低 **0.05**。雷击不会造成额外损伤。

完整度同时代表捕获效率。在 **0.5** 时，避雷针仅能储存雷击所传递能量的一半。在 **0** 时，避雷针依然矗立且可被修复，但无法储存任何能量。

## 维护

避雷针的 `self.input` 存放通过常规物品物流输送的风暴玻璃。修复并非自动进行：必须由运行中的脚本调用 `self.repair()`。每次修复在避雷针受损时消耗 **1 个风暴玻璃**，并将完整度恢复至 **1**。完整度已满时，不消耗风暴玻璃。若输入端没有风暴玻璃，完整度将保持不变。

查阅 DOCS 以获取确切的方法与返回值约定。

## Overview

The Fuel Assembler combines **Raw Uranium + lead plates** into either **Fuel Rods** or **Nuclear Batteries**. Fuel Rods are its peak **1,800 W** craft and the only reactor fuel; Nuclear Batteries use a separate recipe and are ordinary deployable power-storage products.

## What your script does

• **Stage the inputs.** `self.get_recipe_inputs()` reports the selected recipe's requirements. Raw Uranium is hot and may enter only from a Lead Cask. The input port takes one source at a time, so reconnect it to an ordinary local source when pulling lead plates.
• **Commit an unlocked recipe** from `self.list_recipes()`. `craft_fuel_rod` needs 4 Raw Uranium + 2 Lead Plates; `craft_nuclear_battery` needs 4 Raw Uranium + 3 Lead Plates.
• **Route the selected output correctly.** Fuel Rods are hot and must go to a separate Lead Cask (or their exact Supply Dock order). Nuclear Batteries are not hot cargo; send them to ordinary compatible local storage or home Inventory.
• **Schedule the burst.** Run the assembler when power is available; banked lightning can cover its heavy craft draw.

> The assembler draws recipe power only while a craft is actually advancing. Starving the feed pauses the machine; there is no throttle to set.

## 概述

燃料组装机将**粗铀 + 铅板**组合成**燃料棒**或**核电池**。燃料棒是其峰值**1,800 W**的制造产物，也是唯一的反应堆燃料；核电池使用独立配方，属于常规可部署的储能产品。

## 脚本功能

• **准备输入物料。** `self.get_recipe_inputs()` 会报告所选配方的需求。粗铀属于高危物料，仅能从铅制容器输入。输入端口每次仅支持单一来源，因此在提取铅板时，需将其切换至普通本地来源。
• **确认已解锁的配方**（通过 `self.list_recipes()` 获取）。`craft_fuel_rod` 需要 4 份粗铀 + 2 块铅板；`craft_nuclear_battery` 需要 4 份粗铀 + 3 块铅板。
• **正确路由所选输出。** 燃料棒属于高危物料，必须送入独立的铅制容器（或精确匹配补给坞订单）。核电池不属于高危货物；请将其发送至普通兼容的本地存储或主库存。
• **调度峰值运行。** 在电力可用时运行组装机；储备电能可覆盖其制造过程的高耗电。

> 组装机仅在制造实际推进时消耗配方所需电力。断供输入物料会使机器暂停；本机无节流阀可供设置。

en:
## Overview

The Reactor turns Fuel Rods and cooling water into up to **5,000 W**. `set_heat(value)` accepts a value from **0** to **1**, and temperature changes gradually in response.

The reactor's internal condition changes every **12 hours**. The condition is not reported, so the same heat setting can lead to a different temperature after a change.

## Temperature bands

• Below **300 °C**: no output.
• **300-600 °C**, yellow: output rises from **0%** to **50%**.
• **600-900 °C**, green: output rises from **50%** to **100%**. Peak output is exactly **900 °C**.
• **900-950 °C**, red: output falls back from **100%** to **0%** as the core keeps climbing.
• At **950 °C**: the reactor overheats, shuts down, and cools automatically. It returns to service after reaching **600 °C**.

## Supplies

While heating, the cooling loop automatically consumes **0.5-1 t/h** from `water_in`, based on the heat setting. If the loop runs dry, heating and fuel use pause until water returns.

The active Fuel Rod is consumed gradually based on the heat setting. When it runs out, the reactor automatically takes the next Fuel Rod from `input`. `input` is a normal input slot with `connect()`, `take()`, `flush()`, `count()`, `capacity()`, and `connected_to()`.

## Readouts

`heat()` reports the current heat setting. `temperature()`, `power_output()`, and `fuel_level()` report the current machine values. The possible `status()` values are `"running"`, `"overheated"`, `"no_fuel"`, and `"no_coolant"`.

## Writing the controller

Temperature settles at `heat` multiplied by a hidden gain, so the gain is not readable but it is measurable: once temperature stops moving, it equals `temperature()` divided by `heat()`. Dividing your target by that gain gives the heat that holds it, which is why a controller that measures beats one built on a fixed constant.

> Correction strength is applied once per loop, but the core moves per **world-clock hour**, and one world-clock hour is a fixed number of real seconds that the game speed can change. A loop tuned at one speed will over- or under-correct at another unless it scales by `clock.real_seconds_per_hour()`.
zh:
## 概述

反应堆将燃料棒与冷却水转化为最高 **5,000 W** 的功率。`set_heat(value)` 接受 **0** 到 **1** 之间的值，温度会随之逐渐变化。

反应堆的内部状态每 **12 小时** 变化一次。该状态不会对外报告，因此相同的加热设定在状态变化后可能导致不同的温度。

## 温度区间

• 低于 **300 °C**：无输出。
• **300-600 °C**（黄色）：输出从 **0%** 升至 **50%**。
• **600-900 °C**（绿色）：输出从 **50%** 升至 **100%**。峰值输出恰好出现在 **900 °C**。
• **900-950 °C**（红色）：随着堆芯温度持续攀升，输出从 **100%** 回落至 **0%**。
• 达到 **950 °C** 时：反应堆过热停机并自动冷却。温度降至 **600 °C** 后恢复运行。

## 补给

加热期间，冷却回路会根据加热设定自动从 `water_in` 消耗 **0.5-1 t/h** 的水。若回路缺水，加热与燃料消耗将暂停，直至重新供水。

当前使用的燃料棒会根据加热设定被逐渐消耗。耗尽后，反应堆会自动从 `input` 提取下一根燃料棒。`input` 为标准输入槽，支持 `connect()`、`take()`、`flush()`、`count()`、`capacity()` 与 `connected_to()`。

## 状态读数

`heat()` 返回当前加热设定值。`temperature()`、`power_output()` 与 `fuel_level()` 返回设备当前数值。`status()` 的可能返回值包括 `"running"`、`"overheated"`、`"no_fuel"` 与 `"no_coolant"`。

## 编写控制器

温度最终会稳定在 `heat` 乘以一个隐藏增益的数值上。该增益虽不可直接读取，但可测量：当温度停止变化时，增益等于 `temperature()` 除以 `heat()`。将目标温度除以该增益，即可得出维持该温度所需的加热值。这也是为何基于实测反馈的控制器优于依赖固定常数的控制器。

> 修正力度每循环执行一次，但堆芯温度是按 **游戏内时钟小时** 变化的。一个游戏内小时对应的现实秒数是固定的，但会随游戏速度改变。在某一速度下调优的循环，在另一速度下会出现修正过度或不足，除非通过 `clock.real_seconds_per_hour()` 进行比例缩放。
