zh: 传感器阵列已上线。三台仪器已激活。

en: Not connected. Call connect() on this same transmitter handle first. A second get_component("transmitter") returns a different handle that has not connected, so store one in a variable and use it for both connect() and transmit().
zh: 未连接。请先在此发射器句柄上调用 connect()。重复调用 get_component("transmitter") 会返回不同的未连接句柄，请将其存入变量，并在 connect() 与 transmit() 中统一使用该变量。

en: Unknown planet '{name}'. Available: {available}. Use transmitter.list_planets() to see targets.
zh: 未知星球 '{name}'。可用目标：{available}。请使用 transmitter.list_planets() 查看目标列表。

en: Unknown planet '{name}'. Did you mean '{suggestion}'? Planet ids are case-sensitive.
zh: 未知星球 '{name}'。是否指 '{suggestion}'？星球 ID 区分大小写。
{planet}：读数被拒。预期当前值为 {label}，实际获取 {value}。

en: {planet}: "{key}" is the planet, not the key. Expected key "current_temperature".
zh: {planet}: "{key}" 是行星名称，而非键名。预期键名为 "current_temperature"。

en: Error: pressure sensor malfunction, repair required
zh: 错误：气压传感器故障，需要维修

en: Error: oxygen sensor malfunction, repair required
zh: 错误：氧气传感器故障，需要维修

en: Oxygen sensor is not repaired. Repair oxygen_sensor before reading atmosphere.get_o2().
zh: 氧气传感器尚未修复。请在读取 atmosphere.get_o2() 前修复 oxygen_sensor。

en: Pressure sensor is not repaired. Repair pressure_sensor before reading atmosphere.get_pressure().
zh: 气压传感器尚未修复。请在读取 atmosphere.get_pressure() 前修复 pressure_sensor。

en: Component not found: {name}. Tap the ⓘ on any component's card to see its id.
zh: 未找到组件：{name}。点击任意组件卡片上的 ⓘ 可查看其 ID。

en: Component not found: {name}. Did you mean '{suggestion}'? IDs are case-sensitive, tap the ⓘ on any component's card to see them.
zh: 未找到组件：{name}。是否指 '{suggestion}'？ID 区分大小写，点击任意组件卡片上的 ⓘ 即可查看。

en: Cannot access {name}, this is a private component. Use self in its own script. See DOCS > Components for details.
zh: 无法访问 {name}，此为私有组件。请在其自身脚本中使用 self。详见 DOCS > Components。

en: {name} is gated behind research. Unlock {research} before using this API.
zh: {name} 受研究限制。使用此 API 前需先解锁 {research}。

en: Unknown research id: "{id}". Check the Research page or autocomplete inside is_unlocked(...).
zh: 未知研究 ID："{id}"。请查看研究页面，或在 is_unlocked(...) 中使用自动补全。

en: No storage bin named "{name}". Check the name on the component's card.
zh: 未找到名为 "{name}" 的储物箱。请核对组件卡片上的名称。

en: No component named "{name}". Click the pencil on a machine or outpost card to rename, then look it up here.
zh: 未找到名为 "{name}" 的组件。点击机器或前哨站卡片上的铅笔图标进行重命名，然后在此处查找。

en: Cannot call {method}() on {name} remotely, hardware methods only work from the machine's own script (self). Attach a script to {name} to drive it; coordinate between scripts via shared reads or the Signal Bus. You can still read its state from here.
zh: 无法远程在 {name} 上调用 {method}()，硬件方法仅能在机器自身的脚本 (self) 中运行。请将脚本附加至 {name} 以驱动它；脚本间可通过共享读取或信号总线进行协调。你仍可在此处读取其状态。

en: Watch Nocturna change in real time.
zh: 实时观测诺克图纳星的变迁。

en: Bring the exterior camera online and watch the world outside through a live feed. Storms cross the basin, ice gives way, strange life takes hold, and the base you built glows against the dark.
zh: 启动外部摄像头，通过实时画面观测外界。风暴掠过盆地，冰层消融，奇异生命悄然扎根，而你建造的基地在黑暗中熠熠生辉。

en: Unlocks the Ship → Computer page: a dashboard for system status, script management, the Playground, achievements, and notifications. Further research adds more Computer tabs, starting with the Library.
zh: 解锁“飞船 → 计算机”页面：用于查看系统状态、管理脚本、访问游乐场、成就与通知的仪表盘。后续研究将添加更多计算机标签页，首开“库”标签。

en: Adds the Library tab to the Ship Computer. Write reusable helper functions once in the Library, then import them into any machine script, so shared logic lives in one place instead of being copied everywhere.
zh: 为飞船计算机添加“库”标签页。只需在库中编写一次可复用的辅助函数，即可将其导入任意机器脚本中，让共享逻辑集中于一处，避免重复复制。
创建由脚本驱动的控制面板。

en: Opens the Control Room, a top-level page for script-driven dashboard cards. Build clocks, fleet boards, vent-cycle timelines, and recovery controls with drawing and input APIs.
zh: 解锁“控制室”顶级页面，用于承载由脚本驱动的仪表盘卡片。借助绘图与输入 API，可构建时钟、机队面板、排气周期时间轴及回收控制等模块。

en: Adds map markers: named, colored annotations you place in Plan Mode or from any script with `get_component("markers")`. Markers are notes, not construction. They cost nothing, need no Pioneer, and appear the moment you place them, so a survey script can record what it found where it found it.
zh: 添加地图标记：可在规划模式或通过任意脚本调用 `get_component("markers")` 放置的命名彩色标注。标记仅为笔记，并非建筑实体。它们不消耗资源，无需先锋建造机，放置后即刻显示，便于勘探脚本准确记录发现物及其位置。

en: Planet Map and Vehicles tab access.
zh: 星球地图与载具页签访问权限。

en: Unlocks the Planet Map and its Vehicles tab for managing your ground vehicles. Prospect the surface before committing to a vehicle.
zh: 解锁星球地图及其载具页签，用于管理你的地面载具。在决定投入载具前先勘测地表。

en: Unlocks the Rover in the Shop. Its integrated **100 Wh** battery and **10-unit** hold are fixed; Nav, Sonar, and Drill use three dedicated module slots.
zh: 在商店中解锁漫游车。其内置的 **100 Wh** 电池与 **10 单位** 载货空间为固定配置；导航、声呐与钻头模块将占用三个专用插槽。

en: Unlocks Nav modules in the shop. Gives vehicles the ability to navigate and drive from their own script. Stop, completion, or error cancels script-owned movement.
zh: 在商店中解锁导航模块。赋予载具通过自身脚本进行导航与行驶的能力。停止指令、行驶完成或发生错误将终止脚本控制的移动。

en: Unlocks Basic Sonar modules in the shop. Sonar performs point sweeps from a vehicle's current position, discovering nearby map sites and recording them in the Journal.
zh: 在商店中解锁基础声呐模块。声呐可从载具当前位置进行单点扫描，发现附近的地图地点并自动记录至日志中。

en: Unlocks the Vehicle Charging Station in the Shop. Mk I has **1 bay** and a **30 W** charging budget; later packs raise both fleet capacity and pooled solo charging speed.
zh: 解锁商店中的载具充电站。Mk I 型具备 **1 个泊位** 与 **30 W** 充电功率配额；后续升级包将同步提升车队容量与集中供电单车充电速度。

en: Unlocks Drill modules in the shop. Extract raw ore from surveyed mining sites.
zh: 在商店中解锁钻探模块。从已勘测的采矿点提取原矿。

en: Unlocks three advanced contracts as atmospheric oxygen begins to rise.
zh: 随着大气氧含量开始上升，解锁三项高级合约。

en: Unlocks the Storage Bin in the shop. Deployable single-material containers for stockpiling raw and refined materials at an outpost, one material per bin. Keep what you mine, stage what you need. (The Warehouse, researched later, is the larger multi-material depot.)
zh: 解锁商店中的储物箱。可部署的单物料容器，用于在前哨站囤积原始与精炼材料，每箱仅限存放一种物料。留存开采所得，储备所需物资。（后续研究解锁的仓库为更大的多物料集散中心。）

en: Unlocks property-preserving item flow through machine I/O ports. Inventory is a source or destination only at Nocturna Base; other endpoints must be at the machine's outpost or physically present vehicle location. Equal item ids with different properties remain distinct stacks.
zh: 解锁通过机器 I/O 端口传输且保留属性的物品流。仅诺克图纳星基地的库存可作为来源或目的地；其他端点必须位于机器所在的前哨站或载具实际所在位置。物品 ID 相同但属性不同的物品仍视为独立堆叠。

en: Faster intake and dispatch at Drone Depots.
zh: 加快无人机仓库的接收与调度。

en: Automatically improves existing and newly deployed Drone Depots: **2× handling at a base Depot**, **4× at Medium**, and **8× at Large**, stacking with Fast Feeders. Speeds intake and dispatch so several remote machines can share a supply route. Each receiving machine still has its own intake cooldown. Drone speed, cargo capacity and Supply Dock dispatch rates stay the same. No upgrade pack is needed.
zh: 自动改进现有和已部署的无人机仓库：**基础仓库 2× 处理**，**中型 4×**，**大型 8×**，可与快速供料器叠加。加快接收与调度，使多台远程机器可以共享一条补给路线。每台接收机器仍拥有各自的接收冷却。无人机速度、载货容量和补给坞调度速率保持不变。无需升级包。

en: Reduces the duration of every timed discrete-item transfer by **50%**. Machine endpoints remain occupied until the faster handling cycle finishes. Fluids and manual world actions are unaffected.
zh: 将每次定时离散物品传输的耗时缩短 **50%**。在更快的处理周期完成前，机器端点将保持占用状态。流体传输与手动交互操作不受影响。

en: Triple remote gas and liquid throughput.
zh: 远程气体与液体吞吐量提升至三倍。

en: Retrofits every completed and future Gas Pipe and Liquid Pipe component. Each matched source-side and sink-side attachment link carries up to **6,000 t/h** instead of **2,000 t/h**. Pipe length and interior branches still add no capacity; separate attachment links and independent components retain their own budgets.
zh: 改造所有已建成及未来的气体管道与液体管道组件。每个匹配的源端与汇端连接链路承载上限提升至 **6,000 t/h**（原为 **2,000 t/h**）。管道长度与内部分支仍不增加容量；各独立连接链路与组件保留各自的流量配额。

en: Unlocks the Smelter in the Shop. This industrial furnace reduces raw ore into refined metals and components suitable for advanced machinery.
zh: 解锁商店中的冶炼厂。该工业熔炉可将原矿冶炼为适用于高级机械的精炼金属与组件。

en: Unlocks the Fabricator in the Shop. This industrial assembly press combines refined materials into finished equipment, modules, and vehicle frames.
zh: 解锁商店中的制造机。该工业装配压机可将精炼材料加工为成品设备、模块与载具框架。

en: Unlocks the eight-slot Pioneer chassis in the Shop. It has no built-in battery, cargo, or Nav and cannot move until separately purchased hardware is installed.
zh: 解锁商店中的八槽位先锋建造机底盘。该底盘无内置电池、货舱或导航模块，须另行购买并安装硬件后方可移动。

en: Unlocks Orders and Supply Dock purchasing.
zh: 解锁订单与补给港购买权限。

en: A long-range logistics protocol for Earth demand. Supply Docks become available in the Shop and ship **25 units/h** before throughput research; build more docks to serve orders in parallel.
zh: 面向地球需求的远程物流协议。商店中将解锁补给码头，在吞吐量研究完成前，每个码头运输速率为 **25 单位/小时**；建造更多码头可并行处理订单。

en: Adds the Signal Bus tab to the Ship Computer. Scripts coordinate with each other by sending queued messages or broadcasting shared values on named channels: explicit, save-safe shared state instead of hidden globals.
zh: 在飞船计算机中添加信号总线选项卡。脚本通过发送队列消息或在命名通道上广播共享值来相互协调：提供显式且存档安全的共享状态，替代隐藏的全局变量。

en: Adds the Data Archive tab to the Ship Computer. Scripts can store lookup tables, calibration samples, discovered maps, and other learned knowledge that persists across restarts and save/load. Use the Signal Bus for live coordination and the Data Archive for long-lived data.
zh: 在飞船计算机中添加数据档案库选项卡。脚本可存储查找表、校准样本、已探索地图及其他习得知识，这些数据在重启与读档后依然保留。使用信号总线进行实时协调，使用数据档案库存储长期数据。

en: Extends the Sonar Module to detect thermal vents alongside mining sites. Surveyed vents are added to the Journal with their own readings, so you can find where steam can be tapped.
zh: 扩展声呐模块功能，使其在探测矿点的同时识别地热喷口。已勘测的喷口将附带独立读数录入日志，方便你定位可抽取蒸汽的地点。

en: Unlocks the Constructor Module for the Pioneer in the Shop. Plan construction in Planet Map Plan Mode or with `get_component("construction_blueprint")`, load the needed kits, segments, or bridges into the Pioneer's cargo, and drive out to build outposts, pipes, power lines, and machines on site.
zh: 在商店中为先锋解锁建造模块。可在星球地图规划模式或使用 `get_component("construction_blueprint")` 进行建造规划，将所需的套件、分段或桥梁装入先锋的货舱，随后驶出并在现场建造前哨站、管道、电力线路及机器。

en: Unlocks the Thermal Cap and its **Thermal Cap Kit** recipe. Fabricate the kit at a Fabricator, then use a Constructor-equipped Pioneer to build the Cap on a surveyed thermal vent from a Planet Map blueprint. The Cap captures Steam during the vent's active phase and releases it to explicitly connected destinations; remote destinations also need a compatible completed Gas Pipe route. A chamber that reaches **100%** blows away all stored Steam, so its script must release, route, or relieve pressure. Place the blueprint in Plan Mode or with `construction_blueprint.plan_structure("thermal_cap", x, y)`.
zh: 解锁地热盖及其 **地热盖套件** 配方。在制造机处生产套件后，使用搭载建造模块的先锋根据星球地图蓝图，在已勘测的地热喷口上建造地热盖。地热盖会在喷口活跃期捕获蒸汽，并将其释放至明确连接的目的地；远程目的地还需兼容且已完工的气体管道路线。腔室达到 **100%** 时会排空所有储存的蒸汽，因此其脚本必须执行释放、路由或泄压操作。可在规划模式或使用 `construction_blueprint.plan_structure("thermal_cap", x, y)` 放置蓝图。
将蒸汽转化为电网电力。

en: Unlocks the Steam Turbine in the Shop. At full throttle it consumes **90 t/h Steam** and produces **108 W**; a script controls the throttle.
zh: 在商店中解锁蒸汽轮机。满负荷运转时消耗 **90 t/h 蒸汽** 并产出 **108 W** 电力；由脚本控制节流阀。
单电芯提供 5 倍电网储能。

en: Unlocks the Large Battery in the Shop: **2,500 Wh** of base-station storage, five times the base cell. One unit replaces a cluster of Small Batteries.
zh: 在商店中解锁大型电池：提供 **2,500 Wh** 的基站储能，容量为基础电芯的五倍。单个单元即可替代一组小型电池。
在设备间缓冲单一气体。

en: Unlocks the Gas Tank in the Shop, a passive **5000**-ton buffer that latches to the first gas it receives (steam, ammonia, swamp gas, or any gas) and holds only that gas until drained.
zh: 在商店中解锁储气罐，这是一个被动式 **5000** 吨缓冲装置，会锁定接收到的第一种气体（蒸汽、氨气、沼泽气或任意气体），并仅储存该气体直至排空。

en: Unlocks the Liquid Tank in the Shop, a passive **100**-ton buffer that latches to the first liquid it receives (water, oil, or any biome essence) and holds only that fluid until drained.
zh: 在商店中解锁储液罐，这是一个被动式 **100** 吨缓冲装置，会锁定接收到的第一种液体（水、油或任意生态精华），并仅储存该流体直至排空。

en: Unlocks the Oxygen Generator Mk II Upgrade Pack in the shop. Retrofits a Mk I oxygen generator to Mk II for higher output.
zh: 在商店中解锁氧气发电机 Mk II 升级包。将 Mk I 氧气发电机改造为 Mk II 以提升产量。

en: Unlocks the Heat Generator Mk II Upgrade Pack in the shop. Retrofits a Mk I heater to Mk II for higher output.
zh: 在商店中解锁热能发电机 Mk II 升级包。将 Mk I 加热器改造为 Mk II 以提升输出。

en: Unlocks the Bio Luminizer in the shop, the coastal machine that tunes a bioluminescent fragment's glow to an order's exact target color. Coastal Bio Orders require infused fragments.
zh: 在商店中解锁生物发光仪，这是一台海岸设备，可将生物发光碎片的辉光调节至订单指定的精确颜色。海岸生物订单需要已灌注的碎片。

en: Unlocks the DNA Sequencer in the shop, the geothermal machine that reads and rewrites fragment DNA. Geothermal Bio Orders require fragments engineered to carry specific genes.
zh: 在商店中解锁 DNA 测序仪，这是一台地热设备，可读取并重写碎片 DNA。地热生物订单需要经定向改造以携带特定基因的碎片。

en: Unlocks the Bio Caster in the shop, the volcanic machine that heat-casts a fragment with fabricated materials. Volcanic Bio Orders require forged fragments.
zh: 在商店中解锁生物铸造机。该火山机械可使用合成材料对构件进行热铸。火山生物订单需使用锻造构件。

en: Unlocks the Bio Conditioner in the shop, the deep machine that quality-control-inspects a fragment through a 5-stage accept/reject gauntlet against a published rulebook. Deep Bio Orders require conditioned fragments. Power-only, no fluids or materials.
zh: 在商店中解锁生物调理机。该深海机械可依据已发布的规范手册，通过五级合格/淘汰筛选线对构件进行质检。深海生物订单需使用调理过的构件。仅消耗电力，无需流体或材料。

en: Unlocks the Pressure Generator Mk II Upgrade Pack in the shop. Retrofits a Mk I pressure generator to Mk II for higher output.
zh: 在商店中解锁压力发电机II型升级包。可将已部署的I型压力发电机改造为II型，以提升输出功率。

en: Second bay; pools to 120 W solo.
zh: 增设第二充电位；单机总功率达120 W。

en: Unlocks the Vehicle Charging Station Mk II Upgrade Pack in the shop. Retrofits a deployed station to Mk II, adding a second charging bay.
zh: 在商店中解锁载具充电站II型升级包。可将已部署的充电站改造为II型，增设第二个充电位。

en: Unlocks the Warehouse in the shop. A **10,000-unit** multi-material depot: **5** material-locked slots of **2,000** each. Use it as a buffer for drone deliveries and large vehicle hauls.
zh: 在商店中解锁仓库。这是一座容量为 **10,000 单位** 的多材料仓储设施：包含 **5** 个材料锁定槽位，每个容量 **2,000**。可用作无人机配送与大型载具运输的缓冲中转站。

en: Unlocks survey of subsurface water deposits and the **Water Pump recipe**. Sonar scans now reveal water wells across the map. Wells produce continuous water at their yield tier (1× / 2× / 3×). Fabricate a Water Pump at a Fabricator, deploy it on a surveyed well, and pipe the output to base.
zh: 解锁地下水资源勘测与 **水泵配方**。声呐扫描现可显示地图上的水井。水井将根据其产量等级（1× / 2× / 3×）持续产出水资源。在制造机中制作水泵，将其部署于已勘测的水井上，并通过管道将水输送至基地。

en: Oil wells visible to Deep Sonar.

Unlocks survey of subsurface oil deposits and the **Oil Pump recipe**. **Deep Sonar required**: oil wells are a hidden layer for the late-tier sonar. Fabricate an Oil Pump at a Fabricator, deploy it on a surveyed well, and pipe oil to base for power generation and refining.
zh: 解锁地下石油资源勘测与 **油泵配方**。**需配备深层声呐**：油井属于高级声呐才能探测的隐藏地层。在制造机中制作油泵，将其部署于已勘测的油井上，并通过管道将石油输送至基地，用于发电与精炼。

en: Unlocks the Oil Generator in the shop. Burns oil to produce up to **700 W** from one machine (several times a Steam Turbine's peak) with full throttle control via script. Consumes **8 t/h** at full output.
zh: 在商店中解锁石油发电机。该设备通过燃烧石油单台最高可产出 **700 W** 电力（数倍于蒸汽轮机峰值），并支持通过脚本进行全功率调节。满负荷运行时消耗 **8 t/h** 石油。

en: See approaching storms three times further out.
zh: 提前三倍距离观测逼近的风暴。

en: Extends new Weather Station reports and Incoming coverage from **8** to **24 world-clock hours**. Forecasts remain local to storms expected to enter powered-station coverage.
zh: 将新建气象站的报告与 Incoming 覆盖范围从 **8** 延长至 **24** 世界时。预报仅针对预计将进入已供电气象站覆盖区的风暴。

en: Unlocks the **Weather Network**, installs one free completed Weather Station and its building slot at Nocturna Base, and makes additional stations available in the Shop. Observe local storms, handle live transmissions, and publish optional results to the Signal Board.
zh: 解锁 **气象网络**，在诺克图纳星基地免费安装一座已完工的气象站及其建筑槽位，并在商店中提供额外气象站。观测局部风暴，处理实时传输数据，并可选择将结果发布至信号板。

en: Unlocks the **Reactor** in the Shop: Fuel Rods in, cooling water through, **5,000 W** out, day and night, storm or calm. One rod lasts **72 hours** at heat **1.0**, and fuel use follows commanded heat. Keep the core in the green band; push it too hot and it overheats and shuts down safely.
zh: 在商店中解锁 **反应堆**：输入燃料棒，通入冷却水，输出 **5,000 W** 电力，无论昼夜或风暴天气均稳定运行。单根燃料棒在热量 **1.0** 下可持续 **72 小时**，燃料消耗随指令热量变化。保持堆芯处于绿色安全区间；温度过高将触发过热保护并安全停机。

en: Unlocks the **Lightning Rod Kit recipe**. This storm-charged bank stores **4,000 Wh**, catches strikes within **600 m**, and feeds the grid behind batteries. Condition falls **0.05 per day**, reducing capture to zero unless a script repairs it with **1 Storm Glass**.
zh: 解锁 **避雷针套件配方**。该风暴充能储能装置可储存 **4,000 Wh** 电量，捕获 **600 m** 范围内的雷击，并在电池之后向电网供电。状态值每日下降 **0.05**，导致捕获率归零，除非编写脚本使用 **1 块风暴玻璃** 进行修复。
粗铀 + 铅 → 燃料棒。

en: Unlocks the Fuel Assembler in the Shop. This nuclear workbench presses Raw Uranium and lead casing into **Fuel Rods** and draws about **1,800 W** while running.
zh: 在商店中解锁燃料组装机。该核能工作台将粗铀与铅外壳压制成 **燃料棒**，运行期间功耗约为 **1,800 W**。

en: Hot cargo needs a shielded lane: **Lead Casks** are the only stationary home for Raw Uranium and Fuel Rods, and **Shield Plating** lets a drone extract Raw Uranium without gaining exposure. Unlocks both items' availability; the fabrication recipes come through contractor orders.
zh: 热货物需要屏蔽通道：**铅罐**是原铀与燃料棒的唯一固定存放点，而**屏蔽镀层**可让无人机在提取原铀时免受辐射暴露。解锁这两类物品的获取途径；制造配方将通过承包商订单提供。

en: Nuclear-era oxygen tier, fuelled by rods.
zh: 核能时代氧气层级，以燃料棒驱动。

en: Unlocks the **Oxygen Upgrade Pack Mk IV recipe** at the Fabricator. This final tier **replaces the water input entirely** with a **Fuel Rod** magazine fed from a connected Lead Cask and draws roughly 100x Mk I power. **A generator with no rod stops producing** rather than degrading.
zh: 在制造机解锁**氧气升级包 Mk IV 配方**。该最终层级**完全取代水输入**，改为由相连铅罐供料的**燃料棒供料匣**，功耗约为 Mk I 的 100 倍。**发电机若无燃料棒将直接停止运转**，而非效率衰减。

en: Nuclear-era heat tier, fuelled by rods.
zh: 核能时代热量层级，以燃料棒驱动。

en: Unlocks the **Heat Upgrade Pack Mk IV recipe** at the Fabricator. This final tier **replaces the steam input entirely** with a **Fuel Rod** magazine fed from a connected Lead Cask and draws roughly 100x Mk I power. **A heater with no rod stops producing** rather than degrading.
zh: 在制造机解锁**热量升级包 Mk IV 配方**。该最终层级**完全取代蒸汽输入**，改为由相连铅罐供料的**燃料棒供料匣**，功耗约为 Mk I 的 100 倍。**加热器若无燃料棒将直接停止运转**，而非效率衰减。

en: Nuclear-era pressure tier, fuelled by rods.
zh: 核能时代压力层级，以燃料棒驱动。

en: Unlocks the **Pressure Upgrade Pack Mk IV recipe** at the Fabricator. This final tier **replaces the water input entirely** with a **Fuel Rod** magazine fed from a connected Lead Cask and draws roughly 100x Mk I power. **A generator with no rod stops producing** rather than degrading.
zh: 在制造机解锁**压力升级包 Mk IV 配方**。该最终层级**完全取代水输入**，改为由相连铅罐供料的**燃料棒供料匣**，功耗约为 Mk I 的 100 倍。**发电机若无燃料棒将直接停止运转**，而非效率衰减。

en: Move nuclear cargo through Drone Depots.
zh: 允许核货物经由无人机仓库流转。

en: Lines every Drone Depot with containment so hot cargo can pass through your logistics network. Until this is researched a depot refuses Raw Uranium and Fuel Rods outright, and a plated drone has nowhere to unload them. Applies to every depot you own and every one you build afterwards.
zh: 为所有无人机仓库加装屏蔽层，使热货物得以在你的物流网络中通行。在此研究完成前，仓库将直接拒收原铀与燃料棒，且已加装屏蔽镀层的无人机将无处卸货。该效果适用于你当前拥有的所有仓库及此后建造的所有仓库。

en: Open aerial logistics before the biosphere era.
zh: 在生物圈时代前开启空中物流。

en: Unlocks the drone system and its fleet dashboard, the Vehicles / Drones / Support roster under the Planet Map. Electric drones fly up to **300 m/h** and consume **5 Wh/h** at full throttle; burn rises with throttle squared. Drone hardware still requires blueprint recipes earned through Earth Orders. Fabricated facilities and chassis deploy from Inventory into outposts; field Mining Drills use Planet Map blueprints placed in Plan Mode or by script.
zh: 解锁无人机系统及其机队面板（位于星球地图下的载具/无人机/支援列表）。电动无人机最高飞行速度为 **300 m/h**，满油门时耗电 **5 Wh/h**；能耗随油门开度呈平方增长。无人机硬件仍需通过地球订单获取蓝图配方。制造出的设施与底盘从库存部署至前哨站；野外采矿钻机使用在规划模式中放置或通过脚本调用的星球地图蓝图。

en: Allows Heli Thrusters and Oil Tanks to be mounted on drones. Their Fabricator recipes are earned separately through Vestibule orders. Heli drones fly **900 m/h** and consume **5 t/h Oil** at full throttle; burn rises with throttle squared. Three oil-tank sizes set their range, and Drone Service Stations refuel them from their oil input.
zh: 允许在无人机上安装旋翼推进器与油箱。其制造机配方需通过前厅订单单独获取。旋翼无人机最高飞行速度为 **900 m/h**，满油门时消耗 **5 t/h 石油**；能耗随油门开度呈平方增长。三种尺寸的油箱决定其航程，无人机服务站可通过石油输入为其加油。
补给码头吞吐量提升至四倍。

en: Quadruples each Supply Dock's per-pulse emission count from **1** to **4** units, so the effective rate jumps from **25 units/h** to **100 units/h**. Pulse cadence is unchanged; only the packet size scales.
zh: 将每个补给站单次脉冲的发射数量从 **1** 提升至 **4** 单位，使有效速率从 **25 units/h** 跃升至 **100 units/h**。脉冲频率保持不变，仅数据包规模扩大。
补给码头吞吐量提升至十六倍。

en: Bumps each Supply Dock's per-pulse emission to **16** units, an effective **400 units/h**. Pulse cadence is unchanged; only the packet size scales.
zh: 将每个补给站单次脉冲的发射数量提升至 **16** 单位，有效速率达 **400 units/h**。脉冲频率保持不变，仅数据包规模扩大。

en: Your terraforming output has passed Earth's vetting threshold. A second batch of contracts (denser puzzles, higher rewards) routes to your terminal. Adds new tiers to the Contractor Reputation ladder.
zh: 你的地球化产出已通过地球的审核阈值。第二批合约（谜题更密集、奖励更高）将路由至你的终端。为承包商声望阶梯新增等级。

en: Unlocks three difficult contracts in the atmosphere-era program. Completing them contributes to Contractor Reputation; the final contract batch arrives with Smart Contractor.
zh: 解锁大气层时代计划中的三项高难度合约。完成它们可提升承包商声望；最终合约批次将在解锁智能承包商后送达。

en: Your Biomass recovery has opened Earth's final contractor channel. Unlocks Beat the System, Core Sample, and Lattice, the three hardest programming contracts, and completes the Contractor Reputation ladder.
zh: 你的生物质回收工作已开启地球的最终承包商频道。解锁《击败系统》《岩芯样本》与《晶格》这三项最难的编程合约，并补全承包商声望阶梯。
生物质混合器 Mk II

en: 87.5% more biomass per ton of essence.
zh: 每吨精华多产出 87.5% 生物质。

en: Unlocks the Biomass Mixer Mk II Upgrade Pack in the shop. One pack retrofits one deployed Mk I Mixer for **4.5× output** on only **2.4× essence consumption**, with **5× power draw**. That is **87.5%** more biomass per ton of essence, which matters because Liquifier intake is fixed and rare life forms regrow slowly. There is no Mk III.
zh: 在商店中解锁生物质混合器 Mk II 升级包。每个升级包可改造一台已部署的 Mk I 混合器，实现 **4.5 倍产出**，仅消耗 **2.4 倍精华**，但功耗为 **5 倍**。这意味着每吨精华可多产出 **87.5%** 的生物质，鉴于液化器摄入量固定且稀有生命体再生缓慢，这一点至关重要。本作无 Mk III。

en: Fifteen kinds of material in one building.
zh: 单栋建筑容纳十五种材料。

en: Unlocks the **Large Warehouse** in the shop. It holds **30,000 units** across **15** slots of **2,000**, and each slot sticks to one material. That is enough room for a wide biological and industrial supply chain to keep every material apart, without replacing Drone Depot handoffs or scripted transfers.
zh: 在商店中解锁**大型仓库**。它提供 **15** 个 **2,000** 容量的货位，总计 **30,000 单位**，且每个货位仅存放单一材料。这为庞大的生物与工业供应链提供了充足的隔离存储空间，同时不会替代无人机仓库的交接或脚本传输功能。

en: Unlocks the Wide Sonar module in the shop. Extends scan range to **180 m** and detects minerals up to hardness 3, including Titanium, Cobalt and Rare Earth, out in the mid and outer rings.
zh: 在商店中解锁广域声呐模块。将扫描范围扩展至 **180 米**，可探测硬度最高为 3 的矿物（包括钛、钴与稀土），适用于中环与外环区域。

en: Unlocks the Sport Nav module in the shop. One Sport Nav gives 2× top speed with 2.6× movement power draw compared with Basic Nav in the same rig, about 1.3× battery use per meter at full throttle. Further Sport Navs stack at a rising cost, especially on loaded long-haul routes.
zh: 在商店中解锁运动导航模块。在同款底盘上，单个运动导航模块可提供 2 倍最高速度，但移动功耗为基本导航的 2.6 倍，全速行驶时每米耗电量约为 1.3 倍。后续叠加的运动导航模块成本递增，在满载长途运输时尤为明显。

en: Unlocks the Small Battery Holder in the shop. Adds a **1**-bay portable battery mount for modular vehicles, essential for any expedition away from the Vehicle Charging Station.
zh: 在商店中解锁小型电池支架。为模块化载具增加 **1** 个便携式电池挂载位，是远离载具充电站执行远征任务的必备组件。
开放硬度-3矿物开采权限。

en: Unlocks the Industrial Drill module in the shop. Extracts hardness-3 minerals (Rare Earth) from the outer ring. Faster dig time than the basic drill, higher power draw.
zh: 在商店解锁工业钻头模块。可开采外环带的硬度-3矿物（稀土）。挖掘速度优于基础钻头，但功耗更高。

en: Unlocks the Medium Battery Holder in the shop. Two bays for portable batteries, a compact range upgrade for modular vehicles.
zh: 在商店中解锁中型电池支架。提供两个便携式电池挂载位，为模块化载具提供紧凑的续航升级。

en: Unlocks the Heavy Portable Battery in the shop. A **100 Wh** portable cell, double a standard battery, that drops into any vehicle holder bay to sustain long-haul fleets far from the Vehicle Charging Station.
zh: 在商店中解锁重型便携电池。容量为 **100 Wh** 的便携电芯，是标准电池的两倍，可装入任意载具电池挂载位，为远离载具充电站的长途车队提供持续续航。
开放边缘环带勘测硬件。

en: Unlocks the Deep Sonar module in the shop. Extends scan range to **280 m** and detects hardness-4 minerals (Neutronium) at the edge ring. Also deepens thermal/exotic survey detail and is required to reveal oil wells after **Petroleum Survey**.
zh: 在商店中解锁深层声呐模块。将扫描范围扩展至 **280 米**，可探测边缘环带的硬度 4 矿物（中子素）。同时提升热力学/特殊矿脉的勘探精度，且在完成**石油勘探**后，为揭示油井所必需。
开放硬度-4矿物开采权限。

en: Unlocks the Heavy Drill module in the shop. The only drill that can extract hardness-4 Neutronium, required for Mk III fabrication.
zh: 在商店中解锁重型钻头模块。唯一能够开采硬度 4 中子素的钻头，为 Mk III 级制造的必需组件。
开放模块化载具货舱存储。

en: Unlocks the Small Cargo Rack and Portable Bin in the shop. A **1**-bin rack for modular vehicles, letting them haul mined ore back to base.
zh: 在商店中解锁小型货舱架与便携货箱。为模块化载具提供 **1** 个货箱位，使其能够将开采的矿石运回基地。

en: Unlocks the Medium Cargo Rack and Heavy Portable Bin in the shop. Two bins for larger hauls per run, with room for a second mineral.
zh: 在商店中解锁中型货舱架与重型便携货箱。提供两个货箱位，支持单次更大运量，并可同时装载第二种矿物。
开放三槽电池挂载功能。

en: Unlocks the Large Battery Holder in the shop. Three bays, enough capacity to sustain Heavy Drill power draw on long edge-ring expeditions.
zh: 在商店中解锁大型电池支架。提供三个挂载位，容量足以支撑重型钻头在边缘环带长途远征时的功耗需求。

en: Unlocks the Large Cargo Rack in the shop. Three bins for maximum haul capacity on large mining runs.
zh: 在商店中解锁大型货舱架。提供三个货箱位，在大型采矿作业中实现最大运载量。

en: Found new sites across the planet.
zh: 允许在星球各地建立新据点。

en: Unlocks the Outpost Kit in the shop. Founding still requires Constructor Module research plus a Constructor-equipped Pioneer: place an Outpost blueprint in Plan Mode or with `construction_blueprint.plan_structure("outpost", x, y)`, load the kit into Pioneer cargo, then build it. Each outpost begins with a soft capacity of **20** buildings. Expanded Outpost Infrastructure later raises every outpost's capacity by **5**. Marginal kit prices are based on founded expansion outposts plus unbuilt Outpost Kits held in physical storage: **15,000 cr**, **30,000 cr**, **50,000 cr**, **75,000 cr**, **110,000 cr**, **200,000 cr**, **350,000 cr**, **550,000 cr**, **800,000 cr**, then **1,000,000 cr** for every later kit.
zh: 在商店中解锁前哨站套件。建立前哨站仍需先完成建造机模块研究，并配备一台搭载建造机的先锋建造机：在规划模式中放置前哨站蓝图，或使用 `construction_blueprint.plan_structure("outpost", x, y)` 放置，将套件装入先锋建造机货舱后即可建造。每个前哨站初始软容量上限为 **20** 栋建筑。后续的前哨站基础设施扩展研究将使每个前哨站的容量提升 **5**。套件的递增价格取决于已建立的扩展前哨站数量，加上实体库存中未建造的前哨站套件数量：**15,000 积分**、**30,000 积分**、**50,000 积分**、**75,000 积分**、**110,000 积分**、**200,000 积分**、**350,000 积分**、**550,000 积分**、**800,000 积分**，此后每套均为 **1,000,000 积分**。

en: Increase every outpost's building capacity by 5.
zh: 每个前哨站的建筑容量增加 5。

en: Raises the soft building capacity of every current and future outpost by **5**. Nocturna Base increases from **25** to **30** buildings, and founded outposts increase from **20** to **25**. Buildings beyond the new cap still incur the normal overcrowding penalty.
zh: 将所有现有及未来前哨站的建筑容量软上限提升 **5**。诺克图纳星基地的建筑上限从 **25** 增至 **30**，已建立的前哨站从 **20** 增至 **25**。超出新上限的建筑仍会承受常规的过度拥挤惩罚。

en: Every inventory slot holds twice as much.
zh: 每个库存格位的容纳量翻倍。

en: Rebuilds the shelving at Nocturna Base so each slot takes a taller stack. Items that stack now go up to **20 per slot** instead of **10**. Equipment, modules, and other one-off items still take a slot each. This changes Base Inventory only, not vehicle cargo, Storage Bins, or Warehouses.
zh: 重建诺克图纳星基地的货架，使每个格位可容纳更高的堆叠。可堆叠物品的上限现为每格 **20** 个，而非原来的 **10** 个。装备、模块及其他独立物品仍各占一格。此改动仅影响基地库存，不影响载具货舱、储物箱或仓库。

en: Unlocks the **EXPAND** button on the Inventory page. Each slot costs more than the last, starting at **500 cr** for slot 37 and climbing to ~**146,000 cr** for the final slot, capped at **60** total. Total cost to fully max out: ~**666,000 cr**.
zh: 解锁库存页面上的 **EXPAND** 按钮。每个格位的价格递增，第 37 格起价为 **500 积分**，最终格位价格约为 **146,000 积分**，总格位上限为 **60**。完全升满的总花费约为 **666,000 积分**。

en: Unlocks the **Biomass tier** supply chain and makes the Portable Bio Scanner, Portable Bio Extractor, Essence Liquifier, and Biomass Mixer available in the Shop. Scan biome tiles, extract life-form samples, and run them through the chain to produce biomass.
zh: 解锁 **生物质层级** 供应链，并在商店中提供便携式生物扫描仪、便携式生物提取器、精华液化机与生物质混合机。扫描生态群系地块，提取生命体样本，并通过该供应链流程生产生物质。

en: Programmable destruction for unwanted items and fluids.
zh: 可编程销毁不需要的物品与流体。

en: Unlocks the **Waste Processor Kit recipe**. The machine permanently destroys one selected stream: any item through its feeder input, any liquid through `liquid_in`, or any gas through `gas_in`. This provides an explicit overflow path for tar, surplus water, and unwanted gases without recovering power or materials. Fabricate the kit at a Fabricator; its script selects and enables the active mode.
zh: 解锁 **废物处理机套件配方**。该机器可永久销毁单一选定流：通过进料口销毁任意物品，通过 `liquid_in` 销毁任意液体，或通过 `gas_in` 销毁任意气体。这为焦油、多余的水及不需要的废气提供了明确的溢出处理路径，且不回收能量或材料。在制造机处制造该套件；其脚本用于选择并启用工作模式。

en: Opens the **Plants** tier and unlocks the **Seed Maker Kit recipe**. The machine consumes **1 t each of three different harvested life forms** to test a viable-seed recipe. Most `combine()` results have `.status == "sludge"` and produce no item; the working recipes are unique to this planet. Fabricate the kit at a Fabricator, deploy it from Inventory to an outpost, then plant the seeds you find into your Harvester field.
zh: 解锁**植物**阶段并解锁**种子制造机套件配方**。该机器消耗**三种不同已采集生命体各 1 吨**以测试可行的种子配方。大多数 `combine()` 结果的 `.status == "sludge"`，不会产出任何物品；有效的配方仅适用于本星球。在制造机处制作套件，从**库存**将其**部署**至**前哨站**，然后将找到的种子种植到**采集车**田地中。

en: Turn harvested Forage into Plants progress.
zh: 将已采集的草料转化为植物进度。

en: Unlocks the **Plant Terraformer Kit recipe** at **2,000 t Biomass**. It is the only machine that creates permanent Plants km². Feed it harvested Forage, then satisfy the cumulative phase ladder with Water, Salt, Fertilizer, and Growth Accelerant. Fabricate its kit, deploy it at an outpost, connect its supplies, and enable it from its script. Build as many as your harvest can feed.
zh: 在达到 **2,000 吨生物质**时解锁**植物地球化机套件配方**。它是唯一能永久增加植物平方公里数的机器。向其输入已采集的草料，然后通过水、盐、肥料和生长促进剂满足累积阶段阶梯。制作其套件，**部署**至**前哨站**，连接补给，并通过**脚本**启用。根据你的采集量建造尽可能多的该机器。
植物地球化机 Mk II

en: Unlocks the **Plant Terraformer Mk II Upgrade Pack recipe** at the Fabricator. A Mk I has no Fertilizer or Growth Accelerant injector, so it converts only up to the **Fields** threshold and then stops. Mk II adds both injectors, raises throughput from **400** to **2,200 Forage/h**, raises input feeder handling from **16** to **80 items per step**, and raises enabled draw from **180 W** to **900 W**. Each machine needs its own pack.
zh: 在制造机处解锁**植物地球化机 Mk II 升级包配方**。Mk I 没有肥料或生长促进剂注入器，因此只能转化至**田地**阈值便会停止。Mk II 增加了这两种注入器，将吞吐量从 **400** 提升至 **2,200 草料/小时**，将输入供料器处理能力从每步 **16** 提升至 **80 个物品**，并将启用时的功耗从 **180 W** 提升至 **900 W**。每台机器都需要独立的升级包。

en: Unlocks the **Grow Lamp Kit recipe**. Fabricate the kit at a Fabricator, then deploy it in a Harvester field to light the four orthogonally adjacent cells (directly above, below, left, and right). Upgrade packs improve the crops it supports.
zh: 解锁**生长灯套件配方**。在制造机处制作套件，然后将其**部署**至**采集车**田地中，为四个正交相邻的格子（正上、正下、正左、正右）提供光照。升级包可提升其支持的作物种类。

en: Unlocks the **Sprinkler Kit recipe**. Fabricate the kit at a Fabricator, then deploy it in a Harvester field to water the four orthogonally adjacent cells (directly above, below, left, and right) while supplied. Upgrade packs improve the crops it supports.
zh: 解锁**洒水器套件配方**。在制造机处制作套件，然后将其**部署**至**采集车**田地中，在获得补给时为四个正交相邻的格子（正上、正下、正左、正右）浇水。升级包可提升其支持的作物种类。

en: Unlocks the **Dispenser Kit recipe**. Fabricate the kit at a Fabricator, then deploy it in a Harvester field to salt the four orthogonally adjacent cells (directly above, below, left, and right) while supplied. Salt is a Water Pump byproduct.
zh: 解锁**撒盐器套件配方**。在制造机中制作该套件，随后将其部署于采集车作业区内。在获得盐分供应时，它会对正交相邻的四个格子（正上、正下、正左、正右）进行撒盐。盐为水泵的副产品。
自动化收割、种植与养护。

en: Unlocks the **Crop Automator Kit** in the Shop. One automator can queue harvest, plant, and treatment jobs across up to 24 other cells in a centered 5 by 5 area. It executes one at a time in FIFO order by default (first in, first out, so the oldest job runs first), while its script can reorder unfinished work.
zh: 在商店中解锁**作物自动化套件**。单台自动化机可在以自身为中心的 5×5 区域内，为最多 24 个其他格子排队执行收割、种植与养护任务。默认情况下，它按先进先出（FIFO）顺序逐个执行任务（即最早加入的任务最先运行），但其脚本可对未完成的工作重新排序。

en: Holds 10× what a Liquid Tank does.
zh: 容量为普通液体储罐的 10 倍。

en: Unlocks the **Large Liquid Tank** in the shop. It works just like a Liquid Tank, taking whatever liquid reaches it first and holding only that until it runs dry, but it holds **1,000 t** instead of 100 t. Use it where plant, essence, or wildlife supply has to ride out a long gap.
zh: 在商店中解锁**大型液体储罐**。其工作原理与液体储罐相同：优先接收最先流入的液体并仅储存该液体，直至耗尽。但其容量为 **1,000 t** 而非 100 t。适用于需要应对植物、精华或野生动物供应长期空窗期的场景。

en: Turn vent steam into clean water.
zh: 将喷口蒸汽转化为净水。

en: Unlocks the **Steam Condenser** in the shop at **1,000,000 km² Plants**. It consumes up to **250 t/h Steam** and produces the same mass of clean Water, drawing **150 W** at full throttle. Use Gas Tanks to bridge dormant vent phases and decide how much steam becomes water instead of turbine power.
zh: 当植物覆盖面积达到 **1,000,000 km²** 时，在商店解锁**蒸汽冷凝器**。其最大消耗 **250 t/h 蒸汽**，并产出等质量的纯净水，满负荷运行时功耗为 **150 W**。可使用气体储罐来度过喷口休眠期，并自行决定将多少蒸汽转化为水而非用于涡轮发电。

en: Unlocks the Fabricator recipe for **Reinforced Biopolymer**. The composite joins established oil, plant, and water production into a structural material used by large Earth orders and advanced biological chemistry.
zh: 解锁制造机中的**强化生物聚合物配方**。该复合材料将成熟的石油、植物与水资源整合为一种结构材料，用于承接地球方面的大型订单及高级生物化学项目。

en: Revive and house the first fauna.
zh: 复苏并安置首批动物群。

en: Opens the **Wildlife** tier and makes the **Habitat** and **Feed Maker** available in the Shop. A Habitat revives cataloged creatures and houses a breeding colony, while the Feed Maker crafts species feed from harvested **Forage** plus life forms gathered across the biomes. Hold each colony's feed, gas, and liquid bands and it breeds toward its ceiling. Gated on a thriving Plants field because every feed recipe uses Forage; harvested biome life forms provide the remaining ingredients.
zh: 解锁**野生动物**分支，商店将上架**栖息地**与**饲料制造机**。栖息地可复苏已建档的生物并容纳繁殖群落；饲料制造机则利用采集的**饲草**及各生物群落收集的生命体合成物种饲料。维持各群落的饲料、气体与液体供给指标，即可促使其繁殖至数量上限。解锁本项需以繁荣的植物生态为前提，因所有饲料配方均需消耗饲草；采集自各群落的生命体将提供其余原料。

en: Unlocks exotic deposit survey, the **Exotic Gas Cap Kit** and **Exotic Spring Tap Kit** recipes, and the **Refiner** in the Shop. Common and uncommon exotic deposits can now appear on sonar; rare deposits wait for **Deep Exotics**. Capture raw exotic gas or liquid, then refine it into the fluid a Habitat band requires. Fabricate the caps and taps at a Fabricator.
zh: 解锁异质矿脉勘探，商店将上架**异质气体封盖套件**与**异质泉眼抽取套件**配方及**精炼机**。声呐现可探测普通与稀有异质矿脉；极稀有矿脉需等待**深层异质**研究解锁。捕获原始异质气体或液体后，将其精炼为栖息地供给指标所需的流体。封盖与抽取套件需在制造机处加工。

en: Faster feed production with higher power demand.
zh: 饲料生产更快，但电力需求更高。

en: Unlocks the **Feed Maker Mk II Upgrade Pack recipe in the Fabricator** at **250,000 Wildlife**. Craft a pack, then use **Upgrade in Inventory** to apply it to one existing Feed Maker at any outpost. Mk II provides **1.5× crafting and input Auto Feeder speed** with **2× operating power**. Each machine needs its own pack and keeps its existing building slot. Ingredient quantities and feed produced per batch stay the same.
zh: 解锁**制造机中的饲料制造机 Mk II 升级包配方**，费用为**250,000 野生动物**。制作一个升级包，然后使用**库存中升级**，将其应用到任意前哨站中的一台现有饲料制造机上。Mk II 提供**1.5× 制造与输入自动供料器速度**，但运行功率为**2×**。每台机器都需要自己的升级包，并保留现有建筑槽位。每批次的原料用量和饲料产量保持不变。
使栖息地承载容量翻倍。

en: Unlocks the **Habitat Mk II Upgrade Pack recipe** at the Fabricator at **600,000 Wildlife**, after Deep Exotics. Each pack upgrades one Habitat from Mk I to Mk II, doubling its carrying capacity while increasing mature draw to **144-168 W**. Mk II affects capacity only; Insight adaptations control breeding pace and biological costs.
zh: 完成**深层异质**研究后，消耗 **600,000 野生动物**，在制造机解锁**栖息地 Mk II 升级套件**配方。每个套件可将一座栖息地从 Mk I 升级至 Mk II，承载容量翻倍，成熟期功耗增至 **144-168 W**。Mk II 仅影响容量；繁殖速率与生物消耗由“洞察”适应性系统控制。
精炼最稀有的异质资源。

en: Unlocks sonar discovery, extraction, and refining for the **rarest** exotic gases and liquids used by late-stage Habitat requirements.
zh: 解锁声呐探测、开采与精炼功能，用于获取后期栖息地所需的**极稀有**异质气体与液体。
合成后期生物出口物资。

en: Unlocks the Fabricator recipe for **Enrichment Compound** at **2,000 Wildlife**. This advanced biological material is used in late Earth exports; Habitat adaptations are purchased with Insight and do not consume it.
zh: 消耗 **2,000 野生动物**，在制造机解锁**富集化合物**配方。该高级生物材料专用于后期地球化出口物资；栖息地适应性升级需使用“洞察”点数购买，不消耗本材料。

en: Estimated time to this track's next unlock at the current production rate, shown in game time, not real time. Reads "stalled" when nothing is producing toward it, "ready" when the meter has already passed the gate, and a dash only when no estimate can be made at all.
zh: 基于当前产出速率，预计解锁该路线下一项所需的时间。显示为游戏内时间，非现实时间。无产出时显示“已停滞”，进度达标时显示“已就绪”，仅在完全无法估算时显示破折号。

en: Analyze your first specimen in the Bio Lab
zh: 在生物实验室分析你的首个样本

en: Catalog all 16 fragments in the Frozen biome
zh: 收录冰冻生态区的全部16个样本片段

en: Catalog all 5 fragments of any creature
zh: 收录任意生物的全部5个样本片段

en: Catalog all 5 fragments of all 16 creatures
zh: 收录全部16种生物的各5个样本片段

en: Complete every Bio Order on the roster
zh: 完成委托列表上的所有生物委托
收录来自3个不同生态区的样本片段

en: Catalog every fragment of a Legendary creature
zh: 收录传说生物的全部样本片段

en: Grow your wildlife population to **10** individuals
zh: 将野生动物种群数量提升至 **10** 只

en: Grow your wildlife population to **1,000** individuals
zh: 将野生动物种群数量提升至 **1,000** 只

en: Grow your wildlife population to **50,000** individuals
zh: 将野生动物种群数量提升至 **50,000** 只

en: Grow your wildlife population to **500,000** individuals
zh: 将野生动物种群数量提升至 **500,000** 只

en: Grow your wildlife population to **5,000,000** individuals, the Wildlife pillar complete
zh: 将野生动物种群数量提升至 **5,000,000** 只，完成“野生动物”支柱

en: Revive your first creature from extinction and nurse it past the Founded stage
zh: 从灭绝中复苏你的第一只生物，并培育其度过“初创”阶段

en: Bring a legendary creature to the Abundant stage
zh: 将一只传说生物培育至“繁盛”阶段

en: Revive, establish, and house all **16** species
zh: 复苏、建立并安置全部 **16** 个物种

en: Grow planetary biomass to **250 t**. Life leaves a residue.
zh: 将星球生物量提升至 **250 t**。生命总会留下痕迹。

en: Reach **2,000 t** of biomass. Slick green films on every wet rock.
zh: 生物量达到 **2,000 t**。每一块湿润的岩石上都覆着滑腻的绿色薄膜。

en: Reach **10,000 t** of biomass. The soil is alive now.
zh: 生物量达到 **10,000 t**。土壤已焕发生机。

en: Reach **60,000 t** of biomass. Generations of life, stacked.
zh: 生物量达到 **60,000 t**。生命的世代，层层堆叠。

en: Reach **250,000 t** of biomass, the Biomass pillar complete.
zh: 生物量达到 **250,000 t**，生物量进度柱已圆满达成。

en: Reach **500,000 km²** of permanent plant cover. First green against the dust.
zh: 永久植被覆盖面积达到 **500,000 km²**。尘沙中初现绿意。

en: Reach **1,250,000 km²** of permanent plant cover. Color spreads across the map.
zh: 永久植被覆盖面积达到 **1,250,000 km²**。色彩正蔓延至全图。

en: Reach **2,250,000 km²** of permanent plant cover. Grassland to the horizon.
zh: 永久植被覆盖面积达到 **2,250,000 km²**。草原绵延至地平线。

en: Reach **3,500,000 km²** of permanent plant cover. Canopy and shade.
zh: 永久植被覆盖面积达到 **3,500,000 km²**。树冠交织成荫。

en: Reach **5,000,000 km²** of plant cover, the Plants pillar complete.
zh: 植被覆盖面积达到 **5,000,000 km²**，“植物”支柱已完工。

en: Reach **50%** on the Terraform Index. The planet is halfway to home.
zh: 地球化指数达到 **50%**。星球已走完一半的归乡之路。

en: Reach **75%** on the Terraform Index. The finish line is in sight.
zh: 地球化指数达到 **75%**。终点线已近在眼前。

en: Reach **100%** on the Terraform Index. The planet is fully terraformed, home.
zh: 地球化指数达到 **100%**。星球地球化改造圆满完成，此处即是家园。

en: Bank your first strike in a Lightning Rod. You caught the sky.
zh: 在避雷针中成功储存首次雷击。你捕获了天空。

en: Collect storm glass, lightning fused on open ground.
zh: 收集雷击玻璃，由闪电在开阔地表熔融而成。

en: Bring a Weather Station online in all **5** biomes. Full coverage.
zh: 在所有 **5** 个生物群系中启动气象站。实现全面覆盖。

en: Find your first hidden uranium aftermath by decoding its storm packets and reaching the exact coordinate.
zh: 解码风暴数据包并抵达精确坐标，发现首个隐藏的铀沉降区。

en: Harvest your first Raw Uranium. Handle it through the shielded logistics chain.
zh: 采集首批原铀。通过屏蔽物流链进行安全处理。

en: Bring a reactor online and start producing power.
zh: 启动反应堆并开始发电。

en: Sustain **5,000 W** of reactor output. The grid runs on the atom now.
zh: 维持 **5,000 W** 的反应堆输出。电网现已由原子能驱动。

en: Have a reactor cool and recover from an emergency shutdown.
zh: 使反应堆冷却并从紧急停机中恢复。

en: Mine your first mineral. The planet gives up its metals.
zh: 开采你的第一份矿物。星球交出了它的金属。

en: Run your first smelt. Ore becomes ingot.
zh: 完成首次冶炼。矿石化为铸锭。

en: Run your first fabrication. Raw stock becomes a part.
zh: 完成首次制造。原材料变为零件。

en: Deploy your first building with a Pioneer's Constructor.
zh: 使用先锋建造机部署你的第一座建筑。

en: Found your first outpost beyond home base.
zh: 在主基地之外建立你的首个前哨站。

en: Found an outpost in every biome.
zh: 在每个生物群系中建立前哨站。
部署你的首台蒸汽轮机。

en: Run a full steam cycle, vent to cap to turbine to watts.
zh: 运行完整蒸汽循环，经排气、稳压至涡轮发电。

en: Grow your first plant from a Seed Maker blend.
zh: 使用种子机混合物培育出你的第一株植物。
发现你的首个种子配方。

en: Build your first Control Room panel.
zh: 建造你的首个控制室面板。

en: Send your first message over the Signal Bus.
zh: 通过信号总线发送你的第一条消息。

en: Run **10** scripts at once. A planet that runs itself.
zh: 同时运行 **10** 个脚本。让星球自行运转。

en: Repair every base sensor. Full diagnostics online.
zh: 修复所有基地传感器。全面诊断已上线。

en: Write and run your first script
zh: 编写并运行你的首个脚本

en: Transmitted your first sensor reading to Earth
zh: 向地球发送首次传感器读数
完成所有代码实验室课程。

en: Harvested every item on the planet surface
zh: 采集星球地表的所有物品

en: Scanned every sector on the map
zh: 扫描了地图上的每一个扇区

en: Expanded inventory to the full 60 slots
zh: 将库存扩展至满额 60 格。

en: Reach **11 heat units** on the planet. The deep freeze is breaking.
zh: 星球温度达到 **11 热量单位**。极寒正在消退。

en: Reach **140 heat units**. Cold enough to kill in minutes, warm enough to live in gear.
zh: 达到 **140 热量单位**。严寒足以在数分钟内致命，但穿戴装备尚可生存。

en: Reach **3,200 heat units**. Survivable with insulation. Mild, not pleasant.
zh: 达到 **3,200 热量单位**。配备隔热装备即可存活。气候温和，但谈不上舒适。

en: Reach **42,000 heat units**. Sun you can feel on your skin.
zh: 达到 **42,000 热量单位**。阳光终于能真切地照在皮肤上。

en: Reach **360,000 heat units**. A climate worth remembering home by.
zh: 达到 **360,000 热量单位**。足以唤起故乡记忆的气候。

en: Reach **10 ppt O₂**. The air would kill you, but the sensor says something is there.
zh: 达到 **10 ppt O₂**。此空气足以致命，但传感器显示已有氧气存在。

en: Reach **150 ppt O₂**. Mountaineer territory. Gasping, but alive for minutes.
zh: 达到 **150 ppt O₂**。相当于登山者的高度。呼吸急促，但可存活数分钟。

en: Reach **3,000 ppt O₂**. Helmet off. Take a shallow breath.
zh: 达到 **3,000 ppt O₂**。摘下头盔。尝试浅呼吸。

en: Reach **40,000 ppt O₂**. Enough air for running, shouting, and plants.
zh: 达到 **40,000 ppt O₂**。足以支持奔跑、呼喊与植物生长。

en: Reach **380,000 ppt O₂**. A forest's breath. The planet is alive.
zh: 达到 **380,000 ppt O₂**。如森林般的呼吸。这颗星球已焕发生机。

en: Reach **0.3 kPa**. The first wisp of atmosphere, not visible, just measurable.
zh: 达到 **0.3 kPa**。第一缕大气，肉眼不可见，仅可测量。

en: Reach **7 kPa**. A gauze of gas wrapping the planet.
zh: 达到 **7 kPa**。一层气体薄纱包裹着星球。

en: Reach **150 kPa**. An atmosphere with real weight. Dust stays down.
zh: 达到 **150 kPa**。具有实质重量的大气层。尘埃不再飞扬。

en: Reach **2,000 kPa**. Clouds thicken. Storm rewards reach full pressure potency.
zh: 达到 **2,000 kPa**。云层增厚。风暴奖励达到完整气压效能。

en: Reach **19,000 kPa**. The air presses on your skin the way Earth's does.
zh: 达到 **19,000 kPa**。空气压在皮肤上的感觉，终于和地球一样了。

en: Ran an oxygen generator at 100% efficiency. Go ahead, inhale.
zh: 氧气发电机以 100% 效率运行。尽情呼吸吧。

en: Ran a pressure generator at 100% efficiency. Relax.
zh: 气压发电机以 100% 效率运行。放轻松。

en: Ran a Heat Generator at 100% efficiency. Keep your cool.
zh: 让热力发电机以 100% 效率运行。保持冷静。

en: Three running scripts imported from the same library module at once.
zh: 三个运行中的脚本同时导入了同一个库模块。

en: Complete **12** researches. The tech tree rewards breadth, not just depth.
zh: 完成 **12** 项研究。科技树奖励广度，而不仅是深度。

en: Solve **3** contracts. Earth's data brokers like what they see.
zh: 完成 **3** 份合约。地球的数据掮客们对此很满意。

en: Spend **25,000 cr** at the shop. The fleet doesn't build itself.
zh: 在商店消费 **25,000 积分**。舰队可不会自己变出来。

en: Generate **500 W** across all sources at the same instant.
zh: 在同一瞬间，所有电源合计产生 **500 W** 功率。

en: Deploy your first **Water Pump**. Steam was nice; liquid is lifeblood.
zh: 部署你的第一台**水泵**。蒸汽固然不错，但液态水才是生命之源。

en: Deploy your first **Oil Pump**. The black gold era begins.
zh: 部署你的第一台**油泵**。黑色黄金的时代开始了。

en: Burn oil into watts. An **Oil Generator** produces power for the first time.
zh: 将石油转化为电能。**燃油发电机**首次产出电力。

en: Deploy your first **Warehouse**. **10,000 units** of breathing room.
zh: 部署首座**仓库**。获得 **10,000 单位**的缓冲空间。

en: First drone arrives at any Drone Depot. The skies are alive.
zh: 首架无人机抵达任意无人机停机坪。天空焕发生机。

en: First **heli-thruster** drone arrives at a station. Three times electric's top speed.
zh: 首架搭载**直升机推进器**的无人机抵达站点。极速为电动型的三倍。

en: First helicopter airlift completed. Even the rescue is scripted on this planet.
zh: 完成首次直升机空运。在这颗星球上，连救援行动都靠脚本驱动。

en: Complete your first Earth order. The supply chain is open for business.
zh: 完成首个地球订单。供应链正式投入运营。

en: Pump **10,000 t** of water lifetime. Across droughts and harvests both.
zh: 累计抽取**10,000 t**水。历经旱季与丰水期。

en: Pump **10,000 t** of oil lifetime. Reservoirs all over the planet.
zh: 累计抽取**10,000 t**石油。储油设施遍布星球各处。

en: Ship **100,000** units lifetime through Supply Docks. A hundred thousand little wins.
zh: 通过补给坞累计运送 **100,000** 单位。十万次小小的胜利。

en: Complete **10** Earth orders. The contractors know your dock by name.
zh: 完成**10**个地球订单。承包商们已对你的码头如数家珍。

en: Complete **50** Earth orders. The terraformer-as-industrialist arc.
zh: 完成**50**个地球订单。从地球化改造者到工业巨头的蜕变。

en: Complete a **megahaul** order, any single order requesting **10,000+** units. The big show.
zh: 完成一笔**巨型运输**订单，即单笔需求 **10,000+** 单位的合约。重头戏登场。

en: Complete **25 Helios Orbital** orders. Frame and bracing for the orbital habitat.
zh: 完成 **25 笔赫利俄斯轨道**订单。为轨道栖息地搭建框架与支撑结构。

en: Complete **25 Spire Research** orders. Every sensor, every capacitor, in service.
zh: 完成 **25 份尖塔研究** 订单。每一个传感器，每一个电容器，皆已投入服役。

en: Complete **25 Vestibule Logistics** orders. From pipes to oil tanks to the tether platform.
zh: 完成 **25 份前厅物流** 订单。从管道、储油罐到系留平台。

en: Unlock every manufacturing recipe in the game: Smelter, Fabricator, Feed Maker, Refiner, and Fuel Assembler. The full industrial library.
zh: 解锁游戏中所有制造配方：冶炼厂、制造机、供料机、精炼厂与燃料组装机。完整的工业库。

en: Both Bulk Logistics research tiers active. Each Supply Dock pulse ships **16** units.
zh: 激活全部两级大宗物流研究。补给码头每次脉冲出货**16**单位。

en: {name} is offline. Power it on first.
zh: {name} 处于离线状态。请先为其供电。
显示此机器的控制台输出

en: Mk {tier}, production ×{production}, power draw ×{power}. Applied from an upgrade pack.
zh: Mk {tier}，产能 ×{production}，功耗 ×{power}。通过升级包应用。

en: Mk {tier}, {bays} bays, {watts} W total budget. A lone vehicle pools every bay; a fleet shares them.
zh: Mk {tier}，{bays} 个泊位，总功率预算 {watts} W。单车独占全部泊位；车队共享泊位。

en: Mk {tier}, cuts mineral hardness up to {hardness}, extraction rate ×{rate} vs. the basic drill.
zh: Mk {tier}，可切割硬度最高达 {hardness} 的矿物，开采速率为基础钻机的 ×{rate}。

en: Mk {tier}, crafting and input Auto Feeder speed ×{speed}, operating power ×{power}.
zh: Mk {tier}，制作与输入自动供料器速度 ×{speed}，运行功率 ×{power}。

en: Mk {tier}, biomass output ×{production}, essence demand ×{essence}, power draw ×{power}.
zh: Mk {tier}，生物质产出 ×{production}，精华消耗 ×{essence}，功耗 ×{power}。

en: Mk {tier}, ×{production} base Forage on its own for growing crops that require light, power draw ×{power}. Only the strongest active covering lamp counts. The bonus adds to other yield bonuses.
zh: Mk {tier}，自身基础采集量 ×{production}，用于种植需光作物，耗电 ×{power}。仅范围内最强的已激活补光灯生效。该加成可与其他产量加成叠加。

en: Mk {tier}, ×{production} base Forage on its own for growing crops that require water, power draw ×{power}, Water use ×{water}. Only the strongest supplied covering sprinkler counts. The bonus adds to other yield bonuses.
zh: Mk {tier}，自身基础采集量 ×{production}，用于种植需水作物，耗电 ×{power}，耗水 ×{water}。仅范围内最强的已供水洒水器生效。该加成可与其他产量加成叠加。

en: This machine is still being built. Wait for the Pioneer to finish before operating it.
zh: 该设备仍在建造中。请等待先锋建造机完工后再进行操作。

en: An outpost on the planet. Begins with a soft capacity of **20** buildings, expandable to **25** through research. Power lines touching its utility footprint join one power subnet. Fluid components touching that utility footprint remain physically separate and become available to compatible player-connected local machines; the outpost stores no fluid itself. Founded from a Planet Map blueprint, placed in Plan Mode or by script, and physically built by a Constructor-equipped Pioneer.
zh: 星球上的前哨站。初始建筑软容量为 **20**，可通过研究扩展至 **25**。接触其设施覆盖范围的电力线将并入同一电力子网。接触该覆盖范围的流体组件保持物理独立，并可供兼容的本地连接机器使用；前哨站本身不储存流体。通过行星地图蓝图建立，可在规划模式或通过脚本放置，并由先锋建造机实体建造。

en: Automation machine for step 1 of the biology loop, programmatically retrieves a specimen from the field. Single cargo slot; mirrors the manual COLLECT button.
zh: 生物循环第1步的自动化机器，通过编程从野外采集样本。单货物槽；功能等同于手动“采集”按钮。

en: Automation machine for steps 2 and 3. Scripts route reagents through the input port and exact property-bearing samples through the output port. Manual Biology uses the workbench's one stockroom: Base Inventory at Nocturna Base, or an explicitly selected local Warehouse at another outpost.
zh: 生物循环第2步与第3步的自动化机器。脚本通过输入端口调配试剂，并通过输出端口输出具备精确属性的样本。手动生物操作使用工作台的单一储藏室：诺克图纳星基地的基地库存，或其他前哨站明确选定的本地仓库。

en: Fills authored Bio Orders for credit rewards. Scripts stage exact samples through the input port; surplus in-transit samples return through the output port without losing properties.
zh: 完成已编写的生物订单以获取积分奖励。脚本通过输入端口准备精确样本；多余的在途样本将通过输出端口退回，且不丢失属性。

en: Coastal automation machine, step 3 of the coastal loop, between Bio Lab and Bio Exchange. Tunes a bioluminescent fragment's glow to an order's exact target color with three impure tint lamps. Idle until scripted: read the start glow, the target, and the lamp signatures, solve the lamp settings, and infuse.
zh: 海岸自动化机器，海岸循环第3步，位于生物实验室与生物交换站之间。使用三盏非纯色染色灯，将生物发光碎片的辉光调节至订单要求的精确目标颜色。待机状态直至被脚本调用：读取初始辉光、目标颜色与灯管特征，解算灯管设置，并进行注入。

en: Geothermal automation machine, step 3 of the geothermal loop, between Bio Lab and Bio Exchange. Load a fragment, read the genes it carries and the genes an order needs, and splice the target set in (once, a second splice destroys the fragment). You work at the gene level, the machine composes the DNA.
zh: 地热自动化机器，地热循环第 3 步，位于生物实验室与生物交换站之间。装载一个片段，读取它携带的基因和订单所需基因，并将目标基因集剪接进去（一次，第二次剪接会摧毁该片段）。你在基因层面操作，机器负责合成 DNA。

en: Volcanic automation machine, step 3 of the volcanic loop, between Bio Lab and Bio Exchange. Forges a fragment by holding the crucible in the order's target temperature band (steam heats it up, water cools it down) with the right fabricated materials loaded, then casting. Its 20 t steam and water process buffers each need an explicit `FluidPort.connect(...)` relationship to a compatible source. Local sources transfer directly; remote sources also need a completed conflict-free pipe route between both locations. Idle until scripted: drive the two knobs, verify the band + materials, and cast, a cast out of band or with the wrong materials burns the whole charge.
zh: 火山自动化机器，火山循环第 3 步，位于生物实验室与生物交换站之间。通过在订单的目标温度带内保持坩埚（蒸汽加热，水冷却），装载正确的制造材料，然后浇铸来锻造片段。其 20 t 蒸汽和水工艺缓冲各自需要与兼容源建立明确的 `FluidPort.connect(...)` 关系。本地源直接传输；远程源还需要在两地之间建立一条完成且无冲突的管路路线。未编写脚本时保持空闲：控制两个旋钮，确认温度带 + 材料，然后浇铸；在温度带外或使用错误材料浇铸会烧毁整批装料。

en: Deep automation machine, step 3 of the deep loop, between Bio Lab and Bio Exchange. Quality-control inspection: reads a fragment's condition report and runs a 5-stage accept/reject gauntlet against a published rulebook; pass all five and it's conditioned for an order. Power-only, idle until scripted, one wrong call burns the specimen.
zh: 深层自动化机器，深层循环第 3 步，位于生物实验室与生物交换站之间。质量控制检查：读取片段的状态报告，并按照已发布的规则手册执行 5 阶段接受/拒绝考验；全部通过即可为订单完成调理。仅供电，未编写脚本时保持空闲，一次错误判定就会毁掉样本。

en: Renders native life-form samples down into their biome's essence fluid. It only accepts life forms from its own outpost's biome, and produces that biome's essence.
zh: 将本地生命体样本提炼为其所属生物群系的精华液。它只接受来自自身前哨站生物群系的生命体，并产出该生物群系的精华。

en: Blends biome essences into biomass. The global Biomass phase sets the minimum diversity, while every additional well-balanced essence can raise output. Mk II raises output 4.5× while essence demand rises only 2.4×, at five times the power draw.
zh: 将各生物群系精华混合为生物质。全球生物质阶段设定最低多样性，而每一种额外且配比均衡的精华都可提升产出。Mk II 将产出提升 4.5×，精华需求仅提升 2.4×，但耗电量是五倍。

en: An outpost processing building that combines three life-form samples into a viable seed. Most blends fail; the working recipes are unique to this planet and found by trial, and a discovered one can be re-run for more.
zh: 一座前哨站加工建筑，将三个生命体样本组合成可存活的种子。大多数混合都会失败；有效配方是该星球独有的，需通过试验发现，而一旦找到，便可重复运行以生产更多。

en: The sole converter from harvested physical Forage to permanent Plants km². Load its input through ordinary timed item transfers; its high-capacity feeder handles 16 items per step at Mk I and 80 at Mk II. Each phase adds Water, Salt, Fertilizer, then Growth Accelerant. Mk I stops at the Fields threshold; Mk II carries the final two phases.
zh: 唯一将采集到的实体草料转化为永久植物面积（km²）的转换器。通过普通定时物品传输装载其输入；其高容量进料器在 Mk I 每步处理 16 件物品，Mk II 为 80 件。每个阶段依次添加水、盐、肥料，然后添加生长促进剂。Mk I 在田野阈值处停止；Mk II 承接最后两个阶段。

en: Forage, Salt, Fertilizer, and Growth Accelerant
zh: 草料、盐、肥料和生长促进剂

en: **{pct}%** of the way from **{current}** to **{next}**, at {floor} to {ceil} km². This bar tracks the current band only; the tank on the right tracks the whole ladder to Continental, which is why the two numbers differ.
zh: 从 **{current}** 到 **{next}** 的 **{pct}%** 进度，处于 {floor} 至 {ceil} km²。此进度条仅跟踪当前区间；右侧进度槽跟踪通往大陆阶段的完整阶梯，因此两个数值不同。

en: **{current}** is the top of the ladder. There is no further band to convert toward.
zh: **{current}** 是阶梯顶端。没有可继续转换的更高区间。

en: {material} loaded: {stock}. The gauge shows up to {capacity} for one full batch.
zh: {material} 已装载：{stock}。仪表显示一个完整批次最多可装载 {capacity}。

en: {material} remaining: {stock}. Conversion is complete; new deliveries are stopped.
zh: {material} 剩余：{stock}。转换已完成；新交付已停止。

en: Fertilizer remaining: Mk I {mk1}, Mk II {mk2}, Mk III {mk3}. Retained potency from consumed items: {stored} P. Total potency: {value} P. Unopened items can be recovered through the input port.
zh: 肥料剩余：Mk I {mk1}，Mk II {mk2}，Mk III {mk3}。已消耗物品保留的效力：{stored} P。总效力：{value} P。未开封物品可通过输入端口回收。

en: Available Fertilizer potency / potency for one full-size batch at this machine's current tier. Includes {stored} P retained from consumed items plus unopened items: Mk I 10 P, Mk II 30 P, Mk III 50 P. Unused potency carries over to later batches.
zh: 可用肥料效力 / 当前机器等级下一个完整批次所需效力。包括从已消耗物品中保留的 {stored} P，以及未开封物品：Mk I 10 P、Mk II 30 P、Mk III 50 P。未使用的效力会延续到后续批次。

en: Fertilizer holder: Mk I {mk1}, Mk II {mk2}, Mk III {mk3}. Stored potency {stored}. Total available potency {value}. A full-size batch at this tier uses {required} potency.
zh: 肥料容器：Mk I {mk1}，Mk II {mk2}，Mk III {mk3}。已存效力 {stored}。总可用效力 {value}。此等级的一个完整批次使用 {required} 效力。

en: Forage loaded into the running cycle, and the Plants output that batch averages over the cycle
zh: 运行周期中装载的草料，以及该批次在整个周期中的平均植物产出

en: Current conversion state of this machine: converting, waiting, or complete.
zh: 此机器当前的转化状态：转化中、等待中或已完成。
植物阶梯已完成 {pct}%，当前阶段 {phase}

en: {status}. The Plants ladder is {progress}% complete, currently {phase}. Loaded Forage: {forage}.
zh: {status}。植物阶梯已完成 {progress}%，当前阶段 {phase}。已装载牧草：{forage}。

en: Lights the four orthogonally adjacent field cells (directly above, below, left, and right) while powered and enabled.
zh: 通电并启用时，照亮正上下左右四个正交相邻的田地格子。

en: Waters the four orthogonally adjacent field cells (directly above, below, left, and right) while powered, supplied, and enabled.
zh: 通电、供料并启用时，浇灌正上下左右四个正交相邻的田地格子。

en: Salts the four orthogonally adjacent field cells (directly above, below, left, and right) while powered, supplied, and enabled.
zh: 通电、供料并启用时，向正上下左右四个正交相邻的田地格子撒盐。

en: Queues harvest, plant, and treatment jobs across up to 24 other cells in a centered 5 by 5 service area, then executes one job at a time with a short pause between them.
zh: 在以自身为中心的 5×5 服务范围内，最多为其他 24 个格子排队收获、种植和处理作业，然后每次执行一项作业，作业间有短暂停顿。

en: species-specific seeds, Fertilizer Mk I/II/III, or Growth Accelerant
zh: 特定物种种子、肥料 Mk I/II/III 或生长加速剂

en: Permanently destroys one script-selected waste stream: items, liquids, or gases. Use the item input for unwanted stock, `liquid_in` for surplus water or other liquids, and `gas_in` for gases. It has no output and recovers no value.
zh: 永久销毁由脚本选择的一股废物流：物品、液体或气体。将不需要的库存放入物品输入端，`liquid_in` 用于多余水或其他液体，`gas_in` 用于气体。它没有输出，也不会回收任何价值。

en: Houses one revived species and breeds it into a colony. Established colony progress belongs to the species and can be rehoused in another Habitat. Growth requires feed, gas, and liquid life support, produces shared Insight, and supports permanent bonuses purchased with Insight.
zh: 容纳一种已复苏的物种，并将其繁育为群落。已建立的群落进度归属于该物种，可迁移至另一栖息地。生长需要饲料、气体和液态生命支持，产出共享洞见，并支持使用洞见购买的永久加成。

en: Crafts creature feeds from plant forage and life-form samples via recipes. Discrete-item processing machine.
zh: 通过配方，使用植物草料和生命样本制造生物饲料。离散物品加工机器。
原料库存：共 {count}（1 种材料）
原料库存：{materials} 种材料共 {count} 单位

en: Refines raw exotic feedstock with tar into creature-grade gas or liquid. Fluid feedstock and tar in, refined fluid out.
zh: 使用焦油将原始异质原料精炼为生物级气体或液体。输入流体原料和焦油，输出精炼流体。

en: Captures exotic gas from a cyclic vent and routes it to a tank your script picks.
zh: 从周期性喷口捕获异质气体，并将其输送至脚本选择的储罐。

en: Taps exotic liquid from a cyclic spring and routes it to a tank your script picks.
zh: 从循环泉眼中抽取奇异液体，并将其输送到你用脚本选择的储液罐中。

en: Produces up to 50 W when its script tracks the Sun. Poor tilt reduces daytime output; night produces 0 W.
zh: 当脚本追踪太阳时，最高产生 50 W。倾角不佳会降低白天输出；夜间输出为 0 W。

en: Stores 5× the base cell. Charges on surplus, carries the night.
zh: 存储容量为基础电池单元的 5 倍。在电力盈余时充电，支撑夜间用电。

en: Remote sensor array for scanning planet sectors.
zh: 用于扫描行星区域的远程传感器阵列。

en: Slow general-purpose field vehicle for collecting resources, planting and tending crops, harvesting Forage, and deploying field automation.
zh: 缓慢的多用途野外载具，用于采集资源、种植和照料作物、收获牧草，以及部署野外自动化设备。

en: Station clock tracking time and sun position.
zh: 记录时间与太阳位置的前哨站时钟。

en: Ship sensor that reports the current outpost, its name, coordinates, and how many buildings are deployed there. Switch the dashboard to a different outpost to read its data.
zh: 舰载传感器，报告当前前哨站、其名称、坐标以及那里部署的建筑数量。将仪表盘切换到其他前哨站以读取其数据。

en: Physical storage room at Nocturna Base. It starts with 36 slots and 10 units per stack. It is not a freight endpoint for remote outposts.
zh: 诺克图纳星基地内的实体储物间。初始有 36 个槽位，每堆 10 单位。它不是远程前哨站的货运终点。

en: Surface temperature probe. Operational from landing.
zh: 地表温度探针。着陆后即可运行。

en: Atmospheric oxygen level monitor. Requires calibration.
zh: 大气氧含量监测器。需要校准。
大气压力监测器。需进行稳定处理。

en: Programmable expedition vehicle with a fixed 100 Wh battery, 10-unit hold, and dedicated Nav, Sonar, and Drill slots.
zh: 可编程远征载具，配备固定的 100 Wh 电池、10 单位货舱，以及专用的导航、声纳和钻头槽位。

en: Converts atmospheric CO2 into oxygen. Script controls intake rate and waste management; powered draw is 8 W at Mk I and scales with Mk tier.
zh: 将大气中的二氧化碳转化为氧气。脚本控制进气速率与废料处理；Mk I 功耗为 8 W，并随 Mk 等级提升而增加。

en: Warms the planet surface. Script controls base power for the current thermal state; actual grid draw scales with Mk tier.
zh: 加热行星地表。脚本根据当前热状态控制基础功率；实际电网功耗随 Mk 等级提升而增加。

en: Compresses atmospheric gas via resonance chamber. Script must sync release pulse each cycle; powered draw is 7 W at Mk I and scales with Mk tier.
zh: 通过共振腔压缩大气气体。脚本必须在每个周期同步释放脉冲；Mk I 功耗为 7 W，并随 Mk 等级提升而增加。

en: Charges docked vehicles from a 30 W Mk I budget. Higher tiers provide 120 W across 2 bays or 240 W across 4, with idle bays pooled onto one vehicle.
zh: 以 30 W 的 Mk I 功率预算为停靠载具充电。更高等级可提供 2 个泊位共 120 W，或 4 个泊位共 240 W，空闲泊位的功率会汇集到一台载具上。

en: Passive material container. Holds one type of material at a time.
zh: 被动式物料容器。每次仅可存放一种物料。

en: Industrial furnace. Refines raw ore into metal stock, one run at a time.
zh: 工业熔炉。将原矿精炼为金属坯料，每次运行处理一批。

en: Heavy manufacturing press. Builds modules, vehicles, and batteries from refined stock.
zh: 重型制造压机。使用精炼坯料制造模块、载具与电池。

en: Eight-slot modular expedition chassis with no built-in battery, cargo, or Nav. The bare chassis cannot move until separately purchased hardware is installed.
zh: 八槽模块化远征底盘，没有内置电池、货舱或导航模块。裸底盘在安装单独购买的硬件之前无法移动。

en: Ships active Earth Orders at 25 units/h before throughput research. Assign an Order, load its materials, and enable dispatch.
zh: 在未进行吞吐量研究前，以 25 单位/小时发送当前地球订单。分配一个订单，装载其材料，并启用调度。

en: Captures Steam from a thermal vent. If its chamber reaches 100%, every stored ton blows into the atmosphere; a script must release, route, or relieve pressure.
zh: 从热液喷口收集蒸汽。如果其腔体达到 100%，储存的每一吨都会喷入大气层；脚本必须释放、导流或泄压。

en: Produces up to 108 W from 90 t/h Steam. Its script-owned throttle scales both consumption and output.
zh: 使用 90 t/h 蒸汽，最高产生 108 W。其由脚本控制的节流阀会同步调节消耗和输出。

en: Converts incoming steam into clean water at a 1:1 mass ratio. Scripted throttle controls its 250 t/h peak and 150 W draw.
zh: 将输入蒸汽按 1:1 质量比转化为净水。脚本控制的节流阀决定其 250 吨/小时的峰值和 150 瓦功耗。

en: A passive buffer that latches onto the first gas piped in (steam, ammonia, swamp gas) and holds only that until it drains. Sitting between a source and its consumer, it smooths out the gaps in supply.
zh: 被动缓冲装置，会锁定首个通过管道输入的气体（蒸汽、氨气或沼泽气），并在排空前只保留该气体。它置于来源与消耗端之间，可平滑供应缺口。

en: Passive buffer that holds any one liquid, water, oil, or a biome essence. It commits to the first liquid piped in.
zh: 被动缓冲装置，可容纳一种液体：水、油或生态精华。它会锁定首个输入的液体。

en: A big passive tank holding 1,000 t of one liquid. Like a Liquid Tank it sticks to the first fluid piped in, and only lets go once it has drained completely.
zh: 大型被动储罐，可容纳 1,000 吨单一液体。与液体储罐一样，它会锁定首个输入的流体，只有完全排空后才会释放。

en: Extracts water from a surveyed well at a throttle your script sets. Its Planet Map blueprint can be placed in Plan Mode or by script; a Pioneer must still build it on the well.
zh: 从已勘测的井中按脚本设定的流量抽水。其星球地图蓝图可在规划模式或由脚本放置；仍需要先锋建造机在井上建造它。

en: Extracts oil from a surveyed well at a throttle your script sets. Oil wells run in active and dormant phases, so buffer the output through a Liquid Tank to ride out the dry spells.
zh: 从已勘测的井中按脚本设定的流量抽油。油井会在活跃期和休眠期之间切换，因此可通过液体储罐缓冲输出，以度过枯井期。

en: Burns oil into strong buffered bridge power. Oil wells pulse between active and dormant phases, so bank their output in Liquid Tanks for continuous generation. Idle until a script runs it.
zh: 将油燃烧为强劲的缓冲桥接电力。油井在活跃期和休眠期之间脉动切换，因此请将油存入液体储罐，以实现持续发电。在脚本启动前保持待机。

en: Multi-material bulk depot, 5 material-locked slots, 2,000 each (10,000 total). Drone-scale haulage absorption.
zh: 多物料散装仓库，5 个锁定物料槽位，每个 2,000（共 10,000）。具备无人机规模的运输吞吐能力。

en: High-bay multi-material depot, 15 material-locked slots, 2,000 each (30,000 total). Broad enough to stage a full biological catalogue.
zh: 高货架多物料仓库，15 个锁定物料槽位，每个 2,000（共 30,000）。容量足以存放完整的生物图鉴。

en: Programmable node of the Weather Network. It measures local reports, hears live storm transmissions, and can publish to the Signal Board through your script.
zh: 气象网络的可编程节点。它会读取本地报告，收听实时风暴传输，并可通过你的脚本发布到信号板。

en: Shielded storage for hot cargo. Raw Uranium and Fuel Rods live here and nowhere else on the stationary side. Its 100-unit stock is the buffer between storms and reactor burn.
zh: 用于热物料的屏蔽存储。粗铀和燃料棒只能存放在这里，固定端别无他处。其 100 单位库存是风暴与反应堆消耗之间的缓冲。

en: A 4,000 Wh storm-charged reserve catching strikes within 600 m. Condition falls 0.05 per day, reducing capture to zero unless a running script repairs it with one Storm Glass.
zh: 4,000 Wh 的风暴充能储备，可捕获 600 m 内的雷击。状态每天下降 0.05，会使捕获量降至零，除非运行脚本用一块风暴玻璃修复它。

en: Storms currently overlapping this station's reception radius.
zh: 当前与该站点接收半径重叠的风暴。

en: Strikes this station saw inside its own reception radius. Bolts that land outside every station's radius still happen and are simply never witnessed. Recent history only, so an old save loses its oldest entries.
zh: 该站点在其自身接收半径内观测到的雷击。落在所有站点半径之外的闪电仍会发生，只是从未被观测到。仅保留近期历史，因此旧存档会丢失最早的条目。

en: Live receiver. It exposes transmissions while they remain audible and stores no raw history.
zh: 实时接收器。它会在传输仍可听到时显示它们，且不存储原始历史。

en: While powered, this station receives broadcast plus the dust channel for its own biome.
zh: 通电时，该气象站接收广播以及其所在生物群系的尘埃频道。
磨损 · 持有 {count} 块风暴玻璃
故障 · 修复前不储能

en: Dense grid-charged storage cell, 15,000 Wh, thirty times a base battery. Joins the battery pool: charges on surplus, carries the night.
zh: 高密度电网充电储能单元，15,000 Wh，是基础电池的三十倍。加入电池池：在盈余时充电，支撑夜晚。

en: The nuclear workbench: Raw Uranium and lead plates become Fuel Rods or Nuclear Batteries. Its heavy recipe draw rewards scheduling against banked lightning.
zh: 核能工作台：粗铀和铅板可制成燃料棒或核电池。其沉重的配方消耗，适合依据蓄存的雷电能量来安排生产。

en: Temperature-controlled fission plant producing up to 5,000 W. One Fuel Rod lasts 72 hours at heat 1.0; fuel use follows commanded heat even while the core is warming or inefficient.
zh: 温控裂变装置，最高输出 5,000 W。在热量 1.0 下，一根燃料棒可持续 72 小时；燃料消耗跟随设定热量，即使堆芯正在升温或效率低下。

en: Fuel Rods available through the normal machine input. The reactor takes the next rod automatically when the active rod runs out.
zh: 燃料棒可通过常规机器输入口提供。当当前燃料棒耗尽时，反应堆会自动使用下一根燃料棒。
停止，目标已满或不可达
缓冲已满，保持中（打开阀门）
停滞，目标已满或无法到达
无（使用 connect 规划路线）
已停泵，目标已满或不可达
停滞，目标已满或无法到达
输入中没有 {biome} 生命体

en: Output buffer full, configured output cannot drain
zh: 输出缓冲已满，配置的输出口无法排出

en: Rarity yield: every 1 t of this life form becomes {mult} t of essence. Common ×5, uncommon ×10, rare ×25.
zh: 稀有度产量：每 1 吨该生命体可转化为 {mult} 吨精华。普通 ×5，罕见 ×10，稀有 ×25。
需要 {needs} 种生物群系精华（已供给 {active}）
需要 1 种生物群系精华（已供给 {active}）

en: Next phase at {threshold} t (then needs {req} biome essences)
zh: 达到 {threshold} 吨进入下一阶段（之后需要 {req} 种生物群系精华）
生物圈已满，已达到最高阶段

en: Seed Maker: {status}. {samples} of {capacity} samples loaded. {seeds} seed waiting in the result bay.
zh: 种子制造机：{status}。已装载 {samples} / {capacity} 个样本。结果舱中有 {seeds} 颗种子待取。

en: The Seed Maker already holds its 1 t {item} sample. Load a different life form or run the current trio.
zh: 种子制造机已持有 1 吨 {item} 样本。装载另一种生命形式，或运行当前三样本组合。
已发现 {total} 个物种中的 {found} 个

en: Not discovered yet. Every species on this planet exists whether or not you have found its blend; only the three life forms that make it are secret.
zh: 尚未发现。这颗星球上的每个物种都存在，无论你是否找到其配方；只有组成它的三种生命形式是秘密。

en: The Harvester plants these seeds in the Harvesting field.
zh: 采集车会在采集田中种植这些种子。

en: Each trial combines three different life forms into one result. Most blends come back as sludge and produce nothing, and a failed trial still spends 1 t of each of its three life forms.
zh: 每次试验将三种不同的生命形式组合成一个结果。大多数配方只会返回污泥且不产出任何东西，失败的试验仍会消耗其三种生命形式各 1 吨。

en: A successful trial places one physical, species-specific seed here. Remove it before any new trial can start. Sludge produces no item.
zh: 成功的试验会在此放置一颗实体、特定物种的种子。开始任何新试验前必须先取出。污泥不产出物品。

en: The Crop Automator occupies this sector.
zh: 作物自动化机占据此区域。

en: There is no cell here, so this part of the reach does nothing. Placing the automator further from the field edge would use all 24 cells.
zh: 这里没有格子，因此该部分覆盖范围不会起作用。将自动机放置得离田地边缘更远一些，可使用全部 24 个格子。
部分收获：已存储 {collected}，已丢弃 {discarded}
已分配 {used} / {total} 个材料槽位

en: This slot has not latched a material yet.
Small aerial cargo drone, 1 thruster + 2 modules.
zh: 小型空中货运无人机，1 台推进器 + 2 个模块。
中型货运无人机，1 台推进器 + 3 个模块。
重型工业无人机，1 台推进器 + 5 个模块。

en: 1-bay logistics endpoint at an outpost. Cargo I/O.
zh: 前哨站单泊位物流节点。支持货物输入/输出。
生物实验室的五种试剂

en: Choose a cataloged creature to revive, or call rehouse(creature_id) to attach an established colony. Each species can occupy only one Habitat at a time.
zh: 选择一种已编目的生物进行复活，或调用 rehouse(creature_id) 接入已建立的种群。每个物种同一时间只能占据一个栖息地。

en: Rearing failed: bands were lost and the Habitat reverted to empty.
zh: 繁育失败：族群带已丢失，栖息地恢复为空。
已达容量，无法接收更多。
未知的已锁定配方蓝图

en: Load the raw fragment plus its exact materials, then fire inside the band.
zh: 装入原始碎片及其精确材料，然后在温度区间内加热。
已解锁 {unlocked}/{total} 个野外套件

en: The Harvester places these on the field with deploy().
zh: 采集车使用 deploy() 将这些部署到野外。
双泊位物流节点。支持并行停靠。
四泊位大型无人机枢纽。

en: Charges electric drones in the field and recovers heli drones for queued refueling. Grid-tied.
zh: 在野外为电动无人机充电，并回收旋翼无人机以排队加油。并网运行。

en: Mk I static drill for hardness-1 deposits: 25 t/h at standard purity and 10 W while extracting.
zh: Mk I 固定钻机，用于硬度 1 矿床：标准纯度下 25 t/h，开采时功耗 10 W。

en: Mk II static drill for hardness-3 deposits: 75 t/h at standard purity and 35 W while extracting.
zh: Mk II 固定钻机，用于硬度 3 矿床：标准纯度下 75 t/h，开采时功耗 35 W。

en: Mk III static drill for hardness-4 deposits: 200 t/h at standard purity and 100 W while extracting.
zh: Mk III 固定钻机，用于硬度 4 矿床：标准纯度下 200 t/h，开采时功耗 100 W。

en: Click repeatedly to inspect each marker.
zh: 反复点击以查看每个标记。

en: This planet already holds the maximum number of markers.
zh: 该星球已达到标记数量上限。

en: That marker could not be saved.
That marker could not be deleted.
Click the map to move this marker.
zh: 点击地图以移动此标记。

en: Delete the marker **{name}**? This cannot be undone.
zh: 删除标记 **{name}**？此操作无法撤销。

en: Place one in Plan Mode, or call markers.place(...) from a script.
zh: 在规划模式下放置一个，或在脚本中调用 markers.place(...)。

en: Change or clear the search and filters.
zh: 更改或清除搜索与筛选。

en: Could not copy. Please try again.
Could not export the map. Please try again.
Rovers and Pioneers show here wherever they are on the planet.
zh: 无论位于星球何处，漫游车和先锋建造机都会显示在这里。

en: Drones show here wherever they are on the planet. Drone hardware recipes come from Earth Orders; fabricate a station and deploy it into an outpost, then deploy a chassis into a free bay and mount its modules.
zh: 无人机会显示在这里，无论它们位于星球何处。无人机硬件配方来自地球订单；制造一座站点并将其部署到前哨站，然后将底盘部署到空闲舱位并安装模块。

en: No support infrastructure at this outpost.
zh: 该前哨站没有支持设施。

en: Charging stations, drone stations, and mining drills show here.
zh: 充电站、无人机站和采矿钻机会显示在这里。
显示 / 隐藏载具详情
运行 / 停止此载具的脚本

en: Show / hide this vehicle's live output
zh: 显示/隐藏此载具的实时输出

en: Show / hide live output on every vehicle
zh: 显示/隐藏所有载具的实时输出

en: This script is printing very often. Continuous output can reduce UI performance. Consider printing only when values change, or less often.
zh: 此脚本频繁打印。持续输出可能会降低 UI 性能。建议仅在数值变化时打印，或降低打印频率。
已安装模块 / 总槽位

en: {name}. Status: {status}. Battery or fuel: {energy}. {cargo}. Location: {location}. Show or hide details.
zh: {name}。状态：{status}。电池或燃料：{energy}。{cargo}。位置：{location}。显示或隐藏详情。

en: Active weather on the planet, open the Weather page
zh: 星球当前天气，打开天气页面

en: Hide storm cells on the map
zh: 在地图上隐藏风暴单元

en: Show storm cells on the map
zh: 在地图上显示风暴单元

en: {kind} centered at {x}, {y}. Intensity {intensity}. Radius {radius} m. Moving at {speed} m/h. {remaining} h remaining.
zh: {kind}中心位于 {x}, {y}。强度 {intensity}。半径 {radius} 米。移动速度 {speed} 米/小时。剩余 {remaining} 小时。

en: Lock map zoom, wheel scrolls the page instead
zh: 锁定地图缩放，滚轮改为滚动页面

en: Unlock map zoom, wheel zooms the map
zh: 解锁地图缩放，滚轮缩放地图

en: That location is not currently available on the map.
zh: 该位置当前无法在地图上显示

en: Paused. Send a Constructor Pioneer to resume this job.
zh: 已暂停。派遣先锋建造机以恢复此任务。
停滞，目标已满或无法到达

en: Resource signal detected. Its identity is not yet established.
zh: 检测到资源信号。其身份尚未确认。

en: Sonar found no extractable resource signal.
zh: 声呐未发现可开采资源信号。
({x}, {y}) 处的生物点：{count} 个生命体；{status}

en: Install an item into this bay
Battery Holder mounted, no battery installed
zh: 已安装电池架，未安装电池

en: self.{key} is not available, {name} not mounted. Mount one from this vehicle's module slots on the Planet Map. Buy modules from the Shop if none are available.
zh: self.{key} 不可用，未安装 {name}。请在星球地图中从该车辆的模块槽位安装一个。如果没有可用模块，请从商店购买。

en: Must be at base to dump cargo
zh: 必须位于基地才能卸货

en: {id} isn't in your journal. Scan within sonar range to discover it first.
zh: {id} 不在你的日志中。请先在声呐范围内扫描以发现它。

en: Invalid survey target, pass a site id string or a Site object from scan(). A saved dictionary with a string id is also accepted.
zh: 无效勘测目标，请传入站点 ID 字符串或来自 scan() 的 Site 对象。也接受包含字符串 id 的已保存字典。

en: Target ({x}, {y}) is outside the planet bounds (x from {minX} to {maxX}, y from {minY} to {maxY}).
zh: 目标 ({x}, {y}) 超出星球边界（x 从 {minX} 到 {maxX}，y 从 {minY} 到 {maxY}）。

en: {name}'s mineral is too hard for this drill.
zh: {name} 的矿物硬度过高，此钻机无法处理。
无电力，请充电后再采矿。

en: Not enough charge to finish this drill cycle ({available} / {needed} Wh). Recharge first.
zh: 电量不足以完成本次钻探周期（{available} / {needed} Wh）。请先充电。

en: Cargo Rack mounted, no bins installed
zh: 已安装货箱架，未安装货箱

en: Not enough charge to run sonar ({available} / {needed} Wh). Recharge first.
zh: 电量不足以运行声呐（{available} / {needed} Wh）。请先充电。

en: Sonar is still resolving the previous scan. Wait for it to complete before scanning again.
zh: 声呐仍在解析上一次扫描结果。请等待完成后再进行扫描。

en: Sonar is still resolving the previous survey. Wait for it to complete before surveying again.
zh: 声呐仍在处理上一次勘测。请等待完成后再勘测。

en: {name} requires hardness {hardness}; this sonar can resolve up to {limit}. Upgrade sonar and scan again.
zh: {name} 需要硬度 {hardness}；此声呐最高仅能解析至 {limit}。请升级声呐后重新扫描。

en: Vehicle is still moving. Brake and wait for speed to reach 0 before drilling.
zh: 车辆仍在移动。请制动并等待速度降为 0 后再钻探。

en: Drill is still running the previous cycle. Wait for it to complete before drilling again.
zh: 钻机仍在执行上一次作业周期。请等待完成后再进行钻探。

en: {name} is out of sonar range. Drive closer to scan it.
zh: {name} 超出声呐探测范围。请驶近后再进行扫描。

en: No compatible cargo space. Research Auto Feeders to unload vehicle cargo with self.output.send(...).
zh: 没有兼容的货舱空间。研究自动供料器，以使用 `self.output.send(...)` 卸载载具货物。

en: Invalid `self.charge(vehicle_id, target_level)` call, target_level must be a finite number greater than **0** and at most **1** and vehicle_id non-empty.
zh: 无效的 `self.charge(vehicle_id, target_level)` 调用，target_level 必须是大于 **0** 且不超过 **1** 的有限数值，且 vehicle_id 非空。

en: {vehicle} is not docked at this station, drive it within the service area first.
zh: {vehicle} 未在此站点停靠，请先将其驶入服务区。

en: Vehicle Charging Station is offline, power it before queuing vehicle charging.
zh: 载具充电站离线，请先为其供电再排队载具充电。

en: Invalid `self.dispatch_rescue(vehicle_id, target_level)` call, target_level must be a finite number greater than **0** and at most **1** and vehicle_id non-empty.
zh: 无效的 `self.dispatch_rescue(vehicle_id, target_level)` 调用，target_level 必须是大于 **0** 且不超过 **1** 的有限数值，且 vehicle_id 非空。

en: Invalid `self.charge(drone_id, target_level)` call, target_level must be a finite number greater than **0** and at most **1** and drone_id non-empty.
zh: 无效的 `self.charge(drone_id, target_level)` 调用，target_level 必须是大于 **0** 且不超过 **1** 的有限数值，且 drone_id 非空。

en: {drone} is not docked at this Drone Service Station (electric drones only).
zh: {drone} 未在此无人机服务站停靠（仅限电动无人机）。

en: Drone Service Station is offline, power it before queuing drone charging.
zh: 无人机服务站离线，请先为其供电再排队无人机充电。

en: Invalid `self.refuel(drone_id, target_level)` call, target_level must be a finite number greater than **0** and at most **1** and drone_id non-empty.
zh: 无效的 `self.refuel(drone_id, target_level)` 调用，target_level 必须是大于 **0** 且不超过 **1** 的有限数值，且 drone_id 非空。

en: {drone} is not docked at this Drone Service Station (heli drones only).
zh: {drone} 未在此无人机服务站停靠（仅限直升机无人机）。

en: Drone Service Station is offline, power it before queuing drone refueling.
zh: 无人机服务站离线，请先为其供电再排队无人机加油。

en: Drone Service Station's oil buffer is empty. Connect `oil_in` to an oil source; a remote source also needs a completed conflict-free liquid-pipe route between both locations.
zh: 无人机服务站的油料缓冲已空。将 `oil_in` 连接到油源；远程油源还需要在两个位置之间建立一条完成且无冲突的液体管道路线。

en:
**Feed the presses.** Scan the planet's biological sites, harvest life forms by the ton, and turn that life into planetary **Biomass**. It is the foundation the other two pillars grow from.

## The loop

• **Scan and extract.** Send a drone to a bio site, scan it, then harvest its life forms.
• **Liquify.** An **Essence Liquifier** consumes life forms at **1 t/h** and turns them into that biome's essence.
• **Mix.** A **Biomass Mixer** combines biome essences into Biomass tons.

## Where things live

• Right here, on the Biomass tabs.
• Life-form sites live on the Planet Map.

## One tip

Biosites regrow, but essence throughput (the amount of essence produced per hour) is limited by how often extractors run, each Liquifier's intake, and life-form rarity. Keep the richest available species flowing into enough Liquifiers, then feed balanced essences to your Mixers. Reach **500 t** to unlock the Seed Maker and open Plants.
zh:
**喂饱压榨机。** 扫描星球上的生物点，成吨采集生命体，并将这些生命转化为星球**生物量**。它是另外两根支柱赖以生长的基础。

## 循环

• **扫描并提取。** 派一架无人机前往生物点，扫描它，然后采集其中的生命体。
• **液化。** **精华液化机**以 **1 t/h** 的速率消耗生命体，并将其转化为该生物群系的精华。
• **混合。** **生物量混合机**将各生物群系的精华混合成生物量吨。

## 这些东西在哪里

• 就在这里，在生物量标签页上。
• 生命体地点位于星球地图上。

## 一条提示

生物点会再生，但精华产出速率（每小时产生的精华量）受提取器运行频率、每台液化机的摄入量以及生命体稀有度限制。让最丰富的可用物种持续流入足够多的液化机，再向混合机输送均衡的精华。达到 **500 t** 可解锁种子制造机并开启植物。

en:
**Green the surface.** Plants are an active crop chain. The field makes physical Forage, and a fleet of Plant Terraformers processes that stock in visible batches to create permanent Plants km².

## The loop

• **Make seeds.** In the **Seed Maker**, combine **1 t each of three different harvested life forms**. A match records the recipe forever, and you can repeat it for more physical seeds.
• **Plant and tend.** Call `load_seed(seed)` from anywhere to move one seed into the mobile Harvester. Plant it on the **Harvesting field**, then maintain its light, shade, water, salt, spacing, or neighbor conditions. The Harvester can apply light, water, and salt for 24 hours at a time before fixed providers take over.
• **Build diversity.** Every distinct productive species adds another full multiplier to crop yield. Ten supported species produce ten times the base harvest value of the same crops.
• **Harvest and replant.** Forage rises with the crop's visible growth and freezes when ready. At 100% outpost efficiency a Harvester takes **0.5 hours** and each Crop Automator job takes **0.1 hours**; overcrowding slows both proportionally, preserving automation's speed advantage. The mobile Harvester moves as much as Base Inventory can accept and leaves any remainder banked on the crop. A Crop Automator moves whatever fits in its local output, discards the remainder, and clears the cell. A completely full output blocks the job without changing the crop.
• **Terraform.** Route Forage into one or more **Plant Terraformers**. At 100% outpost efficiency a machine holds its materials visibly for a **3 hour** batch, then delivers permanent km²; overcrowding slows that visible cycle. Mk I stops at **2,250,000 km²**; Mk II is required after that.

## Where things live

• Seed Makers and Plant Terraformers are normal outpost buildings managed here under **Plants**.
• The growing field and fixed field automation live on the **Harvesting** page.
• Discovered recipes live in the **Flora** journal there.

## One tip

The mobile Harvester is the slow introductory loop because it must carry one seed and travel between cells. Grow Lamps, Sprinklers, and Dispensers each serve the four orthogonally adjacent cells (directly above, below, left, and right); diagonals do not count. A Crop Automator reaches up to 24 other cells in a centered 5 by 5 area. Its one executor handles up to 50 submitted harvest, plant, and treatment jobs in FIFO order by default (first in, first out, so the oldest job runs first), resting about **1 second** between jobs. Its script can inspect blockers and reorder unfinished jobs with `move_job(...)`. Hover any fixed field machine to see its exact service area.
zh:
**让地表变绿。** 植物是一条主动作物链。田地会产出实体草料，一队植物地球化机会以可见批次处理这些库存，从而创造永久植物 km²。

## 循环

• **制造种子。** 在**种子制造机**中，混合**三种不同已采集生命体各 1 t**。匹配成功后会永久记录该配方，你可以重复它以获得更多实体种子。
• **种植与照料。** 从任何地方调用 `load_seed(seed)`，将一粒种子移入移动采集车。把它种在**采集田**上，然后维持其光照、遮阴、水分、盐分、间距或相邻条件。在固定供给设施接管前，采集车可一次性施加光照、水分和盐分 24 小时。
• **建立多样性。** 每一个不同的生产性物种都会为作物产量增加一个完整倍率。十个受支持物种可产生相同作物基础收获值的十倍。
