• **收获与补种。** 草料随作物可见生长而增加，并在成熟时冻结。在 100% 前哨站效率下，采集车需要 **0.5 小时**，每个作物自动化机任务需要 **0.1 小时**；拥挤会按比例拖慢两者，从而保留自动化的速度优势。移动采集车会搬运基础库存所能接受的最大数量，并把任何剩余暂存于作物上。作物自动化机会搬运其本地输出能容纳的数量，丢弃剩余，并清空格子。完全满的输出会阻塞任务而不改变作物。
• **地球化。** 将草料输送到一个或多个**植物地球化机**。在 100% 前哨站效率下，机器会以可见方式保持材料 **3 小时**一批，然后交付永久 km²；拥挤会拖慢这个可见周期。Mk I 上限为 **2,250,000 km²**；之后需要 Mk II。

## 这些东西在哪里

• 种子制造机和植物地球化机是普通前哨站建筑，在**植物**下于此管理。
• 生长田和固定田地自动化位于**采集**页面。
• 已发现的配方记录在那里的**植物志**日志中。

## 一条提示

移动采集车是缓慢的入门循环，因为它必须携带一粒种子并在格子间往返。生长灯、喷淋器和分配器各自服务四个正交相邻格子（正上、正下、正左、正右）；对角线不计。作物自动化机可覆盖以自身为中心的 5×5 区域内最多 24 个其他格子。它的单个执行器默认以 FIFO 顺序处理最多 50 个已提交的收获、种植和处理任务（先进先出，因此最早的任务先运行），任务之间休息约 **1 秒**。它的脚本可以检查阻塞项，并用 `move_job(...)` 重新排序未完成任务。将鼠标悬停在任意固定田地机器上可查看其确切服务区域。

en:
**Bring the fauna back.** Wildlife is the final Biosphere pillar. Catalog creatures in the Biology Lab, craft their feed, revive them in Habitats, and grow distinct colonies. Population growth produces shared **Insight**. Spend it through each Habitat's API on one species-only Adaptation and one all-species Breakthrough. Nodes can change breeding pace, brood bonuses that build toward guaranteed extra offspring over time, feed efficiency, safe fluid ranges, starting population, how quickly late-stage growth levels off, or which fluid a mature creature requires.

Habitat Mk II unlocks at **600,000 Wildlife** and doubles carrying capacity only. It does not accelerate breeding. One species lives in each Habitat. An established colony can be rehoused without losing progress when the destination Habitat has enough capacity. Unhoused colonies retain their records but do not contribute to active Wildlife until rehoused. The Wildlife page presents colony status and the read-only adaptation tree; scripts make every purchase and life-support decision.
zh:
**让动物群回归。** 野生动物是生物圈最后一根支柱。在生物实验室中登记生物，制作它们的饲料，在栖息地中复活它们，并培育不同的群落。种群增长会产生共享的**洞察**。通过每个栖息地的 API 将其花费在一项仅限该物种的适应和一项全物种突破上。节点可以改变繁殖速度、随时间积累以确保额外后代的育雏加成、饲料效率、安全流体范围、初始种群、后期增长趋于平稳的速度，或成熟生物所需流体。

栖息地 Mk II 在 **600,000 野生动物**时解锁，并仅使承载容量翻倍。它不会加速繁殖。每个栖息地只生活一个物种。当目标栖息地拥有足够容量时，已建立群落可以在不丢失进度的情况下重新安置。未安置的群落保留其记录，但在重新安置前不会计入活跃野生动物。野生动物页面展示群落状态和只读适应树；脚本负责进行每项购买和生命维持决策。

en: Each distinct productive species adds one full multiplier to crop Forage yield. One species earns ×1, five earn ×5, and all fifteen earn ×15. A species counts while at least one planted cell currently meets every growing condition. Harvested Forage must still be routed into a visible Plant Terraformer batch to create permanent Plants km².
zh: 每一种不同的可生产物种都会为作物 Forage 产量增加一个完整倍率。一种获得 ×1，五种获得 ×5，全部十五种获得 ×15。只要当前至少有一个种植单元格满足所有生长条件，该物种即计入。收获的 Forage 仍必须送入可见的植物地球化器批次，才能生成永久植物 km²。

en:
Welcome to Code: Terraform.

You are connected to a remote terminal on an uninhabited planet. Your goal is to terraform it, make it livable, by writing code.

Everything on this planet is controlled through code. Systems, sensors, machines, you bring them online by programming them.

Start by typing code in the editor and clicking ▶ to run it.

```
print("Hello, planet!")
```

The console shows your output and any errors. Sensor readings update as you activate systems.

## Looking things up while you code

• **Hover** over any method or function name in your script to see its signature, description, and return type inline.
• **`Cmd+click` (macOS) / `Ctrl+click` (Windows / Linux)** on any method, function, or component id to open DOCS and jump straight to that entry. The block you clicked is briefly highlighted so you can see where you landed.

See the **Code Editor** DOCS page for the full set of editor shortcuts (rename, autocomplete, parameter hints, find/replace, debug stepping).
zh:
欢迎来到《代号:地球化》。

你连接的是某颗无生命星球上的远程终端。你的目标是通过编写代码对它进行地球化改造，让它变得宜居。

这颗星球上的一切都由代码控制。系统、传感器、机器，你通过编程让它们上线。

先在编辑器中输入代码，然后点击 ▶ 运行。

```
print("Hello, planet!")
```

控制台会显示你的输出和任何错误。当你启动系统时，传感器读数会随之更新。

## 在编写代码时查找信息

• 将鼠标悬停在脚本中的任何方法或函数名称上，即可在行内查看其签名、描述和返回类型。
• 在任何方法、函数或组件 id 上 **`Cmd+click` (macOS) / `Ctrl+click` (Windows / Linux)**，即可打开 DOCS 并直接跳转到该条目。你点击的区块会短暂高亮，让你知道落点在哪里。

查看 **Code Editor** DOCS 页面，了解完整的编辑器快捷键（重命名、自动补全、参数提示、查找/替换、调试步进）。

en:
After **First Contact**, the boot/power/sensors/uplink tutorial chain, you have **2,500 credits** and the **Shop** and **Biology Lab** are unlocked. This page is the handoff guide for what to do next. It remains available in DOCS; search for **First Steps** anytime you want a refresher.

## Next Steps

1. **Pressure Sensor and Oxygen Sensor are already deployed.** Repair **Pressure** to open Harvesting and Contracts; repair **Oxygen** to open Atmosphere. Research is already available.
2. **Open the Shop** in the left sidebar and buy a **Solar Generator**, a **Battery**, and an **Oxygen Generator**.
3. **Open Inventory** and **Deploy** all three.
4. **Script the Solar Generator and Oxygen Generator.** At **1 ppt oxygen**, Auto Feeders unlock and the Biology Lab can be automated.

> Repair the sensors in either order. This starter setup reserves enough credits and power for manual Biology now and automated Biology after Auto Feeders unlock.

## Earning Credits

Four early approaches teach different skills. Harvesting and Contracts sit side by side: which feels easier depends on whether you prefer visible machines or contained logic puzzles.

• **MANUAL BIOLOGY** *(easiest, no code)*, use the Biology workbench buttons to collect, analyze, extract, and deliver samples. This is the simplest first payout, but repeated orders become a click-heavy process.
• **HARVESTING** *(first automation, after Pressure repair)*, write a simple grid sweep that moves, collects, stores, and sells. Heat and the held-item slot need attention, but pathfinding and route optimization are optional.
• **CONTRACTS** *(contained puzzles, after Pressure repair)*, solve isolated programming problems with minimal machine state and safe retries. These favor loops, collections, and abstract reasoning.
• **AUTOMATED BIOLOGY** *(advanced automation, after Auto Feeders)*, coordinate the Bio Collector, Bio Lab, and Bio Exchange through separate scripts while managing orders, reagents, item ports, completed output, and partial state.

Every credit feeds back into the Shop. More machines means more terraforming progress.
zh:
在**初次接触**（启动/电力/传感器/上行链路教程链）之后，你拥有 **2,500 积分**，并且已解锁**商店**和**生物实验室**。本页是接下来该做什么的交接指南。它仍可在 DOCS 中找到；任何时候想复习，搜索 **第一步** 即可。

## 下一步

1. **压力传感器和氧气传感器已部署。** 修复**压力**以解锁采集与合约；修复**氧气**以解锁大气。研究已可用。
2. **在左侧边栏打开商店**，购买一台**太阳能发电机**、一块**电池**和一台**氧气发电机**。
3. **打开库存**并**部署**全部三台。
4. **为太阳能发电机和氧气发电机编写脚本。** 当氧气达到 **1 ppt** 时，**自动投喂器**解锁，生物实验室即可自动化。

> 两种传感器修复顺序均可。这套起步配置会保留足够的积分和电力，供当前手动生物实验使用，并在自动投喂器解锁后支持自动化生物实验。

## 赚取积分

早期有四种方式，各自教授不同技能。采集与合约并列：哪种更容易，取决于你偏好可见的机器还是封闭的逻辑谜题。

• **手动生物实验** *（最简单，无需代码）*，使用生物工作台按钮来采集、分析、提取并交付样本。这是最简单的首次收益，但重复订单会变得非常依赖点击。
• **采集** *（首次自动化，在修复压力之后）*，编写简单的网格扫描，实现移动、采集、存储和销售。需要注意热量和持有物品槽，但寻路和路线优化可选。
• **合约** *（封闭谜题，在修复压力之后）*，解决独立编程问题，机器状态最少且可安全重试。这些更偏向循环、集合和抽象推理。
• **自动化生物实验** *（高级自动化，在自动投喂器之后）*，通过独立脚本协调生物采集器、生物实验室和生物交换站，同时管理订单、试剂、物品端口、已完成输出和部分状态。

每一积分都会回流到商店。更多机器意味着更多地球化进度。

en:
Code: Terraform is a systems game where progress comes from understanding machines, then writing small scripts that make those machines useful.

## The basic loop

1. Pick one machine or problem.
2. Read that machine's **Info** tab.
3. Check DOCS for the methods and return values it exposes.
4. Write a small script that does one clear thing.
5. Run it, inspect returned results, watch the console, then improve it.

The game is not asking you to memorize everything. It is asking you to learn where information lives. Info tabs explain intent. DOCS explain APIs. A command result explains the exact programmatic outcome. The console shows output your script chooses to print, uncaught errors, and dedicated test transcripts, while the dashboard shows whether the world changed.

## Commands and game time

Gameplay commands consistently return a result object: branch on `result.status`, read `result.message`, and then use any command-specific payload fields. Commands do not print their ordinary outcomes automatically. Some commands pause the script while their attempted work finishes; others start or queue background work and return its current state immediately. The planet keeps running in either case. See **Command Results** for the complete model.

## Good habits

Start with one machine. Store every important command result. Check `.status`; print `.message` while learning. Once a tiny script behaves, make it loop. Once one loop behaves, connect it to another system.
zh:
代号:地球化是一款系统模拟游戏，进步来自理解机器，然后编写小脚本，让这些机器发挥作用。

## 基本循环

1. 选择一个机器或问题。
2. 阅读该机器的 **Info** 标签页。
3. 查阅 DOCS，了解它公开的方法与返回值。
4. 编写一个只做一件明确事情的小脚本。
5. 运行它，检查返回结果，观察控制台，然后改进。

游戏不要求你记住所有内容。它要求你学会信息在哪里。Info 标签页解释意图。DOCS 解释 API。命令结果解释精确的程序化结果。控制台显示脚本选择打印的输出、未捕获错误和专门的测试记录，而仪表盘显示世界是否发生变化。

## 命令与游戏时间

游戏命令始终返回一个结果对象：根据 `result.status` 分支，读取 `result.message`，然后使用任何命令特有的负载字段。命令不会自动打印其常规结果。有些命令会在其尝试执行的工作完成时暂停脚本；另一些命令会启动或排队后台工作，并立即返回其当前状态。无论哪种情况，星球都会继续运行。完整模型见 **命令结果**。

## 良好习惯

从一台机器开始。保存每个重要的命令结果。检查 `.status`；在学习时打印 `.message`。一旦一个微小脚本表现正常，就让它循环。一旦一个循环表现正常，就把它连接到另一个系统。

en:
After First Contact, credits become the fuel for expansion. You have four early approaches, and each teaches a different skill. Manual Biology is open immediately. Harvesting and Contracts appear after you repair the Pressure Sensor. Automated Biology becomes practical after your starter Oxygen Generator reaches **1 ppt oxygen** and unlocks **Auto Feeders**.

## Manual Biology - easiest first payout

Your **2,500 starting credits** cover a Solar Generator, Battery, and Oxygen Generator, with credits left for starter reagents. Use the Biology workbench buttons to collect a specimen, analyze it, load its revealed reagents, extract the sample, and deliver it. No code is required. This makes the workflow easy to learn, but the repeated actions become slow after the first few orders.

## Harvesting - first machine automation

A basic Harvester script can sweep the grid, collect what is present, store it, and sell from Inventory. It must account for heat and the one held-item slot, but it does not need pathfinding or an optimized route to work. This is the most direct first automation project for players who like visible machine behavior.

## Contracts - contained programming puzzles

Contracts are not production machines. They read data, compute an answer, and transmit it to Earth. They involve little machine API state and failed answers are safe to retry, but their loops, collections, and abstract reasoning may feel easier or harder than Harvesting depending on the player.

## Automated Biology - advanced early project

After Auto Feeders unlock, Biology changes from one manual workbench flow into three cooperating machine scripts. The Bio Collector, Bio Lab, and Bio Exchange each own their actions. Reliable automation must coordinate order progress, reagent staging, item ports, completed output, and whatever specimen or reagent state remains after a script stops.

## Choosing well

Start with manual Biology if you want the simplest first payout. Choose Harvesting for visible automation or Contracts for a focused logic problem. Automate the full Biology chain when you want a more advanced multi-machine project. All four approaches remain valid ways to earn early credits.
zh:
首次接触之后，积分便成为扩张的燃料。你有四种早期路线，每种都能教会你不同的技能。手动生物立即开放。采集和合约在你修复压力传感器后出现。自动化生物在你初始氧气发电机达到 **1 ppt 氧气**并解锁 **自动进料器** 后才变得实用。

## 手动生物 - 最容易的首次回报

你的 **2,500 初始积分** 可以购买一台太阳能发电机、一块电池和一台氧气发电机，还能剩下一些积分购买初始试剂。使用生物工作台按钮来采集样本、分析样本、装入其揭示的试剂、提取样本并交付。不需要编写代码。这让流程容易上手，但前几单之后重复操作会变得缓慢。

## 采集 - 首次机器自动化

基础采集车脚本可以扫描网格、收集存在的东西、存储它并从库存中出售。它必须考虑热量和只有一个持有物品槽位，但不需要寻路或优化路线也能工作。对于喜欢可见机器行为的玩家来说，这是最直接的第一个自动化项目。

## 合约 - 独立的编程谜题

合约不是生产机器。它们读取数据、计算答案，并将答案传回地球。它们涉及的机器 API 状态很少，失败的答案可以安全重试，但其中的循环、集合和抽象推理可能因玩家不同而比采集更容易或更难。

## 自动化生物 - 进阶早期项目

自动进料器解锁后，生物从一个手动工作台流程变成三个协作机器脚本。生物采集器、生物实验室和生物交换站各自负责自己的动作。可靠的自动化必须协调订单进度、试剂暂存、物品端口、完成输出，以及脚本停止后残留的任何样本或试剂状态。

## 选择得当

如果你想要最简单的首次回报，就从手动生物开始。选择采集来获得可见自动化，或选择合约来应对专注的逻辑问题。当你想要更进阶的多机器项目时，再自动化整条生物链。四种路线都是赚取早期积分的有效方式。

en:
Terraforming machines are the core engines of the base. Heat Generators, Oxygen Generators, and Pressure Generators turn power into planetary progress.

## Power comes first

A machine that has no power cannot help the planet. Early solar power changes with day and night, so a base that works at noon may stall after sunset. Batteries smooth that gap by storing daytime surplus for nighttime use.

A reliable early setup is: add a generator, add a battery, run one terraforming machine, then expand power before adding too many more consumers.

## Terraforming starts with three tracks

Temperature, oxygen, and pressure are the first three tracks, each with their own machines and upgrades. They all matter. You can focus one track for a while, but the planet only becomes livable when all three keep advancing. Later progress opens more terraforming tracks; for now, make these first systems dependable.

The first machines are slow. Add power, add machines, then expand to more outposts and higher tiers to raise the pace.

## Oxygen runs on CO2, the carbon cycle

Oxygen Generators convert atmospheric CO2 into oxygen, one-for-one. The planet starts with a large CO2 reserve, and that reserve is enough for a long time, but large-scale oxygen production outpaces it. CO2 is returned to the atmosphere by burning oil (Oil Generator), incinerating items (Waste Processor), and, at real scale, by wildlife: established colonies exhale CO2. A small volcanic trickle keeps CO2 from ever bottoming out completely, so a starved oxygen fleet always recovers. Watch `atmosphere.get_co2()` and remember the efficiency sweet spot moves with it.

## Scripts should react

Good machine scripts read state before acting. A generator can react to sun angle. A battery or power monitor can warn when storage is low. A terraforming machine can throttle down when power is tight and resume when the base recovers.

If generators stop at night or terraforming machines pause from low power, that is usually not a bug. Power production, storage, and consumption have to fit together.
zh:
地球化机器是基地的核心引擎。热发电机、氧发电机和压发电机将电力转化为星球改造进度。

## 电力优先

没有电力的机器无法为星球出力。早期太阳能随昼夜变化，因此中午运转的基地可能在日落后停摆。电池通过储存白天的盈余供夜间使用，来弥补这段缺口。

可靠的早期配置是：添加发电机，添加电池，运行一台地球化机器，然后在添加太多用电设备之前扩展电力。

## 地球化始于三条轨道

温度、氧气和压力是最初的三条轨道，每条轨道都有自己的机器和升级。它们都很重要。你可以暂时专注一条轨道，但只有当三条轨道持续前进时，星球才会变得宜居。后续进展会开放更多地球化轨道；眼下，先让这些初始系统可靠。

最初的机器很慢。增加电力，增加机器，然后扩展到更多前哨站和更高阶设施来提高节奏。

## 氧气依赖二氧化碳，即碳循环

氧发电机将大气中的二氧化碳一比一转化为氧气。星球起初拥有大量二氧化碳储备，这份储备足以支撑很长时间，但大规模氧气生产会超过它。二氧化碳通过燃烧石油（油发电机）、焚烧物品（废物处理器）返回大气；而在真正规模上，野生动物也会贡献二氧化碳：已建立的殖民地会呼出二氧化碳。少量火山排放可防止二氧化碳完全耗尽，因此缺料的氧机群总能恢复。注意 `atmosphere.get_co2()`，并记住效率最佳点会随其移动。

## 脚本应当响应

好的机器脚本会在行动前读取状态。发电机可以对太阳角度作出反应。电池或电力监视器可以在储能不足时发出警告。地球化机器可以在电力紧张时降速，并在基地恢复后重新运行。

如果发电机在夜间停止，或地球化机器因低电力暂停，这通常不是 bug。电力生产、储存和消耗必须相互匹配。

en:
Manual Biology is the gentlest first credit path because the workbench guides each narrow machine step. Automating the same pipeline is an advanced early project because its separate machine scripts must coordinate persistent state.

## Manual and automated logistics

The manual Biology workbench has exactly **one stockroom per outpost**. At Nocturna Base that stockroom is Base Inventory. At every other outpost, choose one deployed local Warehouse in the Manual Stockroom bar; all manual Biology cards there draw from and return to that Warehouse. The selection does not move existing items. Shop purchases still arrive in Base Inventory, so carry supplies to remote Warehouses with vehicles or drones.

Manual buttons do not create hidden I/O connections or move items through a machine's `self.input` and `self.output` buffers. They load supplies directly from the manual stockroom into the workbench and return finished or recovered items directly to that stockroom. A full machine input or output buffer therefore does not block the matching manual action.

## What changes when you start scripting

Scripts do not use the manual stockroom selector. After **Auto Feeders** research, your code must manage each machine's scripted logistics explicitly: connect item ports where present, move supplies into `self.input`, load them into the machine when required, and drain completed items from `self.output`. Every stationary transfer remains local to that outpost.

The Bio Collector, Bio Lab, and Bio Exchange each own their hardware actions. Stopping or restarting a script does not empty a specimen chamber, unload reagents, drain an output, or reset Bio Order progress. Reliable code must inspect that partial state before deciding what to do next.

```
input_link = self.input.connect("Reagent Warehouse")
output_link = self.output.connect("Sample Warehouse")
if input_link.status != "ok":
  print(input_link.message)
```

## The pipeline

- The Bio Collector retrieves a specimen.
- The Bio Lab analyzes it, stages reagents, and extracts a sample.
- Biome machines transform the sample.
- The Bio Exchange delivers it toward an active Bio Order.

Every gameplay command returns a result object. Branch on `.status`, use `.message` for the exact reason, and read any method-specific payload. For example, `analyze()` returns `AnalyzeResult.info`, while item transfers return `TransferResult.moved`. Statuses such as `"busy"`, `"no_input"`, and `"output_full"` are never bare strings.

Properties belong to each item stack and survive supported transfers. Bio Orders come from a Bio Exchange, not the Earth Supply Dock orders component. Subtract both `.delivered` and `.in_transit` when planning production. See **Long-Running Scripts** for the restart-safe loop pattern used by unattended automation.
zh:
手动生物是最温和的首条积分路径，因为工作台会引导每一个有限的机器步骤。自动化同一条流水线则是一个进阶的早期项目，因为各台机器的脚本必须协调持久状态。

## 手动与自动物流

手动生物工作台在每个前哨站恰好有**一个储藏室**。在诺克图纳基地，该储藏室是基地库存。在每个其他前哨站，在手动储藏室栏中选择一个已部署的本地仓库；那里所有手动生物卡片都从该仓库取用并返回该仓库。选择不会移动现有物品。商店购买仍会到达基地库存，因此请用载具或无人机把补给运到远程仓库。

手动按钮不会创建隐藏的 I/O 连接，也不会通过机器的 `self.input` 和 `self.output` 缓冲区移动物品。它们直接从手动储藏室把补给装入工作台，并把成品或回收物品直接返回该储藏室。因此，机器输入或输出缓冲区已满不会阻止对应的手动操作。

## 开始编写脚本时会发生什么变化

脚本不会使用手动储藏室选择器。在**自动供料**研究之后，你的代码必须明确管理每台机器的脚本化物流：在存在时连接物品端口，把补给移入 `self.input`，在需要时将其装入机器，并从 `self.output` 排出已完成物品。每一次固定传输都保持在该前哨站本地。

生物采集器、生物实验室和生物交换站各自拥有其硬件操作。停止或重启脚本不会清空样本舱、卸下试剂、排空输出，也不会重置生物订单进度。可靠的代码必须在决定下一步做什么之前检查这种部分状态。

```
input_link = self.input.connect("Reagent Warehouse")
output_link = self.output.connect("Sample Warehouse")
if input_link.status != "ok":
  print(input_link.message)
```

## 流水线

- 生物采集器获取一个标本。
- 生物实验室分析它、准备试剂，并提取一个样品。
- 生物群系机器转化该样品。
- 生物交换站将其递送至一个活跃生物订单。

每个游戏命令都会返回一个结果对象。根据 `.status` 分支，使用 `.message` 获取确切原因，并读取任何方法专属负载。例如，`analyze()` 返回 `AnalyzeResult.info`，而物品传输返回 `TransferResult.moved`。状态如 `"busy"`、`"no_input"` 和 `"output_full"` 绝不是裸字符串。

属性属于每个物品堆叠，并在受支持的传输中保留。生物订单来自生物交换站，而不是地球补给坞的订单组件。规划生产时，请同时扣除 `.delivered` 和 `.in_transit`。参见**长时间运行脚本**，了解无人值守自动化使用的重启安全循环模式。

en:
Harvesting is the most direct early path into visible machine automation. It can earn more than manual Biology, while keeping the first working version much smaller than a reliable automated Biology chain.

## What you are building

A useful harvesting route usually has three parts: choose where to go, collect material, then store and sell when Inventory says it is time. The main decision is not the individual call; it is deciding when to move on.

## What to inspect

Read the Harvester Info tab first. Then check the Scanner and Harvester entries in DOCS. The Scanner teaches what is known about the surface. The Harvester teaches movement, collection, heat, and the held-item slot.

## Keep the first route simple

You do not need pathfinding. A fixed sweep across adjacent grid cells can collect and store everything it finds. Check heat before moving, handle the held item before collecting again, and optimize the route only after the basic loop works.

## A good first target

Start with one short trip that reaches a known area, collects something, stores it, and leaves it ready to sell from Inventory. Then extend the sweep or add smarter choices.
zh:
采集是进入可见机器自动化最直接的前期路径。它可能比手动生物交换赚得更多，同时让第一个可用版本比可靠的自动化生物交换链小得多。

## 你要构建什么

一条有用的采集路线通常有三部分：选择去哪里，采集材料，然后在库存提示时机成熟时存储并出售。主要决策不是单个调用；而是决定何时继续前进。

## 要查看什么

先阅读采集车信息页签。然后在 DOCS 中查看扫描仪和采集车条目。扫描仪讲解地表已知信息。采集车讲解移动、采集、热量和持有物品槽。

## 保持第一条路线简单

你不需要寻路。在相邻网格单元上进行固定扫掠，就能采集并存储它发现的一切。移动前检查热量，再次采集前处理持有物品，只有在基本循环能运行后才优化路线。

## 一个好的首个目标

从一次短途行程开始：抵达已知区域，采集一些东西，存储它，并让它准备好从库存中出售。然后扩展扫掠范围或加入更智能的选择。

en:
Contracts are Earth-side programming jobs. They are closer to puzzle problems than factory automation.

## What makes them different

A machine script usually changes the planet. A contract script reads the contract data, computes an answer, and sends it back. The reward comes from correctness, not from keeping a production loop running. Contract state is contained, and a wrong answer is safe to inspect and retry.

## How to approach one

Read the briefing first. Then inspect the available contract data from the script. Work out the answer in small steps and print intermediate values while you are learning the shape of the data. When the answer is ready, use the transmitter workflow described in the contract and DOCS.

## Difficulty

Contracts and Harvesting test different skills, so neither is universally harder. Contracts avoid routes, heat, cargo, and multi-machine recovery, but ask for more abstract reasoning with loops and collections. They are a good choice when you want a focused coding puzzle and a bigger one-time payout. If a contract feels too abstract, leave it and build the base for a while; it will still be there later.
zh:
合约是地球端的编程工作。它们更像解谜题，而不是工厂自动化。

## 有何不同

机器脚本通常会改变星球。合约脚本读取合约数据，计算答案，并发送回去。奖励来自正确性，而不是维持生产循环运行。合约状态是封闭的，错误答案也可以安全地检查和重试。

## 如何入手

先阅读简报。然后在脚本中检查可用的合约数据。以小步骤推导答案，并在熟悉数据形态时打印中间值。答案准备好后，使用合约和 DOCS 中描述的发射器工作流。

## 难度

合约和采集考验不同技能，因此没有哪一方普遍更难。合约不涉及路线、热量、货物和多机恢复，但要求更多使用循环和集合的抽象推理。当你想要一个专注的编程谜题和更高的一次性收益时，它们是很好的选择。如果某份合约显得太抽象，可以先放着，去建设基地一段时间；它之后仍会在那里。
读取错误与控制台输出

en:
The console is part of the interface. It shows output your script explicitly prints, uncaught exceptions, and dedicated transcripts such as sensor calibration tests.

## Opening it

Click **Console** in the bottom window bar to open or focus it. In dock mode, the console sits in the lower-right pane beside the editor. Use the console filter to switch between THIS SCRIPT, ALL output, WARNINGS, and ERRORS.

## Results are the program interface

Gameplay commands return fixed result objects without printing ordinary success or rejection messages automatically. `result.status` is the stable code to branch on, and `result.message` explains the exact outcome. Payload-bearing results add named fields such as `.moved`, `.sites`, or `.info`.

```
result = self.extract()
if result.status != "ok":
  print(result.message)
```

Your script decides which command outcomes belong in the console. Never compare `.message` in program logic because it is localized display text. Malformed calls raise typed exceptions such as `TypeError` or `ValueError`; ordinary game states such as `"busy"` or `"no_cargo_space"` remain result statuses so the script can decide what to do.

## Busy is not failure

A `"busy"` status means the machine is finishing another timed action, not that something broke. For the retry pattern, see **Command Results**.

## Debugging rhythm

Store the result of an important command, inspect `.status` and `.message`, then read any payload fields only for statuses that provide them. Use **Trace** when you want to see where the script is parked, and **Debug** when you need to inspect variables directly.
zh:
控制台是界面的一部分。它会显示脚本显式打印的输出、未捕获的异常，以及传感器校准测试等专用记录。

## 打开控制台

点击底部窗口栏中的 **控制台** 以打开或聚焦它。在停靠模式下，控制台位于编辑器旁边的右下方面板中。使用控制台筛选器在本脚本、全部输出、警告和错误之间切换。

## 结果就是程序接口

玩法命令会返回固定的结果对象，不会自动打印普通的成功或拒绝消息。`result.status` 是用于分支的稳定代码，`result.message` 会解释确切结果。带有效载荷的结果会添加命名字段，例如 `.moved`、`.sites` 或 `.info`。

```
result = self.extract()
if result.status != "ok":
  print(result.message)
```

你的脚本决定哪些命令结果应显示在控制台中。切勿在程序逻辑中比较 `.message`，因为它是本地化显示文本。格式错误的调用会抛出 `TypeError` 或 `ValueError` 等类型化异常；普通游戏状态（如 `"busy"` 或 `"no_cargo_space"`）仍保留为结果状态，以便脚本决定如何处理。

## 忙碌不是失败

`"busy"` 状态表示机器正在完成另一个计时动作，而不是出了故障。重试模式请参见 **命令结果**。

## 调试节奏

保存重要命令的结果，检查 `.status` 和 `.message`，然后仅对提供有效载荷字段的状态读取这些字段。当你想查看脚本停在哪里时使用 **追踪**，当你需要直接检查变量时使用 **调试**。

en:
A Pioneer is the first vehicle that turns remote plans into built infrastructure. The usual flow is: buy a Pioneer, mount the modules it needs, send it to the site, and let its local script do the work.

## What makes it different

A Rover explores and mines. A Pioneer builds. The chassis is only the carrier; mounted modules decide what it can actually do.

For early expansion, look for four module families:

- **Nav Module** - moves the Pioneer across the full planet coordinate plane.
- **Battery Holder** - carries Portable Batteries. At least one charged Portable Battery must be installed or the Pioneer cannot move.
- **Cargo Rack** - hosts Portable Storage Bins that carry kits, pipe segments, power-line segments, and other build materials.
- **Constructor Module** - executes Planet Map blueprints once the right materials are on board.

## Good first goal

Before trying to found an outpost, practice with a small job: put a simple blueprint near home, install a charged Portable Battery, load the required kit or segments into Pioneer cargo, move it to the blueprint, brake, and execute it. The blueprint can come from Plan Mode or `get_component("construction_blueprint")`; either path creates the same persistent job. If the Pioneer cannot leave, check its Battery Holders and installed batteries. If construction is rejected, check the Constructor Module and cargo.

## Where to look

The Info tab explains the module APIs available through `self`. Plan Mode shows material requirements before placement. Query `get_component("construction_blueprint").pending_constructions()` for the queued `Construction` snapshots; every one exposes `required_item` and `required_count` to scripts.
zh:
先锋建造机是首辆将远程规划转化为实体基础设施的车辆。通常流程是：购买一台先锋建造机，安装其所需模块，将其送往现场，并让本地脚本执行工作。

## 它有何不同

漫游车负责探索与采矿。先锋建造机负责建造。底盘只是载体；已安装模块决定它实际能做什么。

在早期扩张时，寻找四类模块：

- **导航模块** - 让先锋建造机在整颗行星坐标平面上移动。
- **电池架** - 携带便携电池。必须至少安装一块已充电的便携电池，否则先锋建造机无法移动。
- **货舱架** - 安装便携储物箱，用于携带套件、管段、电力线段及其他建造材料。
- **建造模块** - 在车上具备正确材料后，执行行星地图蓝图。

## 一个好的初始目标

在尝试建立前哨站之前，先用一个小任务练习：在基地附近放置一个简单蓝图，安装一块已充电的便携电池，将所需套件或管段、电力线段装载到先锋建造机的货舱中，移动到蓝图处，制动，并执行该蓝图。蓝图可以来自规划模式或 `get_component("construction_blueprint")`；两条路径都会创建相同的持久任务。如果先锋建造机无法离开，请检查其电池架和已安装电池。如果建造被拒绝，请检查建造模块和货舱。

## 去哪里查看

信息标签页会说明通过 `self` 可用的模块 API。规划模式会在放置前显示材料需求。查询 `get_component("construction_blueprint").pending_constructions()` 以获取排队中的 `Construction` 快照；每个快照都会向脚本暴露 `required_item` 和 `required_count`。

en:
Plan Mode is the visual construction-planning layer on the Planet Map. It does not build instantly. It creates persistent blueprints that a Constructor-equipped Pioneer can execute later.

## Visual planning flow

1. Open the Planet Map and turn on Plan Mode.
2. Choose a category, then choose a tool.
3. Place a blueprint where the map allows it.
4. Read the placement card and blueprint hover card for the required material.
5. Load that material into a Pioneer with a Constructor Module.
6. Send the Pioneer to the blueprint and execute construction from the Pioneer script.

## Script planning

Scripts write to the same queue through `get_component("construction_blueprint")`. Use `plan_structure(kind, x, y)` for Outposts, caps, pumps, taps, and Mining Drills; use `plan_pipe`, `plan_power_line`, and `plan_bridge` for utilities. A successful planning call places the ghost immediately without sending a vehicle there. The Pioneer is still required for the physical build.

```
plans = get_component("construction_blueprint")
result = plans.plan_structure("thermal_cap", vent.x, vent.y)
if result.status == "ok":
    print(result.blueprint_ids[0])
```

## Locked tools

Visual tools and script calls enforce the same research. Outposts have two gates: **Outpost Construction** unlocks the kit, and **Constructor Module** unlocks the Pioneer module that can build the blueprint.

## Planning habits

Keep plans small until the first one works. One blueprint plus the exact material it asks for is easier to debug than a whole remote base. Once you trust the loop, scale up to outposts, pipes, power lines, pumps, and field extractors. Internal outpost machines, including drone facilities, deploy directly from Inventory and never appear as map blueprints.
zh:
规划模式是星球地图上的可视化建造规划层。它不会立即建造。它会创建持久蓝图，供配备建造器的先锋建造机稍后执行。

## 可视化规划流程

1. 打开星球地图并启用规划模式。
2. 选择类别，然后选择工具。
3. 在地图允许的位置放置蓝图。
4. 查看放置卡片和蓝图悬停卡片，了解所需材料。
5. 将材料装入配备建造器模块的先锋建造机。
6. 将先锋建造机派往蓝图，并从其脚本执行建造。

## 脚本规划

脚本通过 `get_component("construction_blueprint")` 写入同一队列。使用 `plan_structure(kind, x, y)` 规划前哨站、盖帽、泵、阀门和采矿钻机；使用 `plan_pipe`、`plan_power_line` 和 `plan_bridge` 规划公用设施。成功的规划调用会立即放置幽灵预览，而不派遣载具前往。实际建造仍需要先锋建造机。

```
plans = get_component("construction_blueprint")
result = plans.plan_structure("thermal_cap", vent.x, vent.y)
if result.status == "ok":
    print(result.blueprint_ids[0])
```

## 锁定工具

可视化工具和脚本调用遵循相同的研究限制。前哨站有两道门槛：**前哨站建造**解锁套件，**建造器模块**解锁能够建造蓝图的先锋建造机模块。

## 规划习惯

在第一次成功前保持小规模规划。一个蓝图加上它所需的确切材料，比整个远程基地更容易调试。一旦你信任这个流程，就可以扩展到前哨站、管道、电力线、泵和野外采集器。内部前哨站机器，包括无人机设施，直接从库存部署，不会作为地图蓝图出现。

en:
An Outpost expands your build area to a new part of the planet. Buying an **Outpost Kit** is only the material step; founding it also needs the Pioneer construction workflow.

## Requirements

- **Outpost Construction** research to buy the Outpost Kit.
- **Constructor Module** research to build Planet Map blueprints.
- A **Pioneer** with a **Nav Module** and a **Constructor Module** mounted.
- A **Battery Holder** with at least one charged **Portable Battery** installed. Without stored energy, the Pioneer cannot drive.
- A **Cargo Rack** with enough Portable Storage Bin space for one **Outpost Kit**.
- One Outpost Kit loaded into Pioneer cargo, not left in Base Inventory.
- An Outpost blueprint placed in Plan Mode or with `construction_blueprint.plan_structure("outpost", x, y)`.

## What to do

Place the outpost footprint first. Plan Mode gives visual placement feedback; the script API returns an exact planning status. Either path creates the same job marker. Then load the kit, move the Pioneer to the blueprint, brake, and build it from the Pioneer. If the Pioneer cannot leave, inspect its battery capacity and charge. If the kit is in inventory but nothing builds, check that the Constructor Module is mounted and the kit is physically in Pioneer cargo.

## Why this matters

A single home base becomes slow later. The outpost step is when terraforming becomes geographic: more build areas, more machines, more local power, and eventually networks that connect distant production.
zh:
前哨站会将你的建造区域扩展到星球的新区域。购买**前哨站套件**只是材料准备步骤；建立前哨站还需要先锋建造机的工作流程。

## 要求

- 完成**前哨站建造**研究，以购买前哨站套件。
- 完成**建造模块**研究，以建造星球地图蓝图。
- 一台**先锋建造机**，并安装**导航模块**和**建造模块**。
- 一个**电池座**，其中至少安装一块已充电的**便携电池**。没有储存能量，先锋建造机无法行驶。
- 一个**货物架**，其中要有足够的便携储物箱空间来容纳一个**前哨站套件**。
- 一个前哨站套件已装载到先锋建造机的货物中，而不是留在基地库存里。
- 已在规划模式中放置前哨站蓝图，或使用 `construction_blueprint.plan_structure("outpost", x, y)`。

## 需要做什么

首先放置前哨站占地范围。规划模式会提供视觉放置反馈；脚本 API 会返回精确的规划状态。两种方式都会创建相同的作业标记。然后装载套件，将先锋建造机移动到蓝图处，制动，并从先锋建造机建造它。如果先锋建造机无法离开，请检查其电池容量和电量。如果套件在库存中但没有任何建造发生，请检查建造模块是否已安装，以及套件是否实际位于先锋建造机货物中。

## 为什么这很重要

单一主基地在后期会变得缓慢。建立前哨站是地球化改造开始具有地理意义的一步：更多建造区域、更多机器、更多本地电力，最终还有连接远距离生产的网络。

en:
The **Biosphere** is the second major terraforming track. Its first tier is **Biomass**: drone crews discover and harvest native life, then outpost machines convert it into planetary biomass.

## Unlock

**Basic Drone Operations** opens at 180k Terraform Index, before Biosphere. It exposes drone deployment and control, but every chassis, thruster, station, battery, and Cargo Pod still needs a blueprint earned from Earth Orders and must be fabricated. **Biosphere** opens at 210k and adds the Portable Bio Scanner, Portable Bio Extractor, Essence Liquifier, and Biomass Mixer.

## Permanent biosites

The Planet Map contains **35 permanent biological sites**: **7 total per biome type across the entire map**, shared among all disconnected patches of that biome. They begin as the same question-mark contacts used for other physical sites and block construction. Each contains **1-3** native life forms; every biome's six life forms are guaranteed somewhere among its seven sites. Locations and contents are identical in every game.

Biological field tools mount only on drones. You don't hunt for the question marks by eye: `get_component("nocturna").points_of_interest()` returns every "?" contact on the map (each with `.x` / `.y` / `.scanned`), so a scanning drone routes straight to the unscanned ones instead of wandering. Fly to a contact with `go_to(x, y)`, then call `self.bio_scanner.scan()`. The question mark becomes a biological marker and the result persists in the Journal. A contact's `.kind` stays `"unknown"` until scanned, so bio-scan each unknown to find the biosites (minerals, vents, and wells share the same map and scan empty for a bio scanner). A harvester drone returns to a biosite coordinate and calls `self.bio_extractor.extract()`.

A Small electric drone uses its Thruster slot for an Electric Thruster and one of its two Module slots for a Battery Pack. That leaves one specialist slot: fit a Scanner or an Extractor for the trip, swap roles while docked, or field two drones. Medium and Large chassis add room later.

The extractor includes a **25 t sealed chamber** that holds one life-form type at a time. Each Cargo Pod holds ONE material: Small 100, Medium 250, Large 500 units, so a drone carries as many materials as it has pods. Use `self.cargo.space_for(item_id)` to check room for a specific material before a trip. `get_component("journal").biomass_coords()` is the restart-safe list of discovered routes; each sample exposes peak `.tons` and current `.remaining_tons`.

## Depletion and cooldown

A harvest removes only what the drone can carry. Remaining stock stays at the site for another trip. Cooldown starts only after every life form there is depleted. Common, uncommon, and rare sites use progressively longer cooldowns, then replenish at the same permanent coordinate. Use `journal = get_component("journal")`, then `journal.is_ready(x, y)` and `journal.next_ready_at(x, y)` to schedule rotations.

## Local processing

A Drone Depot stockpile belongs to one outpost. Dock there to unload, then route the sample into an **Essence Liquifier at that same outpost**. The specimen must be native to the outpost's biome. The Liquifier produces only that biome's essence.

Nothing is shared between outposts. Move life forms with drones, and move essence through a physical liquid network of ports, pipes, and tanks. A **Biomass Mixer** consumes the required biome essences and produces biomass tons. Later phases require more distinct essences, so progression expands the local station and Liquifier chain into more biomes and brings those liquid lines together at a Mixer.

> The extractor chamber makes a basic harvester functional. Cargo Pods reduce trips but do not replace the local outpost chain.

Plants and Wildlife are the next Biosphere pillars.
zh:
**生物圈**是第二条主要地球化路线。它的第一阶段是**生物质**：无人机团队发现并采集本土生命，然后前哨站机器将其转化为行星生物质。

## 解锁

**基础无人机作业**在地球化指数达到 180k 时开启，早于生物圈。它开放无人机部署与控制，但每个底盘、推进器、站点、电池和货舱仍需要地球订单获得的蓝图，并且必须制造。**生物圈**在 210k 解锁，并新增便携生物扫描仪、便携生物提取器、精华液化器和生物质混合器。

## 永久生物点

行星地图包含 **35 个永久生物点**：**每种生态区在整个地图上共 7 个**，由该生态区所有不连续区域共享。它们起初与其他物理地点一样显示为问号标记，并会阻碍建造。每个包含 **1-3** 个本土生命体；每个生态区的六种生命体都保证存在于其七个地点中的某处。位置和产物在每局游戏中都相同。

生物野外工具只能安装在无人机上。你不需要用肉眼寻找问号：`get_component("nocturna").points_of_interest()` 返回地图上的每个 "?" 标记（每个都有 `.x` / `.y` / `.scanned`），因此扫描无人机会直接前往未扫描标记，而不是四处游荡。使用 `go_to(x, y)` 飞向标记，然后调用 `self.bio_scanner.scan()`。问号会变成生物标记，结果会保存在日志中。标记的 `.kind` 在扫描前保持 `"unknown"`，因此对每个未知标记进行生物扫描以找到生物点（矿物、喷口和井共享同一地图，生物扫描仪扫描结果为空）。采集无人机返回生物点坐标并调用 `self.bio_extractor.extract()`。

小型电动无人机将推进器槽位用于电动推进器，并将两个模块槽位中的一个用于电池组。这会留下一个专用槽位：为往返安装扫描仪或提取器、在对接时交换角色，或现场部署两架无人机。中型和大型底盘之后会增加空间。

提取器包含一个 **25 吨密封舱**，一次只能容纳一种生命体类型。每个货舱只容纳一种材料：小型 100、中型 250、大型 500 单位，因此无人机携带的材料数量等于货舱数量。使用 `self.cargo.space_for(item_id)` 在出发前检查特定材料是否有空间。`get_component("journal").biomass_coords()` 是重启安全的已发现路线列表；每个样本暴露峰值 `.tons` 和当前 `.remaining_tons`。

## 枯竭与冷却

一次采集只会移除无人机能携带的数量。剩余储量会留在该地点，供下一次往返。只有在所有生命体都枯竭后，冷却才会开始。常见、少见和稀有地点使用逐渐更长的冷却时间，然后在同一永久坐标补充。使用 `journal = get_component("journal")`，然后 `journal.is_ready(x, y)` 和 `journal.next_ready_at(x, y)` 来安排轮换。

## 本地处理

无人机仓库的库存属于单个前哨站。在那里对接卸载，然后将样本送入**同一前哨站的精华液化器**。标本必须原产于该前哨站的生态区。液化器只生产该生态区的精华。

前哨站之间没有任何共享。用无人机转移生命体，并通过由端口、管道和储罐组成的物理液体网络转移精华。**生物质混合器**消耗所需的生态区精华并产出生物质吨。后期阶段需要更多不同种类的精华，因此推进过程会将本地站点和液化器链扩展到更多生态区，并将这些液体线路汇聚到混合器。

> 提取器舱室使基础采集车能够运作。货舱减少往返次数，但不能替代本地前哨站链条。

植物和野生动物是生物圈的下一支柱。

en:
**Plants** is an active crop chain. The field grows one-shot **Forage** harvests for Wildlife and industry. The **Plant Terraformer fleet** processes that physical stock in visible batches to create permanent Plants km². Nothing in the field increases km² by itself.

## 1. Discover and make seeds

At **500 t Biomass**, fabricate and deploy a **Seed Maker**. Each `combine(...)` trial consumes **1 t each of three different life forms**. A successful blend places one physical species seed in its result bay and records the recipe in the Flora journal. Repeat known blends whenever you want more seeds.

## 2. Plant and maintain the field

Send seeds to home Inventory. Call `load_seed(seed_id)` anywhere on the local grid to put one physical seed in the Harvester's held slot, move to an empty cell, and call `plant(seed_id)`. Sowing finishes after **0.5 hours**. Every species has visible requirements such as light, shade, water, salt, spacing, clusters, companions, or antagonists. Growth pauses safely while any requirement is missing.

**Beside means orthogonally adjacent: directly above, below, left, and right. Diagonals never count for plant relationships.** Every rule about neighbouring plants reads those four and only those four, so a **cluster** species needs a **2×2 block**, the smallest shape where all four cells have two of their own kind beside them. A row of three leaves both ends stalled forever.

A **Spacer** plant needs all four neighboring cells to be free of **other plants**. Machines, including Grow Lamps, Sprinklers, Dispensers, and Crop Automators, are allowed beside it. For example, a Sprinkler directly to its left does not block growth as long as the plant's other requirements are met. Diagonal plants are allowed, so Spacer plants can form a checkerboard.

**Companion** and **antagonist** read the same four cells. Fixed Grow Lamps, Sprinklers, and Dispensers also serve the four orthogonally adjacent cells (directly above, below, left, and right); diagonals do not count.

Each crop's Forage rises across its visible growth stages and freezes when ready. The Harvester can provide early manual light, water, and salt care for 24 hours per visit. Later, Grow Lamps, Sprinklers, and Dispensers maintain crop conditions while Crop Automators harvest, plant, and apply treatments. Hover any of these machines on the field to see its service area.

## 3. Build productive diversity

Each distinct supported species multiplies crop yield. One productive species gives **×1**, five give **×5**, ten give **×10**, and all fifteen give **×15**. Harder species also have larger base harvest values.

## 4. Grow Lamp and Sprinkler upgrades

Each upgrade pack improves one deployed provider. Both machines keep the same four-cell coverage: directly above, below, left, and right. Tiers increase Forage accumulated during growth; they do not change growth speed or add diagonal coverage.

| Tier | Forage factor on its own | Power per provider | Sprinkler Water use |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Mk I | ×1 | 5 W | 2 t/h |
| Mk II | ×2 | 25 W | 10 t/h |
| Mk III | ×4 | 100 W | 200 t/h |
| Mk IV | ×8 | 500 W | 1,000 t/h |

Power draw applies while enabled. A Sprinkler consumes Water while supplied, even with no crops beside it. The crop must require the provider's service: a Grow Lamp boosts light-requiring crops and a Sprinkler boosts water-requiring crops. All of the crop's other requirements must also be met. Providers must be powered, enabled, and supplied. The Dispenser stays at Mk I and supplies salt with no yield bonus.

Only the strongest covering provider for each required condition counts. Two sprinklers do not stack. Bonuses from different required services add above the ×1 baseline, with a **×12 cap on the combined provider factor**. For a crop requiring both light and water, a Mk II lamp plus a Mk II sprinkler gives **×3**: one baseline plus two +100% bonuses. A Mk IV lamp plus a Mk IV sprinkler reaches the **×12** cap.

## 5. Fertilizer, Growth Accelerant, and Yield Amplifier

Fertilizer Mk I, II, and III give **×2, ×3, and ×5** base Forage yield on their own for **8 hours per dose**. More of the same tier extends duration; wait for the active dose to expire before switching tiers. These field bonuses are separate from the **10, 30, and 50 potency** values used in Plant Terraformer recipes.

Growth Accelerant gives **×2 growth speed for 8 hours per dose**, reaching the same yield sooner while the crop's requirements are met. Fertilizer and Growth Accelerant time drains while the crop is immature, including while missing requirements stall it, and stops draining at maturity. Yield Amplifier gives **×3** base Forage yield on its own to growing crops across the whole field for **24 hours per dose**; its timer runs continuously. Additional doses extend duration.

Provider, Fertilizer, and Yield Amplifier bonuses add above the ×1 baseline. For example, a Mk II sprinkler (+100%), Mk III Fertilizer (+400%), and Yield Amplifier (+200%) give **×8**, before species diversity multiplies the result. This example requires a water-requiring crop with all its other conditions met. Bonuses apply only to Forage earned while they are active. Already banked Forage stays unchanged, and a mature crop gains no more until it is harvested and replaced.

## 6. Harvest and replant

A ready crop stays in its cell until explicitly harvested. The mobile Harvester works for **0.5 hours**. Each Crop Automator job works for **0.1 hours** at 100% outpost efficiency. Submitting a job returns immediately; one physical executor then processes up to 50 jobs total, counting its active and pending jobs, in strict FIFO order (first in, first out, so the oldest job runs first). It never runs two jobs at once or bypasses a blocked queue head on its own, and it pauses about **1 second** between jobs while its arm resets. A script can inspect the active and pending work, then use `move_job(job_id, position)` to implement another scheduling policy. Jobs whose targets no longer match fail immediately when they reach the executor and do not spend work time. The mobile Harvester transfers as much as Base Inventory can accept and leaves any remainder banked on the crop. A Crop Automator moves whatever fits in its local output, discards the remainder, and clears the cell. A completely full output blocks the job without changing the crop. Several automators can still work their separate service areas in parallel.

## 7. Run the Plant Terraformer fleet

At **2,000 t Biomass**, fabricate and deploy one or more **Plant Terraformers** at operational outposts. Connect each Terraformer's standard `input` to a local Crop Automator output, store, or home Inventory, then use `take(...)` or send from the source. Connect Water through `water_in`, then call `self.set_enabled(True)`. Item transfers use ordinary feeder cooldowns; the Terraformer handles **16 items per step** at Mk I and **80** at Mk II. Each machine commits the largest proportional loaded batch, performs **3 hours** of work, and delivers km². Mk I stops at **2,250,000 km²**; Mk II handles the final two bands.

> The complete flow is: discover seeds, load and plant, maintain conditions, diversify, harvest and clear, replant, then transfer Forage into the Terraformer.
zh:
**植物** 是一条主动作物链。田地种植一次性的 **牧草** 收获，用于野生动物和工业。**植物地球化改造机舰队** 以可见批次处理这些实体库存，以创造永久的植物 km²。田地中没有任何东西会自行增加 km²。

## 1. 发现并制作种子

在 **500 t 生物量** 时，制造并部署一台 **种子制造机**。每次 `combine(...)` 试验都会消耗 **三种不同生命形式各 1 t**。成功混合后，会在其结果舱中放入一枚实体物种种子，并在植物日志中记录配方。需要更多种子时，可重复已知混合。

## 2. 种植并维护田地

将种子发送到主库存。在本地网格任意位置调用 `load_seed(seed_id)`，将一枚实体种子放入采集车的持握槽，移动到空单元格，然后调用 `plant(seed_id)`。播种在 **0.5 小时** 后完成。每个物种都有可见需求，例如光照、遮阴、水、盐、间距、集群、伴生或拮抗。缺少任一需求时，生长会安全暂停。

**相邻指正交相邻：正上、正下、正左和正右。植物关系从不计算对角线。** 所有关于邻近植物的规则只读取这四个方向，且仅读取这四个方向，因此 **集群** 物种需要一个 **2×2 方块**，这是四个单元格都有两个同类相邻的最小形状。三个一排会让两端永远停滞。

**间隔** 植物需要四个相邻单元格都没有 **其他植物**。包括生长灯、洒水器、分配器和作物自动机在内的机器可以位于其相邻处。例如，只要满足该植物的其他需求，正左方的洒水器不会阻碍生长。允许对角线植物，因此间隔植物可以形成棋盘格。

**伴生** 和 **拮抗** 读取同样四个单元格。固定生长灯、洒水器和分配器也服务于正交相邻的四个单元格（正上、正下、正左和正右）；对角线不计。

每株作物的牧草会随可见生长阶段增加，并在成熟时冻结。采集车可在每次访问时提供 24 小时的早期手动光照、浇水和施盐照料。之后，生长灯、洒水器和分配器维持作物条件，而作物自动机负责收获、种植和施用处理。将鼠标悬停在田地中的任一机器上可查看其服务范围。

## 3. 建立生产多样性

每个不同的受支持物种都会倍增作物产量。一个有效物种提供 **×1**，五个提供 **×5**，十个提供 **×10**，全部十五个提供 **×15**。更难的物种也具有更大的基础收获值。

## 4. 生长灯与洒水器升级

每个升级包提升一台已部署的供应设备。两种机器保持相同的四格覆盖范围：正上、正下、正左和正右。等级提升生长期间积累的牧草；不会改变生长速度或增加对角线覆盖。

| 等级 | 自身牧草系数 | 每个供应设备功率 | 洒水器用水 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Mk I | ×1 | 5 W | 2 t/h |
| Mk II | ×2 | 25 W | 10 t/h |
| Mk III | ×4 | 100 W | 200 t/h |
| Mk IV | ×8 | 500 W | 1,000 t/h |

功率消耗在启用时生效。洒水器在供水时会消耗水，即使旁边没有作物。作物必须需要供应设备的服务：生长灯提升需要光照的作物，洒水器提升需要水的作物。还必须满足作物的所有其他需求。供应设备必须通电、启用并得到供给。分配器保持 Mk I，提供盐但没有产量加成。

对于每项所需条件，只有覆盖该条件的最强供应设备生效。两个洒水器不会叠加。来自不同所需服务的加成在 ×1 基线之上相加，合并供应设备系数上限为 **×12**。对于同时需要光照和水的作物，Mk II 灯加上 Mk II 洒水器提供 **×3**：一个基线加两个 +100% 加成。Mk IV 灯加上 Mk IV 洒水器达到 **×12** 上限。

## 5. 肥料、生长加速剂与产量增幅器

肥料 Mk I、II 和 III 自身提供 **×2、×3 和 ×5** 的基础牧草产量，每剂持续 **8 小时**。更多同等级剂量延长持续时间；切换等级前需等待当前剂量过期。这些田地加成与植物地球化改造机配方中使用的 **10、30 和 50 效力** 数值分开。

生长加速剂每剂提供 **×2 生长速度，持续 8 小时**，在满足作物需求时更快达到相同产量。肥料和生长加速剂的时间在作物未成熟时消耗，包括因缺少需求而停滞时，成熟后停止消耗。产量增幅器自身为整块田地中生长中的作物提供 **×3** 基础牧草产量，每剂持续 **24 小时**；其计时器持续运行。额外剂量延长持续时间。

供应设备、肥料和产量增幅器加成在 ×1 基线之上相加。例如，Mk II 洒水器（+100%）、Mk III 肥料（+400%）和产量增幅器（+200%）提供 **×8**，然后物种多样性再乘算结果。此示例需要一种需水作物，并且其所有其他条件都满足。加成仅适用于其生效期间获得的牧草。已存入的牧草保持不变，成熟作物在收获并替换前不会继续增加。

## 6. 收获与重新种植

成熟作物会留在其单元格中，直到被明确收获。移动采集车工作 **0.5 小时**。在 100% 前哨站效率下，每个作物自动机作业工作 **0.1 小时**。提交作业会立即返回；随后一个物理执行器按严格 FIFO 顺序（先进先出，因此最早作业先运行）处理最多 50 个作业，包括其活动作业和待处理作业。它绝不会同时运行两个作业，也不会自行绕过被阻塞的队首，并在作业之间暂停约 **1 秒** 以重置机械臂。脚本可以检查活动与待处理工作，然后使用 `move_job(job_id, position)` 实现另一种调度策略。目标不再匹配的作业在到达执行器时会立即失败，且不消耗工作时间。移动采集车转移基础库存可接受的最大数量，并将任何剩余量存入作物中。作物自动机移动其本地输出可容纳的数量，丢弃剩余量，并清除该单元格。完全满的输出会阻塞作业，且不改变作物。多个自动机仍可在各自的服务区域并行工作。

## 7. 运行植物地球化改造机舰队

在 **2,000 t 生物量** 时，在运营中的前哨站制造并部署一台或多台 **植物地球化改造机**。将每台改造机的标准 `input` 连接到本地作物自动机输出、仓库或主库存，然后使用 `take(...)` 或从源头发送。通过 `water_in` 连接水，然后调用 `self.set_enabled(True)`。物品传输使用普通供料器冷却；Mk I 改造机每步处理 **16 个物品**，Mk II 为 **80**。每台机器提交最大比例装载批次，执行 **3 小时** 工作，并交付 km²。Mk I 在 **2,250,000 km²** 处停止；Mk II 处理最后两个区段。

> 完整流程是：发现种子、装载并种植、维持条件、多样化、收获并清理、重新种植，然后将牧草传输到改造机中。

en:
The **Plant Terraformer** is the only machine that raises permanent Plants km². Deploy as many as you can feed across operational outposts. Every supplied machine adds its tier rate multiplied by that outpost's live efficiency.

## Input and cycles

After Auto Feeders research, connect `self.input` to home Inventory, a local Storage Bin or Warehouse, or a local machine output such as a Crop Automator. Use `self.input.take(item_id, count)`, or send from the source's output. This is the same timed item-transfer model used by other machines: both endpoints stay occupied for the transfer duration. The input has one source connection at a time, so scripts may reconnect it when changing sources.

The Terraformer's destination feeder handles **16 items per handling step** at Mk I and **80** at Mk II, regardless of whether the source pushes or the Terraformer pulls. **Fast Feeders** unlocks at **400,000 Terraform Points** and halves the duration of all newly started timed item transfers. A full Forage load therefore takes about **18.8 seconds** at Mk I and **20.6 seconds** at Mk II before that research, or **9.4** and **10.3 seconds** afterward, when the source is free. Direct Crop Automator to Terraformer transport avoids the extra Warehouse leg; Warehouses remain useful player-controlled staging.

The existing holders fit one full Forage batch, the Salt that batch needs, and up to **10 each** of Fertilizer Mk I, Mk II, Mk III, and Growth Accelerant. There is no separate intake buffer. When a cycle can start, the machine commits the largest whole Forage batch supported by every loaded material. For example, 10 Forage with Water for 8 loads a batch of 8. If any required material cannot support one Forage, the machine waits.

All selected items and matching Water are consumed exactly once when the cycle starts. The batch then performs **3 hours** of work at 100% outpost efficiency and delivers its km² in one step. Power loss or `set_enabled(False)` pauses the batch in place. When a cycle finishes, the next affordable loaded batch starts immediately.

## Tiers and fleet cost

At 100% outpost efficiency, Mk I loads up to **1,200 Forage**, averages **400 Forage/h**, and draws **180 W** while enabled. It handles the first three conversions, then reports `"needs_mk2"` at **2,250,000 km²**. Mk II loads up to **6,600 Forage**, averages **2,200 Forage/h**, draws **900 W**, and adds the Fertilizer and Growth Accelerant injectors. Each machine needs its own fabricated Mk II pack.

## Cumulative material ladder

| Progress | km² per Forage | Band Forage | Added support |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 0 to 500,000 km² | 20 | 25,000 | none |
| 500,000 to 1,250,000 km² | 5 | 150,000 | 0.05 t Water |
| 1,250,000 to 2,250,000 km² | 5 / 3 | 600,000 | 0.002 Salt |
| 2,250,000 to 3,500,000 km² | 1 | 1,250,000 | 0.004 Fertilizer potency, Mk II |
| 3,500,000 to 5,000,000 km² | 1 / 3 | 4,500,000 | 0.0001 Growth Accelerant, Mk II |

Fertilizer Mk I supplies **10 potency**, Mk II supplies **30**, and Mk III supplies **50**. Each cycle spends stored potency first. To cover a shortfall, the machine consumes a whole-item combination with the least excess potency, then the fewest items. Unused potency stays in the machine for later batches and survives save/load. One Mk III item leaves **23 potency** after a **27-potency** batch. The card includes stored potency in its total; item counts show only unopened items. A full Mk II batch asks for **27 potency**. Growth Accelerant is counted and consumed as whole items; a full Mk II batch asks for **1**.

## Script control

```
self.input.connect("crop_automator_1")
self.water_in.connect("Water Reservoir")
self.set_enabled(True)

while True:
  result = self.input.take("forage", self.batch_requirements()["forage"])
  print(result.status, self.status(), self.batch_size())
  sleep(1)
```

Salt is consumed as whole items, **1 per 500 Forage rounded up per batch**. A full Mk I cycle consumes **3 Salt**; a full Mk II cycle consumes **14 Salt**. Unused treatment value does not carry over.

`batch_requirements()` reports Fertilizer as `fertilizer_potency` and Growth Accelerant as an item count. Use `fertilizer_potency(item_id)` to inspect a Fertilizer tier. Item transfers are local to the Terraformer's outpost. Water uses the dedicated `water_in` relationship and, for remote sources, a compatible completed Liquid Pipe route.
zh:
The **植物地球化机**是唯一提升永久植物 km² 的机器。在所有运行中的前哨站部署尽可能多的、你能供料的机器。每台获得供料的机器都会增加其等级速率乘以该前哨站的实时效率。

## 输入与周期

完成自动供料研究后，将 `self.input` 连接到主库存、本地储物箱或仓库，或连接到本地机器输出，例如作物自动化机。使用 `self.input.take(item_id, count)`，或从来源的输出发送。这与其他机器使用的定时物品转移模型相同：在转移期间，两个端点都会保持占用。输入一次只连接一个来源，因此脚本在更换来源时可以重新连接它。

地球化机的目标供料器在 Mk I 每次处理步骤处理 **16 个物品**，Mk II 为 **80 个**，无论来源是推送还是地球化机拉取。**快速供料**在 **400,000 地球化点数**解锁，并将所有新启动的定时物品转移的持续时间减半。因此，在该研究之前，满载草料在 Mk I 约需 **18.8 秒**，Mk II 约需 **20.6 秒**；研究之后，在来源空闲时分别约需 **9.4 秒**和 **10.3 秒**。直接从作物自动化机运输到地球化机可避免额外的仓库中转；仓库仍是实用的玩家控制中转站。

现有料仓可容纳一整批草料、该批所需的盐，以及 Mk I、Mk II、Mk III 肥料和生长加速剂各最多 **10 个**。没有单独的进料缓冲。当可以启动一个周期时，机器会锁定所有已装载材料都能支持的最大完整草料批次。例如，10 份草料搭配的水仅够 8 次装载时，批次为 8。如果任何所需材料无法支持一份草料，机器会等待。

周期开始时，所有选定物品和相应的水会被精确消耗一次。随后，该批次会以 100% 前哨站效率工作 **3 小时**，并一次性交付其 km²。断电或 `set_enabled(False)` 会就地暂停该批次。周期结束后，下一个可负担的已装载批次会立即开始。

## 等级与机群成本

在 100% 前哨站效率下，Mk I 最多装载 **1,200 份草料**，平均 **400 份草料/小时**，启用时耗电 **180 W**。它处理前三种转化，然后在 **2,250,000 km²** 时报告 `"needs_mk2"`。Mk II 最多装载 **6,600 份草料**，平均 **2,200 份草料/小时**，耗电 **900 W**，并增加肥料和生长加速剂注入器。每台机器都需要各自制造的 Mk II 组件包。

## 累计材料阶梯

| 进度 | 每单位草料的 km² | 区间草料 | 新增支持 |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| 0 至 500,000 km² | 20 | 25,000 | 无 |
| 500,000 至 1,250,000 km² | 5 | 150,000 | 0.05 t 水 |
| 1,250,000 至 2,250,000 km² | 5 / 3 | 600,000 | 0.002 盐 |
| 2,250,000 至 3,500,000 km² | 1 | 1,250,000 | 0.004 肥料效力，Mk II |
| 3,500,000 至 5,000,000 km² | 1 / 3 | 4,500,000 | 0.0001 生长加速剂，Mk II |

Mk I 肥料提供 **10 效力**，Mk II 提供 **30**，Mk III 提供 **50**。每个周期会先消耗已储存的效力。为弥补缺口，机器会消耗过量效力最少、物品数量最少的完整物品组合。未使用的效力会留在机器中供后续批次使用，并可在存档/读档后保留。一个 **27 效力**批次后，一个 Mk III 物品会留下 **23 效力**。卡片会将已储存的效力计入总量；物品数量仅显示未开启的物品。完整 Mk II 批次需要 **27 效力**。生长加速剂按完整物品计数和消耗；完整 Mk II 批次需要 **1** 个。

## 脚本控制

```
self.input.connect("crop_automator_1")
self.water_in.connect("Water Reservoir")
self.set_enabled(True)

while True:
  result = self.input.take("forage", self.batch_requirements()["forage"])
  print(result.status, self.status(), self.batch_size())
  sleep(1)
```

盐按完整物品消耗，**每批按每 500 份草料向上取整 1 个**。完整 Mk I 周期消耗 **3 个盐**；完整 Mk II 周期消耗 **14 个盐**。未使用的处理值不会结转。

`batch_requirements()` 将肥料报告为 `fertilizer_potency`，将生长加速剂报告为物品数量。使用 `fertilizer_potency(item_id)` 查看肥料等级。物品转移仅限于地球化机所在前哨站。水使用专用的 `water_in` 关系；对于远程来源，则需要一条兼容且已建成的液体管道路线。

en:
Weather is a timed resource system operated through Weather Stations and drones. Active storms are visible on Weather and the Planet Map, but an aftermath coordinate must be recovered from live transmissions.

## Storm lifecycle

Dust storms and thunderstorms move across the planet and may overlap. Heat and Pressure increase intensity, reward yield, and lightning energy; they do not make storms occur more often.

A storm's transmissions become audible when it starts and remain available until **4 world-clock hours after it ends**. Its aftermath appears only when the storm ends:

- A dust storm leaves **14-28 Raw Uranium** for **48 world-clock hours**.
- An eligible thunderstorm leaves **2-4 Storm Glass** for **96 world-clock hours**. A thunderstorm without an aftermath transmits no Storm Glass message.

The reward remains hidden until a drone reaches its exact coordinate. A nearby or expired location returns `nothing_here` and gives no directional hint.

## Build reception coverage

Weather Program installs one completed Weather Station at Nocturna Base. Each powered station draws **50 W**, monitors a **300 m** local radius, and receives broadcast traffic plus the dust channel for its own biome. Additional stations are deployed at outposts.

Dust movement records are divided among all five biome channels, so a complete dust message requires powered reception in every biome. Thunder movement records are broadcast, so one powered station can hear a complete Storm Glass message.

## Recover the coordinate

`signal_receiver.transmissions()` returns only records audible to that station now. It stores no history, several events may be present at once, and corrupted copies may declare the same packet number as a valid record. Player code must retain what it needs before reception closes.

Records with the same `event_id` belong to one event. Each record declares its `number`, expected `total`, encoded `data`, and `checksum`. The data format is `event_id|number|total|dx|dy`. A valid checksum equals the full sum of the ASCII code of every character in `data`, with no modulo reduction.

A complete valid numbered set describes movement from `(0, 0)`. Apply its `dx` and `dy` records in number order; the endpoint is the exact aftermath coordinate. DOCS entries for **SignalTransmission** define every field. Player code decides how to retain records, share them between stations, and track incomplete events.

## Collect the aftermath

After the storm ends, send a drone with cargo space to the recovered coordinate and call `collect()`. One successful collection transfers at most **5 units**, so a larger aftermath may need repeated collections or more than one trip. Raw Uranium adds exposure unless the drone has Shield Plating; Storm Glass is not radioactive. A discovered live aftermath then appears on the maps until it is exhausted or expires.

## What each surface does

- **Incoming** automatically summarizes storms expected to enter powered-station coverage. It does not require `observe()` and never reveals an aftermath.
- `observe()` measures local active storms and forecasts. `last_report()` reads that station's latest report.
- `signal_receiver` supplies the raw records used for aftermath recovery.
- `signal_board` is an optional per-station display. It presents only records and labelled values published by player code; it does not validate, merge, store, or decode them.
- `strikes()` provides bounded local lightning history. Lightning Rod capture works independently of Weather Station scripts.

The required process is reception, retention, validation, assembly, coordinate recovery, and collection. The storage, coordination, presentation, and dispatch program remain yours to design.
zh:
天气是通过气象站和无人机运作的限时资源系统。活跃风暴可在天气界面和行星地图上看到，但余波坐标必须从实时传输中恢复。

## 风暴生命周期

沙尘暴和雷暴在星球上移动，并可能重叠。热量与压力会提高强度、奖励产出和闪电能量；它们不会让风暴更频繁发生。

风暴的传输在开始时变得可听，并持续可用直到 **结束后 4 个世界时钟小时**。其余波仅在风暴结束时出现：

- 沙尘暴会留下 **14-28 原始铀**，持续 **48 世界时钟小时**。
- 符合条件的雷暴会留下 **2-4 风暴玻璃**，持续 **96 世界时钟小时**。没有余波的雷暴不会传输风暴玻璃消息。

奖励会保持隐藏，直到无人机到达其精确坐标。在附近或已过期的位置会返回 `nothing_here`，且不提供方向提示。

## 建立接收覆盖

气象计划在诺克图纳星基地安装一座已建成的气象站。每座通电的气象站消耗 **50 W**，监控 **300 m** 的本地半径，并接收广播流量以及其所在生物群系的沙尘频道。其他气象站部署在前哨站。

沙尘移动记录分布在全部五个生物群系频道中，因此一条完整的沙尘消息需要每个生物群系都有通电接收。雷暴移动记录是广播的，因此一座通电气象站即可听到完整的风暴玻璃消息。

## 恢复坐标

`signal_receiver.transmissions()` 只返回该气象站当前可听到的记录。它不存储历史，可能同时存在多个事件，并且损坏的副本可能将同一个包号声明为有效记录。玩家代码必须在接收关闭前保留所需内容。

具有相同 `event_id` 的记录属于同一事件。每条记录声明其 `number`、预期的 `total`、编码后的 `data` 和 `checksum`。数据格式为 `event_id|number|total|dx|dy`。有效校验和等于 `data` 中每个字符 ASCII 码的总和，不进行取模缩减。

一套完整且有效的编号记录描述从 `(0, 0)` 开始的移动。按 `number` 顺序应用其 `dx` 和 `dy` 记录；终点即为精确的余波坐标。**SignalTransmission** 的 DOCS 条目定义了每个字段。玩家代码决定如何保留记录、在气象站之间共享它们，以及跟踪不完整的事件。

## 收集余波

风暴结束后，派遣一架有货物空间的无人机前往恢复的坐标并调用 `collect()`。一次成功收集最多转移 **5 单位**，因此较大的余波可能需要重复收集或多次往返。原始铀会增加暴露，除非无人机装有护盾镀层；风暴玻璃没有放射性。已发现的活跃余波随后会显示在地图上，直到被耗尽或过期。

## 每个界面的作用

- **传入** 会自动汇总预计进入通电气象站覆盖范围的风暴。它不需要 `observe()`，也不会揭示余波。
- `observe()` 测量本地活跃风暴和预报。`last_report()` 读取该气象站的最新报告。
- `signal_receiver` 提供用于恢复余波的原始记录。
- `signal_board` 是可选的每座气象站显示面板。它只呈现玩家代码发布的记录和带标签的值；它不会验证、合并、存储或解码它们。
- `strikes()` 提供有界的本地闪电历史。避雷针捕获独立于气象站脚本运行。

必要流程包括接收、保留、验证、组装、坐标恢复和收集。存储、协调、展示和派遣程序仍由你设计。

en:
**Wildlife** counts established species colonies currently attached to deployed Habitats. A powered-off Habitat still counts its housed population but pauses growth.

## End-to-end loop

1. Catalog all 5 fragments of a creature and unlock its feed recipe through its Bio Order.
2. Select it with `self.set_revival_target(creature_id)`. This exposes that creature's two-node tree before revival.
3. Stage the exact species feed and rarity-scaled Biology reagents shown by the Habitat or Journal. Creature bonuses never change this one-time reagent recipe.
4. Call `self.revive()`, keep every active need healthy through rearing, then regulate later gas and liquid ranges as the colony advances.
5. Each completed breeding cycle normally adds **1 individual**. Brood bonuses build toward guaranteed extra offspring across breeding cycles. Other nodes can accelerate a part of the population curve, reward uninterrupted support, reduce feed demand, widen fluid bands, retain a base fluid, or improve the founding population.
6. Positive population change automatically produces shared **Insight**. Static population and elapsed time produce none. Use `unlock_bonus(node_id)` for the real spending decision; there is no purchase control outside code.
7. At **600,000 Wildlife**, fabricate Habitat Mk II packs. Mk I stops at **175,000**, the top of Thriving. Mk II raises the ceiling to **350,000**, allowing the colony to enter and complete Abundant without changing any breeding statistic.

One Habitat houses one species, with no Wildlife-specific limit on how many Habitats an outpost may hold. Habitats follow the ordinary outpost overcrowding rules, so concentrating them is allowed while distributing them can improve throughput. The species owns its colony progress; the enclosure is replaceable. Undeploying an established colony's Habitat preserves population, life stage, brood progress, Insight history, and bonuses, while pausing growth and removing that colony from active Wildlife and species-breadth bonuses. Call `self.rehouse(creature_id)` from an empty Habitat whose current capacity fits the whole colony, or use the same call to transfer it directly from another Habitat. Fifteen full Mk II species reach **5,250,000** Wildlife while fourteen reach **4,900,000**. All 16 full Mk II species generate **112 Insight** against **80 Insight** needed for every node, leaving 32 spare. Feed, gas, and liquid are consumed only for individuals actually produced; a capped colony idles.
zh:
**野生动物**统计当前附着于已部署栖息地的已建立物种群落。断电的栖息地仍会计入其容纳的种群数量，但会暂停增长。

## 端到端循环

1. 编录某种生物的 5 个碎片，并通过其生物订单解锁其饲料配方。
2. 使用 `self.set_revival_target(creature_id)` 选择它。这会在复活前展示该生物的两节点树。
3. 备好栖息地或日志所示的精确物种饲料与按稀有度缩放的生物学试剂。生物加成不会改变这个一次性试剂配方。
4. 调用 `self.revive()`，在养育期间保持所有当前需求处于健康状态，然后随着群落推进调节后续的气体与液体区间。
5. 每个完成的繁殖周期通常增加 **1 个个体**。育雏加成会在多个繁殖周期中累积，以确保额外后代。其他节点可以加速部分种群曲线，奖励不间断支持，降低饲料需求，拓宽流体区间，保留一种基础流体，或改善初始种群。
6. 正向种群变化会自动产生共享**洞见**。种群不变与时间流逝不会产生洞见。使用 `unlock_bonus(node_id)` 进行真正的支出决策；代码外没有购买控制。
7. 在 **600,000 野生动物**时，制造栖息地 Mk II 套件。Mk I 止步于 **175,000**，即繁盛阶段的上限。Mk II 将上限提高到 **350,000**，使群落能够进入并完成丰饶阶段，而无需改变任何繁殖统计。

一个栖息地容纳一个物种，且前哨站可容纳的栖息地数量没有野生动物专属限制。栖息地遵循普通前哨站拥挤规则，因此允许集中部署，而分散部署可提升吞吐量。物种拥有其群落进度；容纳设施可替换。回收已建立群落的栖息地会保留种群、生命阶段、育雏进度、洞见历史与加成，但会暂停增长，并使该群落不再计入活跃野生动物与物种广度加成。从当前容量足以容纳整个群落的空栖息地调用 `self.rehouse(creature_id)`，或使用同一调用直接从另一个栖息地转移。十五个满级 Mk II 物种达到 **5,250,000 野生动物**，而十四种达到 **4,900,000**。全部 16 个满级 Mk II 物种会产生 **112 洞见**，而每个节点需要 **80 洞见**，剩余 32。饲料、气体和液体仅被实际产生的个体消耗；达到上限的群体会闲置。
野生动物、补给（气体与液体）

en:
The harder a colony climbs, the rarer the gas and liquid it demands. Exotic fluids come from a **prospect → capture → refine → meter** chain. Common fluids skip the Refiner; uncommon and rare fluids use raw feedstock plus tar.

## Fluids by rarity

Four gases and three liquids appear in Habitat requirements:

- **Common (tap and use directly):** `swamp_gas`, `ammonia` (gases); `brine` (liquid).
- **Uncommon (raw → Refiner + tar):** `sulfur_gas` (gas); `cryofluid` (liquid).
- **Rare (raw → Refiner + heavy tar):** `chlorine` (gas); `quicksilver` (liquid).

Uncommon and rare exotics have a **raw** deposit form (`raw_sulfur_gas`, `raw_cryofluid`, `raw_chlorine`, `raw_quicksilver`) and a **refined** Habitat-ready form. Most colonies never need the rare pair `chlorine` + `quicksilver`, so demand for those deposits stays low.

## 1. Prospect

Exotic deposits follow the same model as thermal vents:

- discover and **survey by sonar** (basic = active?, wide = rate, deep = cycle timing),
- collect with a **cap** (gas vents) or **tap** (liquid springs),
- pipe the output into gas or liquid storage.

Deposits alternate active and dormant phases. Stockpile during the active phase, then feed Habitats from tanks during dormancy. Deep-sonar timing lets you predict dormant phases and size the buffer first. Deposits do not deplete; multiple deposits help cover each other's dormant gaps.

## 2. Refine (uncommon / rare only)

Raw feedstock is not ready for Habitats. The **Refiner** converts `raw feedstock + tar → refined exotic` via a recipe (unlocked through Biolab orders). Pick the exotic with `self.set_recipe(...)`; wire raw feedstock into `gas_in` / `liquid_in`, tar into `self.input`, and the refined product out of `gas_out` / `liquid_out`.

### Tar, the refining reagent

Refining eats **tar** alongside the raw feedstock. Tar is an oil-refining byproduct that otherwise mostly goes to the Waste Processor. Tar cost scales with rarity:

- **Common**, no tar (tapped direct, no Refiner).
- **Uncommon**, moderate tar.
- **Rare (Chlorine / Quicksilver)**, heavy tar.

Tar is a running cost on the liquid pipe network carrying oil, not a hard gate. If you run short, expand oil production or slow the Habitat intake until the Refiner catches up.

## 3. Meter

The refined gas/liquid flows into a Gas/Liquid Tank. Your Habitat script meters it in with `self.set_gas_intake(...)` / `self.set_liquid_intake(...)` to hold the band. See the **Husbandry** page.

## When each step matters

A freshly-founded colony needs only **feed**. Mid-stage colonies add a **basic gas/liquid**. Thriving colonies can demand **rare refined exotics**, which pushes you into farther prospecting and heavier refining. Research **Exotic Husbandry** unlocks survey/cap/tap + Refiner for uncommon exotics. **Deep Exotics** unlocks at **500,000 Wildlife** and opens the rarest extraction and refining. An early legendary colony may pause at its rare-fluid transition until the broader menagerie reaches that total; this is recoverable and costs no population. Read the Habitat's exact next-stage methods and grow other species while preparing the rare supply.
zh:
族群越是发展，所需气体和液体就越稀有。奇异流体来自一条 **勘探 → 捕获 → 精炼 → 计量** 链。普通流体跳过精炼厂；罕见和稀有流体使用原料加焦油。

## 流体稀有度

栖息地需求中会出现四种气体和三种液体：

- **普通（抽取后直接使用）：** `swamp_gas`、`ammonia`（气体）；`brine`（液体）。
- **罕见（原料 → 精炼厂 + 焦油）：** `sulfur_gas`（气体）；`cryofluid`（液体）。
- **稀有（原料 → 精炼厂 + 大量焦油）：** `chlorine`（气体）；`quicksilver`（液体）。

罕见和稀有奇异流体既有 **原料** 矿藏形态（`raw_sulfur_gas`、`raw_cryofluid`、`raw_chlorine`、`raw_quicksilver`），也有 **精炼** 后可供栖息地使用的形态。大多数族群永远不需要稀有组合 `chlorine` + `quicksilver`，因此对这些矿藏的需求会保持低位。

## 1. 勘探

奇异矿藏遵循与热泉口相同的模型：

- 发现并 **通过声呐勘测**（基础 = 活跃？，广角 = 速率，深层 = 周期计时），
- 使用 **集气罩**（气体喷口）或 **抽取口**（液体泉眼）采集，
- 将输出接入气体或液体存储。

矿藏会在活跃与休眠阶段之间交替。在活跃阶段囤积，然后在休眠阶段从储罐供给栖息地。深层声呐计时可让你预测休眠阶段，并提前确定缓冲规模。矿藏不会耗尽；多个矿藏可以互相弥补休眠缺口。

## 2. 精炼（仅限罕见 / 稀有）

原料尚未适合栖息地使用。**精炼厂** 通过配方（通过生物实验室订单解锁）将 `raw feedstock + tar → refined exotic` 转化为精炼奇异流体。使用 `self.set_recipe(...)` 选择奇异流体；将原料接入 `gas_in` / `liquid_in`，将焦油接入 `self.input`，并从 `gas_out` / `liquid_out` 输出精炼产物。

### 焦油，精炼试剂

精炼会随原料一起消耗 **焦油**。焦油是石油精炼的副产品，否则大多送往废物处理器。焦油成本随稀有度增长：

- **普通**，无焦油（直接抽取，无精炼厂）。
- **罕见**，中等焦油。
- **稀有（氯 / 水银）**，大量焦油。

焦油是输送石油的液体管网上的持续成本，而不是硬性门槛。如果短缺，扩大石油生产或降低栖息地输入，直到精炼厂追上。

## 3. 计量

精炼后的气体/液体流入气体/液体储罐。你的栖息地脚本使用 `self.set_gas_intake(...)` / `self.set_liquid_intake(...)` 计量输入，以保持区间。参见 **饲养** 页面。

## 各步骤何时重要

刚建立的族群只需要 **饲料**。中期族群会增加一种 **基础气体/液体**。繁荣的族群可能要求 **稀有精炼奇异流体**，这会推动你进行更远的勘探和更重的精炼。研究 **奇异饲养** 可解锁罕见奇异流体的勘测/集气罩/抽取口 + 精炼厂。**深层奇异** 在 **500,000 野生动物** 时解锁，并开启最稀有的采集与精炼。早期传奇族群可能会在稀有流体过渡阶段暂停，直到更广泛的动物群达到该总量；这是可恢复的，并且不会损失数量。阅读栖息地确切的下一阶段方法，并在准备稀有供应的同时培育其他物种。

en:
Husbandry means keeping every active life-support input ready. The worst active input sets `breeding_efficiency()`, a life-support multiplier rather than the population growth rate. Established populations never decay.

## Revival setup check

Call `set_revival_target(creature_id)` first and branch on its `ActionResult`. It checks the creature, catalog, and one-colony-per-species rule, then saves the target without spending materials. Stage at least **2** correct feed units and every rarity-scaled Biology reagent in the dedicated `reagents` input. Then call parameterless `revive()` and branch on `.status` (`"ok"`, `"occupied"`, `"no_target"`, `"species_exists"`, `"not_cataloged"`, `"wrong_feed"`, `"insufficient_feed"`, or `"insufficient_reagents"`). Any rejected result spends nothing and keeps the target selected. Once revival starts, every active input must stay healthy for **12 world hours** of rearing.

## Relocate an established colony

The colony belongs to its species, not its enclosure. Undeploying an established colony's Habitat leaves that colony awaiting housing while its population, life stage, brood progress, Insight history, and bonuses remain intact. Its Wildlife and species-breadth contributions pause until it is rehoused. From an empty Habitat, call `result = self.rehouse(creature_id)` and branch on the returned `ActionResult`. The same call can transfer a colony directly from another deployed Habitat. The destination's current capacity must fit the whole colony; `"insufficient_capacity"` moves nothing.

## Feed is automatic

`feed_ok()` is true when the input bin holds the creature's exact feed. Revival spends one feed and leaves one for rearing. Established colonies consume feed only when individuals are actually born; a full colony idles without consuming it. `feed_level()` reports usable feed after partial consumption, so scripts can restock from local storage without guessing.

## Gas and liquid are two-sided bands

`gas_band()` and `liquid_band()` return `[low, high]` in tons when active, or `[]` before that input opens. Too little and too much both reduce efficiency. The fluid identity must also match: compare `gas_fluid()` with `required_gas()` and the liquid equivalents. Cutting intake lets an overfilled enclosure bleed back down. For a large excess, explicitly empty that reserve with `purge_reserve("gas")` or `purge_reserve("liquid")`, then refill it correctly. The discarded fluid is lost, while the colony and its other supplies stay intact.

## Complete regulator pattern

```
def regulate_fluid(band, level, set_intake):
  if len(band) == 0:
    set_intake(0)
  elif level < band[0]:
    set_intake(5)
  elif level > band[1]:
    set_intake(0)
  else:
    set_intake(1)

while True:
  regulate_fluid(self.gas_band(), self.gas_level(), self.set_gas_intake)
  regulate_fluid(self.liquid_band(), self.liquid_level(), self.set_liquid_intake)

  if not self.feed_ok():
    print("Feed missing or wrong; need " + self.required_feed())
  if self.gas_band() and self.gas_fluid() != self.required_gas():
    print("Wrong gas, need " + self.required_gas())
  if self.liquid_band() and self.liquid_fluid() != self.required_liquid():
    print("Wrong liquid, need " + self.required_liquid())

  print("efficiency", self.breeding_efficiency())
  sleep(1)
```

Connect and stock the Habitat's feed and dedicated `reagents` inputs from local storage. Connect the gas and liquid ports to tanks containing the exact required exotic. Fluid intake setters change policy immediately, but the buffer and efficiency change only after simulation advances and material arrives.

## Read the transition before it happens

`next_stage_population()` gives the exact threshold and `next_requirement()` names the kind of change. For the actual supply plan, `next_required_gas()` and `next_required_liquid()` name the fluids that will be required immediately after the transition. `next_gas_band()` and `next_liquid_band()` return their exact future `[low, high]` windows. Empty strings or lists mean that input will not be active. This makes prospecting, refining, piping, and regulator tuning possible before the crossing.

## Recovery

A failed rearing attempt costs the staged materials but never the Habitat. Fix the supply or the script, then retry `revive()`.

For excess gas already inside the enclosure, stop intake and explicitly discard that reserve:

```
self.set_gas_intake(0)
result = self.purge_reserve("gas")
print(result.status, result.message)
```

Then refill with the required gas and resume regulation. For liquid, use `set_liquid_intake(0)` and `purge_reserve("liquid")`. Each purge destroys only the chosen enclosure reserve and clears its fluid identity. It preserves the other reserve, feed, colony progress, inlet buffers, connections, and intake settings. `purge_intake("gas_in")` or `purge_intake("liquid_in")` remains the separate tool for clearing an inlet that holds the wrong fluid.
zh:
饲养管理意味着让每个启用中的生命维持输入都保持就绪。最差的启用输入会设定 `breeding_efficiency()`，这是一个生命维持倍率，而不是种群增长率。已建立的种群永远不会衰退。

## 复活准备检查

先调用 `set_revival_target(creature_id)`，并根据其 `ActionResult` 分支。它会检查生物、图鉴，以及每种生物只允许一个种群规则，然后在不消耗材料的情况下保存目标。在专用的 `reagents` 输入中预先放置至少 **2** 份正确饲料单位，以及每种按稀有度缩放所需的生物试剂。然后调用无参数的 `revive()`，并根据 `.status`（`"ok"`、`"occupied"`、`"no_target"`、`"species_exists"`、`"not_cataloged"`、`"wrong_feed"`、`"insufficient_feed"` 或 `"insufficient_reagents"`）分支。任何被拒绝的结果都不会消耗任何材料，并保持目标处于选中状态。一旦复活开始，每个启用中的输入都必须在 **12 世界小时** 的养育期间保持健康。

## 迁移已建立的种群

种群属于其物种，而不是其围栏。回收已建立种群所在的栖息地会让该种群等待安置，同时其数量、生命阶段、繁殖进度、洞见历史和加成保持不变。它的野生动物与物种广度贡献会暂停，直到它被重新安置。从一个空栖息地调用 `result = self.rehouse(creature_id)`，并根据返回的 `ActionResult` 分支。同一个调用也可以直接把种群从另一个已部署的栖息地转移过来。目的地的当前容量必须能容纳整个种群；`"insufficient_capacity"` 不会移动任何东西。

## 饲料自动消耗

当输入料仓中装有该生物所需的精确饲料时，`feed_ok()` 为真。复活会消耗一份饲料，并留下一份用于养育。已建立种群只在个体实际出生时消耗饲料；满员种群会闲置而不消耗它。`feed_level()` 会报告部分消耗后的可用饲料，因此脚本可以从本地存储补货而无需猜测。

## 气体与液体是双边区间

`gas_band()` 和 `liquid_band()` 在启用时返回以吨为单位的 `[low, high]`，在该输入开启前返回 `[]`。太少和太多都会降低效率。流体身份也必须匹配：比较 `gas_fluid()` 与 `required_gas()`，以及液体对应项。切断输入可让过量围栏自行回落。对于大量过量，使用 `purge_reserve("gas")` 或 `purge_reserve("liquid")` 明确清空该储备，然后正确重新补充。被丢弃的流体会损失掉，而种群及其其他补给保持不变。

## 完整调节器模式

```
def regulate_fluid(band, level, set_intake):
  if len(band) == 0:
    set_intake(0)
  elif level < band[0]:
    set_intake(5)
  elif level > band[1]:
    set_intake(0)
  else:
    set_intake(1)

while True:
  regulate_fluid(self.gas_band(), self.gas_level(), self.set_gas_intake)
  regulate_fluid(self.liquid_band(), self.liquid_level(), self.set_liquid_intake)

  if not self.feed_ok():
    print("Feed missing or wrong; need " + self.required_feed())
  if self.gas_band() and self.gas_fluid() != self.required_gas():
    print("Wrong gas, need " + self.required_gas())
  if self.liquid_band() and self.liquid_fluid() != self.required_liquid():
    print("Wrong liquid, need " + self.required_liquid())

  print("efficiency", self.breeding_efficiency())
  sleep(1)
```

从本地存储连接并补给栖息地的饲料和专用 `reagents` 输入。将气体和液体端口连接到装有精确所需外来物质的储罐。流体输入设定器会立即更改策略，但缓冲区和效率只有在模拟推进且材料到达后才会变化。

## 在转变发生前读取

`next_stage_population()` 提供精确阈值，`next_requirement()` 说明变化的类型。对于实际供应计划，`next_required_gas()` 和 `next_required_liquid()` 会指明转变之后立即需要的流体。`next_gas_band()` 和 `next_liquid_band()` 返回它们精确的未来 `[low, high]` 窗口。空字符串或空列表表示该输入不会启用。这使得在跨越转变之前就可以进行勘探、精炼、铺管和调节器调校。

## 恢复

失败的养育尝试会损失预先放置的材料，但绝不会损失栖息地。修复供应或脚本，然后重试 `revive()`。

对于已经位于围栏内的过量气体，停止输入并明确丢弃该储备：

```
self.set_gas_intake(0)
result = self.purge_reserve("gas")
print(result.status, result.message)
```

然后使用所需气体重新补充并恢复调节。对于液体，使用 `set_liquid_intake(0)` 和 `purge_reserve("liquid")`。每次清除只会摧毁所选围栏储备并清除其流体身份。它会保留另一个储备、饲料、种群进度、入口缓冲区、连接和输入设置。`purge_intake("gas_in")` 或 `purge_intake("liquid_in")` 仍是清除持有错误流体的入口的独立工具。

en:
Every established colony learns from successful generations. Positive population change adds **Insight** directly to one shared Wildlife balance; elapsed time and static population add nothing. `self.get_insight()` reports the shared balance, this Habitat's current rate, and its lifetime contribution.

## Two permanent nodes per creature

Each creature has exactly two authored nodes. Its early **Adaptation** affects that species only and gives strong recurring relief tailored to its life support or breeding pace. Its later **Breakthrough** affects every current and future species. The complete set is deliberately bounded: it improves a well-supported late colony by a few times its untreated output, not by an order of magnitude. Bonuses include speed boosts for different parts of the growth curve, brood bonuses that guarantee extra offspring over time, a reward for one full day of uninterrupted support, feed efficiency, wider fluid bands, a larger founding population, and a higher late-stage rate limit. Rearing always takes 12 world hours. Scripts inspect `.scope` and `.source_species` through `self.get_bonus_tree()` and purchase with `self.unlock_bonus(node_id)`; there is no purchase control outside code.

## Costs and gates

The species-only Adaptation has exactly one requirement: **1 shared Insight**. It becomes purchasable after `set_revival_target(...)`, before revival. The all-species Breakthrough has exactly two requirements: **4 Insight** and its source creature reaching **10,000 population**. It does not require the first node, research, a planet-wide Wildlife total, or purchase materials. Every check is atomic; a rejected purchase spends nothing.

## Why more Habitats matter

The cumulative Insight curve has diminishing per-individual yield. A creature has generated **3 Insight** at 10,000 population, while its two nodes cost **5** total, so no creature can self-fund its entire tree at the breakthrough gate. The player must pool growth from several species. Full Mk II populations across all 16 creatures generate **112 Insight** against **80** needed to own all 32 nodes, leaving 32 spare. That is a 1.4 times lifetime budget, while 15 full Mk II species still provide 105 Insight. A full or stalled colony cannot mint currency forever.
zh:
每个已建立的殖民地都会从成功的世代中汲取经验。正向人口变化会直接向共享的野生动物余额添加**洞察**；经过的时间和静态人口不会带来任何收益。`self.get_insight()` 会报告共享余额、该栖息地的当前速率及其终身贡献。

## 每种生物的两个永久节点

每种生物恰好有两个预设节点。其早期**适应**只影响该物种，并提供针对其生命支持或繁殖节奏定制的强力持续缓解。其后期**突破**会影响当前和未来的所有物种。完整加成集被刻意限制：它可将一个支持良好的后期殖民地提升到其未经处理产量的数倍，而不是一个数量级。奖励包括增长曲线不同阶段的速度提升、随时间保证额外后代的育雏奖励、一整个昼夜不间断支持的奖励、饲料效率、更宽的流体区间、更大的初始种群，以及更高的后期速率上限。培育始终需要 12 个世界小时。脚本通过 `self.get_bonus_tree()` 检查 `.scope` 和 `.source_species`，并使用 `self.unlock_bonus(node_id)` 购买；代码之外没有购买控制。

## 成本与门槛

仅影响该物种的**适应**恰好有一个要求：**1 点共享洞察**。它在 `set_revival_target(...)` 之后、复活之前变得可购买。影响所有物种的**突破**恰好有两个要求：**4 洞察**，以及其来源生物达到 **10,000 人口**。它不需要第一个节点、研究、行星范围的野生动物总量或购买材料。所有检查都是原子的；被拒绝的购买不会消耗任何东西。

## 为什么更多栖息地很重要

累计洞察曲线具有递减的个体收益。一种生物在 10,000 人口时已产生 **3 洞察**，而它的两个节点总成本为 **5**，因此在突破门槛处没有生物能够自行负担整个节点树。玩家必须汇集多个物种的增长。全部 16 种生物达到满员 Mk II 种群会产生 **112 洞察**，而拥有全部 32 个节点需要 **80**，剩余 32。这是终身预算的 1.4 倍，而 15 个满员 Mk II 物种仍能提供 105 洞察。满员或停滞的殖民地不能永远铸造货币。

en:
Wildlife has three linked progress scales: each colony's life stage, shared Insight, and planet-wide established population.

## Colony stages

| Current stage | Shared population range | Habitat access |
|---|---:|---|
| Founded | 4-249 | Mk I and Mk II |
| First Breeding | 250-2,499 | Mk I and Mk II |
| Self-Sustaining | 2,500-24,999 | Mk I and Mk II |
| Thriving | 25,000-175,000 | Mk I and Mk II |
| Abundant | 175,001-350,000 | Mk II only |

Both Habitat tiers display this same five-stage ladder. Mk I reaches its **175,000** capacity at the end of Thriving. Mk II unlocks at **600,000 Wildlife** after Deep Exotics and raises capacity to **350,000**, allowing the colony to cross into Abundant. The upgrade changes capacity only. Mature draw is **40-64 W** at Mk I and **144-168 W** at Mk II.

## Breeding

Each creature completes breeding cycles. Population supplies natural momentum: a Common colony produces about **28 individuals/h** naturally at 5,000 population, then the population contribution smoothly flattens toward **150 individuals/h**. Life-support efficiency and rarity change that natural rate: Common **1.0x**, Uncommon **0.75x**, Rare **0.50x**, Legendary **0.30x**. Purchased bonuses improve selected parts of this curve while hard caps keep even a complete tree to a few times untreated output. Some brood bonuses save fractional progress across cycles and eventually guarantee an extra individual. Full-support momentum takes **24 world hours** to reach maximum and loses progress twice as quickly while support is imperfect. Capacity never slows breeding; it only stops growth when the Habitat is full. `breeding_efficiency()` is only the life-support multiplier, not the population rate. Read `breeding_rate()` for expected individuals per hour.

## Adaptations and Insight

Every species has two independent permanent nodes. Its **1 Insight Adaptation** affects that species only. Its **4 Insight Breakthrough** affects every species and also requires its source colony to reach **10,000 population**. Neither node requires research, Compound, planet-wide Wildlife, or the other node.
