en: You don't have any of this item.

## Overview

Scans a small **local sector grid** around the base to reveal surface materials you can harvest for starter credits.

> This is a *proximity* scanner, discrete sectors, just around base. For wider planetary exploration (coordinates, distant mining sites), that's the rover with its sonar module. Two different tools, two different scales.

## The grid

The surface near base is divided into a grid of sectors, named by row (**A-H**) and column (**1-24**). Your base is at `E13`; the full grid is `A1` to `H24` (**192 sectors**).

## What your script does

This script runs on the Scanner, so `self.scan(sector)` is a [[self only]] timed hardware action. It returns `ScanResult` with stable `.status` and `.message` fields plus `.id`, `.name`, and `.value` item details.

```
result = self.scan("E14")
if result.status == "ok":
  print("E14: " + result.name)
else:
  print("E14: " + result.message)
```

An `"empty"` result is a completed scan with no item. Malformed sector ids raise `ValueError` instead of returning an ordinary world-state status.

## Building sector names

Row letters come from `chr`: `chr(65)` is `"A"` and `chr(72)` is `"H"`.

```
sector = chr(65) + "13"
result = self.scan(sector)
print(result.status, result.name, result.value)
```

Other scripts can read saved scan snapshots with `get_component("scanner_1").get_scanned()`. The Scanner script performs scans; the Harvester script reads that map to choose routes. Sell collected items from the Inventory page to earn credits.
zh:
## 概述

扫描基地周围的一个小型**本地扇区网格**，揭示你可以采集以获取初始积分的地表材料。

> 这是一款*近距离*扫描仪，覆盖离散扇区，仅在基地附近。对于更广泛的行星探索（坐标、远处采矿点），那是配有声呐模块的漫游车。两种不同的工具，两个不同的尺度。

## 网格

基地附近的地表被划分为扇区网格，按行（**A-H**）和列（**1-24**）命名。你的基地位于 `E13`；完整网格从 `A1` 到 `H24`（**192 个扇区**）。

## 你的脚本能做什么

此脚本在扫描仪上运行，因此 `self.scan(sector)` 是一个 [[self only]] 定时硬件操作。它返回 `ScanResult`，包含稳定的 `.status` 和 `.message` 字段，以及 `.id`、`.name` 和 `.value` 物品详情。

```
result = self.scan("E14")
if result.status == "ok":
  print("E14: " + result.name)
else:
  print("E14: " + result.message)
```

`"empty"` 结果表示扫描已完成但没有物品。格式错误的扇区 ID 会引发 `ValueError`，而不是返回普通的世界状态。

## 构建扇区名称

行字母来自 `chr`：`chr(65)` 是 `"A"`，`chr(72)` 是 `"H"`。

```
sector = chr(65) + "13"
result = self.scan(sector)
print(result.status, result.name, result.value)
```

其他脚本可以通过 `get_component("scanner_1").get_scanned()` 读取已保存的扫描快照。扫描仪脚本执行扫描；采集车脚本读取该地图以选择路线。在库存页面出售收集的物品以赚取积分。

en:
## Overview

Collects items from sectors on the planet surface.

> Start with one nearby scanned item: move one cardinal cell at a time, collect it, store it, and repeat. Optimize only after that loop works.

## Reading scan data

```
scanner = get_component("scanner_1")
scanned = scanner.get_scanned()
```

`scanned` is a fresh dict of sector ids to `ScanResult` snapshots. Each value has `.status`, `.message`, `.id`, `.name`, and `.value`. Re-call `get_scanned()` inside a loop because an older dict does not update itself.

## Moving and collecting

```
move_result = self.move("E14")
if move_result.status == "ok":
  pickup = self.collect()
else:
  print(move_result.message)
```

`move()` returns `ActionResult`; its statuses distinguish `"ok"`, `"invalid"`, `"too_far"`, `"already_here"`, `"overheated"`, `"moving"`, and `"busy"`. Movement is cardinal and one cell per call. `"busy"` means another physical Harvester action is still active.

`collect()` returns `ScanResult`. Branch on `.status`; `"ok"` includes the collected item payload, while `"empty"`, `"holding"`, `"overheated"`, `"moving"`, `"collecting"`, and `"busy"` explain why no new item entered the held slot. `"busy"` means another physical Harvester action is still active.

Collecting uses the Harvester's single held slot, not Inventory. `store()` returns `ItemResult`, whose `.item_id` is populated after an `"ok"` result.

There is no base sector to drive back to. `store()` moves the held item into Inventory from any sector, and selling also happens from anywhere through the Shop: `shop = get_component("shop")`, then `shop.sell(item_id, quantity)`.

```
pickup = self.collect()
if pickup.status == "ok":
  stored = self.store()
  if stored.status == "ok":
    print("stored", stored.item_id)
  else:
    print(stored.message)
```

## Heat management

Moving to an item sector adds **1** heat, moving to an empty sector adds **7**, and collecting an empty sector adds **9**. Max heat is **100**; it drains at **3 per hour**. Check `self.get_heat()` and use `sleep()` only when you intentionally need cooling time.
zh:
## 概述

从星球表面的扇区收集物品。

> 从附近一个已扫描物品开始：每次沿基本方向移动一格，收集它，存入库存，并重复。只有该循环可用后再进行优化。

## 读取扫描数据

```
scanner = get_component("scanner_1")
scanned = scanner.get_scanned()
```

`scanned` 是一个全新的字典，将扇区 ID 映射到 `ScanResult` 快照。每个值都有 `.status`、`.message`、`.id`、`.name` 和 `.value`。在循环中重新调用 `get_scanned()`，因为旧的字典不会自行更新。

## 移动与收集

```
move_result = self.move("E14")
if move_result.status == "ok":
  pickup = self.collect()
else:
  print(move_result.message)
```

`move()` 返回 `ActionResult`；其状态区分 "ok"、"invalid"、"too_far"、"already_here"、"overheated"、"moving" 和 "busy"。移动沿基本方向进行，每次调用移动一格。`"busy"` 表示另一个采集车物理动作仍在进行。

`collect()` 返回 `ScanResult`。根据 `.status` 分支；"ok" 包含收集到的物品载荷，而 "empty"、"holding"、"overheated"、"moving"、"collecting" 和 "busy" 解释为什么没有新物品进入持有槽。`"busy"` 表示另一个采集车物理动作仍在进行。

收集使用采集车的单个持有槽，而不是库存。`store()` 返回 `ItemResult`，在 "ok" 结果后其 `.item_id` 会被填充。

没有需要返回的基地扇区。`store()` 可从任意扇区将持有物品移入库存，出售也可通过商店在任意位置进行：`shop = get_component("shop")`，然后 `shop.sell(item_id, quantity)`。

```
pickup = self.collect()
if pickup.status == "ok":
  stored = self.store()
  if stored.status == "ok":
    print("stored", stored.item_id)
  else:
    print(stored.message)
```

## 热量管理

移动到物品扇区会增加 **1** 热量，移动到空扇区会增加 **7**，在空扇区执行收集会增加 **9**。最大热量为 **100**；以每小时 **3** 的速度消散。检查 `self.get_heat()`，仅在你有意需要冷却时间时使用 `sleep()`。

en:
## Plants field work

After Plants unlocks, this same Harvester can operate every one of the 15 seed lines by itself. Call `load_seed(seed_id)` from anywhere on the grid, drive to an empty field cell, and call `plant(seed_id)`. The physical seed stays in the held slot until planting finishes. `cell(sector)` and `cells()` report crop state, growth, conditions, and remaining manual-treatment time. Every seed's Inventory details and Flora journal entry list its exact requirements, growth time, and base Forage yield.

Use `light()`, `water()`, and `dispense_salt()` for **24 hours** of manual care. `fertilize(item_id)` raises yield, `accelerate()` doubles growth while its dose lasts, and `amplify()` boosts the whole field. Tending takes **0.25 hours**. Planting, harvesting, and uprooting take **0.5 hours**. Each timed action pauses the script, names the current work in the field tooltip, and shows progress.

Water travels in the Harvester's own tank. Read `self.water_level()` and `self.water_capacity()` in tons before choosing when to call `refill_water()`. Each watering uses **1 t**; a full tank holds **5 t**. Refills draw from the home outpost's water tanks anywhere on the field.

Salt, Fertilizer, Growth Accelerant, and Yield Amplifier come directly from Inventory. Set `inventory = get_component("inventory")`, then check stock with `inventory.count("salt")`, `inventory.count("fertilizer")`, `inventory.count("growth_accelerant")`, or `inventory.count("yield_amplifier")`. For higher Fertilizer tiers, count `"fertilizer_mk2"` or `"fertilizer_mk3"`.

A ready crop waits safely for `harvest()`. If Inventory cannot hold the whole yield, the remainder stays banked on the crop. `uproot()` instead removes a crop and recovers its seed.

`deployables()` lists field-machine kit types unlocked by research. `deploy(kit_id)` still needs the kit in Inventory and an empty current cell. Grow Lamps, Sprinklers, and Dispensers continuously serve the four orthogonally adjacent cells (directly above, below, left, and right). A Crop Automator reaches up to 24 other cells in a centered 5 by 5 area. Submissions return immediately, while its one executor performs up to 50 unfinished planting, harvesting, and treatment jobs one at a time in FIFO order by default (first in, first out, so the oldest job runs first), pausing about **1 second** between them. The automator's script can inspect blockers and reorder unfinished jobs with `move_job(...)`. Valid field work takes **0.1 hours** at 100% outpost efficiency; a target mismatch fails immediately when it reaches the executor. Hover any deployed field machine to see its exact footprint and live work. Heat, travel, and one-seed cargo make this manual route intentionally slower than automation.
zh:
## 植物田间作业

解锁植物后，同一台采集车即可独立操作全部 15 条种子系列。在网格任意位置调用 `load_seed(seed_id)`，驶向空的田格，然后调用 `plant(seed_id)`。实际种子在种植完成前一直留在携带槽中。`cell(sector)` 和 `cells()` 报告作物状态、生长、环境条件和剩余人工处理时间。每种种子的库存详情和植物志条目会列出其确切需求、生长时间和基础采集产量。

使用 `light()`、`water()` 和 `dispense_salt()` 进行 **24 小时**的人工照料。`fertilize(item_id)` 提高产量，`accelerate()` 在剂量持续期间使生长翻倍，`amplify()` 提升整块田。照料耗时 **0.25 小时**。种植、收获和拔除耗时 **0.5 小时**。每个计时操作都会暂停脚本，在田格工具提示中显示当前工作，并显示进度。

水储存在采集车自身的水箱中。在决定何时调用 `refill_water()` 前，以吨为单位读取 `self.water_level()` 和 `self.water_capacity()`。每次浇水使用 **1 吨**；满箱可容纳 **5 吨**。补水从主前哨站的水箱中抽取，可在田间任意位置进行。

盐、肥料、生长加速剂和产量增幅剂直接来自库存。设置 `inventory = get_component("inventory")`，然后使用 `inventory.count("salt")`、`inventory.count("fertilizer")`、`inventory.count("growth_accelerant")` 或 `inventory.count("yield_amplifier")` 检查库存。对于更高阶肥料，检查 `"fertilizer_mk2"` 或 `"fertilizer_mk3"`。

成熟作物会安全等待 `harvest()`。如果库存无法容纳全部产量，剩余部分会保留在作物上。`uproot()` 则会移除作物并回收其种子。

`deployables()` 列出由研究解锁的田间机器套件类型。`deploy(kit_id)` 仍需要库存中有该套件，且当前田格为空。生长灯、洒水器和分配器持续服务四个正交相邻田格（正上、正下、正左、正右）。作物自动化器可覆盖以自身为中心的 5×5 区域内最多 24 个其他田格。提交会立即返回，而其单一执行器默认按先进先出顺序（先进先出，因此最早的任务先运行）一次执行最多 50 个未完成的种植、收获和处理任务，任务之间暂停约 **1 秒**。自动化器的脚本可以检查阻碍项，并使用 `move_job(...)` 重新排序未完成任务。在前哨站效率为 100% 时，有效田间作业耗时 **0.1 小时**；若目标不匹配，任务到达执行器时会立即失败。将鼠标悬停在任意已部署的田间机器上，可查看其确切覆盖范围和实时工作。热量、移动和单一种子载货使这条手动路线有意比自动化更慢。

en:
## Overview

A programmable rover for wider planetary exploration. The chassis alone does nothing; mounted modules provide every capability. The three dedicated slots accept Nav, Sonar, and Drill modules.

Unlike the Harvester's local sector grid, the Rover travels across planet coordinates. Use `self.nav.set_target(x, y)`, set a throttle, and keep the route script running until it arrives.

## Battery

The integrated 100 Wh battery is not upgradeable. Movement, drilling, and sonar scans consume energy. High throttle is fast but less efficient. `self.battery` exposes `level()`, `wh()`, and `capacity()`. Recharge at a Vehicle Charging Station; its rescue drone can recover a stranded Rover.

## Movement lifecycle

Stopping the script, reaching its end, or hitting an uncaught error stops the Rover, clears its route, and cancels an active sonar timer. A distance tolerance only proves the Rover is close enough. Call `self.nav.brake()` after the travel loop before mining, scanning, surveying, or transferring cargo.

## Finding sites: don't roam

Every "?" contact is on the map from the start (they also block building). Instead of driving around blindly, query them: `get_component("nocturna").points_of_interest()` returns every contact with `.x`, `.y`, and a `.scanned` flag. Filter `if not p.scanned:` for your work list, drive to each contact, brake, then sweep with `self.sonar.scan()` and `survey()`. A contact's `.kind` stays `"unknown"` until you scan it: position is known from orbit, identity is not.

## Discoveries and cargo

Sonar discoveries persist in the Journal. Read them from any script with `get_component("journal").discovered_sites(planet_id)`. Mining places ore in `self.cargo`; after Auto Feeders, `self.output` can unload it to Inventory only inside the home outpost's service area, or to a Storage Bin, Warehouse, outpost machine, or stopped cargo vehicle at its current location.

Storage and outpost-machine transfers require the Rover to be inside that target's service area. Inventory is not present at remote outposts. Vehicle handoffs require both vehicles to be stopped within about 2 m.

## Modifying the rig

At any founded outpost service area, `self.modules()` shows the current layout and `self.mount(...)` / `self.unmount(...)` request dedicated-hardware service orders. Those orders may use Base Inventory for empty rig hardware, but they never make ordinary cargo available at a remote outpost. Open DOCS for `self.nav`, `self.sonar`, and `self.drill`.

Biological fieldwork is drone-only. Use a drone with a Portable Bio Scanner or Portable Bio Extractor for life-form operations.
zh:
## 概览

可编程探测车，用于更广泛的行星探索。仅底盘本身不执行任何操作；安装模块提供所有能力。三个专用插槽接受导航、声呐和钻探模块。

不同于采集车的本地扇区网格，探测车在行星坐标上行驶。使用 `self.nav.set_target(x, y)`，设置油门，并保持路线脚本运行直到抵达。

## 电池

内置 100 Wh 电池不可升级。移动、钻探和声呐扫描会消耗能量。高油门速度快但效率较低。`self.battery` 暴露 `level()`、`wh()` 和 `capacity()`。在车辆充电站充电；其救援无人机可以回收搁浅的探测车。

## 移动生命周期

停止脚本、脚本执行结束或遇到未捕获错误都会使探测车停止、清除路线并取消正在进行的声呐计时器。距离容差只能证明探测车足够接近。在移动循环之后、采矿、扫描、勘测或转移货物之前，调用 `self.nav.brake()`。

## 寻找站点：不要漫游

每个“?”接触点从一开始就在地图上（它们也会阻挡建造）。不要盲目驾驶，而是查询它们：`get_component("nocturna").points_of_interest()` 返回每个接触点，具有 `.x`、`.y` 和 `.scanned` 标志。使用 `if not p.scanned:` 筛选你的工作列表，驶向每个接触点，刹车，然后用 `self.sonar.scan()` 和 `survey()` 扫描。接触点的 `.kind` 在你扫描前保持 `"unknown"`：轨道已知其位置，但身份未知。

## 发现与货物

声呐发现会保留在日志中。从任意脚本使用 `get_component("journal").discovered_sites(planet_id)` 读取它们。采矿会将矿石放入 `self.cargo`；在自动供料器之后，`self.output` 只能在主前哨站的服务区内将矿石卸载到库存，或在当前位置卸载到储物箱、仓库、前哨站机器或已停止的货运车辆。

存储与前哨站机器转移要求探测车位于目标服务区内。远程前哨站没有库存。车辆交接要求两辆车在约 2 米内停止。

## 改装设备

在任何已建立的前哨站服务区内，`self.modules()` 显示当前布局，`self.mount(...)` / `self.unmount(...)` 请求专用硬件服务订单。这些订单可以使用基地库存来补充空置的设备硬件，但绝不会让普通货物在远程前哨站可用。打开文档查看 `self.nav`、`self.sonar` 和 `self.drill`。

生物野外作业仅限无人机。使用配备便携生物扫描仪或便携生物萃取器的无人机进行生命体操作。

en:
## Overview

A grid-tied vehicle charging bay. It detects rovers and Pioneers inside its **~2 m** service area and charges them through a station-owned queue.

## Docked vehicles and jobs

`self.get_docked()` lists the vehicle ids currently inside the service area. `self.charge(vehicle_id, 1.0)` requests a full battery target and returns `ActionResult`; the second argument may be a lower target fraction. Charging jobs belong to the station and continue after the script stops.

Mk I has **1** active bay, Mk II **2**, and Mk III **4**. Idle bays pool their rate into the vehicles currently charging. Your script decides which docked vehicles to queue, their target levels, and when to revisit that decision.

Statuses are `"charging"`, `"queued"`, `"target_reached"`, `"not_docked"`, `"station_offline"`, or `"invalid"`. Use the read-only `self.status(vehicle_id)` query for job details such as `state`, `rate_w`, `bay_index`, and `queue_index`.

## Queue controls

`self.stop(vehicle_id)` removes one job. `self.clear_queue()` returns `CountResult`; `.count` is the number of jobs removed. `self.get_active()`, `self.get_queue()`, `self.get_bay_count()`, and `self.get_bay_rate()` expose the queue and bay state.

## Field-service drone

`self.dispatch_rescue(vehicle_name, 1.0)` sends a service drone to the named stranded vehicle; the optional target is its desired battery fraction. Only one service drone can be out at a time. `self.cancel_rescue()` recalls it. Launch requires station power, but a drone already in flight carries its own mission power and finishes travel and charging through a later station outage.

Open DOCS for exact signatures, result codes, and numeric values.
zh:
## 概述

一个并网车辆充电坞。它会检测其 **~2 m** 服务范围内的漫游车和先锋建造机，并通过站点自有队列为它们充电。

## 停靠车辆与作业

`self.get_docked()` 列出当前位于服务范围内的车辆 ID。`self.charge(vehicle_id, 1.0)` 请求将目标电量设为满电，并返回 `ActionResult`；第二个参数可以是更低的目标电量比例。充电作业归站点所有，脚本停止后仍会继续。

Mk I 有 **1** 个活跃充电位，Mk II 有 **2** 个，Mk III 有 **4** 个。空闲充电位会将其充电速率并入当前正在充电的车辆。你的脚本决定将哪些停靠车辆加入队列、它们的目标电量，以及何时重新评估该决定。

状态为 `"charging"`、`"queued"`、`"target_reached"`、`"not_docked"`、`"station_offline"` 或 `"invalid"`。使用只读的 `self.status(vehicle_id)` 查询作业详情，例如 `state`、`rate_w`、`bay_index` 和 `queue_index`。

## 队列控制

`self.stop(vehicle_id)` 移除一个作业。`self.clear_queue()` 返回 `CountResult`；`.count` 是被移除的作业数量。`self.get_active()`、`self.get_queue()`、`self.get_bay_count()` 和 `self.get_bay_rate()` 提供队列和充电位状态。

## 现场服务无人机

`self.dispatch_rescue(vehicle_name, 1.0)` 向指定名称的搁浅车辆派遣一架服务无人机；可选目标参数为该车辆的期望电量比例。同一时间只能有一架服务无人机在外执行任务。`self.cancel_rescue()` 将其召回。起飞需要站点供电，但已在途的无人机携带自身任务电力，即使之后站点断电，也能完成飞行与充电。

打开 DOCS 查看确切签名、结果代码与数值。

en:
## Overview

The Smelter refines raw ore into finished stock. It runs one recipe at a time and processes automatically, your script keeps the input fed and the output drained.

## Recipes

`self.set_recipe(id)` picks what to make. `self.clear_recipe()` unsets the recipe once the smelter is idle and both buffers are empty. The current input and finished output must also be empty before `self.set_recipe(id)` can switch to a different material; drain or flush them first. `self.list_recipes()` returns the available Recipe objects. Each recipe has `.id`, `.inputs`, `.output_item`, `.duration_game_hours`, and `.power_draw`. `self.get_recipe_inputs()` returns the selected recipe's item requirements. You can pass either a recipe id or a Recipe object to `set_recipe()`.

```
for recipe in self.list_recipes():
  print(recipe.id, recipe.inputs, "->", recipe.output_item)
```

## Processing

Once a recipe is set and the input has enough material, processing starts automatically. The script's job is transport, it doesn't start or stop the craft. `self.is_running()` and `self.get_progress()` let you monitor progress. `self.get_output_count()` tells you when finished stock is ready to send.

## Transport

Two I/O ports: `self.input` and `self.output`. Input has `connect(name)`, `take(item_id, count)`, `flush()`, `count()`, and `capacity()`; output has `connect(name)`, `send(item_id, count)`, `count()`, and `capacity()`. At home, connect to `"inventory"`; at remote outposts, connect local Storage Bins or Warehouses supplied by vehicles. Call `self.input.take(item_id, count)` to feed ore. When the output buffer has stock, call `self.output.send(item_id, count)` to drain it. Use `self.input.flush()` to discard a stuck or wrong input load before changing recipes; use `self.clear_recipe()` when you want no recipe selected.

Requires **Auto Feeders** research for transfers.
zh:
## 概述

冶炼厂将原矿精炼为成品库存。它一次运行一个配方并自动处理，你的脚本负责保持输入供料和输出排料。

## 配方

`self.set_recipe(id)` 选择要制造的物品。`self.clear_recipe()` 在冶炼厂空闲且两个缓冲区均为空时取消配方。在 `self.set_recipe(id)` 能切换到不同材料之前，当前输入和成品输出也必须为空；先排空或清空它们。`self.list_recipes()` 返回可用的 Recipe 对象。每个配方都有 `.id`、`.inputs`、`.output_item`、`.duration_game_hours` 和 `.power_draw`。`self.get_recipe_inputs()` 返回所选配方的物品需求。你可以向 `set_recipe()` 传入配方 id 或 Recipe 对象。

```
for recipe in self.list_recipes():
  print(recipe.id, recipe.inputs, "->", recipe.output_item)
```

## 处理

一旦设置配方且输入端有足够材料，处理会自动开始。脚本的工作是运输，不会启动或停止制造。`self.is_running()` 和 `self.get_progress()` 可让你监控进度。`self.get_output_count()` 会告诉你成品库存何时可以发送。

## 运输

两个 I/O 端口：`self.input` 和 `self.output`。输入端具有 `connect(name)`、`take(item_id, count)`、`flush()`、`count()` 和 `capacity()`；输出端具有 `connect(name)`、`send(item_id, count)`、`count()` 和 `capacity()`。在基地，连接到 `"inventory"`；在远程前哨站，连接到由载具提供的本地存储箱或仓库。调用 `self.input.take(item_id, count)` 来供入矿石。当输出缓冲区有库存时，调用 `self.output.send(item_id, count)` 来排空它。使用 `self.input.flush()` 在更换配方前丢弃卡住或错误的输入负载；当你希望不选择任何配方时，使用 `self.clear_recipe()`。

传输需要 **自动供料器** 研究。

en:
## Overview

The Fabricator crafts finished items from multiple refined inputs. Unlike the Smelter, a single recipe can require several different materials at once.

## Stockpile

The input is a multi-material stockpile, not a single bin. Materials from different sources accumulate together until the recipe consumes them. Total stockpile size is capped; going over rejects new deposits. Query with `self.get_stockpile()`, `self.get_stockpile_used()`, `self.get_stockpile_capacity()`.

## Recipes

`self.set_recipe(id)` picks a recipe. `self.clear_recipe()` unsets it once the Fabricator is idle and output/byproduct buffers are empty. The input stockpile is preserved. `self.list_recipes()` returns available Recipe objects. Each recipe has `.id`, `.inputs`, `.output_item`, `.duration_game_hours`, `.power_draw`, `.fluid_inputs`, and byproduct fields. `self.get_recipe_inputs()` returns the required materials for the current recipe as a dict. Changing the recipe while a craft is running or while finished output/byproducts remain is rejected; drain those buffers first.

```
for recipe in self.list_recipes():
  print(recipe.id, recipe.inputs, recipe.fluid_inputs, "->", recipe.output_item)
```

## Processing

Once a recipe is set, the stockpile has every required material, and any recipe fluid ports have enough tons buffered, crafting starts automatically. The script handles transport. `self.is_running()` and `self.get_progress()` let you monitor progress. `self.get_output_count()` tells you when finished items are ready to send.

Fluid requirements are listed on the recipe's `.fluid_inputs`, such as `{"water_in": 1}`. Check the matching port (`self.water_in.level()`, `self.steam_in.level()`, `self.oil_in.level()`) when a recipe is stocked but still waiting.

## Transport

Input port (`self.input`) feeds the stockpile. Since recipes need multiple materials, your script will typically switch `connect()` between sources as it pulls different ingredients. Use `"inventory"` only at home; remote Fabricators use local Storage Bin or Warehouse names. Every fluid input needs an explicit compatible `FluidPort.connect(...)` relationship. Local sources transfer directly; remote sources also need a completed conflict-free pipe route between both locations. `self.input.flush()` discards the whole input stockpile and cancels current progress. Output port (`self.output`) drains finished products to the same kinds of targets once output exists. Recipes with `.byproduct_item != None` also fill `self.byproduct`; route and drain that port separately or a full byproduct buffer stops the whole craft.

Requires **Auto Feeders** research for transfers.
zh:
## 概述

制造机使用多种精炼输入制作成品。与冶炼厂不同，单个配方可能同时需要几种不同材料。

## 储备堆

输入是一个多材料储备堆，而不是单个料箱。来自不同来源的材料会一起累积，直到配方消耗它们。储备堆总容量有上限；超出会拒绝新的存入。使用 `self.get_stockpile()`、`self.get_stockpile_used()`、`self.get_stockpile_capacity()` 查询。

## 配方

`self.set_recipe(id)` 选择配方。`self.clear_recipe()` 在制造机空闲且输出/副产物缓冲区为空时取消设置。输入储备堆会保留。`self.list_recipes()` 返回可用的 Recipe 对象。每个配方都有 `.id`、`.inputs`、`.output_item`、`.duration_game_hours`、`.power_draw`、`.fluid_inputs` 和副产物字段。`self.get_recipe_inputs()` 以 dict 返回当前配方所需材料。在制作运行中或仍有成品输出/副产物时更改配方会被拒绝；请先排空这些缓冲区。

```
for recipe in self.list_recipes():
  print(recipe.id, recipe.inputs, recipe.fluid_inputs, "->", recipe.output_item)
```

## 加工

设置配方后，只要储备堆拥有每种所需材料，并且配方的流体端口有足够吨数缓冲，制作就会自动开始。脚本处理运输。`self.is_running()` 和 `self.get_progress()` 可让你监控进度。`self.get_output_count()` 会告诉你成品何时准备好发送。

流体需求列在配方的 `.fluid_inputs` 中，例如 `{"water_in": 1}`。当配方材料已备齐但仍在等待时，请检查对应端口（`self.water_in.level()`、`self.steam_in.level()`、`self.oil_in.level()`）。

## 运输

输入端口（`self.input`）向储备堆供料。由于配方需要多种材料，你的脚本通常会在拉取不同成分时在来源之间切换 `connect()`。`"inventory"` 只能在家里使用；远程制造机使用本地 Storage Bin 或 Warehouse 名称。每个流体输入都需要显式兼容的 `FluidPort.connect(...)` 关系。本地来源直接传输；远程来源还需要两个位置之间有一条完成且无冲突的管道路线。`self.input.flush()` 会丢弃整个输入储备堆并取消当前进度。输出端口（`self.output`）在存在输出时将成品排向同类目标。`.byproduct_item != None` 的配方还会填充 `self.byproduct`；请单独路由并排空该端口，否则副产物缓冲区满会停止整个制作。

需要研究 **Auto Feeders** 才能传输。

en:
## Overview

A Supply Dock fulfills one **Earth Order** at a time, either a contractor campaign order or a Weekly Earth Order. Three things must happen: the script assigns an id with `self.set_order(...)`, materials enter the order-aware slots, and the script enables dispatch with `self.set_enabled(True)`. Nothing ships without all three.

## Picking an order

`get_component("orders").list_orders()` returns current contractor orders. `list_weekly_orders()` returns the five offers on the current Weekly Earth Orders board, including weekly offers already fulfilled this cycle, or an empty list until an eligible production chain is available. Pass an active id from either list to `self.set_order(id)`. Several docks may serve the same order and share progress. Handle `"ok"`, `"completed"`, `"unknown_order"`, and `"cargo_present"`.

## Loading and dispatch

An assigned dock accepts only the items its order still needs. With **Auto Feeders** researched, pull locally with `self.input.take(item_id, count)` or push from a parked Rover or Pioneer. Overshoot remains at the source. Dispatch is continuous at `dispatch_rate()` units/h after `self.set_enabled(True)`. `self.current_dispatch()` reports the active item and `self.dispatch_progress()` reports **0-1** toward the next unit.

## Completion and weekly expiry

Completion clears `current_order()` and disables dispatch. Weekly refresh does the same for every dock assigned to the expired board. Shipped progress and shipped goods from unfinished weekly orders are permanently lost, but loaded **unshipped cargo stays inside the dock**. A weekly expiration notification appears only if at least one unit had actually shipped. The dock card then shows the preserved unassigned cargo count.

A script should poll `current_order()`, choose from either current order list when it becomes `None`, and explicitly re-enable after assignment. Use `clear_order()` to release the assignment while preserving cargo in the dock. Drain that cargo through a local machine or vehicle before assigning another order; otherwise its `ActionResult.status` is `"cargo_present"`.

## Reading the Order

`self.current_order()` exposes `.requires`, `.shipped`, `.reward_credits`, `.kind`, and `.expires_day`. Campaign orders also have `.contractor_id` and `.contractor_name`; both are `None` for weekly orders. Open DOCS for full method signatures and the Earth Orders guide.
zh:
## 概述

一个补给对接站一次只完成一项**地球订单**，可以是承包商战役订单或每周地球订单。必须满足三个条件：脚本使用 `self.set_order(...)` 分配 id，材料进入可识别订单的槽位，脚本使用 `self.set_enabled(True)` 启用发运。三者缺一不可，否则不会发运。

## 选择订单

`get_component("orders").list_orders()` 返回当前承包商订单。`list_weekly_orders()` 返回当前每周地球订单板上的五个订单选项，包括本周期内已完成的每周订单选项；在出现可用合格生产链之前，它返回空列表。将任一列表中的有效 id 传给 `self.set_order(id)`。多个对接站可以服务同一订单并共享进度。处理 `"ok"`、`"completed"`、`"unknown_order"` 和 `"cargo_present"`。

## 装载与发运

已分配订单的对接站只接受其订单仍需要的物品。在研究**自动供料器**后，可通过 `self.input.take(item_id, count)` 从本地拉取，或从停放的漫游车或先锋建造机推送。超量部分会留在来源处。在 `self.set_enabled(True)` 后，发运以 `dispatch_rate()` 单位/小时连续进行。`self.current_dispatch()` 报告当前发运物品，`self.dispatch_progress()` 报告距下一单位的 **0-1** 进度。

## 完成与每周到期

完成会清空 `current_order()` 并禁用发运。每周刷新会对分配到已过期订单板的每个对接站执行相同操作。未完成每周订单中已发运进度和已发运货物会永久丢失，但已装载的**未发运货物会留在对接站内**。只有当至少一个单位实际发运时，才会出现每周到期通知。对接站卡片随后会显示保留的未分配货物数量。

脚本应轮询 `current_order()`，当它变为 `None` 时，从任一当前订单列表中选择，并在分配后显式重新启用。使用 `clear_order()` 释放分配，同时保留对接站内的货物。在分配另一订单前，通过本地机器或车辆排空该货物；否则其 `ActionResult.status` 为 `"cargo_present"`。

## 读取订单

`self.current_order()` 提供 `.requires`、`.shipped`、`.reward_credits`、`.kind` 和 `.expires_day`。战役订单还有 `.contractor_id` 和 `.contractor_name`；每周订单中这两项均为 `None`。打开 DOCS 查看完整方法签名和地球订单指南。

en:
## Overview

A modular expedition vehicle for longer and heavier ground trips than the Rover. Its eight Universal slots accept Nav, Sonar, Drill, Constructor, Battery Holder, and Cargo Rack modules. Sport Nav modules can stack; the other function capabilities are limited to one each.

## Batteries and range

Battery Holders carry Portable Batteries, and every installed battery contributes to one pool exposed through `self.battery`. No installed battery means no movement. Sport Nav modules increase speed and power draw, while loaded cargo adds movement cost, so long routes reward deliberate battery, cargo, and throttle choices.

## Cargo

Cargo Racks carry Portable Storage Bins. All installed bins form one logical `self.cargo` surface, while `self.cargo.racks()` exposes the physical layout. Each bin latches to one item id until it is emptied.

After Auto Feeders, `self.input` and `self.output` transfer cargo to Inventory only inside the home outpost's service area, or to Storage Bins, Warehouses, outpost machines, and nearby stopped cargo vehicles at the Pioneer's current location. Inventory is not present at remote outposts. Vehicle handoffs require both vehicles to be stopped within about 2 m.

## Finding sites: don't roam

Every "?" contact sits on the map from the start. Don't send the Pioneer wandering: `get_component("nocturna").points_of_interest()` lists every contact with `.x`, `.y`, and `.scanned`. Filter `if not p.scanned:`, drive to each contact, brake, and sweep with `self.sonar.scan()` + `survey()`. A contact's `.kind` reads `"unknown"` until you scan it: you know where the sites are, not what they are.

## Construction and movement

A mounted Constructor exposes `self.constructor` for executing planned blueprints. Nav commands are script-owned: keep the route script active until it is close enough, then brake before construction or another stationary action. Stopping the script, reaching its end, or hitting an uncaught error also stops the Pioneer and clears its active route.

## Modifying the rig

At an outpost service area, use `self.modules()`, `self.mount(...)`, `self.unmount(...)`, `self.install(...)`, and `self.uninstall(...)` to evolve the rig as better hardware unlocks.

Biological scanning and extraction are drone-only capabilities. Pioneer slots do not accept Portable Bio modules.
zh:
## 概述

一种模块化远征载具，适合比漫游车更长、更重的地面行程。它的八个通用槽位可接受导航、声呐、钻头、建造机、电池座和货物架模块。运动型导航模块可以叠加；其他功能模块各限一个。

## 电池与航程

电池座可携带便携电池，每块已安装电池都会汇入通过 `self.battery` 暴露的同一个电池池。没有安装电池就无法移动。运动型导航模块会提高速度并增加功耗，而装载货物也会增加移动消耗，因此长距离路线需要谨慎选择电池、货物和油门。

## 货物

货物架可携带便携储物箱。所有已安装储物箱共同构成一个逻辑上的 `self.cargo` 界面，而 `self.cargo.racks()` 会暴露物理布局。每个储物箱会锁定一个物品 ID，直到被清空。

启用自动供料器后，`self.input` 和 `self.output` 仅在主前哨站的服务区内将货物转入库存，或者在先锋建造机当前位置将货物转入储物箱、仓库、前哨站机器，以及附近已停下的货运载具。远端前哨站没有库存。载具交接要求两辆载具都在约 2 m 内停稳。

## 寻找站点：不要漫游

每个“?”接触点一开始就在地图上。不要让先锋建造机随意游走：`get_component("nocturna").points_of_interest()` 会列出所有接触点及其 `.x`、`.y` 和 `.scanned`。使用 `if not p.scanned:` 进行筛选，驶向每个接触点，制动，然后用 `self.sonar.scan()` + `survey()` 进行扫描。接触点的 `.kind` 在你扫描前显示为 `"unknown"`：你知道站点在哪里，却不知道它们是什么。

## 建造与移动

已安装的建造机会暴露 `self.constructor`，用于执行规划好的蓝图。导航命令由脚本掌控：保持路线脚本运行，直到足够靠近，然后在建造或其他静止动作前制动。停止脚本、脚本结束或遇到未捕获错误也会停止先锋建造机并清除其当前路线。

## 改装载具

在前哨站服务区内，使用 `self.modules()`、`self.mount(...)`、`self.unmount(...)`、`self.install(...)` 和 `self.uninstall(...)`，随着更优硬件解锁来升级载具配置。

生物扫描与提取是无人机专属能力。先锋建造机槽位不接受便携生物模块。

en:
## Overview

Step 1 of the Biology loop. The Bio Collector scans this outpost's biome, travels to one fragment location selected by your script, and returns one specimen to its cargo slot.

## The machine you are scripting

Inside this script, `self` is this Bio Collector. Its scan and collection methods are [[self only]] hardware actions. Other scripts can read public state, but they cannot remotely operate the Collector's hardware.

## Scan results

`self.scan()` returns a list of fragment locations sorted nearest-first. Every location has `.coords`, `.distance`, and `.cataloged`.

A fragment becomes cataloged after a Bio Lab analyzes it. Cataloged locations also expose the stable `.fragment_id`, a display name in `.name`, and `.rarity`; unknown locations keep those fields as `None`. Your script decides whether it is exploring unknown fragments, following a Bio Order, targeting rarity, or using another policy.

Bio Orders identify fragments by stable id. The active order's `.requires` keys can therefore be compared with cataloged scan results without hardcoding one particular order. The Journal retains cataloged fragments between script runs.

## Cargo and timing

The Collector has one specimen cargo slot. `self.collect(coords)` is timed, and a completed specimen remains in `self.cargo` until a Bio Lab takes it or the script discards it. A full cargo slot cannot accept another collection.

`"cargo_occupied"` means a specimen is still waiting in that slot. `"no_fragment"` means the coordinates do not identify a fragment in this biome. `"busy"` means the previous trip is still underway.

Open DOCS for exact result types, method signatures, and the Biology guide.
zh:
## 概览

生物循环的第一步。生物采集器会扫描此前哨站的生物群系，前往你的脚本选择的一个碎片地点，并将一个样本带回其货舱槽位。

## 你正在为其编写脚本的机器

在此脚本中，`self` 即此生物采集器。其扫描与采集方法属于 [[self only]] 硬件操作。其他脚本可以读取公开状态，但无法远程操作采集器的硬件。

## 扫描结果

`self.scan()` 返回按由近到远排序的碎片地点列表。每个地点都有 `.coords`、`.distance` 和 `.cataloged`。

碎片在生物实验室分析后会被编目。已编目的地点还会暴露稳定的 `.fragment_id`、`.name` 中的显示名称以及 `.rarity`；未知地点会将这些字段保持为 `None`。由你的脚本决定是探索未知碎片、遵循生物订单、瞄准稀有度，还是采用其他策略。

生物订单通过稳定 ID 标识碎片。因此，当前订单的 `.requires` 键可与已编目的扫描结果进行比较，而无需硬编码某个特定订单。日志会在脚本运行之间保留已编目的碎片。

## 货舱与计时

采集器只有一个样本货舱槽位。`self.collect(coords)` 有耗时，且完成的样本会留在 `self.cargo` 中，直到生物实验室取走它或脚本将其丢弃。货舱槽位已满时，无法接受另一次采集。

`"cargo_occupied"` 表示该槽位中仍有样本在等待。`"no_fragment"` 表示该坐标未标识此生物群系中的碎片。`"busy"` 表示上一次行程仍在进行。

打开 DOCS 查看确切的结果类型、方法签名和生物学指南。

en:
## Overview

The Bio Lab turns a Collector specimen into an analyzed, property-bearing sample. Manual Biology-page buttons use the workbench's one stockroom: Base Inventory at Nocturna Base, or the selected local Warehouse at another outpost. Scripts use the Lab's chamber and local item ports.

> **Automation prerequisite:** Scripted item transfers through `self.input.take(...)` and `self.output.send(...)` require **Auto Feeders** research. You can use the manual Biology workbench until it unlocks.

## Manual buttons versus scripted ports

The manual buttons do not automatically connect the stockroom to this Lab's ports. They move reagents directly from the manual stockroom into `loaded_reagents`, and a successful manual extraction places its sample directly back in that stockroom. The contents of `self.input` and `self.output` do not supply or block those manual actions.

A script has no automatic stockroom path. It must take reagents into `self.input`, call `self.load(...)` to move them into `loaded_reagents`, then send the extracted sample out of `self.output`.

## Chamber versus ports

`self.specimen` is the `Specimen` inside the analysis chamber. It is separate from `self.input`, which stages reagents, and `self.output`, which holds completed samples or recovered reagents.

A specimen reports its current `.stage`. A newly transferred specimen is `"collected"`; successful analysis changes it to `"analyzed"`. The chamber accepts only one specimen at a time.

## Analysis and recipes

`self.take_from(collector)` asks this Lab to transfer the specimen held by a Bio Collector. `self.analyze()` is a timed action returning `AnalyzeResult`. After an `"ok"` result, its `.info` payload contains the fragment identity and `.required_recipe` revealed by the analysis. Successful analysis also records the fragment in `journal.cataloged_fragments(planet_id)`, so other scripts can plan around everything the player has cataloged. When all five fragments of one creature have been analyzed, the Journal adds a complete automation-ready entry to `journal.cataloged_creatures(planet_id)`. Open the linked **Journal** DOCS page for both collection shapes.

## Buying and staging reagents

All five Bio Lab reagents are sold in the Shop's **Biology** category. Players can buy them in the Shop UI, or a script can use `shop = get_component("shop")`, call `purchase = shop.buy(reagent_id)`, and inspect `purchase.status` and `purchase.message`.

Every Shop purchase lands in base Inventory. It does not appear directly in the Lab or at a remote outpost. A home Lab can connect `self.input` to `"inventory"`; a remote Lab needs reagents delivered to a local Storage Bin or Warehouse first.

Reagents first enter `self.input`. This temporary buffer holds up to **30 units**, but only one reagent type at a time. `self.load(reagent_id, qty)` moves staged reagent units into the chamber's `loaded_reagents` and frees that input space for the next reagent type. The chamber can hold the recipe's different reagent types together.

The loaded amounts remain visible so your script can decide whether the chamber is ready, incomplete, or needs recovery. On a retry, subtract what is already in `loaded_reagents` instead of taking the full recipe again. Otherwise an extra copy of the first reagent can remain in `self.input` and block the next type.

## Extraction and recovery

`self.extract()` checks the analyzed specimen and exact loaded recipe. A successful extraction consumes both and stages one sample in `self.output`, preserving the specimen's properties.

`self.output` is a temporary **30-unit**, multi-material buffer shared by extracted samples and recovered reagents. Extraction does not send its sample onward automatically. Connect the output to Inventory at home, or to local storage elsewhere, then call `self.output.send(...)` to drain it.

> A wrong recipe destroys the loaded reagents but keeps the specimen. Completed work is also preserved when the output is full. `self.unload_reagents()` and `self.discard()` use the output port so recovery depends on available output space.

Every gameplay command returns a result object. Use its `.status` for control flow and `.message` for the player-readable blocker. Open DOCS for exact result types and status values.
zh:
## 概览

生物实验室将采集器样本转化为已分析、具有属性的样本。手动“生物学”页面按钮使用工作台的一个库存：诺克图纳星基地的基地库存，或另一个前哨站中选定的本地仓库。脚本使用实验室的分析舱和本地物品端口。

> **自动化前提：** 通过 `self.input.take(...)` 和 `self.output.send(...)` 进行脚本化物品转移需要 **自动供料器** 研究。在解锁之前，你可以使用手动生物工作台。

## 手动按钮与脚本端口

手动按钮不会自动将库存连接到该实验室的端口。它们将试剂直接从手动库存移入 `loaded_reagents`，成功的手动提取会将样本直接放回该库存。`self.input` 和 `self.output` 中的内容不会为这些手动操作提供物品，也不会阻止它们。

脚本没有自动库存路径。它必须将试剂取入 `self.input`，调用 `self.load(...)` 将其移入 `loaded_reagents`，然后将提取出的样本从 `self.output` 发送出去。

## 分析舱与端口

`self.specimen` 是分析舱内的 `Specimen`。它与暂存试剂的 `self.input` 以及存放已完成样本或回收试剂的 `self.output` 是分开的。

样本会报告其当前 `.stage`。新转移的样本为 `"collected"`；成功分析会将其变为 `"analyzed"`。分析舱一次只接受一个样本。

## 分析与配方

`self.take_from(collector)` 要求该实验室转移由生物采集器持有的样本。`self.analyze()` 是返回 `AnalyzeResult` 的计时操作。在 `"ok"` 结果之后，其 `.info` 载荷包含分析揭示的片段身份和 `.required_recipe`。成功分析还会在 `journal.cataloged_fragments(planet_id)` 中记录该片段，因此其他脚本可以围绕玩家已编目的所有内容制定计划。当一个生物的全部五个片段都被分析后，日志会向 `journal.cataloged_creatures(planet_id)` 添加一条完整、可用于自动化的条目。打开链接的 **日志** DOCS 页面以了解两种集合形式。

## 购买与暂存试剂

全部五种生物实验室试剂都在商店的 **生物学** 类别中出售。玩家可以在商店 UI 中购买它们，或者脚本可以使用 `shop = get_component("shop")`，调用 `purchase = shop.buy(reagent_id)`，并检查 `purchase.status` 和 `purchase.message`。

每次商店购买都会进入基地库存。它不会直接出现在实验室或远程前哨站中。本地实验室可以将 `self.input` 连接到 `"inventory"`；远程实验室则需要先将试剂送达本地储物箱或仓库。

试剂首先进入 `self.input`。这个临时缓冲区最多容纳 **30 单位**，但一次只能容纳一种试剂类型。`self.load(reagent_id, qty)` 将已暂存的试剂单位移入分析舱的 `loaded_reagents`，并为下一种试剂类型释放该输入空间。分析舱可以将配方中的不同试剂类型放在一起。

已装载的数量保持可见，因此脚本可以判断分析舱是就绪、不完整还是需要回收。重试时，应减去 `loaded_reagents` 中已有的数量，而不是再次领取完整配方。否则，第一种试剂的额外副本可能会留在 `self.input` 中并阻塞下一种类型。

## 提取与回收

`self.extract()` 检查已分析的样本和精确装载的配方。成功提取会消耗两者，并在 `self.output` 中暂存一个样本，同时保留样本的属性。

`self.output` 是一个临时 **30 单位**、多材料缓冲区，由提取样本和回收试剂共享。提取不会自动将样本继续发送出去。将输出连接到本地的库存，或其他地方的本地存储，然后调用 `self.output.send(...)` 将其排空。

> 错误的配方会摧毁已装载的试剂，但会保留样本。当输出已满时，已完成的工作也会被保留。`self.unload_reagents()` 和 `self.discard()` 使用输出端口，因此回收取决于可用的输出空间。

每个玩法命令都会返回一个结果对象。使用其 `.status` 进行控制流，使用 `.message` 获取玩家可读的阻碍信息。打开 DOCS 以查看确切的结果类型和状态值。

en:
## Overview

The Bio Exchange fulfills Bio Orders one staged sample at a time. Manual **DELIVER** takes from the Biology workbench stockroom: Base Inventory at Nocturna Base, or the selected local Warehouse at another outpost. Scripted delivery takes from `self.input` and follows ordinary port locality.

## Order accounting

`self.orders()` lists available Bio Orders, and `self.set_order(order_id)` assigns this Exchange. Each `BioOrder` exposes required fragment ids through `.requires`, completed amounts through `.delivered`, and samples already traveling through `.in_transit`.

Several Exchanges can share one order. Order objects are immutable snapshots, so a script that needs current progress must request a fresh snapshot.

## Sample identity

Bio Orders may require properties as well as an item id. Input stacks retain their exact property dictionaries, and `self.matches_order(item_id, properties)` reports whether a candidate qualifies for the active order. The script remains responsible for choosing a source, selecting a stack, and routing the intended variant into `self.input`.

## Delivery and surplus

`self.deliver()` attempts the staged sample and returns `ActionResult`. `"no_input"` means no staged sample qualifies. If another Exchange completes the order first, the exact surplus is placed in `self.output`; `"output_full"` means the Exchange keeps it safely held. Properties are preserved throughout.

Open DOCS for port operations, exact signatures, and result codes.
zh:
## 概览

生物交换站一次只处理一个暂存样本，以完成生物订单。手动 **DELIVER** 从生物工作台仓库取用：诺克图纳基地的基础库存，或其他前哨站选定的本地仓库。脚本交付从 `self.input` 取用，并遵循普通的端口局部性。

## 订单统计

`self.orders()` 列出可用的生物订单，`self.set_order(order_id)` 将此交换站分配给订单。每个 `BioOrder` 通过 `.requires` 暴露所需片段 id，通过 `.delivered` 暴露已完成数量，并通过 `.in_transit` 暴露已在途样本。

多个交换站可以共享一个订单。订单对象是不可变快照，因此需要当前进度的脚本必须请求新的快照。

## 样本身份

生物订单可能除物品 id 外还要求属性。输入堆叠会保留其精确的属性字典，`self.matches_order(item_id, properties)` 报告候选样本是否符合当前活动订单。脚本仍负责选择来源、选择堆叠，并将目标变体路由到 `self.input`。

## 交付与盈余

`self.deliver()` 尝试交付暂存样本并返回 `ActionResult`。`"no_input"` 表示没有符合要求的暂存样本。如果另一个交换站先完成订单，精确的盈余会放入 `self.output`；`"output_full"` 表示交换站会安全地保留它。属性在整个过程中保持不变。

打开 DOCS 查看端口操作、精确签名和结果代码。

en:
## Overview

The Bio Luminizer tunes a coastal sample's RGB glow. Manual buttons use the Biology workbench stockroom: Base Inventory at Nocturna Base, or the selected local Warehouse at another outpost. Automation routes raw and finished samples through local ports.

## Solve and infuse

```
connect_result = self.input.connect("Sample Warehouse")
if connect_result.status != "ok":
  print(connect_result.message)

transfer = self.input.take(fragment_id, 1)
if transfer.status == "ok":
  loaded = self.load(fragment_id)

start = self.chamber.glow
target = get_component("bio_exchange_1").active_order().target_glow
sig_r = self.lamp_signature("red")
sig_g = self.lamp_signature("green")
sig_b = self.lamp_signature("blue")
# Solve start + r*sig_r + g*sig_g + b*sig_b == target.
lamps = self.set_lamps(r, g, b)

if lamps.status == "ok" and self.glow() == target:
  infusion = self.infuse()
  if infusion.status != "ok":
    print(infusion.message)
```

Lamp levels are whole numbers in the **0-40** range and an exact solution always exists. Every gameplay command returns a fixed result object; branch on `.status` and read `.message`. `infuse()` stages the result in `self.output`, preserving every existing property and updating the glow. `"output_full"` keeps the completed result pending; drain the port and retry. `discard()` also ejects through the output without losing properties.

Inspect `self.input.stacks()` and `self.output.stacks()` to distinguish equal fragment ids with different properties.

Open DOCS for exact signatures, result types, and status values.

```
connect_result = self.input.connect("Sample Warehouse")
if connect_result.status != "ok":

transfer = self.input.take(fragment_id, 1)
if transfer.status == "ok":

start = self.chamber.glow

sig_r = self.lamp_signature("red")
sig_g = self.lamp_signature("green")
sig_b = self.lamp_signature("blue")
# Solve start + r*sig_r + g*sig_g + b*sig_b == target.
```

## Overview

The DNA Sequencer engineers a geothermal sample's gene set. Manual buttons use the Biology workbench stockroom: Base Inventory at Nocturna Base, or the selected local Warehouse at another outpost. Automation routes samples through `self.input` and `self.output`.

## Chamber and identity

A selected sample must be staged in `self.input` before `self.load(...)` moves it into the chamber. Stacks with the same item id can carry different properties, so the standard property-matching modes determine which physical sample is moved.

The chamber exposes the loaded fragment's genes and whether it has already been spliced. Bio Orders expose their required genes by fragment id. Your script decides which stored sample belongs to the active order and what target set to submit.

## One rewrite

`self.splice(genes)` replaces the chamber's gene set and returns `ActionResult`. A fragment can be spliced only once; a second attempt destroys it. Successful work is staged in `self.output`, while unrelated properties remain unchanged. If the output is full, the completed sample stays pending instead of being lost.

Open DOCS for exact property matching, signatures, and result codes.

## 概述

DNA 测序仪会改造地热样本的基因集。手动按钮使用生物工作台的库存室：诺克图纳基地的基地库存，或另一前哨站中当前选定的本地仓库。自动化通过 `self.input` 和 `self.output` 路由样本。

## 腔室与身份

必须先将所选样本放入 `self.input`，`self.load(...)` 才会将其移入腔室。相同物品 ID 的堆叠可能带有不同属性，因此标准属性匹配模式决定哪个物理样本被移动。

腔室会暴露已载入片段的基因以及是否已被剪接。生物订单会按片段 ID 暴露所需基因。你的脚本决定哪个存储样本属于当前订单，以及提交什么目标集。

## 一次改写

`self.splice(genes)` 会替换腔室的基因集并返回 `ActionResult`。一个片段只能剪接一次；第二次尝试会摧毁它。成功完成的样本会暂存于 `self.output`，无关属性保持不变。如果输出已满，已完成样本会保持待处理状态，而不会丢失。

en:
## Overview

The Bio Caster forges a volcanic sample by holding its crucible in the recipe's temperature band with exactly the required fabricated materials. Manual loading, recovery, and finished output all use the Biology workbench stockroom: Base Inventory at Nocturna Base, or the selected local Warehouse at another outpost. Automation routes both the raw fragment and materials through `self.input`, then routes the forged result through `self.output` to any compatible local store.

## Stage the charge

```
store = get_component("warehouse_1")  # Inventory works at home only
self.input.connect(store.id)
self.output.connect(store.id)
self.set_recipe(fragment_id)
for stack in store.stacks():
  props = stack.properties
  if stack.id == fragment_id and (props is None or not props.get("forged", False)):
    self.input.take(stack.id, 1, props, "exact")
    self.load(stack.id, props, "exact")
    break
for item, need in self.required_materials().items():
  self.input.take(item, need)
```

`load()` moves only the selected raw fragment from the input stockpile into the chamber. Required materials remain in that stockpile and appear in `materials()`; do not call `load()` for them.

## Control and cast

`set_heat(pct)` consumes steam and raises temperature; `set_cool(pct)` consumes water and lowers it. Both are open-loop controls. Watch `temperature()`, `temp_rate()`, and `required_range()`, then stop the controls before calling `cast()`.

> Casting outside the target band or with the wrong material charge burns the entire charge.

A successful cast stages the forged fragment in `self.output`, retaining all original properties and adding `forged: True`. If the output is full, the result remains pending until drained.

Open DOCS for exact signatures and status values.
zh:
## 概述

生物铸造器会将火山样本熔铸成型：把坩埚保持在配方的温度带内，并加入恰好所需的已制造材料。手动装料、回收和成品输出都使用生物工作台库存室：诺克图纳星基地的基础库存，或另一个前哨站中选定的本地仓库。自动化会将原始碎片和材料都通过 `self.input` 路由，然后将铸造结果通过 `self.output` 路由到任何兼容的本地存储。

## 装填

```
store = get_component("warehouse_1")  # Inventory works at home only
self.input.connect(store.id)
self.output.connect(store.id)
self.set_recipe(fragment_id)
for stack in store.stacks():
  props = stack.properties
  if stack.id == fragment_id and (props is None or not props.get("forged", False)):
    self.input.take(stack.id, 1, props, "exact")
    self.load(stack.id, props, "exact")
    break
for item, need in self.required_materials().items():
  self.input.take(item, need)
```

`load()` 只会将选定的原始碎片从输入库存堆移入腔室。所需材料仍留在该库存堆中，并显示在 `materials()` 中；不要为它们调用 `load()`。

## 控制与铸造

`set_heat(pct)` 消耗蒸汽并升高温度；`set_cool(pct)` 消耗水并降低温度。两者都是开环控制。观察 `temperature()`、`temp_rate()` 和 `required_range()`，然后在调用 `cast()` 前停止控制。

> 在目标温度带之外铸造，或材料装填错误，会烧毁整个装料。

成功铸造后，会将铸造碎片暂存到 `self.output`，保留所有原始属性，并添加 `forged: True`。如果输出已满，结果会保持待处理状态，直到被排出。

打开 DOCS 以查看准确的函数签名和状态值。

en:
## Overview

The Bio Conditioner runs a five-stage quality-control inspection for deep-biome fragments. Manual loading, ejection, and finished output use the Biology workbench stockroom: Base Inventory at Nocturna Base, or the selected local Warehouse at another outpost. Automation routes samples through local ports.

```
report = self.report()
while self.is_running():
  property_id = self.current()
  result = self.accept() if passes_rule(property_id, report) else self.reject()
  if result.status not in ["ok", "conditioned"]:
    print(result.message)
```

`accept()` and `reject()` return `ActionResult`. A correct judgement advances; a wrong one produces `.status == "burned"`. Five correct judgements stage a conditioned sample in `self.output`. `"output_full"` holds completed work safely, and `eject()` stages the unchanged sample in the output. Exact properties remain intact.
zh:
## 概览

生物调节器对深层生物群系碎片执行五阶段质量管控检查。手动装载、排出和成品输出使用生物工作台仓库：诺克图纳星基地的基地库存，或另一前哨站选定的本地仓库。自动化通过本地端口输送样本。

```
report = self.report()
while self.is_running():
  property_id = self.current()
  result = self.accept() if passes_rule(property_id, report) else self.reject()
  if result.status not in ["ok", "conditioned"]:
    print(result.message)
```

`accept()` 和 `reject()` 返回 `ActionResult`。判断正确可推进；判断错误会产生 `.status == "burned"`。五次正确判断会在 `self.output` 中暂存一个调节完成的样本。`"output_full"` 可安全保存已完成的工作，而 `eject()` 会将未改动的样本暂存到输出中。精确属性保持完整。

en:
## Local flow

The Essence Liquifier accepts only life forms native to its outpost's biome and produces only that biome's essence. It runs automatically while powered, supplied, and able to buffer or drain its next whole output.

1. Scan and extract a life form with a drone.
2. Dock at a Drone Depot in the matching biome and unload it.
3. From that station, send the sample into a Liquifier at the same outpost.
4. Connect the Liquifier's essence port to a local Liquid Tank or Biomass Mixer. A remote peer relationship also needs a completed conflict-free Liquid Pipe route between both locations.

Outpost stockpiles are separate. Nothing teleports between them. Supplying more biome essences means building local collection and Liquifier chains in more biomes, then bringing their liquid lines to a Mixer.

## Script checks

- The output is the one `<biome>_essence_out` port exposed by this instance. Call `self.biome()` to identify its prefix.
- `essence_rate()` reports current output in t/h after outpost efficiency and rarity yield are applied.
- `stall_reason()` returns `"no_biome"`, `"no_input"`, `"output_full"`, `"unconnected"`, or `"ok"`.
- The internal buffer holds **50 t**. Base intake is **1 t/h** at 100% outpost efficiency; common, uncommon, and rare samples yield **5**, **10**, and **25** tons of essence per ton.

For example, a Coastal Liquifier uses its Coastal output port:

```
self.coastal_essence_out.connect("liquid_tank_1")
```

Open DOCS for the other biome port names, exact signatures, and port behavior.
zh:
## 本地流程

精华液化器只接受其前哨站所在生物群系的本地生命形式，并且只产出该生物群系的精华。在通电、有供给，并且能够缓冲或排出其下一次完整输出时，它会自动运行。

1. 使用无人机扫描并提取一个生命形式。
2. 在匹配生物群系的无人机仓库停靠并卸下样本。
3. 从该站点将样本送入同一前哨站的液化器。
4. 将液化器的精华端口连接到本地液体储罐或生物质混合器。远程对等关系还需要在两处之间建立一条已完成且无冲突的液体管道路线。

前哨站库存彼此独立。它们之间不会瞬移。供应更多生物群系精华意味着在更多生物群系建立本地采集和液化器链，再把它们的液体管线接入混合器。

## 脚本检查

- 输出是本实例暴露的唯一 `<biome>_essence_out` 端口。调用 `self.biome()` 以识别其前缀。
- `essence_rate()` 报告应用前哨站效率和稀有度产量后的当前输出（t/h）。
- `stall_reason()` 返回 `"no_biome"`、`"no_input"`、`"output_full"`、`"unconnected"` 或 `"ok"`。
- 内部缓冲容量为 **50 t**。在 100% 前哨站效率下，基础摄入为 **1 t/h**；普通、罕见和稀有样本每吨分别产出 **5**、**10** 和 **25** 吨精华。

例如，沿海液化器使用其沿海输出端口：

```
self.coastal_essence_out.connect("liquid_tank_1")
```

打开 DOCS 查看其他生物群系端口名称、精确签名和端口行为。

en:
## Flow

The Biomass Mixer turns biome essences into Biomass. Its five inputs are physical fluid ports. Connect each input to a compatible source. A remote source relationship also needs a completed conflict-free Liquid Pipe route between both locations. Placing a Liquifier at another outpost does not supply this machine by itself.

The current Biomass phase sets the minimum diversity: phase 1 needs any **1** essence, phase 2 needs **2**, up to all **5**. The Mixer evaluates every supplied diversity level above that minimum and uses the strongest balanced mix. A weak extra feed is ignored instead of reducing output.

## Script checks

- Connect each available `<biome>_essence_in` port.
- `active_essences()` reports how many inputs have supply; `mixing_essences()` reports how many the strongest mix selected.
- `required_essences()` reports the phase minimum, and `is_stalled()` becomes `True` below it.
- `phase()` reports the global Biomass phase; `biomass_rate()` reports output from the last tick in t/h.
- `tier()` returns **1** for Mk I or **2** for Mk II. Mk II has 4.5× output on only 2.4× essence demand, at 5× power draw, so it yields **87.5%** more biomass per ton of essence.

Open DOCS for exact port and return-value definitions.
zh:
## 流程

生物质混合器将生态精华转化为生物质。它的五个输入端是物理流体端口。请将每个输入端连接到兼容的来源。若为远程来源关系，还需要在两个地点之间建立一条已建成且无冲突的液管路线。仅仅在另一个前哨站放置液化器，并不会自动为这台机器供料。

当前的生物质阶段决定了最低多样性：阶段 1 需要任意 **1** 种精华，阶段 2 需要 **2** 种，直到全部 **5** 种。混合器会评估所有高于该最低要求的已供料多样性，并使用最强的平衡混合配方。较弱的额外供料会被忽略，而不会降低输出。

## 脚本检查

- 连接每个可用的 `<biome>_essence_in` 端口。
- `active_essences()` 报告有多少输入端有供料；`mixing_essences()` 报告最强混合配方选用了多少种精华。
- `required_essences()` 报告阶段最低要求；低于该要求时，`is_stalled()` 会变为 `True`。
- `phase()` 报告全局生物质阶段；`biomass_rate()` 报告上一 tick 的输出，单位为 t/h。
- `tier()` 对 Mk I 返回 **1**，对 Mk II 返回 **2**。Mk II 的输出为 4.5×，但精华需求仅为 2.4×，功耗为 5×，因此每吨精华可多产出 **87.5%** 的生物质。

打开 DOCS 查看精确的端口与返回值定义。

en:
## Overview

Drones are aerial couriers and field aircraft. Every drone can use raw-coordinate `self.go_to(x, y)` from the beginning. Thrusters decide propulsion, energy modules provide range, Cargo Pods provide storage, and specialist modules decide which biological work is possible after arrival.

## What your script does

- **Set the pace.** Call `self.set_throttle(0.6)` and inspect its `ActionResult`. Burn rises with throttle squared, so slower flights stretch range.
- **Fly station routes.** `go_to_station(...)` returns when dispatch is accepted, not when the drone arrives. Keep the script running and yield with `sleep()` while you wait.
- **Release a Depot bay.** `self.undock()` leaves the drone idle at the same world position with its cargo and fuel intact. This lets a loaded drone wait outside the station when its stockpile cannot accept more material. Only `go_to_station(...)` claims a bay again.
- **Fly coordinates.** `route = self.go_to(x, y)` accepts ordinary map coordinates with no specialist flight gate. Stop, completion, error, or `go_to_station()` cancels the route.
- **Harvest Weather.** `self.collect()` checks the drone's current exact coordinate. The Weather DOCS define the signal interface; the drone provides no target list or targeting shortcut. Wrong, nearby, expired, and exhausted coordinates all return `nothing_here`.
- **Manage hot cargo.** One Raw Uranium collection transfers at most 5. It adds 40 exposure without Shield Plating or zero with it. Reaching 100 retains the batch and scrambles the drone. A working docked drone clears 10 exposure per hour at a powered Service Station; a scrambled drone requires rescue.
- **Move cargo.** Use `self.cargo.space_for(item_id)` before collection or transfer. Raw Uranium can unload only to the shielded chain.

## Waiting for station arrival

The dispatch result, live activity, and physical station are separate. Check the dispatch result first. Then compare `current_station()` with the destination's stable id. Use `status()` inside that loop to report congestion or stop on faults. Do not wait for `status() == "idle"`: a zero-throttle route can be idle before arrival, while charging or refueling can make a docked drone non-idle.

```
clock = get_component("clock")
station = get_component_by_name("Station North")
FAILED_ROUTE_STATES = [
  "stalled_no_battery",
  "stalled_no_oil",
  "stalled_no_route",
  "scrambled",
]

if station is None:
  print("station not found")
else:
  destination_id = station.id
  self.set_throttle(1.0)
  route = self.go_to_station(destination_id)

  if route.status != "ok":
    print(route.message)
  else:
    started = clock.elapsed_game_hours()
    while self.current_station() != destination_id:
      state = self.status()
      if state in FAILED_ROUTE_STATES:
        print("route blocked:", state)
        break
      if clock.elapsed_game_hours() - started >= 24:
        print("route timed out:", state)
        break
      sleep(clock.real_seconds_per_hour() * 0.1)
```

`"waiting_bay"` means the drone reached a full Drone Depot but remains undocked until another drone leaves. A timeout lets your policy choose another Depot or report the deadlock. Drone Service Stations accept parking independently of their charge/refuel service queue.

> A Small electric drone spends one Module slot on its Battery Pack. Shield Plating halves Cargo Pod capacity and increases fuel burn 1.5×, but makes uranium extraction exposure-free.
zh:
## 概览

无人机是空中信使与野外飞行器。每架无人机一开始就能使用原始坐标 `self.go_to(x, y)`。推进器决定动力，能量模块提供航程，货舱模块提供存储，专业模块决定抵达后能进行哪些生物作业。

## 你的脚本做什么

- **设定节奏。** 调用 `self.set_throttle(0.6)` 并检查其 `ActionResult`。燃料消耗随油门平方上升，因此较慢飞行可延长航程。
- **飞站点航线。** `go_to_station(...)` 在调度被接受时返回，而不是在无人机抵达时返回。让脚本保持运行，并在等待期间用 `sleep()` 让出控制权。
- **释放机库泊位。** `self.undock()` 会让无人机在同一世界坐标保持空闲，货物和燃料保持不变。这允许满载无人机在站点库存无法接受更多材料时停在站点外。只有 `go_to_station(...)` 会再次占用泊位。
- **飞坐标。** `route = self.go_to(x, y)` 接受普通地图坐标，没有专业飞行门槛。停止、完成、错误或 `go_to_station()` 会取消航线。
- **采集天气。** `self.collect()` 检查无人机当前精确坐标。天气 DOCS 定义信号接口；无人机不提供目标列表或瞄准捷径。错误、邻近、过期和耗尽的坐标都会返回 `nothing_here`。
- **管理高危货物。** 一次原铀采集最多转移 5。没有护盾镀层会增加 40 暴露，有护盾镀层则为 0。达到 100 会保留该批次并使无人机失控。停泊且工作的无人机在通电服务站每小时清除 10 暴露；失控无人机需要救援。
- **移动货物。** 在采集或转移前使用 `self.cargo.space_for(item_id)`。原铀只能卸载到带护盾的链路。

## 等待站点抵达

调度结果、实时活动和物理站点是分离的。先检查调度结果。然后将 `current_station()` 与目的地的稳定 id 比较。在该循环内使用 `status()` 报告拥堵或在故障时停止。不要等待 `status() == "idle"`：零油门航线可能在抵达前就是 idle，而充电或加油可能使已停泊无人机非 idle。

```
clock = get_component("clock")
station = get_component_by_name("Station North")
FAILED_ROUTE_STATES = [
  "stalled_no_battery",
  "stalled_no_oil",
  "stalled_no_route",
  "scrambled",
]

if station is None:
  print("station not found")
else:
  destination_id = station.id
  self.set_throttle(1.0)
  route = self.go_to_station(destination_id)

  if route.status != "ok":
    print(route.message)
  else:
    started = clock.elapsed_game_hours()
    while self.current_station() != destination_id:
      state = self.status()
      if state in FAILED_ROUTE_STATES:
        print("route blocked:", state)
        break
      if clock.elapsed_game_hours() - started >= 24:
        print("route timed out:", state)
        break
      sleep(clock.real_seconds_per_hour() * 0.1)
```

`"waiting_bay"` 表示无人机到达了满员的无人机机库，但在另一架无人机离开前保持未停泊状态。超时让策略选择另一个机库或报告死锁。无人机服务站接受停车，独立于其充电/加油服务队列。

> 小型电动无人机会用掉一个模块槽位安装电池组。护盾镀层使货舱容量减半并将燃料消耗提高 1.5 倍，但使铀提取无暴露。

en:
## Local endpoint

A Drone Depot provides docking bays and one stockpile at one outpost. A drone must dock here before `cargo.load()` or `cargo.unload()` can use this stock. Stations do not share cargo, so moving items between outposts requires a drone flight.

## Script controls

- `self.input.connect(...)` plus `take(...)` loads the stockpile from a local machine or storage source. Inventory is available only when the Depot is at the home outpost.
- `self.output.connect(...)` plus `send(...)` drains it to a local machine or storage target. Inventory is available only at home.
- `bays_occupied()` and `bay_count()` report congestion. `get_docked()` lists parked drones.

The station never transfers cargo on its own. Open DOCS for exact signatures and return values.
zh:
## 本地端点

无人机站会在一个前哨站提供停泊位和一个储备库。无人机必须先在此停泊，`cargo.load()` 或 `cargo.unload()` 才能使用该库存。站点之间不共享货物，因此在不同前哨站之间搬运物品需要无人机飞行。

## 脚本控制

- `self.input.connect(...)` 配合 `take(...)` 会从本地机器或存储源向储备库装载。只有当无人机站位于主前哨站时，库存才可用。
- `self.output.connect(...)` 配合 `send(...)` 会将其排送到本地机器或存储目标。库存仅在主前哨站可用。
- `bays_occupied()` 和 `bay_count()` 报告拥堵情况。`get_docked()` 列出已停泊的无人机。

该站不会自行转移货物。打开 DOCS 查看准确签名和返回值。

en:
## Overview

The Drone Service Station is the drone-fleet counterpart to the Vehicle Charging Station. It parks arriving drones, runs one shared FIFO of service work, charges **electric** drones, refuels **heli** drones from `oil_in`, and sends a recovery vehicle to field drones. Drone Depots still own hard physical parking bays, commissioning, and cargo. The dedicated recovery berth guarantees drop-off but never acts as an extra service bay.

## What your script does

• **Service parked drones.** `self.get_docked()` lists every parked drone, even when it is idle or queued. `self.charge(drone_id, 0.8)` tops an electric drone to **80%**. `self.refuel(drone_id, 1.0)` fills a heli drone from `self.oil_in`. Both job types share one FIFO and the same service bays. Jobs are station-owned and survive your script stopping.
• **Supply oil.** Connect `self.oil_in` to an Oil Pump or oil tank. A remote source also needs a completed conflict-free Liquid Pipe route between both locations. A heli with no oil reports `"waiting_oil"` and keeps its FIFO position, but it does not occupy a service bay. Ready electric work behind it may proceed, and the heli resumes from its original position when oil returns. A recovered heli waits safely at the station while oil is unavailable.
• **Choose the rescue policy.** `self.dispatch_rescue("Drone 3", 0.5)` sends field service to any undocked drone your script selects. There is no hidden fuel cutoff; use the same player-owned threshold pattern as the Vehicle Charging Station. A rescue request for an already parked target produces `.status == "not_stranded"`, because its own charge/refuel queue owns that service. A **scrambled** drone is the exception: charging cannot reset fried electronics, so it is dispatchable even while parked on a pad, and it stays dark until you fetch it. Electric targets are charged to `target_level` in the field and then resume their saved route. Heli targets are carried home, then the rescue call adds an ordinary refueling job at `target_level` to the visible shared FIFO. The player's normal station script can inspect, update, stop, or clear that job. Scrambled targets are carried home so docking can reset their electronics. Launch requires station power, but a vehicle already in flight carries its own mission power and finishes the recovery through a later outage.
• **Manage work.** `self.get_active()` / `self.get_queue()` expose the shared FIFO; `self.status(drone_id)` reports active, queued, target reached, offline, or oil-blocked state; `self.stop(drone_id)` drops one job; `self.clear_queue()` clears all service jobs. `self.is_rescuing()` / `self.get_rescue_target()` monitor the single recovery vehicle; `self.cancel_rescue()` recalls it without discarding the drone's prior route.

> Use the same fleet-manager shape as the Vehicle Charging Station: service every id from `get_docked()`, then scan `fleet.drones()` against your chosen rescue threshold and dispatch one field rescue at a time.
zh:
## 概述

无人机服务站是车辆充电站在无人机机群方面的对应设施。它会停放抵达的无人机，运行一条共享的先进先出（FIFO）服务队列，为**电动**无人机充电，从 `oil_in` 为**旋翼**无人机加油，并派出一辆回收车前往外勤无人机。无人机仓库仍然拥有固定的实体停机位、调度与货运。专用回收泊位只保证回收交接，绝不会成为额外的服务工位。

## 你的脚本能做什么

• **服务已停放的无人机。** `self.get_docked()` 会列出每架停放的无人机，即使它处于空闲或排队状态。`self.charge(drone_id, 0.8)` 会将电动无人机充到 **80%**。`self.refuel(drone_id, 1.0)` 会从 `self.oil_in` 为旋翼无人机加满油。两种作业共享同一条 FIFO 队列和相同的服务工位。作业归服务站所有，即使你的脚本停止也会继续存在。
• **供应石油。** 将 `self.oil_in` 连接到油泵或油罐。若来源位于远处，还需要两处之间有一条已完成且无冲突的液体管道路线。没有石油的旋翼无人机会报告 `"waiting_oil"` 并保留其 FIFO 位置，但不会占用服务工位。其后方已就绪的电动作业可以继续，旋翼无人机会在石油恢复后从原位置继续。被回收的旋翼无人机会在服务站安全等待，直到石油可用。
• **选择救援策略。** `self.dispatch_rescue("Drone 3", 0.5)` 会向你的脚本选定的任何未停放无人机派遣现场服务。不存在隐藏的燃料截止值；请沿用与车辆充电站相同的玩家自有阈值模式。对已经停放的无人机提出救援请求会产生 `.status == "not_stranded"`，因为该无人机自己的充电/加油队列已经拥有这项服务。**故障**无人机是例外：充电无法重置烧毁的电子元件，因此即使它停放在停机坪上也可以派遣，并且在你取回它之前会保持无电状态。电动目标会在现场充到 `target_level`，然后恢复其已保存路线。旋翼目标会被运回，然后救援调用会在可见的共享 FIFO 队列中添加一个普通的 `target_level` 加油作业。玩家的常规服务站脚本可以检查、更新、停止或清除该作业。故障目标会被运回，以便停泊时重置其电子元件。启动需要服务站电力，但已经在飞行中的车辆会携带自身任务电力，并在后续断电时完成回收。
• **管理作业。** `self.get_active()` / `self.get_queue()` 暴露共享 FIFO 队列；`self.status(drone_id)` 报告活动、排队、达到目标、离线或石油阻塞状态；`self.stop(drone_id)` 移除一项作业；`self.clear_queue()` 清除所有服务作业。`self.is_rescuing()` / `self.get_rescue_target()` 监控那辆唯一的回收车；`self.cancel_rescue()` 会将其召回，而不会丢弃该无人机之前的路线。

> 采用与车辆充电站相同的舰队管理结构：处理 `get_docked()` 返回的每个编号，然后按你选择的救援阈值扫描 `fleet.drones()`，并一次派遣一个现场救援。

en:
## Overview

A static Mining Drill sits on a surveyed mineral site and extracts ore automatically while powered, no move loop, no dig commands. Mk I cuts hardness **1**, Mk II cuts up to **3**, and Mk III cuts up to **4**. Higher tiers also extract faster, while site **purity** multiplies speed. Ore lands in the drill's internal stockpile and extraction stops when it is full.

## What your script does

• **Expose the stockpile.** `self.output.count()`, `capacity()`, and `stacks()` report what is waiting. This pickup-only output has no `connect()` or `send()` method.
• **Send a carrier.** A Rover or Pioneer must physically reach the Drill, connect its own input to the Drill, and call `take(...)`. A drone calls `go_to_drill(name)`, then `cargo.load(...)`, and flies the ore to a Drone Depot.
• **Watch the rate.** `self.drill_rate()` is the live t/h extraction; **0** means unpowered, off-site, incompatible with the deposit hardness, or stockpile full.

> The drill draws no power when it cannot extract. If its stockpile is full, send a carrier and empty it. If the deposit is too hard, deploy the required drill tier.
zh:
## 概述

静态采矿钻机会停留在已勘测的矿点上，并在通电时自动提取矿石，无需移动循环，也无需挖掘命令。Mk I 可切割硬度 **1**，Mk II 最高切割硬度 **3**，Mk III 最高切割硬度 **4**。更高等级的提取速度也更快，而矿点**纯度**会倍增速度。矿石会落入钻机的内部库存，库存装满后提取停止。

## 脚本的作用

• **公开库存。** `self.output.count()`、`capacity()` 和 `stacks()` 会报告等待中的矿石。这种仅供拾取的输出没有 `connect()` 或 `send()` 方法。
• **派遣运输工具。** 漫游车或先锋建造机必须实际抵达钻机，将其自身输入连接到钻机，并调用 `take(...)`。无人机调用 `go_to_drill(name)`，然后调用 `cargo.load(...)`，并将矿石运往无人机仓库。
• **关注速率。** `self.drill_rate()` 是实时 t/h 提取量；**0** 表示未通电、不在矿点上、与矿床硬度不兼容，或库存已满。

> 钻机无法提取时不会耗电。如果其库存已满，请派遣运输工具并清空库存。如果矿床太硬，请部署所需等级的钻机。

en:
## Overview

An Exotic Gas Cap sits on a surveyed exotic **gas** deposit and captures whatever the deposit emits during its active phase into its buffer. Like the Thermal Cap, it releases only after a script opens the valve. Every reachable compatible machine connection may participate.

## What your script does

• **Declare demand, then open the valve.** From the Cap, `self.gas_out.connect("Gas Tank 1")` declares one destination. Additional consumers may connect their own compatible input ports to this Cap. Call `self.set_throttle(value)` with a **0-1** value to release across connected destinations.
• **Build physical reachability.** The Cap is a field structure and never belongs to a nearby outpost. Every destination needs a compatible completed Gas Pipe component reaching the Cap and that destination; scripts never select pipe ids.
• **Diagnose.** `self.capture_rate()` is t/h captured now. `self.is_venting()` means the buffer is full and holding, so capture has paused but nothing is lost. `self.is_stalled()` means `throttle > 0` but no reachable connected destination can accept gas.
• **Plan around the cycle.** Deposits alternate active and dormant phases like thermal vents. Buffer into explicitly connected tanks during active phases so downstream consumers ride out dormancy.

> A tank needs two surrounding relationships: connect the Cap to the Tank, then connect each downstream consumer to the Tank. The outpost does not do this automatically.
zh:
## 概述

异质气体收集帽放置在已勘测的异质**气体**矿藏上，并在其活跃阶段将矿藏排放物收入缓冲区。与热能收集帽一样，它只有在脚本打开阀门后才会释放。所有可达的兼容机器连接都可参与。

## 脚本的作用

• **先声明需求，再打开阀门。** 从收集帽执行 `self.gas_out.connect("Gas Tank 1")` 声明一个目标。其他消费者也可以将其兼容输入端口连接到该收集帽。调用 `self.set_throttle(value)` 并传入 **0-1** 值，以便在已连接目标之间释放。
• **建立物理可达性。** 收集帽是野外结构，永远不会归属于附近的前哨站。每个目标都需要一根兼容且已建成的气体管道组件连接收集帽和该目标；脚本不会选择管道 id。
• **诊断。** `self.capture_rate()` 是当前捕获速率（t/h）。`self.is_venting()` 表示缓冲区已满并保持，因此捕获已暂停，但不会损失任何东西。`self.is_stalled()` 表示 `throttle > 0`，但没有可达的已连接目标可以接收气体。
• **围绕循环规划。** 矿藏会像热泉一样在活跃和休眠阶段之间交替。在活跃阶段将气体缓冲到明确连接的储罐中，以便下游消费者度过休眠期。

> 储罐需要两层关系：先将收集帽连接到储罐，再将每个下游消费者连接到储罐。前哨站不会自动完成这一点。

en:
## Overview

An Exotic Spring Tap sits on a surveyed exotic **liquid** spring and captures its emission during active phases into its buffer. Like the Thermal Cap, it releases only after a script opens the valve. Every reachable compatible machine connection may participate.

## What your script does

• **Declare demand, then open the valve.** From the Tap, `self.liquid_out.connect("Liquid Tank 2")` declares one destination. Additional consumers may connect their own compatible input ports to this Tap. Call `self.set_throttle(value)` with a **0-1** value to release across connected destinations.
• **Build physical reachability.** The Tap is a field structure and never belongs to a nearby outpost. Every destination needs a compatible completed Liquid Pipe component reaching the Tap and that destination; scripts never select pipe ids.
• **Diagnose.** `self.capture_rate()` is t/h captured now. `self.is_venting()` means the buffer is full and holding, so capture has paused but nothing is lost. `self.is_stalled()` means `throttle > 0` but no reachable connected destination can accept liquid.
• **Buffer for dormancy.** Springs cycle through active and dormant phases. Connect the Tap to a tank, then connect downstream consumers to that tank so stored fluid can carry production through the quiet phase.

> Uncommon and rare deposits emit RAW feedstocks that must pass through a Refiner before a Habitat can use them. Check the deposit's survey data to see which.
zh:
## 概览

一个异星泉眼采集器坐落在已勘测的异星**液体**泉眼上，并在活跃阶段将排放物采集到其缓冲器中。与热力帽类似，只有在脚本打开阀门后才会释放。每个可达且兼容的机器连接都可能参与。

## 脚本的作用

• **先声明需求，再打开阀门。** 从采集器出发，`self.liquid_out.connect("Liquid Tank 2")` 声明一个目的地。其他消费者可以将各自兼容的输入端口连接到这个采集器。调用 `self.set_throttle(value)` 并传入 **0-1** 值，以便在已连接的目的地之间释放。
• **建立物理可达性。** 采集器是野外结构，绝不归属于附近的前哨站。每个目的地都需要一条兼容且已建成的液体管道组件，连接采集器与该目的地；脚本从不选择管道 ID。
• **诊断。** `self.capture_rate()` 是当前采集量，单位为 t/h。`self.is_venting()` 表示缓冲器已满并保持，因此采集已暂停，但没有任何损失。`self.is_stalled()` 表示 `throttle > 0`，但没有任何可达且已连接的目的地能够接受液体。
• **为休眠期建立缓冲。** 泉眼会在活跃与休眠阶段之间循环。将采集器连接到储罐，再将下游消费者连接到该储罐，以便储存的流体能够维持生产，度过平静阶段。

> 不常见和稀有矿床会排放原始原料，这些原料必须先经过精炼厂，栖息地才能使用它们。查看矿床的勘测数据，确认是哪一种。

en:
## Overview

The Seed Maker discovers plantable seeds from the same harvested life forms that feed your Essence Liquifiers. Every trial here spends material the biomass chain would otherwise render into essence.

## Combination rules

- The planet has **30 eligible life-form ids** across its five biomes.
- A blend contains exactly **three distinct ids**. The same id cannot appear twice.
- Order does not matter. The same three ids are one blend in every ordering.
- Any three eligible ids may be tested together. Biome and rarity do not restrict the blend.
- A trial consumes **1 t of each life form**, or **3 t total**.

The blends that work are unique to this planet and remain stable throughout the save. They are not written down anywhere, so you discover them by testing.

## Trials and results

`self.life_forms()` lists the eligible life-form ids. The built-in `combinations()` helper can generate unique, order-independent selections from a list; its DOCS entry explains the arguments. Load the current trio with three `self.input.take(item_id, 1)` transfers, then pass those same three ids to `self.combine(blend)`. The chamber cannot accept a duplicate sample, a fourth life form, or surplus tons. `combine()` returns `SeedResult`; use `.status` for control flow and `.message` for readable diagnostics. After `"seed_found"`, `.seed_id` and `.species` identify the one physical seed now waiting in the result bay. Remove that seed through `self.output` before starting any new trial. A `"sludge"` result consumes the same **3 t total** but produces no sludge item.

Successful recipes persist in the Journal and appear through `self.recipes()`. Failed blends are not recorded for you. Deciding which combinations to try, how to avoid repeated work, and how to balance material use is the automation problem.

## Local logistics

Life forms arrive through `self.input` from local Drone Depots, Warehouses, Storage Bins, or home Inventory after Auto Feeders research. The input is an exact three-sample reaction chamber, not storage: it holds **1 t each of three distinct life forms** and remains reserved while the visible trial runs. It empties only when the trial finishes; stopping the script cancels the trial and leaves all three samples in the chamber. The output is one result position, not storage: a successful trial leaves exactly one species-specific seed there, and the machine refuses every later trial until that seed is sent to Inventory, a Storage Bin, a Warehouse, or another valid local destination.

A Data Archive can store your script's own search progress between runs, but the Seed Maker does not choose a checkpoint format or search order. Your source stores, destination, retry policy, and persistence strategy are all player decisions.

## Discovered plants

Every recipe returned by `self.recipes()` includes `.requirements`, a list of structured growing conditions. Each condition has a `.kind`; companion and antagonist conditions also name the related plant in `.species`. The Flora Journal shows the same discovered information so a Harvester script can plan a valid layout.

Open DOCS for exact port behavior, result fields, and method signatures.
zh:
## 概览

种子制造机从喂养你的精华液化器的同一批已收获生命体中发现可种植的种子。这里的每次试验都会消耗生物质链原本会转化为精华的材料。

## 组合规则

- 该星球的五个生物群系共有 **30 个符合条件的生命体 ID**。
- 一个混合组合恰好包含 **三个不同的 ID**。同一 ID 不能出现两次。
- 顺序无关。同样三个 ID 在任何排列下都是同一个混合组合。
- 任意三个符合条件的 ID 都可以一起测试。生物群系和稀有度不会限制混合组合。
- 一次试验消耗 **每种生命体 1 吨**，**共 3 吨**。

有效的混合组合是该星球独有的，并在整个存档期间保持稳定。它们没有记录在任何地方，因此你需要通过测试来发现它们。

## 试验与结果

`self.life_forms()` 列出符合条件的生命体 ID。内置的 `combinations()` 辅助函数可以从列表中生成唯一且与顺序无关的选择；其 DOCS 条目会解释参数。通过三次 `self.input.take(item_id, 1)` 转移载入当前三件套，然后将这三个相同 ID 传给 `self.combine(blend)`。反应舱不能接受重复样本、第四种生命体或多余的吨位。`combine()` 返回 `SeedResult`；使用 `.status` 进行控制流，使用 `.message` 获取可读诊断信息。在 "seed_found" 之后，`.seed_id` 和 `.species` 会标识现在正在结果舱中等待的那颗物理种子。在开始任何新试验前，通过 `self.output` 移除该种子。"sludge" 结果消耗同样的 **共 3 吨**，但不会产生污泥物品。

成功配方会保留在日志中，并通过 `self.recipes()` 显示。失败混合组合不会为你记录。决定尝试哪些组合、如何避免重复工作、如何平衡材料使用，就是自动化问题。

## 本地物流

生命体通过 `self.input` 从本地无人机补给站、仓库、存储箱或主库存到达，前提是完成自动供料研究。输入是一个精确的三样本反应舱，不是存储：它容纳 **三种不同生命体各 1 吨**，并在可见试验运行期间保持占用。它只在试验完成时清空；停止脚本会取消试验，并把三个样本全部留在反应舱中。输出是一个结果位，不是存储：成功试验会在那里留下恰好一颗特定物种的种子，机器会拒绝之后的每次试验，直到该种子被发送到库存、存储箱、仓库或其他有效本地目的地。

数据档案库可以存储你的脚本在运行之间的搜索进度，但种子制造机不会选择检查点格式或搜索顺序。你的源存储、目的地、重试策略和持久化策略都是玩家决策。

## 已发现植物

`self.recipes()` 返回的每个配方都包含 `.requirements`，即结构化生长条件列表。每个条件都有一个 `.kind`；伴生与拮抗条件还会在 `.species` 中命名相关植物。植物志显示相同的已发现信息，因此采集车脚本可以规划有效布局。

打开 DOCS 获取精确端口行为、结果字段和方法签名。

en:
self.input.connect("crop_automator_1")
self.set_enabled(True)

while True:
  if self.input.count("forage") < self.batch_requirements()["forage"]:
    self.input.take("forage", self.batch_requirements()["forage"])
  print(self.status(), self.batch_size())
  sleep(1)

## Overview

The Plant Terraformer is the only machine that creates permanent Plants km². It consumes harvested Forage and the support materials required by the current phase.

## Item input

Use the standard `self.input.connect(source)` and `self.input.take(item_id, amount)` API after Auto Feeders research. The source may be home Inventory, a local Storage Bin or Warehouse, or a local machine output such as a Crop Automator. The input has one connection at a time; reconnect it when you need to load a different source. Sources can also call their normal `output.send(...)` method.

Transfers obey the ordinary cooldown and endpoint-lock rules. The Terraformer's destination feeder moves **16 items per handling step** at Mk I and **80** at Mk II, whether the source pushes or the Terraformer pulls. Fast Feeders research halves the duration of all timed item transfers, including these. Direct Crop Automator to Terraformer transfers avoid the extra Warehouse leg.

Water uses `self.water_in`. Connect it to a compatible water source. A remote source also needs a completed conflict-free Liquid Pipe route between both locations. The input holds one full Forage batch, the Salt that batch needs, and up to **10 of each** Fertilizer tier and Growth Accelerant.

## Batches

When a cycle can start, the machine commits the largest whole Forage batch every loaded material can support. If there are 10 Forage but Water for 8, it loads 8. If any required material cannot support one Forage, it waits. `self.batch_requirements()` reports the full next recipe, while `self.batch_size()` reports what can load now.

Salt is consumed as whole items at cycle start: **1 per 500 Forage**, rounded up for each batch. A full Mk I batch consumes **3 Salt** and a full Mk II batch consumes **14 Salt**. Unused treatment value does not carry over. `self.input.count("salt")` reports every remaining Salt item.

Fertilizer Mk I, Mk II, and Mk III contribute **10**, **30**, and **50 potency**. Any whole-item combination may reach the rounded target. Each cycle spends stored potency first, consuming additional whole items only to cover the shortfall. Unused potency stays in the machine for later batches and survives save/load. One Mk III item supplies 50 potency; a 27-potency batch leaves 23. The card shows total available potency, including both stored potency and unopened items. Its tier badges and `self.input.count(item_id)` count only unopened items. Growth Accelerant is a whole-item count with no potency. A full Mk II batch asks for **27 Fertilizer potency** and, in the final phase, **1 Growth Accelerant**.

Items and Water are consumed when the cycle starts. The cycle then runs for **3 hours** at 100% outpost efficiency and delivers its km². When it finishes, the next affordable loaded batch starts immediately. Power loss or disabling pauses the in-flight batch without losing it.

A Mk I batch holds up to **1,200 Forage** and stops with `"needs_mk2"` at 2,250,000 km². A Mk II batch holds up to **6,600 Forage** and supports Fertilizer and Growth Accelerant.
zh:
## Overview

植物地球化机是唯一能创造永久植物面积（km²）的机器。它消耗采集到的牧草以及当前阶段所需的支持材料。

## 物品输入

在研究自动供料器后，使用标准 `self.input.connect(source)` 和 `self.input.take(item_id, amount)` API。来源可以是主库存、本地存储箱或仓库，或本地机器的输出，例如作物自动化机。输入一次只能有一个连接；需要加载不同来源时请重新连接。来源也可以调用其正常的 `output.send(...)` 方法。

传输遵守普通冷却与端点锁定规则。地球化机的目标供料器在 Mk I 下每搬运步骤移动 **16 件物品**，在 Mk II 下移动 **80 件**，无论由来源推送还是由地球化机拉取。快速供料器研究将所有限时物品传输的持续时间减半，包括这些传输。作物自动化机直接传输到地球化机可避免额外的仓库中转。

水使用 `self.water_in`。将其连接到兼容的水源。远程来源还需要两个位置之间有一条已建成的无冲突液体管道路线。输入可容纳一整批牧草、该批所需的盐，以及每种等级的肥料和生长促进剂最多 **10 件**。

## 批次

当周期可以开始时，机器会投入所有已装载材料都能支持的最大完整牧草批次。如果有 10 份牧草但水只够 8 份，它会装载 8 份。如果任何必需材料无法支持一份牧草，它会等待。`self.batch_requirements()` 报告完整的下一个配方，而 `self.batch_size()` 报告当前可装载的数量。

盐在周期开始时作为整件消耗：每 500 份牧草 **1 件**，按批次向上取整。完整 Mk I 批次消耗 **3 件盐**，完整 Mk II 批次消耗 **14 件盐**。未使用的处理值不会结转。`self.input.count("salt")` 报告所有剩余盐件。

Mk I、Mk II 和 Mk III 肥料分别提供 **10**、**30** 和 **50** 点肥力。任意整件组合都可以达到取整后的目标。每个周期会优先消耗已储存的肥力，仅额外消耗整件物品以弥补缺口。未使用的肥力会留在机器中供后续批次使用，并在存档/读档后保留。一件 Mk III 提供 50 点肥力；27 点肥力的批次会剩下 23 点。卡片显示总可用肥力，包括已储存肥力和未使用物品。其等级徽章和 `self.input.count(item_id)` 只计算未使用物品。生长促进剂按整件计数，没有肥力。完整 Mk II 批次需要 **27 点肥料肥力**，并在最终阶段需要 **1 件生长促进剂**。

物品和水在周期开始时被消耗。随后周期以 100% 前哨站效率运行 **3 小时**，并产出其 km²。完成后，下一个可负担的已装载批次会立即开始。断电或禁用会暂停进行中的批次，且不会丢失它。

Mk I 批次最多容纳 **1,200 份牧草**，并在达到 2,250,000 km² 时以 `"needs_mk2"` 停止。Mk II 批次最多容纳 **6,600 份牧草**，并支持肥料和生长促进剂。
